Ember Jet.name: Ember Jet
Ember Jet.description: The user throws a short jet of flame from an open palm at a target within a few strides. It deals fire damage and sets loose cloth or paper alight; held back, it only scorches, forcing the target to give ground or drop what they hold, with no lasting burns. Strain: light.

Blaze Screen.name: Blaze Screen
Blaze Screen.description: The user sweeps an arm and raises a screen of flame between attackers and the people behind it. Until the end of the user's next turn, anyone who pushes through takes fire damage, nobody can see through it from either side, and thrown wood, cloth or paper burns up inside it. Strain: moderate.

Cinder Lance.name: Cinder Lance
Cinder Lance.description: The user narrows the flame into a white-hot spear from the fingertips that reaches across a street. It deals fire damage to a single target and burns straight through cover of wood, plastic, drywall or thin sheet metal, so a target behind such cover gains no protection from it. Strain: moderate.

Watchfire Flare.name: Watchfire Flare
Watchfire Flare.description: The user lobs a ball of flame high overhead, where it bursts into a slow-falling flare that burns for a few minutes. It lights the whole area, reveals anyone hiding in the dark and marks the spot for responders; anyone facing the burst is dazzled and cannot aim or track the user until the end of their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Ignition Vault.name: Ignition Vault
Ignition Vault.description: Flame bursts from the user's palms and soles and throws them up a building face, across a street-wide gap or out of a fall into a controlled landing. The user can bring a single passenger along, who takes no fire damage as long as the user holds them clear of the jets. Strain: moderate.

Counterfire Lane.name: Counterfire Lane
Counterfire Lane.description: The user burns a clean lane through rubble, furniture and other fuel in a single controlled sweep, leaving nothing on it that can catch. For the rest of the scene the spreading blaze cannot cross the lane, and people led along it take no fire damage from the flames on either side. Strain: heavy.

Furnace Press.name: Furnace Press
Furnace Press.description: The user presses a palm to the target and drives the flame to a white heat at contact. It deals heavy fire damage that ignores worn armor, shields and hardened skin, and it melts through a steel door, a car body or a vault lock in moments. Strain: heavy.

Zenith Pillar.name: Zenith Pillar
Zenith Pillar.description: The user's signature move: every bit of heat gathers into a white star between the palms, then leaves as a pillar of flame wide enough to fill a street. It deals massive fire damage to everything along its line and burns through any armor or barrier in the way; afterward the user cannot make flame until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Mercy Blaze.name: Mercy Blaze
Mercy Blaze.description: The user floods a room or a street with flame that bends around every person they choose to spare. Each enemy inside takes fire damage and is knocked to the ground, while hostages, allies and bystanders in the same space take none and are left a clear path out. Strain: severe.

Rime Rush.name: Rime Rush
Rime Rush.description: The user slaps a hand to the ground and sends a jagged surge of ice racing along it into a target within a few strides. It deals cold damage and frosts the target's legs: they cannot run or dodge until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Black Ice Spread.name: Black Ice Spread
Black Ice Spread.description: The user spreads a thin, clear sheet of ice across the floor or street around them. Until it melts, anyone but the user who runs, charges or swings hard on it falls down, vehicles on it slide out of control, and the user skates across it at speed. Strain: light.

Rime Shackle.name: Rime Shackle
Rime Shackle.description: The user grips a target or sends frost along the ground to them and locks whichever limbs the user chooses in thick ice. The target cannot move those limbs until they break free with a hard effort, the ice is melted or the user lets it go, and the skin under the ice takes no harm. Strain: moderate.

Frost Rampart.name: Frost Rampart
Frost Rampart.description: The user raises a thick wall of ice from the ground in front of themselves or in front of others. It stops bullets, blades, thrown debris and anyone charging into it, and it shields everyone behind it until a heavy blow shatters it or fire melts it. Strain: moderate.

Frost Causeway.name: Frost Causeway
Frost Causeway.description: The user lays a ramp of ice ahead and slides along it as it forms, climbing to a rooftop, crossing a street-wide gap or curving down safely from a height. The causeway stays behind until it melts, so others can cross it on foot or slide down it to safety. Strain: moderate.

Frost Buttress.name: Frost Buttress
Frost Buttress.description: The user packs frost into a sagging ceiling, a cracked wall or a shifting rubble pile until it sets as a single solid mass. For the rest of the scene nothing in it shifts or falls, so trapped people can be pulled out from under it without the collapse going any further. Strain: heavy.

Brittle Frost.name: Brittle Frost
Brittle Frost.description: The user flash-freezes a target's armor, weapon or hardened skin with a touch and strikes the brittle ice apart. It deals heavy cold damage that ignores worn armor and hardened skin, and any shield, blade or body armor it hits cracks and becomes useless. Strain: heavy.

Polar Cathedral.name: Polar Cathedral
Polar Cathedral.description: The user's signature move: both hands hit the ground and release a building-high wave of ice that swallows everything ahead. Every target in its path takes massive cold damage and is encased to the neck, unable to move until they break out with a hard effort or are thawed or chipped free, and fires and vehicles in the path freeze solid; afterward the user cannot make ice until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Whiteout Hush.name: Whiteout Hush
Whiteout Hush.description: The user sends frost out in every direction at once and freezes a whole scene the size of a city block. Fires go out, floodwater stops as solid ice, and each person the user chooses is frozen in place to the waist, unable to leave the spot until they break free with a hard effort or are thawed. The ice harms nobody, and everyone the user spares stands in a pocket of clear air. Strain: severe.

Static Burst.name: Static Burst
Static Burst.description: The user lets the stored charge go in a crackling burst all around their body. Everyone within arm's reach, allies included, takes electric damage and anyone gripping the user is forced to let go; held back, the burst only jolts, making each person drop what they hold. Strain: light.

Jolt Clasp.name: Jolt Clasp
Jolt Clasp.description: The user grips a target's wrist, neck or shoulder and sends a measured jolt through them. It deals minor electric damage and locks the target's muscles: they cannot attack, run or use their hands until the end of their next turn, and they drop whatever they were holding. Strain: light.

Guided Arc.name: Guided Arc
Guided Arc.description: The user flicks a coin, a wire or a spray of water toward a target across a room or a street and sends a bolt along it. It deals electric damage to that target alone, and nobody around them is hit, even in a crowd or in standing water. Strain: moderate.

Blackout Pulse.name: Blackout Pulse
Blackout Pulse.description: The user dumps a surge of power into the wiring around them. Every light, camera, radio, phone, card lock and powered door in the building dies and stays dead until it is restarted or repaired, the user's own devices included. Strain: moderate.

Heartstart Spark.name: Heartstart Spark
Heartstart Spark.description: The user lays both palms on the chest of a person whose heart has stopped or is failing and sends a measured pulse through them. The heart restarts and the patient holds steady long enough to reach medical care, though no wounds close; on a healthy target it only knocks them down. Strain: moderate.

Synapse Sprint.name: Synapse Sprint
Synapse Sprint.description: The user drives electricity through their own nerves and moves in a crackling blur across a room or down a street before anyone can react. During the move they can pull a person out of the path of an attack, which then misses both of them, or reach a target before they can act. Strain: heavy.

Relay Lightning.name: Relay Lightning
Relay Lightning.description: The user releases a bolt that leaps from body to body through a whole group along a path the user chooses. Each enemy the user picks takes electric damage and drops what they are holding, while allies and bystanders between them are passed over untouched. Strain: heavy.

Thunderhead Surge.name: Thunderhead Surge
Thunderhead Surge.description: The user's signature move: the whole charge goes out at once as a storm of lightning that strikes every enemy the user can see. Each takes massive electric damage and cannot act until the end of their next turn, and powered devices for blocks around go dead; afterward the user is dazed and cannot discharge until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Grid Dominion.name: Grid Dominion
Grid Dominion.description: The user lays a hand on a building's wiring and takes over its whole electrical system for the rest of the scene. They can open or seal any powered door, run or stop elevators, switch lights, alarms and cameras, and send a jolt through any metal fixture an enemy touches, dealing electric damage. Strain: severe.

Detonation Palm.name: Detonation Palm
Detonation Palm.description: The user thrusts an open palm at a target within a few strides and detonates. It deals explosive damage and throws the target off their feet; held back, the blast only staggers them and knocks them down without serious injury. Strain: light.

Rocket Hop.name: Rocket Hop
Rocket Hop.description: The user fires a blast behind or below themselves and is thrown clear in an instant: across a room, onto a low rooftop or out of the path of an incoming attack, which misses them. Strain: light.

Needlepoint Blast.name: Needlepoint Blast
Needlepoint Blast.description: The user cups the blast between the fingers and fires it as a narrow, focused shot that crosses a street. It deals explosive damage to a single target at range without throwing blast or debris onto the people around them. Strain: moderate.

Dazzle Burst.name: Dazzle Burst
Dazzle Burst.description: The user claps both palms together on a blast tuned for light and noise instead of force. Everyone facing the user within a room's width is blinded and deafened until the end of their next turn: they cannot aim, read signals or hear orders, but take no damage. Strain: moderate.

Contrail Drive.name: Contrail Drive
Contrail Drive.description: The user chains blasts from both palms into sustained flight, crossing city blocks, climbing past rooftops and turning hard in the air. They can carry a single passenger under an arm while steering with the free hand, but cannot attack while carrying. Strain: moderate.

Shaped Breach.name: Shaped Breach
Shaped Breach.description: The user presses both palms to a wall, a door or a rubble pile and shapes the blast so the barrier breaks back toward the user and the debris drops at the user's feet instead of flying into the space beyond. It opens a passage a person can walk through, and anyone trapped on the far side takes no damage from the breach. Strain: heavy.

Creeping Barrage.name: Creeping Barrage
Creeping Barrage.description: The user walks a rolling line of blasts across the ground ahead. Every enemy in a wide area in front takes explosive damage and is knocked flat, and anything thrown or fired through the barrage is blown apart before it reaches the user or the people behind them. Strain: heavy.

Meteor Breaker.name: Meteor Breaker
Meteor Breaker.description: The user's signature move: a column of blasts throws the user high into the air, then they dive with both palms forward and release everything on impact. It deals massive explosive damage to the target and everyone around the impact point and leaves a crater; afterward the user's arms are numb and cannot fire until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Sky Weaver Dash.name: Sky Weaver Dash
Sky Weaver Dash.description: The user chains blasts so fast and precise that they weave through an entire scene in a single pass before anyone can react. In that pass they either strike every enemy in the area with a point-blank blast that deals explosive damage, or blast aside every piece of falling debris and every thrown or fired attack in the area before it lands on anyone. Strain: severe.

Bellow Wave.name: Bellow Wave
Bellow Wave.description: The user lets out an amplified shout in a cone ahead of them. Everyone in front within a few strides takes sonic damage and is pushed back a step; held back, it only staggers them and drowns out whatever they were saying or hearing. Strain: light.

Echo Sounding.name: Echo Sounding
Echo Sounding.description: The user sends out a sharp click or pulse and reads the echoes that come back. They learn the layout of the room or rubble pile around them and where every person in it is, including anyone hiding or trapped, even in darkness or smoke; anyone nearby can hear the pulse. Strain: light.

Vertigo Hum.name: Vertigo Hum
Vertigo Hum.description: The user holds a low, wavering tone that scrambles the inner ear of everyone in front within a room's width. Until the end of their next turn, each of them falls if they try to run or jump and cannot aim a weapon or a Quirk; the tone deals no damage. Strain: moderate.

Clarion Call.name: Clarion Call
Clarion Call.description: The user's voice carries clearly across a whole disaster site or stadium, cutting through sirens, alarms and screams. Panicked people who hear it can follow the user's simple directions, such as which exit to take or when to stay down, and anyone trapped who calls back is heard and located. Strain: moderate.

Downbeat Leap.name: Downbeat Leap
Downbeat Leap.description: The user slams a beat of focused sound into the ground or a wall and rides the push onto a rooftop or across a street-wide gap. Fired down beneath someone falling, the user included, it slows the fall into a safe landing. Strain: moderate.

Shatter Note.name: Shatter Note
Shatter Note.description: The user taps a wall, a vehicle or a suit of armor, hears the pitch it rings at and hits that note at full strength. Glass, concrete, locks and rigid armor in the target crack apart, and a person struck takes sonic damage that ignores worn armor. Strain: heavy.

Crescendo Sweep.name: Crescendo Sweep
Crescendo Sweep.description: The user builds a single note into a rolling front of sound that sweeps down a street. Every enemy in its path takes sonic damage, is knocked off their feet and cannot hear until the end of their next turn, and thrown objects caught in it drop short. Strain: heavy.

Grand Fortissimo.name: Grand Fortissimo
Grand Fortissimo.description: The user's signature move: all the sound the user can build leaves at once as a single beam that runs the length of a city block. It deals massive sonic damage to everything along its line, shatters every window it passes and deafens anyone it hits until the end of the scene; afterward the user cannot make sound with the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Dead Air.name: Dead Air
Dead Air.description: The user hears every sound in a building or across a city block and answers each with its mirror wave. For the rest of the scene the area falls silent except for what the user lets through: allies still hear each other, alarms and gunshots go unheard, and sonic attacks entering it deal no damage. Strain: severe.

Glint Ray.name: Glint Ray
Glint Ray.description: The user fires a thin, searing beam at a target in sight across a room. It deals light damage and chars cloth and paper; held back, it only stings, and a hand it strikes lets go of whatever it holds. The flash of the shot shows everyone watching where the user stands. Strain: light.

Halo Glare.name: Halo Glare
Halo Glare.description: The user flares white from the whole body. Anyone facing them within a room's width who missed the user's signal to shut their eyes is dazzled until the end of their next turn, and ranged attacks and Quirks they aim at the user, or at anyone behind the user, miss. Held softer, the light fills the area from every angle for the rest of the scene: nobody there can hide in shadow, and people trapped in rubble show through the gaps. Strain: moderate.

Pinpoint Ray.name: Pinpoint Ray
Pinpoint Ray.description: The user narrows the beam to a needle of light that reaches the length of a city block and lands the instant it fires, so the target cannot dodge it. It passes through glass and windshields at full strength and deals light damage, or it burns through a rope, a strap or a cable, or heats a held weapon until the holder drops it, without injuring the person. Strain: moderate.

Mirage Decoy.name: Mirage Decoy
Mirage Decoy.description: The user bends light into a glowing double of themselves or of someone nearby, standing a few strides from the real person, who fades to a faint shimmer. Until the end of the user's next turn, the next attack aimed at that person hits the double instead, which bursts into sparks, and the real person can slip away while eyes stay on the double. Strain: moderate.

Kickback Leap.name: Kickback Leap
Kickback Leap.description: The user fires a thick beam at the ground or a wall and lets its kick throw them: up a building face, across a street-wide gap, or down from a height in short bursts that end in a soft landing. Anyone watching the launch point is dazzled and loses sight of the user until the user next attacks or calls out. Strain: moderate.

Surgeon's Line.name: Surgeon's Line
Surgeon's Line.description: The user narrows the beam to a hair-thin cutting line and traces it through steel, rebar, a crushed car door or a jammed shutter, freeing whoever is pinned without burning them. At low power the same line seals a bleeding wound shut, so the patient stops losing blood until a doctor can treat the burn it leaves. Strain: heavy.

Lighthouse Beam.name: Lighthouse Beam
Lighthouse Beam.description: The user plants their feet and swings a held beam in a full circle at chest height, keeping it turning until the start of their next turn. Anyone who steps into the circle or reaches across it takes light damage and cannot aim until the end of their next turn, while people crouched at the user's feet stay under the beam and take no harm. Strain: heavy.

Daybreak Cannon.name: Daybreak Cannon
Daybreak Cannon.description: The user's signature move: every bit of light in their body gathers at the emitting spot until it burns white, then leaves as a beam the width of a street. Everyone along its line takes massive light damage and cannot dodge it, and it bores through cars, walls and armor in its way; afterward the user goes dark and cannot make light until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Prism Rain.name: Prism Rain
Prism Rain.description: The user throws a fan of light overhead that splits into a rain of hair-thin rays across a city block, each aimed by the user. Every gun, blade and support gadget an enemy holds is cut apart or fused useless, every enemy camera and scope goes blind, and each armed enemy takes light damage to the hands and drops what they hold; nobody else in the area is touched. Strain: severe.

Gust Shove.name: Gust Shove
Gust Shove.description: The user thrusts both palms and drives a hard gust into a target across a room. It deals force damage and throws them off their feet along with anything loose around them; held back, it only shoves them several steps back without injury. Strain: light.

Updraft Bound.name: Updraft Bound
Updraft Bound.description: The user slams air into the ground and rides the updraft up a story, onto a low roof or out of an attack's path, which misses them. Aimed beneath someone else who is falling, the same updraft slows them into a safe landing. Strain: light.

Sickle Wind.name: Sickle Wind
Sickle Wind.description: The user swipes a hand and throws a thin, curved edge of compressed air across a room. It deals slashing damage to a single target and cuts rope, straps, cloth, boards and tires in its path; the edge shows only as a ripple in dust or rain, so only a target watching the user's hand can dodge it. Strain: moderate.

Howling Wall.name: Howling Wall
Howling Wall.description: The user raises a roaring wall of wind between attackers and the people behind it. Until the end of the user's next turn, thrown objects, smoke, gas and loose debris cannot cross it, bullets fired through it veer wide, and anyone who tries to push through is thrown back to where they started. Strain: moderate.

Jetstream Rider.name: Jetstream Rider
Jetstream Rider.description: The user rides a rising column of wind into true flight for the rest of the scene, hovering in place, climbing past rooftops and crossing city blocks. People pressed close beside the user at liftoff can be carried up in the same column and set down wherever the user lands, but the user cannot attack while carrying anyone. Strain: moderate.

Chimney Draft.name: Chimney Draft
Chimney Draft.description: The user drives a turning draft through a burning building, a tunnel or a gas-filled street and pulls the smoke, gas or dust out through a single opening they choose, steering it clear of open flame. For the rest of the scene the air there stays breathable, and the user feels which rooms the draft cannot reach, where doors are shut or people are trapped. Strain: heavy.

Cyclone Cage.name: Cyclone Cage
Cyclone Cage.description: The user spins the air into a tight cyclone over a group within a room's width. Everyone caught is lifted off their feet, takes force damage from the spin and the flying debris, and cannot move by their own power until the end of their next turn; then the user sets them down, or drops them from a story up. Strain: heavy.

Hurricane Front.name: Hurricane Front
Hurricane Front.description: The user's signature move: they draw in all the air they can hold around them and release it as a level storm the width of a street. Everyone in its path takes massive force damage and is hurled far down the street, parked cars roll, and barricades, cover and smoke are torn away; afterward the air around the user hangs still and they cannot make wind until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Sky Convoy.name: Sky Convoy
Sky Convoy.description: The user rises at the heart of a broad updraft over a whole city block and flies every person they choose along with them: a whole crowd carried over fire, floodwater or collapse and set down together anywhere in sight. Enemies left out of the lift are knocked flat by the downdraft at its edges and cannot stand until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Hydrant Shot.name: Hydrant Shot
Hydrant Shot.description: The user fires a hard jet of water from the palm at a target within a few strides. It deals bludgeoning damage and knocks them back a step; held back, it only drenches them and washes into their eyes, so they cannot aim until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Dousing Fan.name: Dousing Fan
Dousing Fan.description: The user opens both hands and sprays a wide fan of water across a room. Ordinary fires it reaches go out, people it soaks cannot catch fire until they dry, and smoke and dust in the room settle out of the air; on a grease fire it makes a fireball, and on live wiring it carries current back to the user. Strain: light.

Whirlpool Cocoon.name: Whirlpool Cocoon
Whirlpool Cocoon.description: The user wraps a person, themselves included, in a thick, turning shell of water with air inside. Until the end of the user's next turn, blows, blades and bullets slow to a shove against it, and fire, heat, smoke and gas cannot reach the person inside; thrown under someone falling, the shell catches them unhurt. Strain: moderate.

Washout Torrent.name: Washout Torrent
Washout Torrent.description: The user drives a waist-high wave down a hallway or along a street. Everyone in its path takes bludgeoning damage, is swept off their feet and carried several strides before it drains away, and loose weapons and debris wash out of reach. Strain: moderate.

Geyser Ride.name: Geyser Ride
Geyser Ride.description: The user fires jets from the soles and rides a rising column of water up a building face, onto a rooftop or a bridge, or skims across a river or a flooded street at a run. A single person the user holds rides along, and the user can hover at a high window long enough to bring someone out. Strain: moderate.

Floodgate Turn.name: Floodgate Turn
Floodgate Turn.description: The user plunges both hands into standing water, a flood or a burst main and turns its flow. For the rest of the scene they can hold rising water back from a doorway, open a dry lane through a flooded street or tunnel, or pull anyone caught in a current to the user's side. Strain: heavy.

Water Hammer.name: Water Hammer
Water Hammer.description: The user packs their water into a single dense slug and drives it into a target at full force. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage and knocks the target flat, and it flows around raised shields, crossed arms and riot barriers, so blocking gives the target no protection against it. Strain: heavy.

Rogue Wave.name: Rogue Wave
Rogue Wave.description: The user's signature move: every drop they can make leaves at once as a wave taller than a bus that runs the length of a street. Everyone in its path takes massive bludgeoning damage and is swept to the street's far end, every fire along it goes out, and the street floods ankle-deep; afterward the user is parched and cannot make water until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Ebb and Flood.name: Ebb and Flood
Ebb and Flood.description: The user lays both hands in a flood, a river or a burst reservoir and takes hold of the whole body of water across a city block for the rest of the scene. They can raise it into walls, drain streets dry, lift everyone caught in it to the surface and carry them to a safe point, or pull the enemies they choose to their knees and hold them there until each breaks free with a hard effort or the user lets go. Strain: severe.

Liftoff Tap.name: Liftoff Tap
Liftoff Tap.description: With a touch, the user makes a person, or an object up to a small car's weight, weightless. The target drifts slowly upward and comes down only when the user makes a release gesture; a floating person cannot run, brace or put weight behind a blow until they catch hold of something solid. Strain: light.

Ballast Palm.name: Ballast Palm
Ballast Palm.description: The user slaps a palm onto a target and floods their body with weight. The target is dragged to the ground, takes force damage from their own weight and cannot stand until the end of their next turn; held back, they only sink to a knee and drop whatever they hold. Strain: moderate.

Hanging Hail.name: Hanging Hail
Hanging Hail.description: The user touches rubble, crates, chairs or parked bikes in quick succession and pushes them drifting over a spot they choose. On the user's gesture they all drop at once: everyone beneath takes bludgeoning damage and is knocked down, and the fallen debris blocks the way until it is cleared. Strain: moderate.

Featherweight Haul.name: Featherweight Haul
Featherweight Haul.description: The user lays hands on whatever pins someone, a fallen slab, a steel beam or a car, and takes its weight away without letting it drift, so a single rescuer can lift it clear or swing it aside. Injured people the user touches float level and steady and can be guided out by hand without jostling a broken bone or an injured spine; all of it stays weightless until the user releases it. Strain: moderate.

Orbit Step.name: Orbit Step
Orbit Step.description: The user makes themselves weightless and moves by pushing off whatever is near: up a wall, across a ceiling, over a street-wide gap, or off a roof in a slow float to a soft landing. In midair they change direction by pushing off anything they have floated, and they can tow a single person by the hand. Strain: moderate.

Deadweight Anchor.name: Deadweight Anchor
Deadweight Anchor.description: The user touches a person, a door or a vehicle and roots the target in place with weight until the end of the user's next turn. An anchored ally cannot be knocked down, thrown, pushed back or carried off by a blast, a current or a grab; an anchored door or barricade cannot be forced; an anchored enemy cannot take a step. Strain: heavy.

Payload Pitch.name: Payload Pitch
Payload Pitch.description: The user floats a car, a vending machine or a steel beam, hurls it with a single hand while it weighs nothing, and gives its full weight back the instant it strikes. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage and knocks the target and anyone beside them flat; returning only part of the weight instead pins the target against a wall or the ground, unhurt, until they heave it off with a hard effort or the user lifts it away. Strain: heavy.

Leaden Sky.name: Leaden Sky
Leaden Sky.description: The user's signature move: they slam both palms to the ground and pour weight into everything within a street's width. Everyone there except the user and anyone holding on to them takes massive force damage and is pinned flat, unable to stand or lift their arms until the end of their next turn, and cars and walls buckle; afterward the user's hands go numb and they cannot change any weight until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Atlas Hold.name: Atlas Hold
Atlas Hold.description: The user lays both hands on a collapsing building, a falling bridge span or a derailed train and takes the weight out of the whole thing at once. For the rest of the scene nothing in it falls: walls, rubble, vehicles and the people inside hang where they are and can be floated out by hand, but if the user is knocked out, everything still inside comes down. Strain: severe.

Bounceback Sheet.name: Bounceback Sheet
Bounceback Sheet.description: The user swipes a hand and stretches a pane of elastic air between themselves and an attacker. The next punch, kick, charge or thrown object that hits it before the end of the user's next turn sinks in and is flung straight back: an attacker takes force damage and is thrown off their feet, and a thrown object flies back toward its thrower. Strain: light.

Springstep.name: Springstep
Springstep.description: The user stamps an elastic patch into the ground, or into the air underfoot, and springs off it: a story up, across a gap or out of an attack's path, which misses them. Patches set on facing walls let them rebound from wall to wall to climb a shaft or change direction in midair. Strain: light.

Rescue Hammock.name: Rescue Hammock
Rescue Hammock.description: The user stretches a wide elastic canopy across a street, a stairwell or the open air beneath a balcony. For the rest of the scene, every person and object that falls into it is caught unhurt and lowered to the ground, so people trapped on an upper floor can jump to safety. Strain: moderate.

Slingshot Launch.name: Slingshot Launch
Slingshot Launch.description: The user stretches a band of elastic air between lampposts, railings or doorframes, draws back into it and lets go. They fly across a street, onto a rooftop or straight into a target, who takes force damage and is knocked off their feet; the user can launch a willing ally or a heavy object the same way instead. Strain: moderate.

Pullback Band.name: Pullback Band
Pullback Band.description: The user wraps a band of elastic air around a target's legs and pins its far end to the ground. Every step or lunge the target makes is pulled back to the spot: they cannot move away, run or reach anyone beyond arm's length until they tear free with a hard effort, the user lets go or the scene ends. Strain: moderate.

Drumskin Floor.name: Drumskin Floor
Drumskin Floor.description: The user slaps the floor and turns a whole room, a platform or a street-wide stretch of road into a heaving elastic surface for the rest of the scene. Enemies on it cannot run, charge or plant their feet for a heavy blow without being thrown off balance and knocked down, while the user and any allies they warn bounce across it at will. Strain: heavy.

Crash Cushion.name: Crash Cushion
Crash Cushion.description: The user stretches a deep elastic barrier across a road, a rail line or an elevator shaft for the rest of the scene. A speeding truck, a runaway train car, a falling elevator or a stampeding crowd that hits it sinks in and is brought to a slow stop, and the people inside or caught up in it are unhurt. Strain: heavy.

Bowstring Boulevard.name: Bowstring Boulevard
Bowstring Boulevard.description: The user's signature move: they stretch the air across a whole street into layer on layer of elastic sheets and charge them with their Quirk until they hum, then let go. The snap slams down the street: everyone in front takes massive force damage and is thrown off their feet, and cars, barricades and cover are shoved aside; afterward the user cannot make a patch until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Springback Sanctum.name: Springback Sanctum
Springback Sanctum.description: The user wraps a whole scene, up to a city block, in layered elastic panes they reshape on the fly. For the rest of the scene, every punch, charge, thrown object and bullet an enemy aims at the user's allies or at bystanders sinks into a pane and flies straight back at the attacker, who takes force damage; fire, light, gas and electricity still pass. The user cannot move while holding it. Strain: severe.

Palm Forge.name: Palm Forge
Palm Forge.description: The user pulls a staff, a baton or a short spear out of an open palm and strikes with it in the same motion. It deals bludgeoning damage, or piercing damage with the spear, and stays in hand afterward. Because it comes from the skin, a searched, disarmed or handcuffed user can still make one, or a crowbar, a rope or a cuff shim instead. Strain: light.

Bulwark Shield.name: Bulwark Shield
Bulwark Shield.description: The user pushes a broad shield of layered steel and rubber out of the forearm and plants its edge on the ground. It turns aside bullets, blades, thrown debris and blasts from the front for the user and anyone crouched behind them, and it keeps standing as cover after the user steps away, until a heavy blow or a vehicle knocks it flat. Strain: moderate.

Snare Bolas.name: Snare Bolas
Snare Bolas.description: The user forms a set of weighted cords in the palm and hurls them at a target across a room or down a corridor. They wrap the target's legs, or their arms and chest if the user chooses: the target cannot run, kick or use the bound limbs until they wrench free with a hard effort, cut the cords or someone unwinds them, and the cords leave no injury. Strain: moderate.

Relief Bundle.name: Relief Bundle
Relief Bundle.description: Over about a minute the user unrolls field supplies from their forearms: sterile gauze, splints, slings and foil blankets for a handful of injured people. Patients treated with them stop bleeding, keep broken limbs still and stay warm, so each can be moved without worsening their injuries, and for the rest of the scene First Aid on them needs no kit. Strain: moderate.

Spring Grapple.name: Spring Grapple
Spring Grapple.description: The user forms a spring-loaded launcher with a hooked line and fires it at a ledge, a beam or a rooftop. They reel themselves up a building face or swing across a street-wide gap carrying a passenger, then leave the line anchored as a zip line that lowers trapped people to the ground one after another. Strain: moderate.

Shelter Shell.name: Shelter Shell
Shelter Shell.description: The user kneels, spreads both arms and pours out a dome of foam-lined steel over themselves and the people beside them, wide enough for a small group. Until it is cut or blasted open, gunfire, falling debris, flame and smoke cannot reach anyone inside, a collapse cannot crush them, and the user can open a hatch in it from within. Strain: heavy.

Lullaby Canister.name: Lullaby Canister
Lullaby Canister.description: The user builds a canister of fast-acting anesthetic gas in the palm, primes it and throws it into a room or across a street. Everyone in the cloud who breathes it, except anyone wearing a respirator or holding their breath, cannot run or fight until the end of their next turn, and anyone still inside after that falls asleep until woken or until the scene ends. Strain: heavy.

Grand Battery.name: Grand Battery
Grand Battery.description: The user's signature move: they spend their reserves at once on a ring of loaded cannons that pour from their back and arms and turn on every enemy in sight. Each enemy takes massive bludgeoning damage and is knocked flat, or takes a net round instead and stays pinned to the ground until they tear free with a hard effort or are cut loose; afterward the user cannot make anything until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Masterwork Assembly.name: Masterwork Assembly
Masterwork Assembly.description: Over about a minute the user builds a single large working machine or structure they have studied, part by part, straight from the skin: a truss bridge across a river or between rooftops, a pump that drains a flooded tunnel, a generator, a vehicle. It works for the rest of the scene and stays afterward, and a bridge made this way carries a whole evacuating crowd at once. Strain: severe.

Tendril Bind.name: Tendril Bind
Tendril Bind.description: Vines shoot from the user's forearm at a target across a room and coil around their legs, or around their arms if the user chooses. The target cannot run, kick or use the bound limbs until they break free with a hard effort, cut the vines or the user lets go, and the vines grip without bruising. Strain: light.

Thorn Lash.name: Thorn Lash
Thorn Lash.description: The user cracks a thorned vine at a target within a few strides. It deals slashing damage and can tear a weapon, a bag or a phone out of their grip; grown without thorns, it deals bludgeoning damage instead and only stings, leaving no cuts. Strain: light.

Bramble Hedge.name: Bramble Hedge
Bramble Hedge.description: The user drives vines into the ground and raises a head-high hedge of tangled thorns across a corridor or a narrow street. It stops thrown objects and blocks sight from either side, and anyone forcing through takes slashing damage and is caught fast until they cut free; it stands until burned or hacked apart, sheltering the people behind it. Strain: moderate.

Taproot Listening.name: Taproot Listening
Taproot Listening.description: The user sinks roots into soil, rubble or a cracked floor and feels the tremors that run through them. While they stay rooted and still, they know where every person in the building or rubble field is moving, hiding or lying trapped, down to the faint shifts of someone breathing under debris, but they cannot see faces or hear words. Strain: moderate.

Liana Swing.name: Liana Swing
Liana Swing.description: The user throws a vine to a ledge, a lamppost or a branch, anchors it and swings or climbs along it, crossing a street-wide gap or reaching a rooftop in one move with a passenger held in a loop of vine. The line stays anchored afterward, so others can climb it or be lowered down it. Strain: moderate.

Root Lift.name: Root Lift
Root Lift.description: The user sends roots through a rubble pile, a collapsed wall or a crushed car and thickens them under the weight. The slabs rise and stay propped on living wood, a crawlway opens to the people trapped beneath, and nothing settles back onto them until everyone is out or the user lets the roots wither. Strain: heavy.

Ironwood Ram.name: Ironwood Ram
Ironwood Ram.description: The user grows a trunk of dense hardwood from both forearms and drives it straight ahead across a room. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage, throws the target into whatever stands behind them and smashes through a door, a barricade or a car; held back, it stops at the target's chest and pins them to the wall until they shove the trunk aside or the user lets it wither. Strain: heavy.

Forest Rising.name: Forest Rising
Forest Rising.description: The user's signature move: they plant both hands and a stand of trunks and vines bursts up through soil and pavement across a street-wide area. Every enemy caught in the growth takes massive bludgeoning damage and is held aloft in coiled vines, unable to move until they tear free with a hard effort or are cut loose, while allies are lifted clear of danger; afterward the user cannot grow anything until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Living Grove.name: Living Grove
Living Grove.description: The user roots into the ground and spreads through every tree, hedge and patch of soil across a city block. For the rest of the scene those plants answer them: they can bind any enemy standing on soil, grass or broken pavement until the enemy tears free with a hard effort or is cut loose, raise a hedge across any street and catch anyone who falls in a net of branches, and the bindings cause no injury. Strain: severe.

Upturned Slab.name: Upturned Slab
Upturned Slab.description: The user stamps on the ground and tips up a chest-high slab of pavement or floor between the attackers and the people behind it. The slab is solid stone: shots and thrown objects from the front cannot pass it until a heavy blow breaks it, and it stays standing as cover after the user moves on. Strain: light.

Stone Spur.name: Stone Spur
Stone Spur.description: The user strikes the ground and a fist-thick spur of stone drives up under a target within a few strides. It deals bludgeoning damage and throws the target off their feet; held back, it only shoves them a step back and jars any weapon from their hands. Strain: light.

Granite Grip.name: Granite Grip
Granite Grip.description: The user lays a palm on the floor and the stone flows up over the feet of a target within a few strides, or over their hands and knees if they are down, then sets hard. The target cannot move the held limbs until they break the stone with a heavy blow or tools or the user softens it, and the stone grips without crushing. Strain: moderate.

Tremor Ridge.name: Tremor Ridge
Tremor Ridge.description: The user slams a palm down and drives a heaving ridge of stone along the ground in a straight line down a street. Everyone standing on the line takes bludgeoning damage and is thrown off their feet, and anyone crossing the broken strip it leaves must slow to a walk until the end of the scene. Strain: moderate.

Column Ride.name: Column Ride
Column Ride.description: The user raises a column of stone under their own feet and rides it up to an upper-floor window or a rooftop, or tips it over into a ramp that spans a street-wide gap. The column and the ramp stay solid afterward, so rescued people can climb down or cross on foot. Strain: moderate.

Keystone Shoring.name: Keystone Shoring
Keystone Shoring.description: The user presses both palms to a sagging ceiling, a cracked wall or a collapsing stairwell and pushes the stone into new pillars and arches. For the rest of the scene that structure cannot fall any further, and the user can open a crawlway through the rubble to the people trapped inside. Strain: heavy.

Canyon Vise.name: Canyon Vise
Canyon Vise.description: The user raises walls of stone on both sides of a target and slams them together. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage that ignores worn armor and hardened skin; held back, the walls stop short and hold the target upright between them, unable to move anything but their head, until they break out with a hard effort, the stone is broken or the user releases them. Strain: heavy.

Bedrock Tide.name: Bedrock Tide
Bedrock Tide.description: The user's signature move: both palms hit the ground and the street ahead rears up into a rolling wave of stone. Every enemy in its path takes massive bludgeoning damage and is buried to the chest when the wave sets, unable to move until they break out with a hard effort or are dug out; afterward the user's hands go numb and they cannot shape stone until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Citadel Command.name: Citadel Command
Citadel Command.description: The user lays both palms on the street and takes hold of the stone and concrete across a whole city block. For the rest of the scene they can raise a wall across any street, open stairs to any roof, seal or open any doorway and close a stone cage around any enemy standing on the ground. Each cage holds until heavy blows break it, and everything they shape stays when they let go. Strain: severe.

Iron Snatch.name: Iron Snatch
Iron Snatch.description: The user crooks a hand at a steel object they can see across a room or a street, and it flies to them: a knife, a pipe, a pistol, a ring of keys. Pulled from a person's grip, it is gone before they can swing or fire, and the user catches it or lets it drop at their feet. Strain: light.

Repulse Burst.name: Repulse Burst
Repulse Burst.description: The user slaps a target with an open palm, marking them with a pole, and repels them in the same instant. It deals force damage and throws the target a few strides back and off their feet, with or without metal on them; held back, it only shoves them away and breaks any hold they had on the user. Strain: light.

Polar Lock.name: Polar Lock
Polar Lock.description: The user touches a target and then a wall, a lamppost, a car or a second target, giving the two opposite poles. They slam together and stick: the target cannot pull away until they wrench free with a hard effort, someone pries them apart, the user releases them or the scene ends, and the hold leaves no injury. Strain: moderate.

Scrap Squall.name: Scrap Squall
Scrap Squall.description: The user lifts every loose bolt, coin, nail and scrap of steel nearby into a whirling cloud and flings it flat-side first through a cone across a room. Everyone in the cone takes bludgeoning damage and, battered from all sides, cannot aim a weapon or a Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Girder Glide.name: Girder Glide
Girder Glide.description: The user marks themselves with a pole and rides the pull toward steel: up a steel-framed building, along a rail or a girder, across a street to a lamppost or a bus. They can carry a passenger, and by pushing off the steel in the ground or the frame below they turn any fall into a soft landing. Strain: moderate.

Steelfall Catch.name: Steelfall Catch
Steelfall Catch.description: The user throws both hands up and seizes every piece of steel falling or flying into a street-wide area: beams, rebar, signs, a dropping car, thrown blades. Each hangs in the air until the user sets it down somewhere safe, so nobody under it or in its path is hurt. Strain: heavy.

Wrecking Pull.name: Wrecking Pull
Wrecking Pull.description: The user tears a car, a steel door or a streetlight loose and swings it into a target across a street. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage to the target and anyone beside them and smashes through a barricade or a wall behind them; held back, the user lets it fall short across the target, pinning them to the ground without crushing until they heave it off with a hard effort or someone lifts it away. Strain: heavy.

Meridian Slam.name: Meridian Slam
Meridian Slam.description: The user's signature move: a single pulse marks every enemy in sight and the ground beneath them with opposite poles and slams them all down at once. Each takes massive force damage and cannot rise until the end of their next turn, and every phone, camera and card reader nearby is wiped; afterward the user's field is spent and they cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Lodestar Field.name: Lodestar Field
Lodestar Field.description: The user takes hold of every piece of steel across a city block at once. For the rest of the scene they can hold a collapsing steel-framed building upright, stop vehicles in their tracks, strip the steel weapons from every enemy they choose and bend rebar around those enemies' ankles until cut or pried free, while everyone else's steel stays untouched. Strain: severe.

Sizzle Flick.name: Sizzle Flick
Sizzle Flick.description: The user flicks a spray of acid from the fingertips at a target within a few strides. It deals corrosive damage and eats holes in the cloth, rope and plastic it lands on; held back to a mild sting, it leaves no burn, but the target lets go of whatever they hold and cannot grip anything until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Slick Skate.name: Slick Skate
Slick Skate.description: The user lays a film of weak acid under their soles and skates on it across any floor or road faster than a sprinter, sliding under closing doors and around obstacles. Until the end of the user's next turn, anyone who tries to grab them slips off, and anyone who chases them across the film falls. Strain: light.

Lockmelt Touch.name: Lockmelt Touch
Lockmelt Touch.description: The user lays a hand on a lock, a chain, handcuffs, a seat belt or a jammed car door and dissolves just that part in moments, leaving everything around it unharmed. Cuffs and zip ties fall away, doors swing open, and people pinned in wreckage can be pulled out without cutting tools. Strain: moderate.

Mire Glob.name: Mire Glob
Mire Glob.description: The user lobs a glob of thick, sticky gel across a room onto the ground under a target, or under a few people standing together. Their feet stick fast: they cannot walk, run or kick until they peel free with a hard effort or the user thins the gel, and the gel is too weak to burn. Strain: moderate.

Etched Ascent.name: Etched Ascent
Etched Ascent.description: The user runs up a wall or across a ceiling, etching handholds and footholds with acid as they go and gripping with tacky gel on the palms. They can carry a passenger on their back, and the etched holds stay behind so others can climb up or down the same route. Strain: moderate.

Hissing Mantle.name: Hissing Mantle
Hissing Mantle.description: The user sweats a coat of strong acid over their whole body and holds it there. Until the scene ends or the user lets it dry, anyone who grabs, grapples or strikes them bare-handed takes corrosive damage and must let go, ropes, tape and cuffs on them dissolve, and wooden or plastic weapons that hit them pit and break; their own clothes dissolve too unless acid-proof. Strain: heavy.

Caustic Downpour.name: Caustic Downpour
Caustic Downpour.description: The user flings a spray high overhead and it comes down as a fine, stinging rain over a street-wide area, only where they aim it. Every enemy beneath takes corrosive damage, and their worn armor, shields and support gear pit and sag: until repaired, that gear no longer protects them or works. Bystanders outside the aimed area stay dry. Strain: heavy.

Corrosion Crest.name: Corrosion Crest
Corrosion Crest.description: The user's signature move: they pour out a rolling wave of acid gel the length of a street and ride its crest. Every enemy in its path takes massive corrosive damage, or only a sting if the user thins it, and is swept off their feet and stuck in the setting gel until they tear free with a hard effort or are dug or washed free; afterward the user's skin runs dry and they cannot make acid until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Selective Solvent.name: Selective Solvent
Selective Solvent.description: The user tunes their acid to a single material they name, such as steel, concrete, glass, plastic or wood, and floods a room or a rubble field with it. Only that material dissolves while skin and everything else stay untouched: concrete melts away from buried survivors, or every enemy's steel weapons and armor run to sludge in their hands. Strain: severe.

Bitter Breath.name: Bitter Breath
Bitter Breath.description: The user spits a jet of stinging irritant gas into the face of a target within a few strides. It deals toxic damage, and the target's eyes stream shut while they cough: they cannot see well enough to aim or pick anyone out until the end of their next turn. Held back, it deals no damage and leaves only the tears and coughing. Strain: light.

Smoke Pall.name: Smoke Pall
Smoke Pall.description: The user breathes out a thick bank of harmless smoke that fills a room or a stretch of street. Until wind clears it or the scene ends, nobody inside can see past arm's reach and nobody outside can see in, while the user, who knows the cloud's shape, can lead allies out through it or slip away unseen. Strain: light.

Drowse Fog.name: Drowse Fog
Drowse Fog.description: The user releases a slow cloud of heavy knockout gas that fills a room. Anyone breathing it grows drowsy and cannot run, strike with full force or use fine skills while inside, and anyone still inside at the end of their next turn falls asleep until shaken awake, hurt or carried into fresh air. Sealed masks and held breath keep it out. Strain: moderate.

Tracer Mist.name: Tracer Mist
Tracer Mist.description: The user lets a thin, harmless trace gas seep through a building, a rubble pile or a smoke-filled floor and feels it curl around everything that breathes. They learn where each person inside is, whether each is moving, still or pinned, and which gaps lead out; anyone watching closely may notice a faint haze. Strain: moderate.

Retching Tide.name: Retching Tide
Retching Tide.description: The user rolls a low, churning front of nauseating gas down a corridor or along a street. Everyone it reaches without a sealed mask, allies included, takes toxic damage and doubles over retching: until the end of their next turn they cannot attack, aim or use a Quirk, and anyone who tries to run falls. Strain: heavy.

Starve the Blaze.name: Starve the Blaze
Starve the Blaze.description: The user floods a burning room, stairwell or vehicle with a heavy, inert gas that sinks over the flames and starves them of air. Every fire in that space goes out and cannot relight while the gas lingers, and the user keeps it away from the faces of everyone inside, so trapped people breathe normally while they are carried out. Strain: heavy.

Filter-Eater Haze.name: Filter-Eater Haze
Filter-Eater Haze.description: The user pushes out a gas fine enough to slip through mask filters, visor seals and the joints of armor, and breathes it straight at a single target. It deals heavy toxic damage that ignores masks, respirators and worn armor; held back, it deals no damage and leaves the target too dizzy to stand until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Miasma Tempest.name: Miasma Tempest
Miasma Tempest.description: The user's signature move: they empty every reserve at once, and a towering storm of churning gas rolls out across a whole city block. Everyone inside without a sealed mask, allies included, takes massive toxic damage and collapses coughing, unable to stand, attack or use a Quirk until the end of their next turn; afterward the user cannot release gas until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Perfect Dose.name: Perfect Dose
Perfect Dose.description: The user feeds a precisely measured knockout blend through the vents, stairwells and gaps of an entire building. Everyone inside without a sealed mask who has not reached open air by the end of the user's next turn falls asleep, captors and hostages alike, and sleeps until the scene ends or someone shakes them awake. The dose harms no one, not even children, the sick or the elderly. Strain: severe.

Sidelong Reach.name: Sidelong Reach
Sidelong Reach.description: The user opens a pair of hand-sized gates, one at their side and one beside a target within a few strides, and reaches through. They can land a blow from behind or around a shield, dealing bludgeoning damage, or snatch a weapon, phone or key from the target's hand or belt; a target who did not see the gate open cannot block or dodge it. Strain: light.

Threshold Step.name: Threshold Step
Threshold Step.description: The user opens a door-sized gate and steps through to a spot they can see within their gates' reach, bringing along a single person they are holding. Any attack already aimed at either of them misses, and they come out behind cover, across a gap or at an opponent's back. Strain: light.

Detour Gate.name: Detour Gate
Detour Gate.description: The user throws open a gate in the path of a bullet, blade, blast or Quirk attack aimed at themselves or someone near them. The attack vanishes into it and comes out where the user chooses: into the ground, into the open sky, or back at the attacker, who takes the damage it would have dealt. Strain: moderate.

Keyhole Window.name: Keyhole Window
Keyhole Window.description: The user opens a coin-sized gate into a room, vehicle or rubble void they can picture within reach, and sees and hears through it without opening any door. They can pass air, water, a phone or a bandage through it to someone trapped, or flip a latch from the inside, and only someone looking right at it notices it. Strain: moderate.

Open Exit.name: Open Exit
Open Exit.description: The user opens a door-sized gate and holds it until the end of their next turn, its exit set in a safe place they know within a few blocks. Everyone who walks, runs or is carried through in that time is out of the danger; pursuers can follow unless the user lets it close, which pushes anyone halfway through back out unharmed. Strain: moderate.

Scatter Drop.name: Scatter Drop
Scatter Drop.description: The user opens a gate around a target who is standing still, held down or caught off guard, and drops them out of an exit at a place within reach the user can picture, such as a riverbank, a fenced lot or the far side of a police line. The target lands unhurt but stranded until they make their way back; a target who sees it coming can leap clear. Used on a hostage, it pulls them to safety. Strain: heavy.

Far Door.name: Far Door
Far Door.description: The user opens a door-sized gate to any place they know well anywhere in the city and holds it while they and a handful of people step through. They can reach a hospital, an agency, a hideout or a home across town in a single step, though anyone else who reaches the gate before it closes comes too. Strain: heavy.

Collapse Point.name: Collapse Point
Collapse Point.description: The user's signature move: they ring an area the size of a street corner with linked gates, fold the space inside, pass their allies out to its edge, then let every gate slam shut at once. The snapping space deals massive force damage to every enemy inside and throws them down, unable to act until the end of their next turn; afterward the user cannot open a gate until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Maze of Doors.name: Maze of Doors
Maze of Doors.description: For the rest of the scene the user ties every doorway, hatch and window in a building to their Quirk and decides where each one leads. Enemies who pass through any of them come out where the user chooses, such as a locked room, the roof or the front steps, while allies and evacuees step from any door straight to safety; only breaking through a wall gets around it. Strain: severe.

Shade Catch.name: Shade Catch
Shade Catch.description: The shadow lunges out and catches a blow, a thrown object or a falling person within its reach. The caught attack deals no damage to the user or the ally it was aimed at, and a falling person is set down unhurt; in bright light the shadow can stop a punch or a thrown object but is too small to catch a person. Strain: light.

Umbra Rake.name: Umbra Rake
Umbra Rake.description: The shadow lashes out at a target within its reach and rakes them with its claws for slashing damage, or slams them with a fist for bludgeoning damage that knocks them flat. Held back, it only shoves them to the ground and leaves no wound. In darkness the blow lands harder; in bright light it barely stings. Strain: light.

Penumbra Pin.name: Penumbra Pin
Penumbra Pin.description: The shadow wraps around a target within its reach and pins them to the ground or a wall. They cannot move their arms or legs until they break free with a hard effort, a bright light falls on the shadow or the user lets go, and the user stays free to act while the shadow holds them. Strain: moderate.

Gloaming Lift.name: Gloaming Lift
Gloaming Lift.description: The shadow grips a ledge, railing or pipe above and hauls the user up a building face or across a street-wide gap, or lowers them from a height at a safe pace. It can carry a single other person in its free arm, lifting someone off a ledge or out of a flooded street along the way. Strain: moderate.

Lightless Errand.name: Lightless Errand
Lightless Errand.description: The shadow thins into a ribbon and slips under doors, through vents and along dark corners as far as a whole floor away while the user stays still. It sees in the dark, whispers back what it finds and can flip a latch or carry a phone to someone trapped; a light or a blow sends it snapping back to the user. Strain: moderate.

Rubble Delve.name: Rubble Delve
Rubble Delve.description: The shadow pours into the dark gaps of a collapsed building, where it is at its strongest, finds every person trapped inside and braces the debris off them. Nothing it holds shifts or falls until the user calls it back, and it hauls each trapped person out to the user, carrying them clear of the jagged edges. Strain: heavy.

Eclipse Mantle.name: Eclipse Mantle
Eclipse Mantle.description: The shadow wraps the user's whole body as a dark coat with claws. Until bright light strips it away or the scene ends, the user's unarmed blows reach a few strides and deal slashing damage, and blades, fists and bullets that hit the user strike the coat instead and deal no damage until a heavy blow tears it open. Strain: heavy.

Nocturne Crossfall.name: Nocturne Crossfall
Nocturne Crossfall.description: The user's signature move: user and shadow strike together from opposite sides in a single rhythm, the shadow swollen to full size for that moment even in bright light. The target cannot block or dodge, takes massive slashing and bludgeoning damage and is driven to the ground, unable to act until the end of their next turn; afterward the shadow is spent and cannot come out until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: severe.

Pitch-Dark Accord.name: Pitch-Dark Accord
Pitch-Dark Accord.description: The shadow smothers every light and window across a building or a city block at night, drowning the area in darkness, and the user keeps its full strength under control there for the rest of the scene. It grows taller than a truck, strikes any enemy within a street's width for heavy slashing damage on command, and can hold up a falling floor or carry several people at once. Strain: severe.

Mending Touch.name: Mending Touch
Mending Touch.description: The user lays a hand on a wounded person and speeds their healing. Cuts close, bleeding stops and bruises and sprains ease within moments, restoring some health, and the user feels any hidden injury beneath, such as a cracked rib or internal bleeding. The patient pays with brief stamina and feels the tiredness at once. Strain: light.

Ward Rounds.name: Ward Rounds
Ward Rounds.description: The user moves down a line of wounded people within a room, touching each in turn. Every person touched stops bleeding, keeps breathing steadily and holds on until medical care arrives, though their wounds stay open and each loses brief stamina. Strain: moderate.

Knitting Grip.name: Knitting Grip
Knitting Grip.description: The user sets a broken bone, a torn ligament or a dislocated joint with both hands and drives the healing through it in moments. The limb bears weight and works normally from the patient's next turn and heals fully overnight, and the patient loses heavy stamina. Strain: moderate.

Wilting Palm.name: Wilting Palm
Wilting Palm.description: The user grips a target's bare skin and pours healing into a body with nothing to mend. The target's strength drains into empty repair work: they lose heavy stamina and cannot run, strike hard or lift anything heavy until the end of their next turn. It leaves no wound, so heroes use it to end a fight without injuring anyone. Strain: moderate.

Fever Purge.name: Fever Purge
Fever Purge.description: The user holds a patient's wrist and drives their body's defenses into a fever that burns out a poison, a venom, a knockout gas, a drug or a fresh infection. Its effects end at once, including the frenzy of a Quirk-boosting drug, and the patient loses heavy stamina and runs a fever for about an hour. Strain: moderate.

Unbroken Vigil.name: Unbroken Vigil
Unbroken Vigil.description: The user keeps both hands on a dying person and does not let go. While contact holds, the user can do nothing but walk beside a stretcher, and the patient cannot die from their wounds or blood loss, holding on until a surgeon or a stronger technique can save them; they lose heavy stamina when the user lets go. Strain: heavy.

Deep Mend.name: Deep Mend
Deep Mend.description: The user pours the Quirk into a single grave injury in one long session: a deep burn across a limb, a crushed hand, a collapsed lung or a gunshot wound. The injury closes and the patient regains most of their health, but they lose extreme stamina and fall asleep for hours unless danger forces them up. Strain: heavy.

Wellspring Pulse.name: Wellspring Pulse
Wellspring Pulse.description: The user's signature move: the Quirk leaves their hands as a wave of warm light that reaches everyone they choose within a room's width, no touch needed. Each of them stops bleeding, regains a large share of health and has broken bones set and knitting at the price of heavy stamina, while anyone too weak to pay is healed only as far as is safe; afterward the user cannot heal until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Whole Again.name: Whole Again
Whole Again.description: The user rebuilds what a body cannot mend on its own: a severed limb or finger brought within a few hours reattaches with full feeling, a crushed organ is remade, or a fresh injury that would have left a lifelong disability heals clean. The patient loses extreme stamina and sleeps through the next day. Strain: severe.

Spoken Tether.name: Spoken Tether
Spoken Tether.description: The user speaks to a single target within earshot, and if the target answers aloud, the user's voice takes hold. The target's eyes glaze and they follow simple spoken commands (stop, drop it, sit, come here) until pain, a hard shake or a loud noise at close range snaps them out, the user releases them, the scene ends, or the user orders them to hurt anyone. Strain: light.

Loaded Question.name: Loaded Question
Loaded Question.description: The user reads a guarded target's pride and fears and says the one thing they cannot leave unanswered: a taunt, a plea, a secret, their own name. Unless the target makes a hard effort of will, they answer aloud, and the user's Quirk takes hold of them at once if the user chooses. Strain: light.

Standing Order.name: Standing Order
Standing Order.description: The user gives a person under their control a single order that keeps working after the hold ends: sit and wait, stay in this room, sleep, keep your hands on the wall. The person keeps obeying it, even with the user gone, until the scene ends, until they are hurt or shaken hard, or until the user lifts it. Strain: moderate.

Waking Word.name: Waking Word
Waking Word.description: The user studies a person's eyes and voice and knows whether a mind-affecting Quirk, a drug or panic has hold of them, and how firmly. A sharp word from the user then snaps them free: someone under another's control, a bystander frozen in terror or a teammate under an induced emotion acts normally again from their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Voice on the Line.name: Voice on the Line
Voice on the Line.description: The user's Quirk carries through a phone call, radio, intercom or loudspeaker. A target who answers the user's voice through the device falls under the user's control just as they would face to face, within the same limits, so a hero can talk a hostage-taker into setting down the knife from a block away. Strain: moderate.

Split Leash.name: Split Leash
Split Leash.description: The user keeps several people under control at once, each caught by their own answer, and commands them together or each by name. Snapping one person free leaves the others held, so a whole gang can be walked out of a building with their hands on their heads. Strain: heavy.

Overload Command.name: Overload Command
Overload Command.description: The user floods a person under their control with every command at once. The held person's mind whites out: they take psychic damage and drop unconscious until the scene ends, waking with a pounding headache and no memory of the fight, and the user's hold on them ends. Strain: heavy.

Sovereign Call.name: Sovereign Call
Sovereign Call.description: The user's signature move: they read a whole crowd and call out the one question nearly everyone in earshot answers without thinking. Everyone who answers, ally, enemy or bystander, falls under the user's control and obeys a single shared command, such as kneel, drop your weapons or walk to the exits, until hurt, shaken or the scene ends; afterward the user's voice gives out until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Complete Direction.name: Complete Direction
Complete Direction.description: A person under the user's control follows long, detailed instructions with all their own skill: they drive, climb, pick a lock or perform surgery. They can also use or stop their own Quirk on command, undoing what it did, lowering a barrier, ending a transformation or holding an unstable Quirk steady. An order to hurt themselves or anyone else still snaps them free. Strain: severe.

Quell Gaze.name: Quell Gaze
Quell Gaze.description: The user fixes their eyes on a single person in clear sight and switches off that person's Quirk. Until the end of the user's next turn, or sooner if the user blinks or looks away, the target cannot use an Emitter or Transformation Quirk, an active transformation drops back to normal and anything the Quirk was holding up falls. Mutant features keep working. Strain: light.

Cutoff Glance.name: Cutoff Glance
Cutoff Glance.description: The user watches a person for a moment and reads the tell their Quirk gives before it fires: a tensed hand, a held breath, a flicker on the skin. If that person tries to use their Quirk on the user or anyone near the user before the end of the user's next turn, the user's look lands on them first and the Quirk fails to fire, so the attack never leaves their body. Strain: light.

Grounding Stare.name: Grounding Stare
Grounding Stare.description: The user locks onto a person moving with an Emitter or Transformation Quirk: flying, speeding, leaping or opening a portal. The move dies halfway: a speedster stumbles to an ordinary run, a jumper falls short, a portal closes before anyone passes, and a flyer drops, the look slipping a moment before impact so they land hard but unhurt. While the look holds, they cannot use the Quirk to get away until the end of their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Flicker Sweep.name: Flicker Sweep
Flicker Sweep.description: The user lets the look sweep slowly across a crowd, a room or a street. Every Emitter or Transformation effect in use there falters for an instant as the gaze passes its user: a disguise slips, a hidden sensor goes blind, a victim under a mind-control Quirk comes to for a breath. The user learns who in sight is using a Quirk right now, even someone trying to hide it. Strain: moderate.

Circuit Breaker.name: Circuit Breaker
Circuit Breaker.description: The user fixes the look on a person whose Quirk is running wild from panic, a boosting drug or a breakdown, and shuts it off. Until the user blinks or looks away, the runaway effect stops spreading, anyone it was holding, crushing or carrying is let go unharmed, and the person takes no harm from the sudden stop; when the look ends, their Quirk comes back under their own control. Strain: moderate.

Unblinking Vigil.name: Unblinking Vigil
Unblinking Vigil.description: The user forces their eyes to stay open and holds the look on a single person far past the usual limit. For the rest of the scene that person cannot use an Emitter or Transformation Quirk while they stay in the user's sight; only smoke, a flash, a blow to the user's head or losing sight of them breaks the hold, so a dangerous Quirk stays down through an arrest or a transfer. Strain: heavy.

Threshold Watch.name: Threshold Watch
Threshold Watch.description: The user takes a stand facing a doorway, a corridor, a breach or a stairwell and watches it. Until the end of their next turn, every person who enters that space loses their Emitter and Transformation Quirks while inside it, so attackers must come through on foot and by hand while the people behind the user get clear. Strain: heavy.

Null Horizon.name: Null Horizon
Null Horizon.description: The user's signature move: their eyes blaze and the look takes in the whole scene at once. Until the end of the user's next turn, every person in sight, allies included, loses their Emitter and Transformation Quirks, transformations collapse and every barrier, portal or construct a Quirk is holding up drops; when it ends the user's eyes are spent, and the Quirk does not work through their following turn. Strain: severe.

Afterimage Seal.name: Afterimage Seal
Afterimage Seal.description: The user sweeps the look from opponent to opponent across a whole group in a room or a street, timing each blink to a moment when none of them can act. For the rest of the scene, every enemy the user chooses who stays in the user's sight cannot use an Emitter or Transformation Quirk; smoke, a flash, a blow to the user's head or getting out of sight frees that person at once. Strain: severe.

Borrowed Touch.name: Borrowed Touch
Borrowed Touch.description: The user touches a person's bare skin with a handshake, a grab or a slap and copies their Emitter or Transformation Quirk, replacing any copy they held. They know at once what it does and where its limits lie, and can use its basic effect right away and for the next few minutes. Mutant features and Quirkless people give nothing. Strain: light.

Like for Like.name: Like for Like
Like for Like.description: The user holds a copy of an opponent's Quirk and waits for its owner to use it. If the owner attacks the user or someone next to them with that Quirk before the end of the user's next turn, the user answers with the same Quirk at the same instant: blast meets blast, ice meets ice, and both uses cancel out with no harm to anyone. Strain: light.

Coattail Leap.name: Coattail Leap
Coattail Leap.description: The user taps a person whose Quirk moves them, such as a jumper, a flyer or a speedster, and uses the copy in the same motion. This turn the copy carries the user wherever it could carry its owner: onto a rooftop, across a street-wide gap or out of a fall into a safe landing, with a single passenger if they choose. Strain: moderate.

Owner's Trail.name: Owner's Trail
Owner's Trail.description: The user concentrates on a Quirk they copied earlier that day and feels for its owner. Until the day ends, they know whenever that owner uses the Quirk within a few city blocks, which direction it came from and roughly what it did, so a fleeing suspect, a hidden villain or a lost child can be followed. Strain: moderate.

Second Responder.name: Second Responder
Second Responder.description: The user touches a rescuer at work, such as a healer, a barrier maker or a water or earth user, and copies the Quirk to work beside them. Until the end of the scene the user repeats that rescue effect in a second place: another wall shored up, another blaze held back, another patient treated. Strain: moderate.

Stacked Deck.name: Stacked Deck
Stacked Deck.description: The user stores copies instead of replacing them. For the rest of the scene they hold a few copied Quirks at once and switch between them freely as part of any action, raising a copied wall one moment and sprinting on a copied speed Quirk the next. Each copy still works at a beginner's level, and only a single copy runs at a time. Strain: heavy.

Trump Card.name: Trump Card
Trump Card.description: The user reads a copied Quirk from the inside until they know it as well as its owner, then opens it all the way. For a single move it works at the full scale its owner can reach rather than a beginner's: an attack deals heavy damage of that Quirk's type, and a wall, a lift or a rescue effect reaches the owner's full size. Strain: heavy.

Full House.name: Full House
Full House.description: The user's signature move: a sweep of the hands across everyone within reach copies each of their Quirks, enemies and allies alike, and the user fires them all in a single, precisely timed sequence. Each attack among them deals massive damage of its own type to a target the user picks, each defensive one shields the user as it fires, and every copy is spent afterward; the user cannot copy again until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Perfect Splice.name: Perfect Splice
Perfect Splice.description: The user runs a pair of copied Quirks at once and splices them into a single effect neither owner can make: flame carried on a gale, a wall of ice thrown up by water pressure, hardened skin moving at a speedster's pace. Every enemy in a wide area in front takes damage of both copied types and is knocked down, or the spliced effect performs a rescue neither Quirk could manage alone. Strain: severe.

Mindcast.name: Mindcast
Mindcast.description: The user sends a few sentences into the minds of a handful of chosen people within range. Each hears the message at once in the user's voice through walls, smoke, noise or deafness, nobody else can overhear it, and allies who receive a plan this way can act on it together at the exact moment the user names, with no signal an enemy could catch. Strain: light.

Mind Census.name: Mind Census
Mind Census.description: The user reaches out and feels every mind within a building's width, through walls, floors and rubble. They learn how many people are there, where each one is, and whether each is awake, unconscious, panicking or in pain, so nobody can hide from them by keeping still and silent, and no trapped survivor is missed. Strain: light.

Thought Spike.name: Thought Spike
Thought Spike.description: The user drives a burst of mental static into a single person in sight. It deals psychic damage, and until the end of their next turn the target cannot aim a weapon or a Quirk or follow a plan; held back, it only startles them, and they drop whatever they were holding. Strain: moderate.

Mind's-Eye Feed.name: Mind's-Eye Feed
Mind's-Eye Feed.description: The user sends what they see, or what a single ally sees, into the minds of a handful of chosen people. Until the end of the user's next turn those people see through those eyes alongside their own, so they can run through smoke or darkness without losing the way and aim at a target only the seer can see. Strain: moderate.

Party Line.name: Party Line
