Party Line.description: The user links a small team, themself included, into a two-way line for the rest of the scene. Everyone on it talks mind to mind at the speed of thought, nobody on the line can be surprised from a direction another member is watching, and a member caught by a mind-control, emotion or illusion Quirk shakes it off at the end of their next turn when the others call to them. Strain: moderate.

Stay With Me.name: Stay With Me
Stay With Me.description: The user holds a steady link with every trapped, hurt or lost person they have sensed in a collapsed building or a disaster zone and talks each one through it. Until rescuers reach them, those people do not black out from shock or panic, they follow simple directions such as keep still or crawl left, and every rescuer the user links goes straight to them. Strain: heavy.

Open Book.name: Open Book
Open Book.description: The user pushes past the surface of a single mind in sight and reads what that person is thinking right now. Until the end of the scene the user hears their passing thoughts, including intentions and their next move, so that person cannot surprise or deceive the user; they feel a pressure behind the eyes and may guess what is happening. Strain: heavy.

Silent Thunder.name: Silent Thunder
Silent Thunder.description: The user's signature move: a single soundless shout of thought hits every hostile mind in a wide area around them. Each enemy takes massive psychic damage and cannot act until the end of their next turn, while allies and bystanders, whom the user picks out one by one, feel nothing; afterward the user cannot send until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Common Frequency.name: Common Frequency
Common Frequency.description: The user opens a line to every mind across a whole district for the rest of the scene. Every person in it hears the user's directions in their own head at once, anyone trapped or hurt can call back and be found, and every hero and responder in the area shares a single live picture of the disaster, so evacuation and rescue run as a single operation. Strain: severe.

Tack Shot.name: Tack Shot
Tack Shot.description: The user flicks a glob or strip of tape at a target across a room and glues whatever they aim at: a hand to what it holds or to the target's side, a foot to the ground, a weapon into its holster. That part cannot move until the target tears free with a hard effort or cuts it loose, and the shot causes no injury. Strain: light.

Tapeline Swing.name: Tapeline Swing
Tapeline Swing.description: The user fires a line to a high anchor, such as a lamppost, a ledge or a beam, and swings or hauls themself along it: across a street, up to a high window or clear of an incoming attack, which misses them. They can grab a single passenger on the way and carry them along. Strain: light.

Parcel Wrap.name: Parcel Wrap
Parcel Wrap.description: The user circles a target with a fast stream of tape and wraps them from shoulders to knees, then sticks the bundle to a wall or the floor if they choose. Until cut free or peeled loose by the user, the target cannot use their arms, run, climb or leave the spot, though they can still breathe and talk; the wrap leaves no injury. Strain: moderate.

Reel-In Save.name: Reel-In Save
Reel-In Save.description: The user fires a line at a person in danger anywhere within a street's width and hauls them to the user's side in an instant: out from under a falling beam, out of a car's path, off a ledge or out of a burning doorway. An attack aimed at them misses, and they land on their feet beside the user, unhurt by the pull. Strain: moderate.

Catchweb.name: Catchweb
Catchweb.description: The user strings a web of sticky lines across a gap, between buildings, under a sagging floor or over a crowd. Until the end of the scene it catches falling people unhurt and holds them until the user peels them free and lowers them, and it stops falling debris and thrown objects that hit it. Strain: moderate.

Plug and Patch.name: Plug and Patch
Plug and Patch.description: The user packs a thick plug of adhesive into a breach: a burst water main, a gas leak, a cracked tank, a holed hull, a door that must stay shut or a deep wound. The seal holds against pressure and force for the rest of the scene, and a sealed wound stops bleeding until a medic takes over, though it heals nothing. Strain: heavy.

Flypaper Ground.name: Flypaper Ground
Flypaper Ground.description: The user sprays a sheet of adhesive across a whole street or a large hall in a single sweep, leaving clean lanes only where they choose. Anyone standing on it outside those lanes is stuck fast by the feet and cannot leave the spot until they tear free with a great effort, anyone knocked down on it is glued flat, and vehicles that roll onto it stall. Strain: heavy.

Tanglestorm.name: Tanglestorm
Tanglestorm.description: The user's signature move: they swing a full circle around the scene on a flurry of lines, wrapping every enemy they pass. Each enemy in a wide area ends bound from shoulders to knees and glued to the ground, a wall or a lamppost, unable to move or use their hands until cut free or until they tear loose with a great effort; afterward the user's skin is spent and makes no adhesive until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Skyline Stitch.name: Skyline Stitch
Skyline Stitch.description: The user stitches a failing building, a cracked bridge or a toppling crane to the ground and the structures around it with a mesh of heavy lines. For the rest of the scene it does not fall or shift any further, everyone inside can be led out safely, and the user can lower people down the outside on single strands. Strain: severe.

Splitting Image.name: Splitting Image
Splitting Image.description: In an instant the user splits off a pair of doubles, and the user and both doubles go at a single target from different sides. The target takes bludgeoning damage and can defend against only one of them this turn; afterward the doubles stay and act on their own until the end of the scene or until they burst. Strain: light.

Fall Guy.name: Fall Guy
Fall Guy.description: The user keeps a double at their shoulder for the rest of the scene, watching for danger. The first time an attack would hit the user or someone beside them, the double throws themself into its path and bursts, and the attack does no harm to anyone behind them. Strain: light.

Spare Self.name: Spare Self
Spare Self.description: The user makes a single double built to last, who stays until the user next sleeps or until they burst. The spare can keep watch, wait in line, guard a door, carry on a shift's work or be seen in one place while the user is in another, and the user feels the moment the spare bursts and where. Strain: moderate.

Pyramid Boost.name: Pyramid Boost
Pyramid Boost.description: Doubles appear beneath and beside the user, brace and throw. The user, and a single ally if they choose, is boosted onto a rooftop or a high ledge, flung across a street-wide gap or caught by a stack of doubles before hitting the ground in a fall; the doubles burst afterward, leaving nothing for pursuers to climb. Strain: moderate.

Spot the Original.name: Spot the Original
Spot the Original.description: The user splits into a crowd of identical doubles, all moving, talking and dressed the same, and slips in among them. Until the end of the user's next turn nobody can tell which one is real: each attack aimed at the user strikes a double instead and bursts them, though an attack that covers the whole crowd still reaches the user, and the user can walk away through the crowd unnoticed. Strain: moderate.

Rescue Roster.name: Rescue Roster
Rescue Roster.description: The user pours out a crew of doubles to search a collapsed building, a flooded block or a burning floor room by room. Until the end of the scene the doubles find every trapped person in the area, pass each one hand to hand along a chain to safety and call every find back along the line, while the user directs them from outside. Strain: heavy.

Dogpile Drop.name: Dogpile Drop
Dogpile Drop.description: A heap of doubles drops onto a single target from every side, even a target far larger than the user. The target takes heavy bludgeoning damage and is pinned flat: they cannot move, attack or use their hands until they break free with a great effort, which bursts the whole pile. Strain: heavy.

Army of One.name: Army of One
Army of One.description: The user's signature move: they flood the scene with doubles, enough to fill a street, and every double goes for an enemy. Each enemy in the area takes massive bludgeoning damage and is buried under doubles, unable to move until the end of their next turn; afterward the doubles burst together, and the user cannot make doubles until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Two of Everyone.name: Two of Everyone
Two of Everyone.description: The user touches each willing member of their team and makes a double of every one of them alongside their own. Each double has their original's body and skills in copies of their clothes, but no Quirk and no working gear, follows their original's lead and acts until the end of the scene or until they burst, so the whole team can fight or rescue in two places at once. Strain: severe.

Crumbling Palm.name: Crumbling Palm
Crumbling Palm.description: The user closes a full hand on a weapon, a shield, a lock or a piece of worn armor, and it breaks down into grit in a moment: a held weapon falls apart in its wielder's grip, and the armor or shield is gone. Gripping a person instead deals corrosive damage to the flesh under the hand, and the wound stops spreading the moment the user lets go. Strain: light.

Hairline Cut.name: Hairline Cut
Hairline Cut.description: The user lays a hand on a chain, a seatbelt, a lock's bolt, a pair of handcuffs or the bent frame pinning someone's leg, and holds the decay to a thin band under the edge of the palm. Only that band turns to dust, so the object parts cleanly and anyone caught by it is freed without a scratch. Strain: light.

Ashen Parry.name: Ashen Parry
Ashen Parry.description: The user meets a swung blade, bat or pipe, a thrown object or a falling chunk of debris with an open palm, whether it is aimed at them or at a person beside them, and it turns to dust on contact. That attack deals no damage and the weapon is destroyed; a bare fist or kick met this way is only blocked, because the user holds the decay back from flesh. Strain: moderate.

Ground to Grit.name: Ground to Grit
Ground to Grit.description: The user slaps a full hand to the floor or the street, and the surface crumbles into loose, shifting grit across a room's width while the patch under their own feet holds. Everyone else on it loses their footing: anyone moving falls, and until the end of their next turn nobody on it can run, charge or dodge. Strain: moderate.

Straight Through.name: Straight Through
Straight Through.description: The user runs in a straight line with a hand out, and every wall, door, fence or floor in the way crumbles into a doorway-sized hole a moment before they reach it. They cross a building or a block of alleys without going around anything, or drop through floors to the level below, and others can follow through the holes; the decay never touches anyone on the other side. Strain: moderate.

Grain by Grain.name: Grain by Grain
Grain by Grain.description: The user lays both hands on a collapsed pile that is pinning people and unmakes it from the top down, layer by layer, so the weight comes off without anything shifting onto the people beneath. Within moments the pile is a spill of sand and the trapped are freed unhurt, while any beam or slab still holding up a ceiling is left standing. Strain: heavy.

Controlled Collapse.name: Controlled Collapse
Controlled Collapse.description: The user grips a load-bearing point and brings down a chosen piece of a structure, such as a wall, a stairway, a section of floor, a bridge span or a crane, so it falls exactly where they choose. Dropped clear of people, it opens a way in or out; dropped on enemies, it deals bludgeoning damage and pins them under rubble until they are dug out or haul themselves free. Strain: heavy.

Street Unmade.name: Street Unmade
Street Unmade.description: The user's signature move: a full hand slams down and the decay races out through the ground across a street-wide area, crumbling asphalt, cars, barricades and cover around every enemy but never touching living flesh. Each of them drops with the ground, takes massive bludgeoning damage and is half buried until they dig out; afterward the user's hands go numb and cannot decay anything until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Ruin by Name.name: Ruin by Name
Ruin by Name.description: The user lays a hand on a building or a vehicle and sends the decay all through it, unmaking only the things they name: every gun, every lock, the bars of every cell, a bomb down to its last wire. Walls, floors and every person inside are left untouched, so a whole hostage scene can be disarmed and thrown open in a single moment. Strain: severe.

Disappearing Prop.name: Disappearing Prop
Disappearing Prop.description: The user touches a weapon, a crate, a barricade or a motorcycle with an open palm and it folds into a marble-sized sphere in an instant. Someone whose weapon is taken this way is unarmed until the user releases it, and cover or a barricade in the way is gone; the user restores any sphere within reach with a snap. Strain: light.

Palm Survey.name: Palm Survey
Palm Survey.description: The user lays a palm on a wall, a crate, a car or a rubble pile and feels the shape and weight of everything inside it. They learn where any person, hollow, weapon or hidden compartment sits and which beams carry the load, so rescuers know where to dig, police know what to seize and nobody pulls the wrong piece. Strain: light.

Safekeeping Sphere.name: Safekeeping Sphere
Safekeeping Sphere.description: The user touches a person who agrees to it or is unconscious, even someone pinned under debris, and compresses them out from under any weight. Inside the sphere they are safe from smoke, fire, gas, falling debris and further injury and feel no time pass; the user can carry several people this way and must release them before the spheres open on their own. Strain: moderate.

Snap Unfold.name: Snap Unfold
Snap Unfold.description: The user flicks a stored sphere anywhere within a stone's throw and snaps it back to full size where it lands. A stored wall panel, dumpster or car set in an attack's path shields everyone behind it until it is smashed or moved; dropped onto a target instead, it deals bludgeoning damage and pins them until they shove it off or are dug out. Strain: moderate.

Unfolding Stairway.name: Unfolding Stairway
Unfolding Stairway.description: The user releases stored ladders, planks and scaffold sections against a wall or across a gap and climbs or runs over them, reaching a rooftop or crossing a street-wide gap, then pockets each piece again behind them. Released under someone falling, a stored mattress or awning catches them and sets them down unhurt. Strain: moderate.

Curtain Call.name: Curtain Call
Curtain Call.description: The user plants a palm on a struggling target and holds on. If the contact lasts until the end of the target's next turn, they fold into a sphere and are held unharmed until the user releases them or the sphere opens on its own; a shove, a blow or a dodge that breaks the contact before then stops it, and the target feels the pull begin. Strain: heavy.

Pickpocket Encore.name: Pickpocket Encore
Pickpocket Encore.description: The user moves through a group of enemies in a room in a single pass, tapping each with a palm, and every weapon, support item and piece of armor they carry folds into a sphere that drops into the user's pocket. Until those spheres are released, the whole group fights bare-handed and unprotected; anyone who steps back out of reach first keeps their gear. Strain: heavy.

Skyline Pocket.name: Skyline Pocket
Skyline Pocket.description: The user's signature move: they press both palms to a mass up to the size of a building, such as a collapsing tower, a runaway train, a landslide or a villain's armored truck, and compress it all at once. Anyone inside who does not fight the pull goes with it and comes out unharmed on release, and anyone who fights it is left in the open; afterward the user's hands shake and cannot compress until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Palmed at a Glance.name: Palmed at a Glance
Palmed at a Glance.description: The user reads the shape of what they can see within a room's width and closes a hand on it from where they stand, compressing without a touch: every gun in the room, a bomb, a door, or a hostage who does not resist, plucked from a captor's grip. Every sphere drops into the user's hand, and anyone who fights the pull is not taken. Strain: severe.

Stopgap Pane.name: Stopgap Pane
Stopgap Pane.description: The user snaps a door-sized panel into being anywhere within a few strides. Set in an attack's path, it takes the blow, blade, thrown object or handgun round meant for the person behind it; slammed into a target instead, it deals force damage and shoves them back a few steps, or, held back, only pushes them away. Strain: light.

Shelter Dome.name: Shelter Dome
Shelter Dome.description: The user curves a dome over themselves and the few people within arm's reach and holds it. Nothing gets in or out, smoke and gas included, until the user drops it or a blow too heavy for it shatters it; while holding it, the user can talk and give directions but cannot move or attack. Strain: moderate.

Clear Cage.name: Clear Cage
Clear Cage.description: The user closes a box of panels around a single target within sight. Until the end of the user's next turn, or for as long after that as the user does nothing but hold it, the target cannot leave, attack anyone outside or be reached; a heavy blow from inside shatters it, and it holds enough air for the scene. Strain: moderate.

Catching Slope.name: Catching Slope
Catching Slope.description: The user throws a slanted panel under anyone falling within sight, even from a few stories up: they strike it at an angle, slide down and land on their feet unhurt. The same slope catches a falling car, a dropped beam or a crowd tumbling down a stairway and brings them to the ground without injury. Strain: moderate.

Open-Air Stair.name: Open-Air Stair
Open-Air Stair.description: The user sets panels under their own feet a step at a time and runs up them, climbing to a rooftop or crossing a street-wide gap in open air. A few people can follow them across while the stair stands, and it vanishes once the last of them steps off. Strain: moderate.

Breakwater Wall.name: Breakwater Wall
Breakwater Wall.description: The user raises a wall of force across a whole street or corridor and braces behind it. Until the user lets it fall or the scene ends, it stops a stampeding crowd, floodwater, a sliding facade, a truck or a mob of attackers, and everyone behind it is untouched; only a blow strong enough to level a building breaks it, and the user cannot move while holding it. Strain: heavy.

Glancing Facet.name: Glancing Facet
Glancing Facet.description: The user sets a thick pane at a steep slant across the path of an attack too strong to stop head-on, such as a speeding car, a blast, gunfire or a heavy Quirk strike. The pane holds, and the attack glances off along the line its slant sets, never straight back: into the ground, the open sky or an enemy standing on that line, who takes its damage, while the person it was aimed at takes none. Strain: heavy.

Bastion Burst.name: Bastion Burst
Bastion Burst.description: The user's signature move: a dome bursts out from them to the width of a city block in a heartbeat. Every enemy it meets is hurled out, taking massive force damage and landing flat, while everyone the user chooses stays sheltered inside. Nothing passes through it until the end of the user's next turn, and the user can do nothing else while it stands; afterward they cannot raise a barrier until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Second Skin Ward.name: Second Skin Ward
Second Skin Ward.description: The user wraps a thin, close-fitting barrier around every person they choose in sight, a whole crowd at once, and each shell moves with its wearer. Until the end of the scene, each shell stops the next attack, fall, blast or crush of debris that would harm its wearer and then breaks, while the wearer can still walk, carry and fight freely. Strain: severe.

Heart Jolt.name: Heart Jolt
Heart Jolt.description: The user picks out a single person within a room's width and pushes a sharp feeling into them. Laughter doubles them over: until the end of their next turn they cannot aim a weapon or a Quirk or speak clearly; fear instead deals psychic damage and drives them a few steps back from the user. Strain: light.

Mood Sweep.name: Mood Sweep
Mood Sweep.description: The user goes still and feels every strong emotion around them, through walls and floors. They learn how many people are nearby and where, who is panicking, who hides hostility behind a calm face, and where someone trapped or hiding is holding their breath in fear. Strain: light.

Settling Tide.name: Settling Tide
Settling Tide.description: The user spreads a steady calm through every frightened person in a crowd around them, across a station platform or a whole floor. Screaming and shoving stop, and for the rest of the scene they can hear and follow simple directions, walk out in order and help the injured; only a fresh shock breaks the calm. Strain: moderate.

Wall of Dread.name: Wall of Dread
Wall of Dread.description: The user throws a wave of dread at everyone in front of them within a room's width. Each person in it takes psychic damage and, until the end of their next turn, cannot bring themselves to step toward the user, though they can still hold their ground, shoot or retreat. Strain: moderate.

Parting Wave.name: Parting Wave
Parting Wave.description: The user pushes a wave of unease ahead of them, and everyone in a packed crowd, a jammed corridor or a riot steps aside without knowing why. The user and anyone close behind them, a stretcher team or a fire crew included, pass through at a run, and the crowd closes again behind them, blocking pursuit until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: moderate.

Red Rag.name: Red Rag
Red Rag.description: The user reads what sets a single enemy off and stokes it into blind anger at the user alone. On their next turn rage drives them at the user and nobody else, charging in the open without cover, careful aim or tricks; a hostage-taker baited this way lets go of the hostage to do it. Strain: heavy.

Uproar.name: Uproar
Uproar.description: The user sets off helpless laughter in every enemy they choose across a room or a street. Until the end of their next turn, each of them can barely stand: they cannot attack, aim a weapon or a Quirk, run or give orders, and they drop anything held in both hands. Allies and bystanders nearby feel nothing. Strain: heavy.

Heartstorm.name: Heartstorm
Heartstorm.description: The user's signature move: they open completely and flood every enemy within a city block with a single feeling at its peak (terror, despair or helpless laughter). Each takes massive psychic damage and cannot attack or use a Quirk until the end of their next turn, while allies and bystanders there shake off any fear or panic; afterward the user is wrung out and cannot push feelings until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Unburdening.name: Unburdening
Unburdening.description: The user reaches into a single person within sight, finds the feeling driving them (the panic behind a Quirk running wild, a jumper's despair, a rampaging villain's rage) and lifts it out. That feeling is gone for the rest of the scene: a runaway Quirk settles, a jumper steps back from the edge, and a rampage stops long enough for someone to talk them down. Strain: severe.

Sleeve Lock.name: Sleeve Lock
Sleeve Lock.description: The user seizes the clothing of a single person within sight and pulls it tight around either their arms or their legs. Until they tear free with a hard effort or the end of their next turn, pinned sleeves keep them from swinging a weapon or throwing a punch, or bound pant legs keep them from running, and they fall if they try. Strain: light.

Weave Sense.name: Weave Sense
Weave Sense.description: The user touches any fabric, such as a carpet, a curtain, a seat or a sleeve, and feels through it to every woven thing within a room's width. They learn where people stand or hide by the clothes they wear, what weighs down a pocket or a bag, who carries a holstered gun or a hidden blade, and where someone buried under rubble lies. Strain: light.

Collar Haul.name: Collar Haul
Collar Haul.description: The user seizes the clothing of a person in danger within sight and hauls them clear by it: out of a car's path, back from a ledge, out from under falling debris or out of a villain's reach. They are pulled a few strides at once and set down on their feet, and any attack aimed at them that turn misses. Strain: moderate.

Unraveled Dragnet.name: Unraveled Dragnet
Unraveled Dragnet.description: The user unravels a curtain, a banner or a coil of rope into a wide net and casts it over a few people within a room's width. Everyone under it is tangled: they cannot run, attack or use their hands until they cut their way out, tear free with a hard effort or the user lets the net go slack. Strain: moderate.

Spun Line Swing.name: Spun Line Swing
Spun Line Swing.description: The user pulls fibers from a coat, a flag or a coil of rope into a long line, snaps its end around a railing, a pole or a ledge, and swings or climbs on it across a street, up a building face or down from a roof. A passenger can ride along holding on, and the line stays anchored until the user lets it come apart. Strain: moderate.

Loose Thread.name: Loose Thread
Loose Thread.description: The user reads the weave of every woven guard within a room's width, such as fiber body armor, padded costumes, harnesses, holsters and slings, and pulls the single thread that holds each together. All of them fall apart at once: their wearers lose that protection and whatever the straps carried drops to the floor, while ordinary clothing is left alone. Strain: heavy.

Patchwork Canopy.name: Patchwork Canopy
Patchwork Canopy.description: The user pulls every awning, flag, curtain and banner along a street or across a hall into a single thick canopy and stretches it overhead or across an opening. Until the end of the scene it catches falling glass, debris and people without letting anything through, and stretched across a gap, it bears a crowd crossing on foot. Strain: heavy.

Grand Lockstitch.name: Grand Lockstitch
Grand Lockstitch.description: The user's signature move: they seize the clothing of every enemy they can see across a street and stitch it in place, locking limbs to bodies and bodies to the ground. Until the end of the user's next turn, none of them can step from the spot, swing a limb or draw a weapon unless they wear almost no cloth; the user can do nothing else while holding, and afterward cannot move fibers until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Ironweave Guard.name: Ironweave Guard
Ironweave Guard.description: The user tightens and packs the weave of every garment worn by the people they choose in sight, a whole crowd at once, until each is stiff and dense enough to serve as body armor. For the rest of the scene that clothing stops blades, glass and thrown debris and takes the worst of blows, blasts and falls, so its wearers suffer only light harm from them, while it still moves freely. Strain: severe.

Scarlet Quills.name: Scarlet Quills
Scarlet Quills.description: The user flicks blood from a nicked fingertip and hardens the drops in flight into thin needles aimed at a target within a few strides. They deal piercing damage; held back, they only pin the target's sleeve, hem or bag strap to the wall or floor, and the target must tear free before moving away. Strain: light.

Garnet Cuffs.name: Garnet Cuffs
Garnet Cuffs.description: The user casts a thin rope of blood that wraps a target's wrists or ankles and hardens around them. The target cannot use the bound limbs until they break the cuff with a hard effort or a heavy tool, or the user lets it run liquid again, and the cuff leaves no injury. Strain: light.

Clot Seal.name: Clot Seal
Clot Seal.description: The user lays a film of their own blood over a bleeding wound, theirs or someone else's, and hardens it into a close-fitting seal. The bleeding stops and the patient can be moved without the wound reopening until a medic replaces the seal with a proper dressing; the seal heals nothing. Strain: moderate.

Tracer Drop.name: Tracer Drop
Tracer Drop.description: The user flicks a single drop of blood onto a person, a vehicle or a bag, where it hardens into a speck too small to notice without a close search. Until it is scrubbed off or the day ends, the user feels the direction and rough distance to that speck from anywhere in the same city and knows when it stops moving. Strain: moderate.

Crimson Lifeline.name: Crimson Lifeline
Crimson Lifeline.description: The user casts a long cable of blood that hardens where it strikes a ledge, a pole or a railing, then hauls themselves up a building face or swings across a street-wide gap. Cast at a person who is falling or in the water, the cable wraps around them and the user lowers or pulls them to safety. Strain: moderate.

Sanguine Dome.name: Sanguine Dome
Sanguine Dome.description: The user opens a deeper cut and spreads the blood into a curved shell over themselves and the people beside them, hardening it in an instant. Until a heavy blow breaks it or the user lets it fall, bullets, blades, thrown debris and falling rubble stop at the shell and nobody outside can reach those inside. It costs the user some health in spent blood. Strain: heavy.

Thorned Gyre.name: Thorned Gyre
Thorned Gyre.description: The user whirls a long lash of blood around their body, its outer edge hardened into serrated thorns. Every enemy within a few strides takes slashing damage and drops what they are holding, allies in reach are passed over, and ropes, cables, chain and thin sheet metal in its path are cut through. It costs the user some health in spent blood. Strain: heavy.

Vermilion Briar.name: Vermilion Briar
Vermilion Briar.description: The user's signature move: they open both palms and pour blood across the ground ahead, then harden it all at once into a thicket of spikes and thorned ropes that fills a street. Every enemy in it takes massive piercing damage and is pinned until they tear free with a hard effort or are cut loose; afterward the user is pale and dizzy, has lost a large share of their health and cannot release blood until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Lifeblood Muster.name: Lifeblood Muster
Lifeblood Muster.description: The user calls on every drop of their own blood already spilled in the scene, even blood that has dried, soaked into cloth or been trodden into the ground, and it rises at once without a new cut. They harden it into cuffs on every enemy they choose, who cannot move their arms or legs until they break free with a hard effort, into seals on every bleeding person in sight, or both. Strain: severe.

Friendly Ask.name: Friendly Ask
Friendly Ask.description: The user asks one animal within earshot for a simple favor that fits what it is: a crow drops a note on a balcony, a cat slips through a gap and knocks a latch loose, a dog barks to raise the alarm or plants itself across a doorway. The animal does it at once unless it is afraid, hurt or asked to fight. Strain: light.

Street Witnesses.name: Street Witnesses
Street Witnesses.description: The user asks the birds, cats and rats around a place what passed through it. They learn how many people came by in the last few hours, what each looked and smelled like, which way each one left and whether anyone is still hiding or trapped nearby, told in smells, sizes, colors and noise rather than names or faces. Strain: light.

Soothing Word.name: Soothing Word
Soothing Word.description: The user speaks low and steady to an animal that is panicking or attacking, from a frightened pet to a guard dog set on intruders or an animal loose from a zoo. It stops, backs away and lets people pass, and it attacks nobody for the rest of the scene unless it is hurt or cornered again. Strain: moderate.

Crow Patrol.name: Crow Patrol
Crow Patrol.description: The user sends the crows and pigeons nearby up over the surrounding blocks. Within a few minutes they come back and report where crowds are running, where smoke is rising, where someone lies hurt on a roof or in an alley, and where a person the user describes by look or smell has gone. Strain: moderate.

Catwalk Route.name: Catwalk Route
Catwalk Route.description: The user asks the neighborhood's cats to lead the way and follows them through back alleys, fence gaps and rooftop paths with anyone who keeps up. The group crosses the district faster than traffic allows, stays clear of crowds and street cameras, and loses anyone following on foot unless the pursuer can track by scent or fly. Strain: moderate.

Burrow Search.name: Burrow Search
Burrow Search.description: The user sends the rats, cats and dogs of the area into a collapsed building, a flooded underpass or a landslide to search by scent. The animals find every trapped person they can reach and lead rescuers to each one, and rats drag a light line, a flashlight or a phone through gaps too small for a person. Strain: heavy.

Corvid Mob.name: Corvid Mob
Corvid Mob.description: The user calls a flock of crows and pigeons down on a few targets at once. The birds beat their wings and claw at each target's face and hands: until the end of their next turn, those targets cannot aim, read, use a Quirk that needs sight or do anything with their hands but shield their eyes. The flock deals no lasting harm and scatters if a bird is hurt. Strain: heavy.

Great Wildcall.name: Great Wildcall
Great Wildcall.description: The user's signature move: one long call carries across several blocks, and every animal in them answers at once. Each enemy in the area is mobbed by birds and swarmed by small animals and cannot aim, run or use a Quirk that needs sight until the end of their next turn, while bystanders are led to the nearest safe exit; afterward the user's voice gives out and they cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Wild Grapevine.name: Wild Grapevine
Wild Grapevine.description: The user sets every animal in a district to watch for them until the end of the day. They learn at once when anyone they have described enters the district and where that person goes, hear of every fire, crash and person in danger there as it happens, and can have birds lead any ally in the district to them. Strain: severe.

Crag Knuckle.name: Crag Knuckle
Crag Knuckle.description: The user hardens a fist and forearm mid-swing and drives the ridged knuckles into a target within reach. It deals bludgeoning and slashing damage and knocks the target back; struck with a smoothed fist instead, it only staggers the target and leaves bruises. Strain: light.

Stone Skin.name: Stone Skin
Stone Skin.description: The user hardens their whole body in an instant as an attack comes in. Until the end of their next turn, fists, clubs, blades, thrown objects and falling debris do them no harm, a blade or club that strikes them chips or bends, and a pistol round only bruises; heat, cold, electricity, gas and sound hurt them as normal. Strain: light.

Ironclad Charge.name: Ironclad Charge
Ironclad Charge.description: The user hardens and charges headlong through whatever stands in the way. Everyone in the line of the charge takes bludgeoning damage and is thrown aside, and a wooden door, a drywall partition, a fence or a parked scooter in the path is smashed open or shoved clear. Strain: moderate.

Shell Dive.name: Shell Dive
Shell Dive.description: The user throws themselves over a person in danger and hardens around them. Until the user gets up, that person takes no harm from blows, gunfire, a blast or falling rubble, which all strike the user's back instead, and the user can still crawl to cover dragging them along. Strain: moderate.

Freefall Plunge.name: Freefall Plunge
Freefall Plunge.description: The user hardens and drops from a height of several stories, or stamps straight down through a floor to the level below, and lands unhurt. Everyone close to the landing point is knocked off their feet, and a hole punched through a floor gives rescuers a way down to people trapped beneath. Strain: moderate.

Keystone Brace.name: Keystone Brace
Keystone Brace.description: The user hardens and braces under a falling slab, a sagging ceiling or a tipping truck, taking its weight on their back and arms. While they hold, it falls no further and everyone under it can crawl or be pulled out; the user cannot move or attack while bracing and lets go at the end of the scene at the latest. Strain: heavy.

Faultline Flurry.name: Faultline Flurry
Faultline Flurry.description: The user hardens to their densest and drives a flurry of ridged blows into a target. It deals heavy bludgeoning and slashing damage, and the worn armor, riot shields, support gear and hardened skin it strikes crack apart and give no protection for the rest of the scene. Strain: heavy.

Adamant Peak.name: Adamant Peak
Adamant Peak.description: The user's signature move: they harden past their limit until the skin turns dense and glitters. Until the end of their next turn, no blow, blade, bullet or crushing weight harms them, though heat, electricity and gas still do, and their next strike deals massive bludgeoning damage and shatters any wall, vehicle or armor it lands on; afterward the hardening cracks away and they cannot harden until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Living Fortress.name: Living Fortress
Living Fortress.description: The user plants themselves at one spot and hardens into cover for a whole crowd. For the rest of the scene, as long as they stay on that spot, gunfire, blasts, falling rubble and charging attackers aimed at anyone sheltering behind them strike the user instead, and only the heaviest blows can crack their skin. Strain: severe.

Outsize Swat.name: Outsize Swat
Outsize Swat.description: The user's hand swells to the size of a car door mid-swing and swats a target within a few strides. It deals bludgeoning damage and knocks the target and anyone beside them off their feet; held back to an open-palmed shove, it only puts them flat on the ground without injury. Strain: light.

Palm Shelter.name: Palm Shelter
Palm Shelter.description: The user grows both hands and cups them over the people beside them or raises them as a wall. Until the end of the user's next turn, blows, thrown objects, gunfire and falling debris aimed at those people strike the hands instead, and the user can lift them in the cupped hands and carry them clear. Strain: light.

Giant Grip.name: Giant Grip
Giant Grip.description: The user's hand swells around a target within a few strides and closes with just enough pressure to hold. The target cannot move their arms or legs or reach anything until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go, and the user can lift and carry them in that hand. Strain: moderate.

Doubled Frame.name: Doubled Frame
Doubled Frame.description: The user grows to double their height and holds it. Until they shrink back or the scene ends, they reach second-floor windows, step over cars and barricades, carry a few adults at once, and nobody of ordinary size can wrestle or shove them; they no longer fit through doors or into vehicles. Strain: moderate.

Long Stride.name: Long Stride
Long Stride.description: The user grows their legs mid-run and crosses a city block in a few huge strides, stepping over traffic, fences and crowds or up onto a low rooftop. They can scoop a person into one arm along the way and set them down safely at the far end. Strain: moderate.

Skyline Rise.name: Skyline Rise
Skyline Rise.description: The user grows to the height of an apartment building for about a minute. While giant, their blows deal heavy bludgeoning damage, they can lift a bus, pin down a giant opponent or pluck people from upper floors, and nothing of ordinary size can push them back, but every step risks cars, pipes and windows. Strain: heavy.

Titan Footfall.name: Titan Footfall
Titan Footfall.description: The user grows one leg to giant size for a single step and brings the foot down in front of them. Everyone within a street's width ahead takes bludgeoning damage and is thrown off their feet, vehicles there bounce and stall, and the shock runs forward only, sparing the people behind the user. Strain: heavy.

Highrise Hammer.name: Highrise Hammer
Highrise Hammer.description: The user's signature move: they leap, grow to their full giant height at the top of the leap and drive a heel down onto the target. It deals massive bludgeoning damage to the target and knocks everyone within a block off their feet, cracking the street around the impact; afterward the user drops back to normal size at once and cannot grow until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Colossus Cradle.name: Colossus Cradle
Colossus Cradle.description: The user grows to giant height in a crowded street and, for the rest of the scene, moves with such care that no step breaks a window, a car or a pipe. They catch a falling bus, a derailed train car or a collapsing facade in both hands and set it down without harming anyone inside or below, and carry whole groups to safety in cupped hands. Strain: severe.

Raking Paw.name: Raking Paw
Raking Paw.description: The user's hand swells into a clawed paw mid-swing and rakes a target within reach. It deals slashing damage and drives the target back a step; swung with the back of the paw instead, it only bowls them over and leaves bruises. Strain: light.

Full Shift.name: Full Shift
Full Shift.description: The user takes their full beast form in a few seconds and holds it until they change back, tire or the scene ends. While shifted they carry a few adults on their back, break through a wooden door or a fence, smell and hear far beyond any person, and fists and knives barely mark their hide; they cannot use tools, fit through ordinary doors or say more than a few rough words. Strain: moderate.

Scent Trail.name: Scent Trail
Scent Trail.description: With the beast's nose, the user takes a person's scent from a worn item or the spot where they stood and follows it through streets, stairwells and crowds until running water or a vehicle breaks the trail. Along the way they smell gunpowder, gas leaks, fresh blood and fear, and find anyone hiding or trapped within a few rooms. Strain: moderate.

Pinning Pounce.name: Pinning Pounce
Pinning Pounce.description: The user springs at a target within a few strides and lands on them with the beast's full weight. It deals bludgeoning damage, or none if the user lands soft, and the target is knocked flat and cannot rise or use their arms until they break free with a hard effort or the user steps off. Strain: moderate.

Wall Bound.name: Wall Bound
Wall Bound.description: The user bounds up a building face on claws and powerful legs, leaps street-wide gaps between rooftops and drops down stairwells without slowing, carrying anyone who can hold on to their back. A winged form glides from roof to roof instead and can carry a single passenger. Strain: moderate.

Den Shelter.name: Den Shelter
Den Shelter.description: The user curls their full beast form around the people beside them, or braces over them on all fours. Until the user moves, gunfire, blades, thrown debris and falling rubble aimed at those people strike the user's hide instead, and the people inside stay warm, out of reach and hidden from sight. Strain: heavy.

Dread Roar.name: Dread Roar
Dread Roar.description: The user lets loose a roar that rattles windows down the block. Every enemy within a street's width who hears it cannot step toward the user or attack until the end of their next turn, and anyone without hero or combat training drops what they hold and runs; bystanders in earshot panic too, so the user must calm or clear them afterward. Strain: heavy.

Wildfang Rampage.name: Wildfang Rampage
Wildfang Rampage.description: The user's signature move: they let the beast loose for a single rampage across the whole scene that swerves around allies and bystanders. Every enemy within a street's length is struck once, taking massive slashing and bludgeoning damage and being thrown down, and barricades, vehicles and walls in the path are smashed aside; afterward the user is forced back to human form and cannot change until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Monarch Form.name: Monarch Form
Monarch Form.description: The user swells into a greater beast the size of a house and holds it for the rest of the scene. They can carry a crowd on their back, flying with them if the form has wings, knock down walls with a sweep and wade through floodwater and rubble; pistol rounds and blades only scratch their hide. They cannot go indoors, and every step damages roads and cars. Strain: severe.

Crescent Draw.name: Crescent Draw
Crescent Draw.description: The user grows a curved blade along the forearm in the middle of a swing and cuts a target within reach. It deals slashing damage; held back, the flat of the blade strikes instead and staggers the target without cutting them, or the edge slices only a strap, a sleeve or a bag the user picks. Strain: light.

Freeing Cut.name: Freeing Cut
Freeing Cut.description: The user grows a short hooked edge at the wrist or fingertip and slips it between a person and whatever binds them. Rope, tape, zip ties, seatbelts, netting and cloth part in a single draw without nicking the skin beneath, and the user can free their own hands the same way when they themselves are tied up. Strain: light.

Crossguard Catch.name: Crossguard Catch
Crossguard Catch.description: The user throws a forearm into the path of a strike aimed at them or at someone within arm's reach and grows a blade at the point of impact. The attack is stopped; a knife, bat, pipe or staff is cut through and useless, and an attacker striking barehanded takes slashing damage to the striking hand. Strain: moderate.

Pinning Thicket.name: Pinning Thicket
Pinning Thicket.description: The user drives a spray of thin blades from the forearm into the floor or wall around a target, through their sleeves, pant legs and coat but never their skin. The target is pinned where they stand: they cannot step away or raise their arms until they tear free with a hard effort, wriggle out of their clothes or the user draws the blades back. Strain: moderate.

Climbing Spurs.name: Climbing Spurs
Climbing Spurs.description: Short spurs grow from the user's palms, knees and toes and bite into brick, concrete or wood with every move. The user climbs a sheer wall or crosses a ceiling at a run and can anchor in place against wind, water or a pull; while anchored they can catch and hold a falling person, and neither of them falls. Strain: moderate.

Wreck Carver.name: Wreck Carver
Wreck Carver.description: The user carves through a crushed car roof, a jammed steel door or a heap of beams and drywall around a trapped person, shaping each cut so nothing shifts onto them. In moments there is a gap wide enough to pull the person out, and they take no harm from the cuts or from the debris settling. Strain: heavy.

Plate Cleaver.name: Plate Cleaver
Plate Cleaver.description: The user grows a single heavy blade the length of an arm and brings it down on a target with their whole weight. It deals heavy slashing damage that ignores worn armor, riot shields and hardened skin, and it splits a car door, a steel shutter or a safe's hinges in a single stroke. Strain: heavy.

Razor Bloom.name: Razor Bloom
Razor Bloom.description: The user's signature move: blades burst from every surface of the body at once, and the user spins through the enemies around them. Every enemy within a room's width takes massive slashing damage, is knocked off their feet and has every weapon they hold cut apart; afterward the user's skin is torn raw and they cannot grow blades until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Bloodless Tempest.name: Bloodless Tempest
Bloodless Tempest.description: The user crosses a whole room or a stretch of street in a single pass of cuts so fine that no skin is touched. Every weapon, gun, strap, harness and restraint the user chooses falls apart: enemies are left disarmed with their belts hanging cut, and every hostage or captive in the scene is freed of their bindings. Strain: severe.

Quick-Change Fade.name: Quick-Change Fade
Quick-Change Fade.description: The user breaks line of sight for a moment, behind a pillar, a passing bus or a crowd, and steps back out wearing a face from a sample they carry. Anyone tailing them loses the trail and must search the area to pick them out again, and descriptions already given to police no longer fit. Strain: light.

Stand-In Double.name: Stand-In Double
Stand-In Double.description: With a sample from someone in danger, the user takes their form and steps into view while the real person slips away. Until the user is exposed or reveals themselves, anyone hunting that person goes after the user instead, and the borrowed form holds even when the user is struck. Strain: moderate.

Borrowed Trust.name: Borrowed Trust
Borrowed Trust.description: Wearing the face of someone the target trusts, such as a teammate, a boss or a relative, the user walks right up to them. The target lets the user within reach, and the user's opening blow, grab or handcuffing lands before they can defend, dodge or shout a warning; a blow deals bludgeoning damage and knocks them down. Strain: moderate.

Living Key.name: Living Key
Living Key.description: The user reshapes only their fingertips, eyes or face to match a sampled person and leaves the rest of the body as it is. Until the sample runs out, fingerprint pads, face scanners, eye readers and ID photos accept the user as that person, and anyone comparing a badge to a face waves them through. Strain: moderate.

Familiar Guide.name: Familiar Guide
Familiar Guide.description: Using a sample from someone a frightened group trusts, such as a parent, a teacher or a hero they know, the user takes that person's face and voice. Panicking people stop, listen and follow the user's directions until they reach safety, and anyone hiding or refusing to move comes out to the user. Strain: moderate.

Slip the Shape.name: Slip the Shape
Slip the Shape.description: Caught in a grip, handcuffs or a tight spot, the user drops in an instant into a smaller, slimmer form from a sample they carry. Cuffs and bindings slide off, a grappler is left holding loose clothes, and the user squeezes through any gap a smaller adult could pass before changing back. Strain: heavy.

Lived-In Face.name: Lived-In Face
Lived-In Face.description: The user settles into a borrowed form for the long haul. From any sample it holds for a full day and night through sleep, pain and shock, and the user picks up the person's walk, accent, handwriting and habits, so coworkers, neighbors and casual friends accept them; only a blood test, a tracking dog, a Quirk-suppressing effect or a question only the real person could answer exposes them. Strain: heavy.

Carousel of Faces.name: Carousel of Faces
Carousel of Faces.description: The user's signature move: they weave through a group of enemies, changing form at every step, wearing each carried face and the face of any enemy whose blood or hair they took this scene. Until the end of the user's next turn, no enemy can tell the user from their own side: none can target the user, and any who attacks hits another enemy or holds back. Then the user cannot change form until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Borrowed Command.name: Borrowed Command
Borrowed Command.description: Wearing the form of a gang's boss, a crew chief or a squad leader, the user takes their place in front of their people. Until the real leader appears or the user is exposed, those people carry out any order their leader could plausibly give: releasing hostages, standing down, moving out or walking into a trap. Strain: severe.

Sledge Blow.name: Sledge Blow
Sledge Blow.description: The user's arm swells in the middle of a swing and drives a blow into a target within reach. It deals bludgeoning damage and throws the target back a few strides; pulled, the blow only knocks them down and drives the air out of their lungs, with no broken bones. Strain: light.

Rubble Lift.name: Rubble Lift
Rubble Lift.description: The user bulks through the back and legs and lifts what no unboosted person could: a fallen beam, a concrete slab, the front end of a car. They hold it up until the end of their next turn or until they set it down safely, so anyone trapped beneath can crawl out or be pulled free. Strain: moderate.

Gatecrasher.name: Gatecrasher
Gatecrasher.description: The user's hands swell and sink into a locked steel door, a security shutter or a crushed car's frame, and they tear it open in moments, wide enough for people to walk through. A door or panel torn free can be raised as a shield: until the end of the user's next turn, bullets, blows and thrown objects from the front hit it instead of the user or anyone behind them. Strain: moderate.

Vise Hold.name: Vise Hold
Vise Hold.description: The user wraps a target in swollen arms and locks the hold. The target cannot move their arms, strike or use anything they hold until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go, and each turn the user chooses to hold them harmlessly or squeeze, dealing bludgeoning damage. Strain: moderate.

Springload Leap.name: Springload Leap
Springload Leap.description: The user's legs swell and launch them onto a rooftop, across a street-wide gap or up a building's face in a single bound. They land hard enough to crack pavement but take no harm, and they can carry a person in their arms through the leap and set them down unhurt. Strain: moderate.

Pillar Stance.name: Pillar Stance
Pillar Stance.description: The user gets under a collapsing ceiling, a sagging floor, a toppling wall or a falling sign and takes its weight on their whole body. While they hold, nothing above them falls any further and everyone beneath can get out; the user cannot move or attack, and can hold until the end of the scene or until they let go. Strain: heavy.

Freight Stopper.name: Freight Stopper
Freight Stopper.description: The user plants their feet and meets a speeding car, a runaway truck or a charging giant head-on with both swollen arms. Whatever they catch stops within a few strides: people inside a vehicle are jolted but unhurt, and a charging person takes bludgeoning damage and is knocked flat. Strain: heavy.

Tectonic Haymaker.name: Tectonic Haymaker
Tectonic Haymaker.description: The user's signature move: every muscle swells to its limit and pours into a single swinging blow. It deals massive bludgeoning damage to the target and throws them through whatever stands behind them, and the shock knocks everyone near the impact off their feet; afterward the user's arm hangs limp and they cannot boost until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Skyward Heave.name: Skyward Heave
Skyward Heave.description: The user lifts a weight no human body should move: a fallen overpass span, a derailed train car or a whole collapsed floor. They raise it high enough for everyone trapped beneath to be pulled out, hold it there for the rest of the scene and set it down where they choose without crushing anyone. Strain: severe.

Snap Sprint.name: Snap Sprint
Snap Sprint.description: The user bursts into motion and crosses a room or a stretch of street before anyone can react, stopping at a chosen spot such as cover, a doorway or an ally's side. Any attack aimed at the user during the dash misses, and nobody can step in to block their path in time. Strain: light.

Drumroll Barrage.name: Drumroll Barrage
Drumroll Barrage.description: The user throws a burst of rapid punches in the time a single blow should take. It deals bludgeoning damage to a target within reach, knocks loose whatever they hold and leaves them unable to block or counter until the end of their next turn; pulled, the barrage only stings, with the same effect. Strain: light.

Passing Snatch.name: Passing Snatch
Passing Snatch.description: The user blurs past a target and plucks away something they hold or wear loose: a weapon, a detonator, a phone, keys or a bag. The target notices only after the user has stopped, and cannot use the taken thing unless they get it back. Strain: moderate.

Express Carry.name: Express Carry
Express Carry.description: The user darts in and carries a person out of danger before it lands: out of the path of a car, a falling object, an attack or a spreading fire. The danger misses them both, and the user sets the person down anywhere within a street's distance, jolted but unhurt. Strain: moderate.

Surface Sprint.name: Surface Sprint
Surface Sprint.description: The user runs fast enough to keep going where a runner should fall: straight up a building face to the roof, along a wall over a gap, or across open water for about a street's length. If they slow down partway, they drop or sink. Strain: moderate.

Smoke Funnel.name: Smoke Funnel
Smoke Funnel.description: The user sprints tight circles around a burning room, a smoke-filled stairwell or a cloud of gas and drags the air along with them. The smoke or gas spins up and out, small fires gutter out, and everyone inside can see and breathe clearly until the end of the scene unless a fire keeps feeding new smoke. Strain: heavy.

Ricochet Rush.name: Ricochet Rush
Ricochet Rush.description: The user caroms from enemy to enemy across a room or a street corner, striking each before anyone can react. Every enemy the user chooses in that area takes bludgeoning damage and is knocked off their feet, while allies and bystanders between them are passed untouched. Strain: heavy.

Mach Comet.name: Mach Comet
Mach Comet.description: The user's signature move: a long run-up squeezed into a few strides, ending in a single strike at a speed that cracks the air. It deals massive bludgeoning damage and throws the target through a wall or down the street, and the boom knocks everyone nearby off their feet; afterward the user's legs lock and they cannot speed up until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Blitz Evacuation.name: Blitz Evacuation
Blitz Evacuation.description: In the moments before a building collapses, a fire spreads or a flood arrives, the user empties the danger zone. Every person who can be moved is carried out in turn and set down safely beyond its reach, the unconscious and injured included; only people pinned under something heavy stay behind. Strain: severe.

Hollow Guard.name: Hollow Guard
Hollow Guard.description: The user turns intangible for an instant as an attack arrives, and it passes straight through them. A blow, a blade, a bullet, a blast or a thrown object aimed at the user misses entirely and keeps going into whatever lies behind them, and the user is solid again before their next action. Strain: light.

Wallwalk.name: Wallwalk
Wallwalk.description: The user takes a breath, turns intangible and walks through a wall, a door, a fence or a parked car to the open space beyond. They cannot see or hear while inside, so they move from memory; if the far side is not open, they come back out where they went in. Strain: moderate.

Periscope Peek.name: Periscope Peek
Periscope Peek.description: The user pushes their head through a wall, a door or a ceiling and turns only the head solid on the far side. They see and hear the room beyond: who is there, where each person stands and whether anyone is held captive; anyone there who looks their way sees a face in the wall. Strain: moderate.

Passthrough Counter.name: Passthrough Counter
Passthrough Counter.description: The user lets an opponent's strike pass through them and turns solid inside the opponent's reach, where the opponent cannot guard. The strike misses, and the user's counterblow deals bludgeoning damage and knocks the opponent off their feet. Strain: moderate.

Rubble Diver.name: Rubble Diver
Rubble Diver.description: The user moves through a collapsed building's rubble, surfacing into each air pocket to look and listen before going on. They find every trapped person in that part of the collapse, learn who is hurt and how badly, and mark a safe line for diggers to follow, without adding weight to the pile or shifting it. Strain: moderate.

Shared Passage.name: Shared Passage
Shared Passage.description: The user wraps their arms around a person and spreads the phase into them, then carries them through a wall, out of a crushed car or up out of rubble. For those few seconds the person cannot see, hear or breathe, nothing can hit either of them, and they come out the far side unharmed. Strain: heavy.

Shudder Run.name: Shudder Run
Shudder Run.description: The user runs straight through a line of enemies, phasing through each body on the way. Every enemy passed through feels it in every nerve: they are left dizzy and retching, drop what they hold and cannot stand or attack until the end of their next turn, with no lasting harm. Strain: heavy.

Specter Drive.name: Specter Drive
Specter Drive.description: The user's signature move: their fist phases through armor, shields and a raised guard and turns solid only as it meets the target's body. It deals massive bludgeoning damage that no armor, block or barrier reduces and throws the target off their feet; afterward the user cannot phase until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Hollow Expanse.name: Hollow Expanse
Hollow Expanse.description: The user's phase spreads into anything they touch, up to the size of a bus or a falling section of ceiling. A runaway truck passes through the crowd in its path, a collapsing slab passes through the people beneath it, or a chain of people holding hands walks through a wall of fire; until the end of the user's next turn, nothing they phase harms anyone or is harmed. Strain: severe.

Sinking Guard.name: Sinking Guard
Sinking Guard.description: The user braces and lets their body go soft. The next punch, kick, club swing, thrown object or fall they see coming before their next turn sinks in and stops, dealing them no damage, and its force is stored for their next release. Blades, bullets and blows from behind get no such help. Strain: light.

Payback Blow.name: Payback Blow
Payback Blow.description: The user drives everything they have stored into a single punch, shove or stomp against a target within reach. It deals bludgeoning damage that grows with the force stored and throws the target across the room; held back, it only shoves them off their feet unhurt. With nothing stored, it lands as an ordinary punch. Strain: light.

Living Bulwark.name: Living Bulwark
Living Bulwark.description: The user plants themselves in front of the people they protect and softens their whole body. Until the start of their next turn, blunt attacks, thrown debris and falling objects aimed at anyone directly behind them strike the user instead, deal no damage and are stored as force for the next release. Strain: moderate.

Engulfing Hold.name: Engulfing Hold
Engulfing Hold.description: The user presses into a target, or lets a punch or kick land, and draws the arm or leg deep into their soft body before clamping down. The target cannot pull free, strike with that limb or run until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go, and the hold does them no harm. Strain: moderate.

Rebound Vault.name: Rebound Vault
Rebound Vault.description: The user throws themselves hard against the ground or a wall, soaks the impact and lets it fling them back out: onto a rooftop, across a street-wide gap or into the path of a falling person, whom they catch against their soft body with no harm to either. On this move the user lands from any height unhurt. Strain: moderate.

Deep Catch.name: Deep Catch
Deep Catch.description: The user thickens their body across the path of incoming fire. Until the start of their next turn, blades, bullets, arrows and shrapnel aimed at the user or at a person they cover sink into the soft mass and stop: they deal no damage, bullets drop at the user's feet, and a blade stays held until the user lets go. Strain: heavy.

Quake Release.name: Quake Release
Quake Release.description: The user slams everything they have stored into the floor or the street. A shock runs out a room's width in every direction: every enemy standing in it takes bludgeoning damage and is knocked flat, while allies who were warned keep their feet. Driven into a single wall or a jammed door instead, it opens a passage a person can walk through. Strain: heavy.

Kinetic Reckoning.name: Kinetic Reckoning
Kinetic Reckoning.description: The user's signature move: every bit of force soaked up during the scene leaves through a single strike. It deals massive bludgeoning damage that passes through worn armor, shields and hardened skin and hurls the target through whatever stands behind them; afterward the user's body is spent and cannot soften or absorb until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Dead Stop.name: Dead Stop
Dead Stop.description: The user plants themselves in the path of a runaway truck, a falling slab, a giant's fist or the blast wave of an explosion and takes the whole impact into their body. It sinks in and stops within a stride: nobody behind the user is hurt, nobody aboard a stopped vehicle is thrown, and the force is stored for the user's next release. Strain: severe.

Pincer Snap.name: Pincer Snap
Pincer Snap.description: The user's hand swells into the claw of a crab, lobster or shrimp they have eaten and snaps shut on a target within reach. It deals slashing damage; held back, the claw clamps a wrist or ankle without cutting, and the target cannot pull that limb free until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Suckerline Reach.name: Suckerline Reach
Suckerline Reach.description: The user's fingers stretch into the tentacles of octopus or squid they have eaten, long enough to cross a small room. They can grab a person or object in that reach and pull them in, wrap a target's arms so they cannot strike until they break free with a hard effort, or fix the suckers to a wall or ceiling and haul themselves up. Strain: light.

Clamshell Cover.name: Clamshell Cover
Clamshell Cover.description: Shell from clams, oysters, scallops or crab they have eaten spreads over the user's back, chest and forearms, and they can close their arms around a person they hold. Until the start of the user's next turn, blades, clubs, thrown debris and falling rubble that hit the shell deal no damage to either of them; the first bullet is stopped but cracks it open, ending the cover. Strain: moderate.

Wingspread Descent.name: Wingspread Descent
Wingspread Descent.description: Wings grown from chicken, duck or other fowl they have eaten spread from the user's back. They glide down from any height and land safely while carrying a single person in their arms, and a few hard beats lift them onto a low rooftop or across a street-wide gap; they cannot climb any higher. Strain: moderate.

Ink Screen.name: Ink Screen
Ink Screen.description: The user's palms swell with the ink sacs of squid or cuttlefish they have eaten and blast out a black cloud that fills a room or a stretch of street. Until the end of the user's next turn nobody can see into or through it, and anyone hit in the face by the jet is blinded until they wipe their eyes clear; the ink does no harm and washes off. Strain: moderate.

Horned Charge.name: Horned Charge
Horned Charge.description: Horns and hooves from beef or goat they have eaten grow from the user's head and feet, and they charge in a straight line across a room. Every enemy in the line takes bludgeoning damage and is thrown aside, and doors, drywall and barricades in the way break open; held back, the charge only shoves people out of the path unhurt. Strain: heavy.

Crusher Claw.name: Crusher Claw
Crusher Claw.description: One arm swells into a crusher claw the size of the user's torso, grown from crab or lobster eaten that day. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage that ignores worn armor, shields and hardened skin, and it shears through steel bars, car doors and rebar, so it can cut trapped people out of a wreck in moments. Strain: heavy.

Banquet Form.name: Banquet Form
Banquet Form.description: The user's signature move: every feature from that day's meals erupts into one hybrid form of claws, shell, tentacles and wings. Until the end of their next turn they strike with claws and tentacles in one action, dealing slashing and bludgeoning damage, glide on the wings, and take no damage from blades or blunt blows on the shell until a heavy blow cracks it; afterward they cannot manifest until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Hundred-Arm Haven.name: Hundred-Arm Haven
Hundred-Arm Haven.description: After a meal of octopus or squid, the user grows dozens of tentacles from their arms and back, each long enough to cross a street, and works every one at once. In a single action they catch everyone falling in the area and set them down unhurt, pin every chosen enemy so they cannot move or strike until they break free with a hard effort or are released, and brace a collapsing structure while everyone beneath is lowered out. Strain: severe.

Leaping Lunge.name: Leaping Lunge
Leaping Lunge.description: The user crosses the distance to a target within a few strides in a single bound on their animal legs and lands a blow with their natural weapon. Claws or teeth deal slashing damage, and a kick, headbutt or tail deals bludgeoning damage; either way, the target is knocked off their feet. Strain: light.

Keen Read.name: Keen Read
Keen Read.description: The user stops and reads the area with their animal's sharpest sense: a dog's nose, a cat's or rabbit's ears, a frog's eye for movement or a lizard's tongue tasting the air. They learn where everyone on that floor or stretch of street is, including anyone hiding, can tell fear, blood or a drawn weapon on a person, and pick up any trail left in the last hour. Strain: light.

Wall Runner.name: Wall Runner
Wall Runner.description: The user goes straight up a sheer wall, a cliff face or the side of a building with their animal's grip, claws or spring, and runs across rooftops at full speed. They can carry a single person on their back while doing it, and that passenger cannot fall while the user holds them. Strain: moderate.

Raised Hackles.name: Raised Hackles
Raised Hackles.description: The user's animal instincts flag danger a heartbeat early. Until the start of their next turn, neither they nor a person beside them can be caught by surprise, and the first attack aimed at either of them, even a sniper's shot or an ambush from behind, misses as the user pulls them both clear. Strain: moderate.

Lifeline Snatch.name: Lifeline Snatch
Lifeline Snatch.description: With a long tongue or a gripping tail, or with jaws or hooked claws after a quick lunge, the user snatches a person or object within a few meters. They can pull someone who is falling or drowning to safety, yank a weapon out of a hand, or wrap a target's arms so they cannot strike until they break free with a hard effort. Strain: moderate.

Feral Strike.name: Feral Strike
Feral Strike.description: The user puts the full strength of their animal body behind a single blow with its strongest weapon: a rabbit's kick, a bear's claws, a crocodile's jaws or a lizard's tail. It deals heavy slashing or bludgeoning damage that cracks worn armor and throws the target across the room; held back, it drops them winded and unable to fight until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Ricochet Rampage.name: Ricochet Rampage
Ricochet Rampage.description: The user bounds from floor to wall to ceiling around a room, an alley or a train car, never still long enough to be aimed at. Every enemy in that space takes a hit from their natural weapons, dealing slashing or bludgeoning damage, and none of them can target the user until the end of their next turn; the user lands wherever they choose. Strain: heavy.

Apex Pounce.name: Apex Pounce
Apex Pounce.description: The user's signature move: they bound off every surface in reach to build speed, rise above the rooftops, then drop onto a single target with their strongest natural weapon. It deals massive slashing or bludgeoning damage, knocks everyone around the impact off their feet and leaves a crater; afterward the user's legs are spent and they cannot bound or sprint until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Every Heartbeat.name: Every Heartbeat
Every Heartbeat.description: The user opens every sense their animal body has across a whole city block for the rest of the scene. They know where every living person in it is, who is hurt and how badly, who is hiding or lying in wait, and which way anyone flees; nobody there can ambush the user or the allies they warn, and trapped survivors are found without searching. Strain: severe.

Snap Takeoff.name: Snap Takeoff
Snap Takeoff.description: The user snaps their wings open and launches in a single beat: onto a rooftop, across a street or river, or out of the path of an incoming attack, which misses them. They can land anywhere in sight or stay aloft and circle until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Wingbeat Gust.name: Wingbeat Gust
Wingbeat Gust.description: The user plants their feet and drives both wings forward in one hard beat. Everyone in front within a few strides is pushed back a step and cannot close on the user until the end of their next turn, smoke, gas and dust there are blown clear, and thrown objects in flight are knocked aside; the gust deals no damage. Strain: light.

Skyhook Carry.name: Skyhook Carry
Skyhook Carry.description: The user swoops down, catches a single person from a window ledge, a rooftop, a river or the middle of a fall, and flies them anywhere in sight. The passenger takes no damage from the fall or the flight, and the user cannot attack while carrying them. Strain: moderate.

Overwatch Circle.name: Overwatch Circle
Overwatch Circle.description: The user climbs high and circles over the scene. They see every person in the open across several blocks, where a fire or flood is spreading, where enemies are moving and which routes out are clear, and allies who hear their calls cannot be surprised by anything the user can see from above. Strain: moderate.

Stoop Strike.name: Stoop Strike
Stoop Strike.description: The user climbs, folds their wings and drops on a target, snapping them open at the last instant to sweep past at head height. The wings' hard leading edges deal slashing damage, and the user is back out of reach before the target can strike back; held back, they hit with the flat of a wing and only knock the target down. Strain: moderate.

Quill Storm.name: Quill Storm
Quill Storm.description: The user sheds a cloud of stiffened feathers and steers each one by will out to a street's width. The feathers can slash a target for slashing damage, cut ropes, straps and cables, or pin a person's clothes to a wall or the ground so they cannot move until they tear free. Shed feathers take days to regrow, and only feathered wings can do this. Strain: heavy.

Canopy Guard.name: Canopy Guard
Canopy Guard.description: The user drops over a group of people and wraps their wings around them in a tight canopy. Until the start of the user's next turn, falling rubble and glass, flames, thrown objects and the blast of an explosion strike the wings instead: the people under them take no damage, and the user takes it on the wings. Strain: heavy.

Peregrine Pass.name: Peregrine Pass
Peregrine Pass.description: The user's signature move: they climb out of sight, fold their wings and drop faster than any car, then snap them open at street level and tear down a whole street in one pass. Every enemy along it takes massive slashing damage and is thrown off their feet, and the wind of the pass shatters windows; afterward the user's wings are spent and they cannot fly until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Skyward Exodus.name: Skyward Exodus
Skyward Exodus.description: The user flies so fast and so precisely through a burning, flooded or collapsing building that in a single action they clear a whole floor of it. Every person on that floor is carried out through windows and gaps and set down safely, and none of them takes damage from the flight, the smoke or the fall. Strain: severe.

Slipstream Dash.name: Slipstream Dash
Slipstream Dash.description: The user drives through the water with fins, webbed limbs or a tail and crosses a river, a flooded street or a stretch of harbor in moments. They can reach a swimmer and pull them along, launch out onto a pier or a boat deck at the end, or ram a target in the water, dealing bludgeoning damage and leaving them too winded to swim or strike until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Deepwater Breath.name: Deepwater Breath
Deepwater Breath.description: The user fills their lungs and seals them for several minutes, in water or out of it. Until they breathe again they can swim through polluted water, cross a smoke-filled building and stand in tear gas, knockout gas or toxic fumes without breathing any of it in; anything that burns the eyes or skin still harms them. Strain: light.

Sonar Sweep.name: Sonar Sweep
Sonar Sweep.description: The user sends out a string of clicks and reads the echoes: underwater out to a harbor's width, on land across a building's floor. They learn the layout, where every person and vehicle is, including anyone trapped in a sunken car, an air pocket or rubble, and who is moving; darkness, mud and smoke do not block it. Strain: moderate.

Riptide Tow.name: Riptide Tow
Riptide Tow.description: The user gathers several people in the water, holds their heads clear and tows them through rip currents, floodwater or surf to the nearest safe footing. While the user holds them, none of them can be pulled under or swept away, and a panicking swimmer cannot drag the user down. Strain: moderate.

Slickskin Slip.name: Slickskin Slip
Slickskin Slip.description: The user's skin flushes with a thick, slick coat. They slide out of any grab, hold, handcuffs, rope or capture tape at once, and until the end of their next turn nobody can get a grip on them; on wet or smooth ground they can slide on their belly at a sprinter's speed. Strain: moderate.

Tail Hammer.name: Tail Hammer
Tail Hammer.description: The user swings a heavy tail, or slams their whole dense body, into a target within reach. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage and throws the target off their feet or clear out of the water; held back, it only knocks them flat and winded, unable to rise until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Keel Breaker.name: Keel Breaker
