Keel Breaker.description: The user rams a vessel or vehicle at full swimming speed, from below or from the side. A fleeing boat or jet ski stops dead or flips, a hull is holed, and a sunken car's door or windshield caves in so the people inside can be pulled out; against a person it deals heavy bludgeoning damage that ignores worn armor. Strain: heavy.

Leviathan Breach.name: Leviathan Breach
Leviathan Breach.description: The user's signature move: they rocket up out of deep water, or charge from a long running start on land, and drive their whole dense body into a target. It deals massive bludgeoning damage, knocks everyone around the impact off their feet and, from water, throws up a wall of spray that nobody can see through until the end of the user's next turn; afterward the user is winded and cannot dash until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Floodtide Vigil.name: Floodtide Vigil
Floodtide Vigil.description: For the rest of the scene the user works a flooded district, a capsized ferry or a storm-tossed harbor without leaving the water or surfacing for air. They find every person in the water or trapped beneath it and bring each of them to air and footing before they drown; nobody the user reaches is lost to the water. Strain: severe.

Crossing Blows.name: Crossing Blows
Crossing Blows.description: The user strikes a single target within reach with several limbs at once, each blow arriving from a different angle. It deals bludgeoning damage, and the target cannot block or parry it with a single guard or shield; held back, the limbs only buffet and shove, driving the target back a few steps without injury. Strain: light.

Many-Handed Bind.name: Many-Handed Bind
Many-Handed Bind.description: The user wraps spare limbs around a person within reach and pins their arms to their sides or their legs together. Until the person breaks free with a hard effort or the user lets go, they cannot use the pinned limbs or anything held in them, while the user's own hands stay free to cuff them, search them or keep working. Strain: light.

Stretcher Arms.name: Stretcher Arms
Stretcher Arms.description: The user gathers several injured or trapped people at once, one to each spare limb, bracing each person's neck, back and hips, and carries them out at a steady jog. Nobody carried takes further harm from being moved, a person with a neck or spine injury is held still, and the user keeps a hand free for doors, debris or guiding others. Strain: moderate.

Budding Lookout.name: Budding Lookout
Budding Lookout.description: The user buds a working eye, ear or mouth at the tip of a limb and slides it around a corner, through a cracked door or into a gap in rubble. They see or hear from the tip while their body stays behind cover, and a budded mouth lets them talk a trapped person through the wait; a blow to the bud hurts the user, and it sinks back when they let it go. Strain: moderate.

Scaffold Scramble.name: Scaffold Scramble
Scaffold Scramble.description: The user climbs with every limb at once, catching ledges, pipes, balconies and window frames, and sprints up a sheer building face or swings across a street from cable to sign to balcony. A spare limb can carry a single passenger, and the user can stop anywhere on the wall and hang there with their own hands free to work. Strain: moderate.

Pillar of Arms.name: Pillar of Arms
Pillar of Arms.description: The user plants their feet and braces a sagging ceiling, a fallen girder or an overturned car on their extra limbs, holding it off the people beneath. Until the user lets go, moves or is knocked down, nothing they hold sinks further, falling debris strikes the user's limbs instead of the people under them, and the user's own hands stay free to pull people out. Strain: heavy.

Round-Up Slam.name: Round-Up Slam
Round-Up Slam.description: The user's limbs lash out at the opponents around them, seizing as many as they have extra limbs, and slam them into the ground or into each other. Each seized opponent takes bludgeoning damage, drops what they hold and stays pinned down until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go. Strain: heavy.

Anvil Embrace.name: Anvil Embrace
Anvil Embrace.description: The user's signature move: some limbs lock a single opponent in place while the rest hammer them from every side at once. The target cannot dodge, block or pull away, takes massive bludgeoning damage and is thrown down at the end with any shield or held weapon broken; afterward the user's extra limbs hang numb and cannot grip or strike until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Every Hand at Work.name: Every Hand at Work
Every Hand at Work.description: The user splits their limbs among separate tasks and works them all at once. Until the end of their next turn, each limb, their own arms included, takes its own action on a different person or object: a pin, a catch, a strike, a carry, first aid or forcing a jammed door, and none of these actions slows or weakens the others. Strain: severe.

Trail Reader.name: Trail Reader
Trail Reader.description: The user fixes on a person's scent, voice, footsteps or the marks they leave and follows the trail through crowds, streets and stairwells. They know which way the person went and roughly how long ago, as long as the trail is hours old rather than days; rain, bleach, running water or a ride in a vehicle breaks it. Strain: light.

Pulse in the Crowd.name: Pulse in the Crowd
Pulse in the Crowd.description: The user filters a busy scene down to a single person within a street's distance and tracks their words, breathing, pulse and sweat over the noise. Until the end of the scene the user can follow them through the crowd and notices each time their pulse jumps or their breath catches at something said, which shows stress, not truth. Strain: light.

Forewarned.name: Forewarned
Forewarned.description: The user catches the click of a safety, the scrape of a shoe or the breath drawn before a lunge. Until the start of the user's next turn, nobody can surprise the user or a person beside them, and the first attack aimed at either of them misses, because the user calls it out and gets them both out of the way in time. Strain: moderate.

Spotter's Call.name: Spotter's Call
Spotter's Call.description: The user locks onto an enemy hidden by smoke, darkness, foliage or an invisibility Quirk and calls out their exact position. Until the end of the user's next turn, the user and every ally who hears the call can aim at that enemy without seeing them, and the enemy cannot move or hide without the user calling out the new spot. Strain: moderate.

Lead in the Dark.name: Lead in the Dark
Lead in the Dark.description: The user shuts out the noise and moves at a full run through total darkness, thick smoke, fog or a rubble maze, guided by sound, air currents and scent. A line of people holding on behind them keeps the same pace without stumbling or getting lost, and the user steers everyone around gas, fire and floors that will not hold. Strain: moderate.

Breath Census.name: Breath Census
Breath Census.description: The user goes still and takes in a whole collapsed building, a flooded block or a smoke-filled site at once: breathing, heartbeats, tapping, blood and sweat. They learn where every living person in it is, whether each is conscious, breathing or bleeding, and who is in the worst danger, and can lead rescuers straight to each of them. Strain: heavy.

Behind the Mask.name: Behind the Mask
Behind the Mask.description: The user reads a person or a room down to the faintest trace. Until the end of the scene, a disguised, transformed or impersonating person's own scent and pulse give them away even when face and voice match, and a concealed weapon or explosive, a drugged drink, a hidden compartment and a false wall all show themselves to the user. Strain: heavy.

A Moment Ahead.name: A Moment Ahead
A Moment Ahead.description: The user's signature move: every sense locks onto a single opponent until the user knows each movement a moment before it starts. Until the end of the user's next turn, that opponent's attacks against the user all miss and the user's own attacks on them cannot be dodged or blocked; afterward the senses white out, and the user is deaf and cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Needle in the City.name: Needle in the City
Needle in the City.description: The user names a person they have smelled, heard or seen before and sifts a whole city district for them through traffic, crowds, rain and walls. They learn where that person is now and the way to reach them, even if the person is disguised, invisible or underground, or their trail is days old, and can lead others straight there. Strain: severe.

Empty-Air Strike.name: Empty-Air Strike
Empty-Air Strike.description: The user bends the light around a gloved fist, a shoe or a short baton for an instant and strikes from apparently empty air. It deals bludgeoning damage, and the target cannot see it coming to dodge or block it; held back, it only knocks them off balance and leaves them unsure where the blow came from. Strain: light.

Out of Mind.name: Out of Mind
Out of Mind.description: The user goes still and silent where nobody's eyes rest, with nothing visible on them. Anyone not actively searching for the user loses track of them and speaks and acts freely, taking the user for gone, until the user moves quickly, makes a sound, touches someone or is found by a sense other than sight. Strain: light.

Cupped Daylight.name: Cupped Daylight
Cupped Daylight.description: The user gathers the light passing through their body into cupped palms and opens them at a target's eyes in a sudden white flash. The target is dazzled until the end of their next turn: they cannot aim, read signals or track the user, though they take no damage. A target who looks away in time or wears tinted lenses is unaffected. Strain: moderate.

Sight-Line Survey.name: Sight-Line Survey
Sight-Line Survey.description: The user studies a room, a floor or a guarded lot and maps every camera angle, mirror, reflecting window and guard's line of sight, including hidden cameras and one-way glass. Until the end of the scene, the user can cross that space unseen by any of them, even in visible clothes, and can lead a single person along the same blind route. Strain: moderate.

Clear-Air Dash.name: Clear-Air Dash
Clear-Air Dash.description: The user bends the light around everything they wear and carry and breaks into a sprint across a street, through a crowd or past a checkpoint. Attacks aimed at them as they go miss, and enemies who rely on sight lose track of them until the user attacks or speaks, or until the end of their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Shared Shade.name: Shared Shade
Shared Shade.description: The user holds a person close, or a bundle no bigger than a person, and bends the light around both of them. While the user keeps hold and moves no faster than a walk, the held person and everything they wear are invisible too, so a hostage can be walked out past guards; it ends if the user lets go, takes a hard hit or the scene ends. Strain: heavy.

Lens Point.name: Lens Point
Lens Point.description: The user cups the light gathered through their body into a single white-hot point and holds it on a target. It deals heavy light damage that burns through worn armor and padding, and within moments it cuts rope, zip ties, cuffs or a padlock without harming the person bound by them. It needs daylight or bright lamps to draw on. Strain: heavy.

Glass Sun.name: Glass Sun
Glass Sun.description: The user's signature move: all the light passing through the user's body gathers at once and bursts out of them in a blaze that floods the area. Every enemy facing the user within a street's width takes massive light damage and is blinded until the end of their next turn, while allies warned to look away are spared; afterward the user flickers faintly into view and cannot bend light until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Empty Street.name: Empty Street
Empty Street.description: The user bends the light around every person linked to them by touch, through joined hands, a hand on a shoulder or a rope held between them, and around everything those people wear and carry. While the chain holds and nobody runs, the whole group stays invisible for the rest of the scene, so civilians can be walked out past a villain or a team can cross open ground unseen. Strain: severe.

Piston Kick.name: Piston Kick
Piston Kick.description: The user fires the engines behind a single kick, or a punch for arm thrusters, at a target within reach. It deals bludgeoning damage and throws the target off their feet and back across the room; held back, the thrust only shoves them away and puts them on the ground without injury. Strain: light.

Throttle Dash.name: Throttle Dash
Throttle Dash.description: The user opens the engines to full and races up to a city block in a straight line or a wide curve, outpacing cars on a city street. They arrive before anyone there can act, can snatch up an object or a light person on the way, and need a long skid to stop. Strain: light.

Turbine Sweep.name: Turbine Sweep
Turbine Sweep.description: The user plants a foot and spins on it with the engines firing, sweeping the other leg through a full circle at knee height. Every opponent within reach all around takes bludgeoning damage and is knocked flat, and any of them gripping a hostage or a weapon is forced to let go. Strain: moderate.

Thruster Shuttle.name: Thruster Shuttle
Thruster Shuttle.description: The user runs a rescue shuttle at engine speed: into a burning building, a crash site or a flooded street and back out with an injured person, again and again. In the time others carry a single person to safety the user carries several, and nobody carried takes harm from the speed, the turns or the stops. Strain: moderate.

Facade Sprint.name: Facade Sprint
Facade Sprint.description: The user hits a building face at full speed and runs straight up it on engine thrust to a rooftop or a high window, or clears a street-wide gap from a running start. They can carry a single passenger, and if they lose their footing the engines slow their fall into a safe landing. Strain: moderate.

Cut-In Save.name: Cut-In Save
Cut-In Save.description: The user sees a falling sign, a speeding car or an attack about to hit someone and gets there first from anywhere within a city block. They either carry the person clear or kick the threat off course, and the person takes no harm; a thrown object, a swinging weapon or a car door kicked aside hits nobody. Strain: heavy.

Redline Ram.name: Redline Ram
Redline Ram.description: The user charges at top speed shoulder-first along a straight line and does not stop for what is in the way. Every enemy along a street-length line takes heavy bludgeoning damage and is thrown aside, and the user bursts through a door or an inner wall, knocks a parked car out of the way and keeps going; the charge cannot pick targets, so anyone else in the line is hit too. Strain: heavy.

Afterburner Comet.name: Afterburner Comet
Afterburner Comet.description: The user's signature move: the engines are forced past their redline for a single flying kick too fast for the eye to follow. It deals massive bludgeoning damage, breaks through any guard, shield or armor and drives the target through the wall behind them; afterward the engines stall and the user cannot run or kick with them until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Full Stop.name: Full Stop
Full Stop.description: The user runs down anything moving on the ground, from a getaway car or a runaway bus to a fleeing speedster, and matches speed alongside. They plant their heels and fire the engines against the motion: a vehicle halts without crashing or rolling, so nobody aboard is hurt, and a fleeing person is pinned until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go. Strain: severe.

Accepted Blow.name: Accepted Blow
Accepted Blow.description: The user steps into an attack instead of avoiding it, takes the blow and uses the opening it leaves. The user still takes the attack's damage, but the attacker cannot dodge or block the counterblow, which deals bludgeoning damage; held back, the counter only throws the attacker off balance and drives them back. Strain: light.

Knit Shut.name: Knit Shut
Knit Shut.description: The user drives the healing into their own fresh wounds and forces them shut in moments. Bleeding from cuts and grazes stops, a sprain, a cracked rib or a dislocated joint sets, and injuries from the current fight stop slowing the user; a broken bone or a burn still heals at the usual pace. Strain: moderate.

Bare-Hand Catch.name: Bare-Hand Catch
Bare-Hand Catch.description: The user grabs a blade, a bat or a fist barehanded and takes the cut or the impact; a cut palm heals shut around the blade and locks it in place. The attacker cannot pull free or use that hand or weapon until they let go of the weapon, break free with a hard effort or the user releases them, and the user's hand heals as soon as the grip ends. Strain: moderate.

Burn It Out.name: Burn It Out
Burn It Out.description: The user turns their healing on their own blood and burns through whatever is in it. Poison, venom, a sedative, sleeping gas, alcohol or a Quirk-boosting drug stops affecting them within moments, along with the dizziness, nausea or drowsiness it caused, and more of the same substance has no effect on them until the end of the scene. Any damage it already dealt remains. Strain: moderate.

Bone-Set Landing.name: Bone-Set Landing
Bone-Set Landing.description: The user jumps from a rooftop, a high window or a bridge, or crashes through glass or a fence at a run, and lets the body take the damage. They take the fall's damage but land on their feet and keep moving at full speed, with fractures from the landing setting as they go, so the drop never stops or slows them. Strain: moderate.

Smoke Eater.name: Smoke Eater
Smoke Eater.description: The user walks into a burning room, a hall full of smoke or gas, or icy floodwater, reaches the people trapped there and brings them out. Until the end of the scene the user takes the hazard's damage but is never stopped by it: smoke does not knock them out, heat and cold do not drop them, and burns close as they work. The people they carry still need air. Strain: heavy.

Mending Bulwark.name: Mending Bulwark
Mending Bulwark.description: The user throws their body over the people beside them, or spreads their arms in front of a group, and takes everything meant for them. Until the start of the user's next turn, every attack, blast, bullet and piece of falling debris aimed at those people strikes the user instead; the sheltered people take no damage, and the user's wounds start closing at once. Strain: heavy.

Unbroken March.name: Unbroken March
Unbroken March.description: The user's signature move: the body heals as fast as it is hurt, and the user walks straight at a single target in sight. Attacks still wound them, but nothing short of a solid wall stops or slows them, and on arrival they seize the target, who cannot move until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go; afterward the user cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

From the Marrow.name: From the Marrow
From the Marrow.description: The user pours everything into a single surge that rebuilds their own body at once. Every wound, burn and broken bone in them heals and any poison burns away, they get up from serious injury ready to fight, and a limb, eye or organ they lost earlier regrows over the following night; afterward they are starving and heal no faster than an ordinary person until they eat a large meal. Strain: severe.

Color-Tag Triage.name: Color-Tag Triage
Color-Tag Triage.description: The user moves through a group of casualties, checking breathing, bleeding and response in seconds each, and tags each person red, yellow, green or black by urgency. The user learns who is dying, who can wait and who can walk, and stops the most dangerous bleed among them in the same action. Stamina: brief.

Hold the Pulse.name: Hold the Pulse
Hold the Pulse.description: The user works on a dying patient with whatever is at hand, holding the airway open, packing wounds, treating shock and doing chest compressions if the heart stops. The patient stops getting worse and survives until an ambulance, a hospital or a healing Quirk takes over, as long as the user stays with them or hands them to a trained medic. Stamina: demanding.

Knock and Listen.name: Knock and Listen
Knock and Listen.description: The user shouts into the debris, orders silence across the site, then listens and feels for knocks, voices and shifting dust throughout the collapse. The user learns where every trapped person who can make a sound or move is, and which of them can be reached without bringing more debris down. Stamina: brief.

Crib and Lift.name: Crib and Lift
Crib and Lift.description: The user levers a fallen slab up a little at a time, stacking timber, bricks or anything solid under it after every lift. It takes minutes rather than seconds, but a pinned person comes free without the load shifting onto them, and the stacked supports keep that part of the structure from collapsing further, even after the user moves on and even if the building is failing elsewhere. Stamina: heavy.

Deep Void Extraction.name: Deep Void Extraction
Deep Void Extraction.description: The user goes where no stretcher fits, such as a flooded basement, a burning floor or a crawlspace under a failing slab, then straps the victim into a harness and hauls them out by rope. The user can reach and bring out a trapped person anywhere their own body fits, and the victim takes no further injury on the way out, though the user still faces the fire, water and debris. Stamina: extreme.

Stairwell Clear.name: Stairwell Clear
Stairwell Clear.description: The user plants themselves at the choke point of a stairwell, corridor or exit and sorts a panicking crowd into a moving line with short, loud commands. Everyone in that crowd gets through without anyone being trampled or crushed, as long as the user holds the choke point and does nothing else. Cost: none.

Sweep and Count.name: Sweep and Count
Sweep and Count.description: The user splits a crowd into small groups, names a calm person to lead each group, sends them out by different exits, then counts heads at the assembly point. A whole floor, station platform or street block empties in a single action, and the user knows exactly who is still missing and where each of them was last seen. Cost: none.

Crossfire Corridor.name: Crossfire Corridor
Crossfire Corridor.description: The user times a crowd's movement to the fight around it, holding people behind cover and sending them through during each lull in the attacks. Bystanders cross or leave an active battle zone without any of them being hit by stray attacks or falling debris, as long as the user stays with them and does nothing else. Stamina: demanding.

Wrist Wrap.name: Wrist Wrap
Wrist Wrap.description: The user pins a subdued or cornered target's arms and binds the wrists behind their back with capture tape, cuffs, zip ties or cloth in a single motion. The target cannot use their hands or arms, including any Quirk aimed or emitted through the palms, until someone cuts them free or they break the binding with a feat of strength or Quirk power. Stamina: brief.

Running Snare.name: Running Snare
Running Snare.description: The user throws a weighted line, a capture cloth or a loop of tape around the legs of a target who is still running or fighting, yanks it tight and anchors the other end to a post, a railing or the user's own planted weight. The target falls and cannot use their legs, and pulling at the line does not free them: someone must cut them loose, or they must break it with a feat of strength or Quirk power. Stamina: demanding.

Custody Bind.name: Custody Bind
Custody Bind.description: The user binds a subdued target for transport: limbs strapped, eyes covered, mouth gagged, and any tail, wings or extra limbs pinned to the body. Until the user hands them over or someone frees them, the target cannot use any Quirk that needs sight, speech, movement or touch, and cannot get out of the binding without outside help. Stamina: demanding.

Slip the Line.name: Slip the Line
Slip the Line.description: The user reads the attacker's shoulders and eyes, steps off the line of the attack at the last instant and comes out at the attacker's side. A single melee attack misses, and the user ends beside the attacker with an open flank to strike or a clear path to run. Stamina: brief.

Volley Weave.name: Volley Weave
Volley Weave.description: The user watches the hand, barrel or glow that starts a ranged attack and moves before it fires, weaving through the spread. The user avoids every projectile or beam in a single volley, including a scattered spray, as long as they can see where it comes from. Stamina: demanding.

Blast Gap Dive.name: Blast Gap Dive
Blast Gap Dive.description: When an explosion, a shock wave or a collapse fills the area, the user dives for the only gap in it: behind a pillar, at the edge of the blast, under a slab that holds. The user takes no harm from an area attack or falling structure they see coming, and can drag a person within arm's reach into the gap with them. Stamina: heavy.

Rolled Guard.name: Rolled Guard
Rolled Guard.description: The user takes a blow on the forearms, a shield or a hardened part of the body and turns with it, sending the force along the guard. A punch, kick or blunt weapon that would cause a serious injury causes only a minor one, and the user stays on their feet even if the blow should knock them down. It turns blows of human strength, not a Quirk-powered blow that could send a person through a wall. Stamina: brief.

Body Between.name: Body Between
Body Between.description: The user throws themselves into the path of an attack aimed at someone within a few steps and takes it on a planted guard. The intended target takes no harm, and the injury the user takes from the hit is a category lighter than an unguarded hit would cause. Stamina: demanding.

Rooted Guard.name: Rooted Guard
Rooted Guard.description: Facing a blow strong enough to send a person through a wall, the user drops their stance, braces against the ground and meets it on a locked guard. The user is not knocked back or down, the injury is a category lighter than the blow would cause, and the attacker is left off balance and open to the user's next action. Stamina: heavy.

Blind-Side Cover.name: Blind-Side Cover
Blind-Side Cover.description: The user calls a direction and shifts to guard a partner's blind side as the partner moves or attacks. Until the user's next action, the partner cannot be flanked, ambushed or hit from behind: any such attack has to get past the user first. Stamina: brief.

Setup Relay.name: Setup Relay
Setup Relay.description: The user boosts a partner into the fight: cupped hands under a foot, a shoulder to spring from or a two-handed throw. The partner reaches a spot they could not reach alone in time, such as a rooftop, the far side of a gap or an opponent in the air, and attacks, grabs or rescues on arrival in the same action. Works only on a partner the user can lift or push. Stamina: demanding.

Unison Blow.name: Unison Blow
Unison Blow.description: The user and a partner time their attacks, Quirks or gear into a single combined blow: wind feeding a fire, an impact shattering fresh ice, a hold pinning a target in front of a strike. The combination deals the damage types of both parts and breaks through a defense that could stop either part alone; any Quirk used in it still costs its usual Strain. Stamina: heavy.

Opening Read.name: Opening Read
Opening Read.description: The user studies an opponent through a few exchanges, watching stance, footing and habits until a pattern shows. The user learns a concrete weakness the opponent has in this fight, such as a guard that drops after a kick or a bad knee, and the next attack aimed at it by the user or an ally ignores the opponent's guard. Cost: none.

Chosen Ground.name: Chosen Ground
Chosen Ground.description: The user draws the fight onto ground that works against an opponent's strength: a slick floor against a charger, a low ceiling against a flier, a cluttered room against a sniper, open ground against an ambusher. While the fight stays there, the opponents lose the one advantage the user chose to deny: speed, reach, range, flight or surprise. Stamina: brief.

Doorway Scan.name: Doorway Scan
Doorway Scan.description: Entering a place, the user stops at the threshold and sweeps it in a fixed order: exits, hands, high ground, shadows, anything out of place. The user spots anyone hiding, any trap and any concealed weapon that a careful look could find, and cannot be ambushed in that place for the rest of the scene. Cost: none.

Trace the Invisible.name: Trace the Invisible
Trace the Invisible.description: The user watches for what an unseen person cannot hide: rain or dust parting around empty space, breath fogging cold glass, a footprint pressing into mud. The user can track an invisible, camouflaged or Quirk-hidden person in the area and point allies to their exact position for the rest of the scene. Cost: none.

Walk the Scene.name: Walk the Scene
Walk the Scene.description: The user walks the scene in order, from entry to struggle to exit, matching marks, debris, blood and burns against each other. The user learns the order of events at the scene, how many people took part and which marks a Quirk left, though not who those people were. Cost: none.

Red String Method.name: Red String Method
Red String Method.description: The user lays out every clue, statement and record on a wall or in a notebook and tests the links between them until a connection holds. The user gains a true lead (a name, a place or a time) that brings the case closer to the person responsible, and learns which existing clue is false or planted, if any is. Cost: none.

Routine Map.name: Routine Map
Routine Map.description: The user watches a person or place over hours or days from a fixed post or a camera, logging arrivals, departures and habits. The user learns the target's routine and can say where they will be at a given hour of the next day, or when the place is empty or lightly guarded, unless something breaks the pattern. Cost: none.

Ghost Tail.name: Ghost Tail
Ghost Tail.description: The user follows a target through streets, stations and crowds, switching sides, changing a jacket, using reflections and letting cameras cover the gaps. The target does not notice the tail even while checking for followers, unless they have a sensing Quirk, and the user follows them all the way to their destination. Cost: none.

Ledge Talk.name: Ledge Talk
Ledge Talk.description: The user lowers their voice, uses the person's name and offers a way out that lets them keep their pride. A frightened, angry or desperate person who is not a committed villain holds off their next violent act and keeps listening for as long as the user keeps talking and nobody threatens them. Cost: none.

Second Chance Appeal.name: Second Chance Appeal
Second Chance Appeal.description: The user lays out the person's real situation and offers them a real alternative: a lawyer, protection, a job, a clean start. The person agrees to a concrete, reasonable request, such as testifying, standing down, leaving a gang or handing over a key, and keeps to it after the user leaves unless they are threatened or deceived. A committed villain or anyone devoted to a cause is not moved. Cost: none.

Split the Story.name: Split the Story
Split the Story.description: The user watches the face, hands and timing while someone talks, then replays the statement in their head piece by piece. The user knows whether the statement contains a lie and exactly which part of it is false, though not what the truth is. A trained liar, such as a spy, a con artist or an undercover pro, shows only that they are guarded. Cost: none.

Read the Pressure.name: Read the Pressure
Read the Pressure.description: Over a short conversation, the user tracks what a person avoids saying and what they keep coming back to. The user learns what this person most wants and most fears right now, and whether they are acting under someone else's threat, blackmail or mind-affecting Quirk. Cost: none.

Practiced Alibi.name: Practiced Alibi
Practiced Alibi.description: The user delivers a lie backed by matched details (a name, a receipt, a believable errand) and keeps every detail straight under questioning. A stranger, guard or official accepts the user's stated identity or reason for being there for the rest of the scene, unless they find hard evidence against it. Cost: none.

Planted Rumor.name: Planted Rumor
Planted Rumor.description: The user feeds a false sighting, tip or rumor to a source the target trusts and lets it travel. The false information reaches the intended person or group, and they act on it at least once before they find out it is false. Cost: none.

Cold Ultimatum.name: Cold Ultimatum
Cold Ultimatum.description: The user closes the distance, lets the silence sit, then makes a specific threat they can back up. A minor thug, guard or bystander backs off, drops what they are holding or truthfully answers a single question, then avoids the user for the rest of the scene. Cost: none.

Line in the Sand.name: Line in the Sand
Line in the Sand.description: The user marks a line, a doorway or a distance and tells a group exactly what happens to the first person who crosses it. No ordinary opponent, such as a thug, guard or gang member, crosses it for the rest of the scene unless a leader forces them to, and those who were already wavering flee or surrender. Cost: none.

Assign and Move.name: Assign and Move
Assign and Move.description: The user takes charge in a crisis, naming each person and giving them a short, specific task. Allies, sidekicks or bystanders who hear the orders act on them at once, without freezing, panicking or arguing, until the situation changes. Cost: none.

Rally Point.name: Rally Point
Rally Point.description: When the group falters after a loss, under fear or at the edge of exhaustion, the user stands where everyone can see them and calls them back to the task. Every ally who hears it shakes off fear, panic and despair and acts normally on their next turn, and allies under a fear-causing Quirk get a fresh chance to resist it. Cost: none.

Set the Headline.name: Set the Headline
Set the Headline.description: Facing cameras or a crowd right after an incident, the user gives a short, quotable account that frames what happened on their terms. News coverage and online talk about the event follow the user's framing, unless hard footage contradicts it. Cost: none.

Spotlight Draw.name: Spotlight Draw
Spotlight Draw.description: The user steps into full view on purpose and gives the crowd and cameras a show: a pose, a speech, a name to chant. While the user holds the spotlight, onlookers and press cameras miss whatever happens out of frame, such as a teammate's approach, a quiet arrest or an accomplice slipping away, and no phone footage of it spreads; fixed security cameras still record. Cost: none.

Last-Second Hide.name: Last-Second Hide
Last-Second Hide.description: When discovery is a moment away, the user drops into the nearest cover or shadow, slows their breathing and holds still. A searcher looking straight at the spot passes over the user unless they use a sensing Quirk, touch the user or bring a light right up to them. Stamina: brief.

Dead-Angle Approach.name: Dead-Angle Approach
Dead-Angle Approach.description: The user closes on a target from their blind side, timing each step to the target's own movements and the noise around them. The user gets within arm's length unnoticed, even when the target is alert and watching for intruders, and the first action against them catches them off guard: they cannot dodge, block or call out against it. A sensing Quirk or a target facing the user spoils the approach. Stamina: demanding.

Rooftop Line.name: Rooftop Line
Rooftop Line.description: The user chains vaults, wall-runs and rail slides into an unbroken line across rooftops, railings and street clutter. The user crosses obstacles without slowing from a sprint, and pursuers on foot without a mobility Quirk lose sight of them for a moment. Stamina: demanding.

Gap Run.name: Gap Run
Gap Run.description: The user runs up a wall, kicks off and catches a ledge, sign or railing across a gap too wide to clear with a flat jump. The user crosses gaps between buildings and climbs or drops a floor at a time without losing speed, and a chase on foot cannot follow without a mobility Quirk. Stamina: demanding.

Breakfall Roll.name: Breakfall Roll
Breakfall Roll.description: Thrown, knocked down or falling, the user tucks, slaps the ground and rolls through the landing. The user takes no injury from being thrown or knocked down or from a fall of a story or so, and comes up on their feet ready to act. Stamina: brief.

Rebound Landing.name: Rebound Landing
Rebound Landing.description: Sent flying by a blow or a blast, the user twists in midair, lands feet-first on a wall, a car or the ground and springs off it. The user takes no extra injury from the landing or from hitting anything, and can spend the rebound on an immediate attack or escape before the attacker recovers. Stamina: demanding.

Field Patch.name: Field Patch
Field Patch.description: The user opens up a broken piece of support gear, a costume system or a vehicle, finds the fault and bypasses it with tape, spare parts and a toolkit. The equipment works again for the rest of the scene, then fails until it gets a proper workshop repair. Cost: none.

Spot Prototype.name: Spot Prototype
Spot Prototype.description: The user takes a machine already at hand and spends a few minutes rebuilding it for a job it was never made for: a phone turned into a signal jammer, a delivery drone into a searchlight, a hand truck into a stretcher. The rebuilt device does that one job reliably for the rest of the scene, then is ruined. It cannot be done in the middle of a fight. Cost: none.

Wipe Recovery.name: Wipe Recovery
Wipe Recovery.description: The user takes the storage out of a damaged, burned or wiped phone, laptop or drive and rebuilds its deleted files and logs. The user recovers messages, photos, location history or files the owner believed were destroyed, even after a factory reset or a fire, as long as the storage chip itself survived. Cost: none.

Loop the Feeds.name: Loop the Feeds
Loop the Feeds.description: The user gets into a building's security network and feeds its cameras and door logs a recorded loop. For the rest of the scene the cameras show nothing out of place and the doors record no openings, so the user and allies move through unrecorded until someone checks the equipment in person. Cost: none.

Back-Alley Ear.name: Back-Alley Ear
Back-Alley Ear.description: The user works the bars, arcades and back alleys where talk moves, buying drinks and trading small talk. The user learns the current street rumor about a named person, gang or crime, whether it is true, and the name of someone on the street who knows more. Cost: none.

Vouched Entry.name: Vouched Entry
Vouched Entry.description: The user calls in favors and gets vouched for to reach people who never talk to strangers: a forger, a fixer, a dealer in illegal support gear. The user gets a meeting with an underworld broker who can supply a specific illegal item, service or piece of information, and the broker does not suspect the user is police or a hero unless the user gives it away. Cost: none.

No-Trace Pick.name: No-Trace Pick
No-Trace Pick.description: The user opens a mechanical lock, a padlock or a simple keycard reader with picks, a shim or a cloned card, and relocks it the same way on the way out. The door opens without damage or alarm, and nothing shows that anyone passed through unless someone takes the lock apart. Cost: none.

Sensor Bridge.name: Sensor Bridge
Sensor Bridge.description: The user traces an alarm system's wiring and sensors, then bridges, blinds or delays each sensor on the route in. The user and anyone following their path move through a secured area with motion sensors, pressure plates and laser grids without setting off an alarm for the rest of the scene. Cost: none.

Hard Weather Drill.name: Hard Weather Drill
Hard Weather Drill.description: The user paces their breathing, covers their mouth and nose and keeps working through smoke, heat, freezing water or thin air. For the rest of the scene the user loses no extra stamina or health to those conditions, though direct flames, cold attacks and poison gas still hurt them. Stamina: demanding.

Refuse to Fall.name: Refuse to Fall
Refuse to Fall.description: When an injury or exhaustion would drop the user, they lock their legs, grit through it and refuse to go down. The user stays conscious and able to act through the end of their next action, then collapses unless they have been healed or stabilized by then. Stamina: heavy.

Anchor Thought.name: Anchor Thought
Anchor Thought.description: Under threats, panic or an interrogator's pressure, the user fixes on a chosen thought (a promise, a name or a reason) and holds it. For the rest of the scene the user cannot be frightened, panicked or pressured into talking by ordinary threats, though fear caused by a Quirk is resisted normally. Cost: none.

Break the Hold.name: Break the Hold
Break the Hold.description: Under a mind-affecting Quirk, the user forces a moment of clarity through sharp pain or a fixed memory and fights back to their own will. The user acts freely for their next action despite control, illusion, induced fear or forced sleep, and if they use that action to break line of sight or contact with the source, the effect ends. Cost: none.

Field Profile.name: Field Profile
Field Profile.description: The user studies a person before any Quirk is shown: hands, skin, costume, support gear, old burns or frost scars, what they keep their distance from. The user learns what kind of Quirk they most likely have (Emitter, Transformation or Mutant, and roughly what it acts on) and is not caught off guard by its first use. A Quirk that leaves no mark on the body, gear or habits shows nothing. Cost: none.

Activation Read.name: Activation Read
Activation Read.description: Seeing a Quirk activate more than once, the user pins down what it needs to work, such as eye contact, a spoken reply or a touch, and calls it out to allies. The user learns the Quirk's activation condition, and the Quirk cannot catch the user or any ally who heard the warning unless they meet that condition by choice or are forced into it. A Quirk that needs only aim gives nothing to read. Cost: none.

Bedside Diagnosis.name: Bedside Diagnosis
Bedside Diagnosis.description: The user examines a patient's symptoms, history, vital signs and any test results at hand and works through the possible causes. The user learns exactly what is wrong, including poisoning, a hidden internal injury or an illness caused by a Quirk, and what treatment it needs. Cost: none.

Critical Procedure.name: Critical Procedure
Critical Procedure.description: With the equipment of a clinic, an ambulance or a field hospital, the user performs a critical procedure: closing a bleeding vessel, draining a collapsed lung, setting a compound fracture or giving the right antidote. The patient's serious or near-fatal injury stops threatening their life, and they recover from it in days of rest instead of weeks. Cost: none.

Handbrake Slip.name: Handbrake Slip
Handbrake Slip.description: The user throws the vehicle into a hard swerve, a handbrake turn or a sudden reverse at the moment a threat comes. The vehicle avoids a single collision, roadblock or attack aimed at it, and nobody inside is hurt by the maneuver. Stamina: brief.

Rear-Quarter Pin.name: Rear-Quarter Pin
Rear-Quarter Pin.description: The user pulls alongside a fleeing vehicle, taps its rear corner at the right speed, then boxes it against a curb, a barrier or another car. The fleeing vehicle spins out or is pinned and stops, without anyone inside it or nearby being seriously hurt. Stamina: demanding.

Shoulder Breach.name: Shoulder Breach
Shoulder Breach.description: The user drives a shoulder or a planted kick into a locked or jammed door, gate or shutter right at the lock or hinge. It gives way in a single action, and anyone bracing it from the other side is knocked off their feet and takes bludgeoning damage. A reinforced security door or a vault holds. Stamina: demanding.

Heavy Hurl.name: Heavy Hurl
Heavy Hurl.description: The user hauls up something heavy, such as a manhole cover, a full trash bin or a steel road barrier, and hurls it at a target or into a path. The object deals bludgeoning damage to the target it hits and knocks them down, or it lands to block a doorway, an alley or a corridor. Stamina: heavy.

Rescue Clutch.name: Rescue Clutch
Rescue Clutch.description: The user pulls a rescued person in close (on the back, under one arm or behind them) and keeps hold while the fight goes on. The user can still dodge, block and strike one-handed, and the person they hold takes no harm from the user's movement or from any attack the user blocks. Stamina: demanding.

Villain's-Eye Plan.name: Villain's-Eye Plan
Villain's-Eye Plan.description: The user looks at an attack the way its planners did: who was hit first, which exits were cut, who is being kept alive. The user learns the attackers' true objective in this scene (a person, an object or a distraction) and the route they will take to reach it, so the user's side can get there first. Cost: none.

Goal-Line Gambit.name: Goal-Line Gambit
Goal-Line Gambit.description: Facing an opponent the user cannot beat, the user stops trying to win and commits to one goal: getting a person through an exit, getting cuffs or capture tape around the opponent's wrists, or reaching an alarm. For that action, the opponent's greater strength or speed cannot keep the user from the goal, though the user takes any blows that land along the way. Stamina: heavy.

Partner Switch.name: Partner Switch
Partner Switch.description: The user calls a switch and trades places or targets with an ally in one motion, so each of them faces the opponent the call picked. Neither opponent gets a free strike during the switch, and an attack already aimed at one partner meets the other instead, who is ready for it. Stamina: brief.

Box Them In.name: Box Them In
Box Them In.description: The user sends allies to cover a target's exits while the user closes the last gap. While the user and at least one ally hold their positions, the target cannot leave the area by running, jumping or climbing; only a Quirk that carries them over, under or through the line gets them out. Stamina: demanding.

Dogpile Capture.name: Dogpile Capture
Dogpile Capture.description: The user calls the pile-on, and every ally within reach hits the same opponent at once: arms, legs, tape and body weight. That opponent, even one far stronger than any of them alone, is pinned to the ground and cannot move or attack until they break free with a Quirk or someone drags the group off. Stamina: heavy.

Just Another Student.name: Just Another Student
Just Another Student.description: In a crowd, a campus building or a stadium stand, the user reads where everyone's attention is going and keeps out of it. Villains, heroes and fighters treat the user as one more bystander: they do not watch or target the user until the user acts against them or calls attention to themselves. Cost: none.

Replay Study.name: Replay Study
Replay Study.description: Before a match, an exam or a confrontation, the user studies footage, broadcasts and notes on a rival's past fights. The user knows every technique the rival has shown on camera, its reach and its tell, and the first time the rival starts one of them in their next clash, the user acts before it lands. Cost: none.

Breakout Showing.name: Breakout Showing
Breakout Showing.description: When the user does something remarkable in front of teachers, scouts, sponsors or a broadcast, they make sure the right person sees it and remembers the name. Before the week is out a concrete offer arrives: a transfer review, an internship, a sponsor's call or a teacher's invitation to train. Cost: none.

Quirk-Fit Tuning.name: Quirk-Fit Tuning
Quirk-Fit Tuning.description: The user retunes their own or an ally's costume or support gear to how that wearer's Quirk behaves in use: venting heat, damping recoil or feeding fuel more smoothly. The next Quirk technique the wearer uses this scene counts one Strain step lower: severe to heavy, heavy to moderate, moderate to light. Cost: none.

Hazard-Proof Mod.name: Hazard-Proof Mod
Hazard-Proof Mod.description: The user reworks a costume or support item in the field against one hazard: sealing it against gas or acid, lining it against heat or cold, or grounding it against electricity. For the rest of the scene, injuries its wearer takes from that one damage type (toxic, corrosive, fire, cold or electric) are a category lighter. Stamina: brief.

Overnight Build.name: Overnight Build
Overnight Build.description: With a night in the Development Studio or a workshop as well equipped, the user designs and builds a support item for one person's Quirk and body: a gauntlet that aims a blast, boots that grip walls, a mask that filters a gas. From the next morning the item does that one job reliably until it breaks. Cost: none.

Press Line.name: Press Line
Press Line.description: The user takes charge of the reporters and phone-filming onlookers at an incident, gives them a spot with a clear view and promises a statement. Until the scene ends, the press stays behind the user's line and out of the rescuers' way, and broadcasts nothing that gives away a hero's position or a victim's face. Cost: none.

Image Rebuild.name: Image Rebuild
Image Rebuild.description: The user builds a campaign for a hero, agency or person whose image has taken a hit: an apology that lands, a charity appearance, a new story for the cameras. Once it runs, public opinion of them returns to where it stood before the damage, unless new wrongdoing comes out. Cost: none.

Stadium Voice.name: Stadium Voice
Stadium Voice.description: The user takes a microphone, loudspeaker or stage and speaks to a panicking crowd. Everyone within reach of the speakers, even a full stadium, stops, listens and follows the user's directions toward the exits in order; nobody is trampled or left behind while the user keeps talking, though the user cannot fight or leave while they do. Cost: none.

Halt Order.name: Halt Order
Halt Order.description: The user calls a stop in the voice of a teacher and a licensed pro. Students, trainees and anyone else who accepts the user's authority stop what they are doing and wait for instructions. Anyone else hearing it for the first time in a scene hesitates, so the user acts before them in the next exchange. Cost: none.

Live Correction.name: Live Correction
Live Correction.description: When a student or ally fails an action within the user's sight, the user calls out what went wrong and how to fix it. That person may at once try the same action again using the correction, and the second attempt stands. Cost: none.

Security Lockdown.name: Security Lockdown
Security Lockdown.description: The user triggers U.A.'s security protocol from a faculty terminal or radio: barriers drop, gates seal, staff are paged and students are sent to shelter points. Until a teacher lifts the alert, nobody enters or leaves the sealed grounds or building without a faculty ID or a Quirk that passes through walls, unless the system has been sabotaged. Cost: none.

On-Scene Authority.name: On-Scene Authority
On-Scene Authority.description: The user shows their license and takes charge of the hero response at an incident. Police officers and bystanders on scene follow the user's directions, and civilians or students who help under the user's supervision are covered: their Quirk use for the rescue counts as lawful. Cost: none.

By-the-Book Arrest.name: By-the-Book Arrest
By-the-Book Arrest.description: The user makes the arrest by procedure: states the charge, keeps the scene untouched for the police, records what happened and hands the suspect and the scene over by the book. The arrest holds up: the villain cannot walk free on a procedural error, and the user's statement counts in court. Cost: none.

Cordon Call.name: Cordon Call
Cordon Call.description: The user radios the agency and police with the location, the villain, their Quirk and the casualties, then directs the first officers into a perimeter. Until the scene ends, no bystander wanders into the danger zone, and anyone leaving it on foot or by vehicle is seen and reported. Cost: none.

Hired-Hand Command.name: Hired-Hand Command
Hired-Hand Command.description: The user stares down the hired thugs and lesser villains on a job until they fear the user more than the heroes. For the rest of the scene they follow the user's orders without arguing, and they do not break and run while the user is still standing. Cost: none.

Signal-Cut Raid.name: Signal-Cut Raid
Signal-Cut Raid.description: Before the attack, the user slips around the site and cuts it off: a jammer switched on, a phone line cut, a guard taken out quietly, an exit chained. When the attack starts, nobody inside can call for help or get word out until someone reaches a working line beyond the site. Stamina: brief.

Spark the Stampede.name: Spark the Stampede
Spark the Stampede.description: The user commits a sudden act of violence or wreckage in a crowded place: a smashed storefront, a fire set in a doorway, a blade raised in a packed station. Bystanders panic and scatter, and every hero, student or officer present must spend their next action protecting or evacuating civilians instead of attacking or chasing the user. Stamina: demanding.

Broker's Number.name: Broker's Number
Broker's Number.description: The user calls a broker or fixer who knows their name and what they can do. Before the next day ends, the broker comes through with one thing: a paying job that fits the user's skills, a safe room for the night, or the name of whoever has been asking about the user. Cost: none.

Fallback Hideout.name: Fallback Hideout
Fallback Hideout.description: The user keeps rented rooms, coin lockers and back doors across the city under other names. When chased or exposed, the user reaches the nearest one: pursuers lose them at its door unless a sensing Quirk follows, and inside wait a change of clothes, a spare phone and a way out the back. Stamina: demanding.

Untraceable Job.name: Untraceable Job
Untraceable Job.description: After a job, the user cleans up in the order brokers teach: prints, cameras, phone, witness, route. Investigators who work the job find no trace that names the user; only new evidence from outside the scene can put the user back in the frame. Cost: none.

Before the Sirens.name: Before the Sirens
Before the Sirens.description: The user cuts across rooftops, walls and alleys toward trouble they can hear or see in their own neighborhood. They reach the scene ahead of police and heroes, with time for one action before anyone official arrives. Stamina: demanding.

Gone Before the Cuffs.name: Gone Before the Cuffs
Gone Before the Cuffs.description: As police or a hero close in, the user breaks away through a gap nobody covered: a fire escape, a drain, a roof, a crowd. The user leaves the scene unidentified and leaves no trail back to their civilian life; witnesses and cameras catch the costume, never the face. Stamina: demanding.

Snatch-Back.name: Snatch-Back
Snatch-Back.description: When a villain drags or carries someone off (a kidnapping, a mugging, a hostage grab), the user cuts them off through the alleys and takes the victim back. The victim ends up free and behind the user, unharmed by the grab, and the villain has to fight or flee without them. Stamina: heavy.

Back-Door Shortcut.name: Back-Door Shortcut
Back-Door Shortcut.description: The user leads people through the back ways of their own neighborhood: a shop's rear door, a parking garage, a shrine path, a service stair. The group comes out ahead of whatever they were fleeing or racing toward, and anyone sticking to the main streets falls behind. Stamina: brief.

Neighborhood Favor.name: Neighborhood Favor
Neighborhood Favor.description: The user asks the people who know them from work and the street, such as regulars, shop owners, a station attendant or the landlady, for help. Someone comes through with one thing the user needs right now: a place to hide, a phone, a ride, first aid supplies or word of what is happening down the road. Cost: none.

Bar the Door.name: Bar the Door
Bar the Door.description: The user braces a door, shutter or barricade against a villain, a fire or a crowd crush while the people behind them get away. Until everyone behind the user is clear, nothing gets through that way without first getting through the user. Stamina: heavy.

First-Look Read.name: First-Look Read
First-Look Read.description: The user watches a Quirk in use and works out what it is: its type, what sets it off and where it stops. The user learns a true limit of that Quirk (range, trigger, duration, fuel, blind side or recovery time), and the user and anyone they tell can plan around it for the rest of the scene. Cost: none.

Bait-and-Slip.name: Bait-and-Slip
Bait-and-Slip.description: The user shows an opening on purpose, waits for the opponent's Quirk to fire, and moves at the moment of activation. The attack lands where the user chose instead (empty ground, a wall, or another enemy in its path, who takes its damage), and the attacker is left overcommitted: they cannot attack again before the user or an ally acts. Stamina: demanding.

Limit Squeeze.name: Limit Squeeze
Limit Squeeze.description: Using a limit the user already knows, they hold the fight at the range, pace or angle where that Quirk works worst, so the target must push it harder for less. The target's own Quirk drawback (recoil, heat, nausea, fatigue or whatever it has) sets in now and stays for the rest of the fight. Stamina: demanding.

Pocket Rig.name: Pocket Rig
Pocket Rig.description: In moments the user turns carried gear and whatever lies nearby into a working device: a tripwire snare, a rope pulley, a smoke screen or a noise lure. A snare holds a target's legs until they break free or the user cuts it; a pulley lets the user alone lift debris off a trapped person; a lure draws an enemy to a chosen spot. The device lasts the scene. Stamina: demanding.

Playbook Call.name: Playbook Call
Playbook Call.description: The user calls a short plan that matches each ally's Quirk to the enemy's weakness and counts the timing out loud. Allies who follow the call act in the order given, no ally's attack or Quirk hits another ally this turn, and the ally whose Quirk best counters the target's gets one opening the target's Quirk cannot block. Cost: none.

Between Beats.name: Between Beats
Between Beats.description: The user reads the rhythm of a Quirk attack, a fire or a collapsing structure and runs into the danger at the safe moment. They reach a person caught in it and drag or carry that person clear before the next blow, blast or fall lands: neither of them takes harm from that threat this turn. Stamina: heavy.

Full Breakdown.name: Full Breakdown
Full Breakdown.description: Having watched a Quirk work during this fight, the user lays out its mechanism and hits its weak point in a single sequence: cutting its line of sight, emptying its fuel, running out its clock or blocking what it must touch. The target cannot use their Quirk until the end of their next action, and the user's closing strike deals bludgeoning damage. Stamina: heavy.

Gut Check Hook.name: Gut Check Hook
Gut Check Hook.description: The user slips inside the opponent's guard and drives a short hook under the ribs. Deals bludgeoning damage, and an opponent without armor or a hardened body is winded: they cannot sprint, shout or make a demanding effort on their next action. Stamina: brief.

Linebreaker Charge.name: Linebreaker Charge
Linebreaker Charge.description: The user lowers a shoulder and charges through whoever blocks the way: a lone opponent, a riot shield or a line of people. Each person in the path takes bludgeoning damage and is knocked to the ground, and the user ends on the far side. An opponent much larger or heavier than the user stops the charge instead. Stamina: demanding.

Blow-for-Blow Counter.name: Blow-for-Blow Counter
Blow-for-Blow Counter.description: When an opponent's punch, kick or club lands, the user takes it on a braced forehead or shoulder and answers in the same instant. The user still takes the hit, but the answering blow deals bludgeoning damage and cannot be dodged or blocked, because the opponent's guard is still open from their own attack. Stamina: demanding.

Street Sweeper.name: Street Sweeper
Street Sweeper.description: The user tears loose a bench, a signpost or a parked bicycle and swings it in a wide arc. Every opponent within reach in front of the user takes bludgeoning damage and is thrown to the ground, and the object breaks or drops after the swing. Needs something heavy within reach. Stamina: heavy.

Closing Bell.name: Closing Bell
Closing Bell.description: The user plants both feet, turns the hips and puts the whole body into a single overhand blow. It deals bludgeoning damage that carries through armor plates, riot shields and hardened skin, and the opponent is knocked down and cannot act on their next turn; a giant or vehicle-sized opponent is only staggered. Afterward the user's guard is down until the user acts again. Stamina: heavy.

Borrowed Force Throw.name: Borrowed Force Throw
Borrowed Force Throw.description: As an opponent rushes, swings or grabs, the user catches the arm, turns with it and lets the opponent's own momentum carry them over the user's hip. The opponent lands on their back, takes bludgeoning damage and must spend their next action getting up. Works only on an attacker who closes to arm's reach. Stamina: brief.

Empty-Hand Disarm.name: Empty-Hand Disarm
Empty-Hand Disarm.description: The user traps the weapon arm against the user's body and turns the wrist against the joint. The opponent drops whatever they hold in that hand (a knife, baton, gun or handheld support device), and the user keeps it or kicks it away. A weapon strapped or fused to the body cannot be stripped this way. Stamina: brief.

Nerve-Point Strike.name: Nerve-Point Strike
Nerve-Point Strike.description: The user lands a precise knee or knuckle strike on a nerve point: the outside of the thigh or the inside of the upper arm. Deals bludgeoning damage, and the struck limb goes numb: the target cannot put weight on that leg or grip with that arm until the end of their next turn. Thick armor or a hardened body blocks the effect. Stamina: brief.

Arm Bar Pin.name: Arm Bar Pin
Arm Bar Pin.description: The user takes the opponent face-down and locks an arm straight across the user's knee, pinning them to the ground. The opponent cannot stand, strike or use a Quirk that works through their hands until they overpower the hold or the user lets go, and the user keeps a hand free to cuff or tape them. Stamina: heavy.

Mirror Reversal.name: Mirror Reversal
Mirror Reversal.description: The user meets a punch, kick, weapon swing or grab with a turning parry and sends the attacker's force back along the line it came in on. The attack misses the user; the attacker takes the damage they meant to deal, of the same type, and lands on the ground. Works against physical attacks at arm's reach, not beams, blasts or projectiles. Stamina: heavy.

Reach Ward.name: Reach Ward
Reach Ward.description: The user holds the weapon point-first between the user and the opponent and snaps a strike at anyone who steps inside its reach. An opponent who tries to close to fist or grappling range this turn is struck first, taking bludgeoning damage from a blunt weapon or slashing or piercing damage from a blade, and is stopped at weapon length. Stamina: brief.

Knuckle Rap.name: Knuckle Rap
Knuckle Rap.description: The user whips the weapon down across the opponent's knuckles or wrist. Deals bludgeoning damage (slashing damage with an edge), and the opponent drops whatever they hold in that hand. A gauntleted or hardened hand keeps its grip but still takes the hit. Stamina: brief.

Sidestep Riposte.name: Sidestep Riposte
Sidestep Riposte.description: The user waits until an attack is fully committed, steps off its line at the last instant and strikes as the attacker passes. The attack misses, and the counterstrike lands behind the attacker's guard, dealing bludgeoning damage with a blunt weapon or slashing or piercing damage with a blade. Works only on an attacker who comes within weapon reach, not on shots or blasts from a distance. Stamina: demanding.

Low Circle Sweep.name: Low Circle Sweep
Low Circle Sweep.description: The user drops low and spins the staff, baton, chain or blade in a full circle at ankle height. Every opponent within weapon reach takes bludgeoning damage (slashing damage from a blade), is knocked off their feet and must spend their next action getting up. Flying and vehicle-sized opponents are not affected. Stamina: heavy.

Seam-Finder Thrust.name: Seam-Finder Thrust
Seam-Finder Thrust.description: The user reads the joints of an armored or hardened opponent and drives the weapon's point into a gap: elbow, armpit, knee or hip. The thrust ignores armor, shields and hardened skin, deals piercing damage with a blade or bludgeoning damage with a blunt weapon, and the struck arm or leg cannot grip or bear weight until the end of the target's next turn. Stamina: demanding.

Pin-Down Fire.name: Pin-Down Fire
Pin-Down Fire.description: The user fires or throws at the edges of an opponent's cover, close enough to make them duck. Until the end of their next turn, the opponent cannot leave that cover or aim their own ranged attack without being hit for piercing damage (bludgeoning damage from rubber rounds or thrown stones). Stamina: brief.

Weapon-Hand Shot.name: Weapon-Hand Shot
Weapon-Hand Shot.description: The user puts a round, dart or thrown knife into an opponent's weapon or the hand that holds it. The opponent drops what they hold in that hand; a hit on the hand deals piercing damage (bludgeoning damage from rubber rounds), and a hit on the weapon itself knocks it away without injury. Stamina: brief.

Weak Point Read.name: Weak Point Read
Weak Point Read.description: The user studies a target through the sights for a breath and finds the gap: a costume seam, a bare joint, a support item's power cell. The shot that follows ignores armor and shields and deals piercing damage (bludgeoning damage from rubber rounds), and a hit on a support item shuts it down until it is repaired. Stamina: brief.

Bank Shot.name: Bank Shot
Bank Shot.description: The user angles a shot or a thrown blade off a wall, pillar or car body to strike a target behind cover. The target gets no protection from their cover and takes piercing damage (bludgeoning damage from rubber rounds), and because they cannot tell where the shot came from, they cannot target the user on their next action. Stamina: demanding.

Long Watch.name: Long Watch
Long Watch.description: The user takes a firing position over a doorway, street or rooftop and holds it. Until the user moves, is attacked or runs out of rounds, each opponent who enters that area, draws a weapon there or attacks an ally under the user's watch is shot before they can finish the action: the action fails and the opponent takes piercing damage (bludgeoning damage from rubber rounds). Stamina: heavy.

Cover Drag.name: Cover Drag
Cover Drag.description: The user grabs an injured or frozen person by the collar or under the arms and hauls them behind the nearest solid cover in a single motion. The person ends out of the line of fire and clear of the immediate danger, and any attack aimed at them during the drag strikes the user instead. Stamina: brief.

Pressure Seal.name: Pressure Seal
Pressure Seal.description: The user packs the wound, presses hard and binds it tight with a bandage, belt or torn sleeve without stopping: while running, carrying the patient or under fire. That wound stops bleeding and stays closed even if the patient is moved, carried or keeps fighting, so it costs them no more health. Lost health does not come back. Stamina: brief.

Load-Bearing Brace.name: Load-Bearing Brace
Load-Bearing Brace.description: The user wedges a beam, a door or the user's own back under a collapsing slab, wall or car and holds it up. The load does not fall on anyone beneath it until the user lets go or is struck, and everyone trapped under it can crawl out on their next action. A whole collapsing building is beyond this brace. Stamina: heavy.

Rapid Triage.name: Rapid Triage
Rapid Triage.description: The user turns the bystanders at a mass-casualty scene into a field team: a few words each on pressing a wound, cooling a burn or keeping an airway open, then the user moves between them checking the work. Every injured person in the area stops losing health to bleeding and burns, and anyone dazed or in shock comes back to awareness and can walk with help. It does not restore lost health. Stamina: demanding.

Through-Fire Carry.name: Through-Fire Carry
Through-Fire Carry.description: The user lifts a casualty across the shoulders and runs them out through fire, smoke, falling debris or an active fight. The rescued person takes no further harm during the run, attacks and debris that would hit them strike the user instead, and the user reaches the nearest safe exit even if the way passes through danger. Stamina: extreme.

Tangle Shot.name: Tangle Shot
Tangle Shot.description: The user fires capture tape, a weighted cord or an adhesive round from a launcher or gauntlet, or throws a homemade bola, at an opponent's legs. The opponent's legs are bound: they cannot run, kick or climb until they spend an action tearing free or someone cuts them loose. Stamina: brief.

Eye-Level Burst.name: Eye-Level Burst
Eye-Level Burst.description: The user lobs a flashbang or smoke grenade so it bursts at the opponents' eye level instead of at their feet. Every opponent in a small area is blinded or lost in smoke, without injury: none of them can aim a ranged attack or pick out a target until the end of their next turn. Needs a flashbang, a smoke grenade or a device built to do the same. Stamina: brief.

Fault Strike.name: Fault Strike
Fault Strike.description: The user spots the power cell, nozzle, hinge or cable that makes an opponent's support item work and hits it with a tool, a dart or a jammed wire. That item stops working until someone repairs it, and powered gear sparks as it dies, dealing electric damage to its wearer. Works on thrusters, gauntlets, launchers, respirators and armor joints. Stamina: brief.

Scrapyard Rig.name: Scrapyard Rig
Scrapyard Rig.description: The user rips the power cell, motor or wiring out of wrecked gear, a vehicle or a vending machine and wires a single-use powered trap mid-fight: a shock plate that deals electric damage to the first opponent who steps on it and knocks them down, a shorted panel that blacks out a room's lights, or a salvaged motor that winches a shutter down and jams it. Stamina: demanding.

Redline Overload.name: Redline Overload
Redline Overload.description: The user strips the safety limits from a piece of the user's own support gear for a single use. A launcher fires a round that deals explosive damage and knocks down everyone at the impact point, a thruster pack clears a street in a single jump, or a gauntlet punches through a steel door for bludgeoning damage. The item then breaks and needs a workshop repair. Stamina: heavy.

Blindside Opener.name: Blindside Opener
Blindside Opener.description: The user strikes an opponent who has not noticed the user yet, from behind or from a blind side. The blow lands before the opponent can dodge, block or counter, dealing bludgeoning damage (slashing or piercing damage with a blade), and the opponent cannot strike back on their next action. Stamina: brief.

Quiet Drop.name: Quiet Drop
Quiet Drop.description: The user catches an unaware target from behind, covers their mouth and drops them with a choke or a strike to the back of the head. The target falls unconscious without a sound, and nobody nearby hears a thing. Works only on a target who has not noticed the user; an armored or hardened target, or a seasoned pro or villain, is only staggered and alerted. Stamina: brief.

Strike and Fade.name: Strike and Fade
Strike and Fade.description: The user darts in, strikes and slips back into shadow, smoke or a crowd in the same motion. Deals bludgeoning damage (slashing or piercing damage with a blade), and the opponent loses track of the user: they cannot attack the user on their next action unless a sensing Quirk finds the user. Needs cover, darkness, smoke or a crowd close by. Stamina: demanding.

Vanishing Shift.name: Vanishing Shift
Vanishing Shift.description: The user throws a feint, breaks line of sight behind a pillar, smoke or a crowd and moves somewhere else. Every opponent loses track of the user until the user attacks or makes a noise, and while unseen the user can move anywhere in the area, including behind an opponent. Sensing Quirks, heat vision and cameras can still find the user. Stamina: demanding.

Lights-Out Sweep.name: Lights-Out Sweep
Lights-Out Sweep.description: Moving from shadow to shadow, the user drops every unaware guard in a room, corridor or rooftop in turn before any of them can raise the alarm. Each target the user reaches falls unconscious; an armored or hardened target, or a seasoned pro or villain, is only knocked down, and the sweep stops the moment anyone sees the user. Stamina: heavy.

Call the Tell.name: Call the Tell
Call the Tell.description: The user watches an opponent for a moment and calls out their habit aloud or by signal: the hand they favor, the pause before their Quirk fires, the way they reload. The first time that opponent repeats the habit in this fight, the user or an ally who heard the call avoids that attack completely. Cost: none.

Handoff Opening.name: Handoff Opening
Handoff Opening.description: The user feints, trips or crowds an opponent for the sole purpose of opening them up for a partner. The partner's next attack against that opponent this turn cannot be dodged or blocked. Needs an ally close enough to strike in the same moment. Stamina: brief.

Choke Point Play.name: Choke Point Play
Choke Point Play.description: The user pulls the fight back into a doorway, stairwell, alley or bridge where only a narrow front can reach the user's side. While the fight stays there, opponents can come at the user's group only in single file, and anyone trying to slip around the side or behind is spotted before arriving. Stamina: brief.

Converging Strike.name: Converging Strike
Converging Strike.description: The user times a combined attack with every ally in reach so that all strike the same opponent at the same instant from different sides. The opponent can dodge or block only the first blow; every other blow lands and deals its own damage type, Quirk attacks included. Needs an ally besides the user. Stamina: demanding.

Whole-Board Read.name: Whole-Board Read
Whole-Board Read.description: The user takes in the whole engagement and gives a plan in a few words: who covers whom, where to fall back, which opponent goes down first. Until the scene changes, allies who follow the plan never hit one another with attacks or Quirks or cut across each other's line, and when the user calls the fallback, every ally breaks off at once with no opponent getting a free attack on them. Cost: none.

Step-In Burst.name: Step-In Burst
Step-In Burst.description: The user closes the distance with a quick step and releases the Quirk at point-blank range as the front foot lands. Deals the Quirk's own damage type (bludgeoning damage from a body-strengthening Quirk) and pushes the opponent back out of arm's reach and off balance: they cannot counterattack on their next action. Strain: light.

False Start Feint.name: False Start Feint
False Start Feint.description: The user starts a visible Quirk activation on one side (a flare, a flex, a twitch of a Mutant feature), then strikes from the other. The opponent reacts to the false start and cannot dodge or block the real blow, which deals bludgeoning damage, or the Quirk's own damage type when the Quirk powers the strike. Strain: light.

Pivot Wheel.name: Pivot Wheel
Pivot Wheel.description: The user plants a foot, spins and releases the Quirk in a full circle around the user's body. Every opponent within arm's reach takes the Quirk's own damage type (bludgeoning damage from a strengthened body) and is pushed back out of reach; a Quirk with no attack applies its usual effect to each of them instead. Strain: moderate.

Counterburst Step.name: Counterburst Step
Counterburst Step.description: The user meets an incoming attack with a small, exact release of the Quirk at the instant of impact: a burst, a flare, a hardened patch or a surge of strength. The attack is knocked aside without harm, including a thrown object or a shot, and an attacker within reach takes the Quirk's own damage type from the same release (bludgeoning from a strengthened or hardened body). A blast that fills the area is too big to turn. Strain: moderate.

Chain Step Assault.name: Chain Step Assault
Chain Step Assault.description: The user fires the Quirk on every step through an exchange, each release carrying the user on to the next opponent. Every opponent along the path takes the Quirk's own damage type (bludgeoning from a strengthened body), and the user ends anywhere in the area, where none of them can strike back before the user's next action. A Quirk that cannot move the user is released at each opponent as the user sprints between them. Strain: moderate.

Drop and Bolt.name: Drop and Bolt
Drop and Bolt.description: When an attack, a thrown object or falling debris comes at the user, the user drops, rolls clear and comes up already running. The danger misses, and on the same action the user moves away toward cover or an exit, pulling a nearby person along by the hand. Works against danger the user can see or hear coming; a blast or collapse that fills the whole area is too big to roll clear of. Stamina: brief.

This Way Out.name: This Way Out
This Way Out.description: The user reads where the danger is moving (the spread of smoke, the direction a villain faces, the surge of a crowd) and calls out a way to safety that avoids it in a clear, steady voice. Everyone who hears the user stops panicking and takes that route, and the danger the user read does not reach the route while they are on it; a new danger, such as a second villain, can. Cost: none.

Go to Ground.name: Go to Ground
Go to Ground.description: The user pulls the people nearby into a doorway, under a car, behind a counter or into a crowd and keeps them silent.
