Villains and other searchers pass over the hidden group until one of them moves or makes a noise; a sensing Quirk or a close search can still find them. Stamina: brief.

Run for Help.name: Run for Help
Run for Help.description: The user breaks away from the danger, weaving past attackers and debris, and reaches help: the nearest hero, police officer, teacher or a working phone line. Nothing stops the user on the way, the helper learns exactly where the danger is and who is caught in it, and help arrives before the scene ends. A sealed exit, such as a lockdown shutter or a barrier Quirk's wall, still has to be opened first. Stamina: demanding.

Last One Out.name: Last One Out
Last One Out.description: After the others have fled, the user goes back into the danger zone alone and checks every place a person could still be: under desks, behind counters, beside the injured. The user finds everyone still inside, including people hiding, unconscious or too frightened to answer, and gets them all out; attacks and falling debris aimed at the user or the people they lead miss, and the user leaves last. Stamina: heavy.

Agency Dispatch.name: Agency Dispatch
Agency Dispatch.description: The user calls their agency's dispatch and the police band with what they see. Their sidekick or the nearest allied pro is sent to a point the user names and arrives within a few minutes, and police set up behind the user's lead. Cost: none.

Name on the Door.name: Name on the Door
Name on the Door.description: The user names their agency and stands on its record. Civilians, shop owners, building managers and junior officers who have heard of it cooperate: they open doors, share camera footage and answer questions without a warrant for the rest of the scene. Cost: none.

Team-Up Request.name: Team-Up Request
Team-Up Request.description: The user formally requests a team-up through the Commission's channel. A pro from another agency whose Quirk fits the problem joins the operation for the rest of the scene and follows the user's plan; the favor is owed back later. Cost: none.

Shadow Snare.name: Shadow Snare
Shadow Snare.description: The user lifts the shadow under a target within about ten meters into flat black bands that wrap their ankles or wrists and hold without hurting. The target cannot walk away or swing the held arm until they break free with a hard effort, a strong light falls on the bands or the end of the user's next turn. On a sunlit open street the bands are too thin to hold anyone. Strain: light.

Dark Crossing.name: Dark Crossing
Dark Crossing.description: The user steps into a shadow at least as large as their own body and steps out of another shadow they can see within about fifteen meters in the same instant. An attacker aiming at them must find them again, and the user can cross a locked gate or a gap between rooftops this way; they carry only what they wear and hold, and a floodlight on either shadow closes the way. Strain: light.

Blackglass Pin.name: Blackglass Pin
Blackglass Pin.description: The user hardens a sliver of shadow into a pin of dark glass and drives it at a target within about ten meters. It deals piercing damage and pins a sleeve, a coat or a foot to the floor or wall behind them until they tear free with a hard effort; held back, the pin catches only clothing and draws no blood. In strong light the pin shatters before it lands. Strain: moderate.

Blackglass Pane.name: Blackglass Pane
Blackglass Pane.description: The user hardens a shadow into a pane of dark glass as wide as a door between an attack and the people behind it. Until the end of the user's next turn, fists, thrown objects and pistol rounds from the front stop against the pane and deal no damage to anyone behind it; a rifle round or a heavy blow cracks it open, and a floodlight on it softens it away. Strain: moderate.

Dusk Coat.name: Dusk Coat
Dusk Coat.description: The user pulls the surrounding shadow around their body as a close-fitting coat of flat black. For the rest of the scene, while they keep to shadowed ground, watchers and cameras cannot pick them out beyond a few strides, so they can scout a dark warehouse or slip past guards to a hostage; a flashlight beam or a lit doorway strips the coat away at once. Strain: moderate.

Ribboned Descent.name: Ribboned Descent
Ribboned Descent.description: The user draws the shadow under a ledge, a stairwell or a dark shaft into firm black ribbons and lowers up to three people from a height to the ground at a safe pace, or reaches into a dark gap in rubble and draws a trapped person out along the ribbons. Firelight or a floodlight thins the ribbons, so the user must keep the people inside the shade the whole way down. Strain: moderate.

Black Splinter Field.name: Black Splinter Field
Black Splinter Field.description: The user hardens every shadow in a room or across a street's width into a bed of dark glass splinters that bursts upward. Every enemy standing in shadow there takes heavy piercing damage and is caught among the splinters, unable to move their legs until they break free with a hard effort; held back, the splinters stay blunt and only cage their legs. Enemies standing in full light are out of reach. Strain: heavy.

Shadowline Relay.name: Shadowline Relay
Shadowline Relay.description: The user's signature move: they step from shadow to shadow through every shadow in sight in a single breath, surfacing behind each of up to five enemies in turn. Each takes massive bludgeoning damage from a blow out of their blind spot and is left bound in shadow bands, unable to stand until the end of their next turn; afterward the user's own shadow is spent and they cannot shape shadow until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Every Shadow Answers.name: Every Shadow Answers
Every Shadow Answers.description: At dusk, at night or indoors, the user takes hold of every shadow in a building or across a city block for the rest of the scene. They can bind any enemy they see standing in shadow there, step between any two shadows in the area and raise dark glass panes over any doorway or window; each bind holds until a hard effort or a strong light breaks it. Floodlights and fires cut the area into pieces the user cannot reach. Strain: severe.

Frozen Swing.name: Frozen Swing
Frozen Swing.description: The user meets an incoming punch, a swung bat or a thrown object with an open palm, and its motion locks where it touches. The strike stops dead and deals no damage, and the attacker's arm hangs locked for a heartbeat, so the user's next blow or grab against them lands before they can guard. A strike the user does not see coming lands as normal. Strain: light.

Turnabout Throw.name: Turnabout Throw
Turnabout Throw.description: The user touches a lunging attacker or a thrown object in flight, locks its motion and turns it onto a new line at the same speed. A lunging attacker is turned into the ground and takes bludgeoning damage from their own momentum; held back, the user turns them aside and they only stumble past. A thrown object can be turned back toward its thrower, and a slow attack turns only into a slow fall. Strain: light.

Mid-Stride Lock.name: Mid-Stride Lock
Mid-Stride Lock.description: The user glances at a running, leaping or falling person within about twenty meters and locks their body's motion. The target hangs in place mid-stride, unable to move their limbs until the end of their next turn or until the user looks away, though they can still breathe, speak and see. Someone standing still gives the Quirk nothing to hold. Strain: moderate.

Midair Pivot.name: Midair Pivot
Midair Pivot.description: The user leaps and locks their own motion at the top of the jump, hanging in place for a moment before turning onto a new line at the same speed. Chaining leaps, they cross a street-wide gap, change course in the middle of a fall or climb a building face in zigzags. The user gains no speed from it, so a short hop turns only into a short hop, and a fall turned sideways is still a fall. Strain: moderate.

Softened Stop.name: Softened Stop
Softened Stop.description: The user locks a falling person, a sliding car or a crashing scooter within about twenty meters and eases its motion away instead of releasing it. The locked thing settles to the ground gently and no one in it or under it is hurt. The user can ease one person or one vehicle up to a car's weight each use, and must see it fall or slide before it lands. Strain: moderate.

Glancing Turn.name: Glancing Turn
Glancing Turn.description: Until the end of the user's next turn, every bullet, arrow or thrown object aimed at the user or an ally within a few strides locks for an instant as it arrives and turns down into the floor, dealing no damage. A sustained burst from an automatic weapon is more than the user can read: only the first few rounds are turned and the rest land as normal. Strain: heavy.

Crossed Vectors.name: Crossed Vectors
Crossed Vectors.description: The user locks up to four moving enemies within a street's width at a glance, runners, leapers or a charging heteromorph, and turns each onto a new line: into each other, into a wall or down into the ground. Each takes heavy bludgeoning damage from their own speed; held back, the user turns them into open ground where they only tumble and lose their footing. Enemies standing still are out of reach. Strain: heavy.

Still Point.name: Still Point
Still Point.description: The user's signature move: everything in motion within a street's width locks at once: runners, swung weapons, bullets and falling glass. Until the end of the user's next turn nothing there moves unless the user releases it, every locked attack is turned aside, and each enemy locked mid-charge is turned into the ground for massive bludgeoning damage. Afterward the user cannot lock anything until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Rerouted Avenue.name: Rerouted Avenue
Rerouted Avenue.description: For the rest of the scene the user reads every moving thing across a city block and can lock or turn any of them at a glance: a runaway bus turned into an empty lot, a falling sign held overhead until people clear, a fleeing car eased to a stop. They can lock or turn a dozen things in a single turn, never adding speed, and a flash or a blow to the eyes ends the technique at once. Strain: severe.

Circling Guard.name: Circling Guard
Circling Guard.description: The user sets the loose things at hand, a bag, a few stones or a bottle, circling an arm's length around their body. Until the end of the user's next turn, the first thrown object, swung club or grabbing hand to cross the circle strikes an orbiting object instead and is knocked aside without harming the user; the circle then breaks and the objects fall. In a narrow corridor the objects strike the walls and drop at once. Strain: light.

Tangent Shot.name: Tangent Shot
Tangent Shot.description: The user lets a circling stone, can or bolt fly off its orbit along a straight line at a target within about twenty meters. It deals bludgeoning damage and knocks the target back a step; held back, the user lets a soft object fly instead, a balled-up jacket or a rubber ball, which only staggers them and knocks a weapon from their hand. The user must already have something circling. Strain: light.

Coiling Pass.name: Coiling Pass
Coiling Pass.description: The user sets a rope, a cable or a coat circling and widens the circle until it sweeps a target within a few strides, winding around them several times and binding their arms to their sides. The target cannot use their arms until they work free with a hard effort or are cut loose, and the bind never tightens past holding; the user needs a cord at least a few meters long. Strain: moderate.

Gravel Carousel.name: Gravel Carousel
Gravel Carousel.description: The user scatters a handful of gravel, bolts or broken tile into a wide ring that circles them at chest height. Until the end of the user's next turn, every enemy who steps within a few strides of the user takes bludgeoning damage and is driven back; held back, the user drops the ring to ankle height and it only trips them. Allies close to the user must crouch or be struck too. Strain: moderate.

Wide Loop Scout.name: Wide Loop Scout
Wide Loop Scout.description: The user sets a phone recording video circling and widens the loop until it swings around a whole building or across a street and back to their hand. The footage shows every window, rooftop and alley the loop passed: who is there, where hostages are held and where an attacker waits. A phone that strikes a wall or is snatched out of the air falls and is lost. Strain: moderate.

Slow Circle Catch.name: Slow Circle Catch
Slow Circle Catch.description: The user touches a falling person within reach, or leaps to brush one passing, and lets go. Instead of hitting the ground the person swings into a wide, slow circle around the user, losing speed with every lap, and is set down on their feet unhurt by the end of the user's next turn. The user can catch up to two people at once and must keep the space around them clear of walls. Strain: heavy.

Debris Halo.name: Debris Halo
Debris Halo.description: The user sets dozens of pieces of rubble, glass and scrap circling in a dense ring around themselves and everyone within a few strides. For the rest of the scene, while the user moves no faster than a walk, gunfire, thrown objects and charging enemies are struck aside by the ring, and the user can let any piece fly as a sling shot for bludgeoning damage. Breaking into a run flings the whole ring outward. Strain: heavy.

Full Revolution.name: Full Revolution
Full Revolution.description: The user's signature move: they set a manhole cover, a car door or a steel beam circling faster with every lap and release it at a target within a street's length. It deals massive bludgeoning damage, throws the target down and smashes any cover between them; held back, it strikes the ground at the target's feet and the shock knocks them down. Afterward the user cannot set anything circling until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Gathering Ring.name: Gathering Ring
Gathering Ring.description: For the rest of the scene, anything that crosses the ring circling the user joins it: thrown objects, falling glass, bullets and the projectiles of other Quirks fall into the circle instead of striking anyone inside. The user can send any of them back out for heavy bludgeoning or piercing damage; held back, they drop them harmlessly at their feet. The ring reaches only a few strides out and stops nothing that comes from below. Strain: severe.

Leaden Brace.name: Leaden Brace
Leaden Brace.description: The user turns heavy in an instant as a shove, a tackle, a blast wave or a gust arrives. Until the end of their next turn nothing that pushes can move them a step: they cannot be knocked down, thrown or carried off, and a tackler rebounds and falls. Blades, bullets, heat and electricity hurt them as normal, and they cannot move faster than a walk while braced. Strain: light.

Dropweight Strike.name: Dropweight Strike
Dropweight Strike.description: The user turns heavy in the instant a punch, a kick or an elbow lands on a target within reach, putting their multiplied weight behind it. It deals bludgeoning damage and knocks the target flat; held back, the user turns heavy only after the blow lands and simply bears the target down to the ground. Mistiming the shift leaves the user slow and open until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Drifting Descent.name: Drifting Descent
Drifting Descent.description: The user turns light and steps off a roof, a bridge or a high window. They fall slowly enough to land unhurt from any height, glide along a breeze across a street-wide gap or leap from the street to a third-floor ledge. A strong gust carries them off course, and anything they carry keeps its full weight, so they can bring down no more than a small child with them. Strain: moderate.

Leadfall Pin.name: Leadfall Pin
Leadfall Pin.description: The user tackles or kneels on a target who is down and turns heavy. The target is pinned flat under several hundred kilograms and cannot rise or use their arms until the user shifts back, and the user sets the weight to hold them without cracking ribs. While pinning, the user cannot move or attack, and a floor weaker than concrete gives way under them both. Strain: moderate.

Riverbed Walk.name: Riverbed Walk
Riverbed Walk.description: The user turns heavy and walks along the bottom of a flooded underpass, a river or a harbor, unmoved by the current, to reach a sunken car, pull a door open against the water or free a person snagged below. They work on a held breath of about a minute, and to rise they turn light and float up, slowly, because anyone they carry keeps their own weight. Strain: moderate.

Counterweight Hold.name: Counterweight Hold
Counterweight Hold.description: The user grabs a tow cable, a rescue line or the bumper of a car tipping off a ledge and turns heavy, anchoring it in place. Nothing they hold slides any further, and with a rope over a railing or a pulley they lift up to two people a floor at a time as a living counterweight. The user cannot move or attack while holding, and lets go at the end of the scene at the latest. Strain: heavy.

Rise and Plummet.name: Rise and Plummet
Rise and Plummet.description: The user turns light, leaps to a third-floor height, then turns heavy at the top and drops onto a target below. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage, and everyone within a few strides of the landing is knocked off their feet; held back, the user lands beside the target and only the shock knocks them down. The landing cracks pavement and breaks through any floor weaker than concrete. Strain: heavy.

Feather to Anvil.name: Feather to Anvil
Feather to Anvil.description: The user's signature move: they turn light so their arm whips forward with no weight to slow it, then turn as heavy as they can in the instant the blow lands. It deals massive bludgeoning damage that no block or brace can stop and drives the target into the ground, unable to rise until the end of their next turn; afterward the user's joints lock up and they cannot change density until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Immovable Mass.name: Immovable Mass
Immovable Mass.description: The user plants themselves and turns heavier than ever before, the weight of a loaded truck, for the rest of the scene. A runaway truck, a charging heteromorph or a flood surge stops dead against them, a crane cable or a bridge span they hold stays in place, and any enemy they grip cannot pull free. The user can take only a slow step each turn, sinks through any floor weaker than concrete, and blades and bullets still hurt them. Strain: severe.

Quake Palm.name: Quake Palm
Quake Palm.description: The user drives an open palm into a target within reach and releases a hard shudder through their body. It deals bludgeoning damage and knocks the target off their feet, even through a raised guard; held back, it only rattles them off balance and numbs their arms with no lasting harm. The user must touch the target, and the release jars the user's own wrist. Strain: light.

Footfall Read.name: Footfall Read
Footfall Read.description: The user lays a palm on a floor or wall and feels every footstep, dropped object and hollow space through about two rooms or one floor of the building. They learn how many people are moving there, where each one is, roughly how heavy they are, and where a hidden room or a buried air pocket lies. Someone standing perfectly still, a flier or the roar of running machinery escapes the reading. Strain: light.

Numbing Grip.name: Numbing Grip
Numbing Grip.description: The user grabs an opponent's arm or leg and sends a steady buzzing shake into it. The limb goes numb: a held weapon drops, and the opponent cannot use that limb until the end of their next turn, or for as long as the user keeps hold. Thick armor or hardened skin dulls the shake to a tremble, and the user's own hand is tied up while they keep the grip. Strain: moderate.

Fracture Tap.name: Fracture Tap
Fracture Tap.description: The user presses a palm to stone, concrete, brick or glass and shakes it apart: a door-sized section of wall or floor crumbles into rubble, opening a way through or a hole to the level below. Metal and wood only rattle. Breaking a load-bearing wall can bring down the floor above, so the user must take a moment to feel for the load first or risk the collapse. Strain: moderate.

Settling Hum.name: Settling Hum
Settling Hum.description: The user presses both palms to a rubble pile or a cracked wall and drives a low, even hum through it. Loose debris settles and packs tight and does not shift or slide again for the rest of the scene; the user also feels each trapped person inside and can shake loose a crawl-width gap to them. While packing, the user cannot move or defend themselves until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Shatterhold Climb.name: Shatterhold Climb
Shatterhold Climb.description: The user taps fingertips and boot toes into a wall and shakes out a small pocket with each tap, climbing a stone, brick or concrete face up to a rooftop at a steady pace. The pockets stay, so one other person can follow the same holds up or down. Smooth metal and glass give no holds, and the user cannot climb and fight at the same time. Strain: moderate.

Bone-Deep Quake.name: Bone-Deep Quake
Bone-Deep Quake.description: The user plants a palm on a target and releases a deep quake that passes through armor, padding, shields and hardened skin into the body behind them. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage that no worn armor or block reduces, and the target cannot stand until the end of their next turn; held back, it only drops them dizzy to their knees. Afterward that arm is numb and the user cannot use it until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Epicenter Drop.name: Epicenter Drop
Epicenter Drop.description: The user's signature move: both palms slam into the ground and a quake spreads across a circle a street wide. Every enemy standing in it takes massive bludgeoning damage and is thrown down, unable to stand until the end of their next turn; held back, the quake only throws them down. Windows in the circle shatter, and afterward the user's arms go numb and they cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Steady Frame.name: Steady Frame
Steady Frame.description: The user lays both palms on a building's frame and meets every shake in it with an equal counter-shake. For the rest of the scene, as long as the user keeps contact, that building does not shake, crack further or collapse from an earthquake, a blast or a falling neighbor, and the user feels every person inside it and calls out where each one is. The user cannot move, attack or defend while holding. Strain: severe.

Fresh Trace.name: Fresh Trace
Fresh Trace.description: The user lays bare fingertips on an object or a spot, and impressions of the last few minutes come to them: the faces and hands of whoever touched it, what those people felt and what happened within a few strides. A dropped knife shows the face of the person who dropped it; a doorknob shows who left in a hurry. The impressions are images and feelings, not words, and gloves block the reading. Strain: light.

Parry Reading.name: Parry Reading
Parry Reading.description: The user touches an opponent's weapon as it comes in, whether a blade, a bat, a pipe or a gun barrel, and reads where it was about to go. The opponent's next attack with that weapon misses the user or an ally beside them, and the user's counter shoves the opponent off balance. A bare fist or a Quirk attack holds no residue to read, so it lands as normal. Strain: light.

Chain of Hands.name: Chain of Hands
Chain of Hands.description: The user holds an object and follows its residue back through the last few hours, hand by hand: every person who held it, in order, their faces, where each one took it and what they did with it there. A stolen wallet leads back through the fence to the pickpocket. Each step back is fainter, and objects handled by crowds, such as cash or a train strap, blur into noise. Strain: moderate.

Turned Grip.name: Turned Grip
Turned Grip.description: The user seizes an opponent's weapon and reads at once how its owner holds it, which way they twist and when they let go. The user wrenches it free into their own hand, and the opponent is thrown off balance and pinned in a wrist lock until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go. The weapon must be one the opponent has carried for at least a few minutes, long enough to leave residue. Strain: moderate.

Moment of Collapse.name: Moment of Collapse
Moment of Collapse.description: The user presses a palm to a beam, a slab or a wall of a collapsed building and reads the moment it fell. They see where each person inside stood, which way they ran and where the floors came down on them, and can point rescuers to every likely survivor. The reading shows that moment, not the present, so it cannot tell who is still alive, and it takes the user a full minute of contact. Strain: heavy.

Worn Path Run.name: Worn Path Run
Worn Path Run.description: The user trails a hand along walls, railings and door frames as they move, reading where people have walked in the last few hours. They and up to three allies find the back stairs and service doors the staff use, time their crossing between the guards' rounds and pass through a building or a city block unseen by its regular patrols. A newcomer who has left no trail yet is not avoided. Strain: moderate.

Battleground Reading.name: Battleground Reading
Battleground Reading.description: The user kneels, palms on the ground where enemies have fought this scene, and reads every feint and swing they made there. For the rest of the scene, those enemies' attacks on the user miss unless the attacker makes a hard effort, and the user's counters deal heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, a counter only throws the enemy down. The user is open to attack while kneeling, and an enemy new to that ground gives nothing to read. Strain: heavy.

Whole Fight Read.name: Whole Fight Read
Whole Fight Read.description: The user's signature move: they catch an opponent's weapon and read in one moment the whole fight its owner has planned. Every attack the opponent makes misses the user until the end of the opponent's next turn, and the user's counter deals massive bludgeoning damage and leaves them unable to act until then; held back, it only drops them. Afterward the user's head pounds and they cannot read until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Full Scene Reading.name: Full Scene Reading
Full Scene Reading.description: The user walks a crime scene or a room, touching surfaces as they go, and reads its last few days in order: who came and went, what was done there, what was hidden and where, and the faces, vehicles and routes involved. Police can follow each lead to a person or a hidden object, but the reading is never evidence by itself, and the user spends the whole scene reading and cannot fight while they do. Strain: severe.

Diagnostic Touch.name: Diagnostic Touch
Diagnostic Touch.description: The user lays bare fingertips on a machine and feels its state: whether it is running, what it is doing, what is failing and how it is meant to work. They learn how to open, stop or start it, whether a bomb's circuit is live, how much charge or fuel it holds and whether a part is about to give out. They read one machine at a time, and anything with no motor, engine or circuit tells them nothing. Strain: light.

Coaxed Lock.name: Coaxed Lock
Coaxed Lock.description: The user touches an electronic lock, an automatic door, a shutter, a turnstile or a running engine and talks it into one thing it was built to do: the lock opens or locks, the door or shutter opens or shuts, or the engine stalls and will not start again until the user allows it. A key lock, a padlock or a deadbolt does not answer, and a separate alarm system still sounds unless the user touches it too. Strain: light.

Seized Servos.name: Seized Servos
Seized Servos.description: The user grabs an opponent's powered gear, such as an exoskeleton, a motorized gauntlet, a jet pack or a support-item harness, and orders every motor in it to lock. The wearer is frozen inside it and cannot move the locked parts until the end of their next turn, or longer while the user keeps hold; a drone or a scooter simply stops. The wearer can climb out with a hard effort, and gear without motors does not answer. Strain: moderate.

Lurch Command.name: Lurch Command
Lurch Command.description: The user slaps a hand on a machine with moving parts and orders it to lurch: a parked car rolls a stride, a forklift sweeps its tines, a roller shutter slams down or a conveyor jerks. A target in its path takes bludgeoning damage and is knocked flat; held back, the machine only bumps them over and pins them in place until they wriggle free. The user needs a suitable machine at hand, and it moves only as far as its parts allow. Strain: moderate.

Gentle Halt.name: Gentle Halt
Gentle Halt.description: The user grips the controls or frame of a failing machine, such as a falling elevator, a runaway train car or a tipping crane, and talks every working part into holding it steady. It comes to a gentle stop and stays there for the rest of the scene, so the people on it can climb out. If a cable has snapped, the machine holds only as much as its remaining parts allow, and the user cannot let go until everyone is clear. Strain: heavy.

Drone Errand.name: Drone Errand
Drone Errand.description: The user holds a drone or a remote-control car for a moment, then sends it out as far as a few city blocks. For the rest of the scene they steer it without the controller, feel what its camera picks up and can have it carry a phone or a rope to trapped people. The user must stay still with eyes closed while steering, and if the machine is smashed the jolt keeps them from using the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Driverless Run.name: Driverless Run
Driverless Run.description: The user lays a hand on a car, a truck or a motorbike, and it drives itself at their will for the rest of the scene, with the user inside or up to a city block away in sight. It boxes in a fleeing vehicle, carries injured people to an ambulance or rams a target for heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, it only pins them to a wall. A crash hurts anyone inside, and the user cannot use another technique while it runs. Strain: heavy.

Grand Shutdown.name: Grand Shutdown
Grand Shutdown.description: The user's signature move: they slam a palm onto any machine and their order runs through every machine within a street's width at once. Every enemy wearing or riding powered gear there is locked inside it and cannot act until the end of their next turn, every vehicle stops dead, and every electronic door the user names opens or seals. Afterward the user's hands shake and they cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Building Concord.name: Building Concord
Building Concord.description: The user lays a hand on a building's control panel or machine room and takes hold of every machine in the building for the rest of the scene. They know what every camera sees, run every elevator and fan, open or seal any electronic door, start the sprinklers and drop the fire shutters anywhere, trapping villains or opening a path for evacuees. The user must stay at that spot and cannot fight or defend while holding. Strain: severe.

Left-Behind Self.name: Left-Behind Self
Left-Behind Self.description: The user steps aside and leaves an image of themselves standing where they were, still moving and looking around. Attacks aimed at the image pass through it into whatever lies behind, and anyone tracking the user goes after the image until the end of their next turn. The image makes no sound and casts no shadow, so anyone who touches it, listens closely or checks the floor sees through it at once. Strain: light.

Phantom Feint.name: Phantom Feint
Phantom Feint.description: An image of the user lunges at a target within a few strides from one side while the real user strikes from the other. The target guards against the image, and the real blow lands unblocked for bludgeoning damage and knocks them off balance; held back, it only shoves them down. A target who has already seen this feint during the scene is not fooled by it again. Strain: light.

Stored Glare.name: Stored Glare
Stored Glare.description: The user releases a stored glimpse of a blinding light, such as the noon sun, a welding arc or a pair of headlights, as a flash in a cone a few strides wide. Everyone in the cone who is looking toward the user is blinded until the end of their next turn, with no lasting harm. The user must have kept a sight that bright in their store, and anyone wearing tinted goggles or looking away is unaffected. Strain: moderate.

Witness Reel.name: Witness Reel
Witness Reel.description: The user projects up to ten minutes of what they saw, life-size and in full color, a few strides away. Police see the suspect's face, the license plate and the route taken; before a breach, teammates see the room the user glimpsed, with every guard and hostage in place. The reel shows only what the user's own eyes saw, from their angle, and carries no sound, so anything said must be told. Strain: moderate.

False Dead End.name: False Dead End
False Dead End.description: The user projects a stored image of a wall, a closed shutter or a parked truck across an alley, a corridor or a doorway. Anyone who sees it believes the way is blocked: a fleeing villain turns back toward waiting heroes, and civilians keep away from danger. The image lasts as long as the user watches it, and anyone who touches it or throws something through it sees that the way is open. Strain: moderate.

Remembered Route.name: Remembered Route
Remembered Route.description: In smoke, darkness or a blackout, the user projects the corridor, stairwell or street they saw before it went dark, outlined in faint light at full size over the real one. Evacuees can follow the projected route to the exit at a steady pace for the rest of the scene. The image shows the place as it was when the user saw it, so any new collapse, fire or locked door does not appear in it. Strain: heavy.

Hall of Selves.name: Hall of Selves
Hall of Selves.description: The user fills a street-wide area with a dozen moving images of themselves, each acting on its own. Until the end of the user's next turn, every attack aimed at the user hits only an image unless the attacker makes a hard effort, and the user strikes from among them for heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, the strike only knocks the target down. The images make no sound, and the user can only move and strike while holding them. Strain: heavy.

Banked Sunlight.name: Banked Sunlight
Banked Sunlight.description: The user's signature move: they release every bright sight stored in their eyes in a single burst down a street. Every enemy within a street's length looking toward the user takes massive light damage and is blind until the end of their next turn; held back, the burst only blinds them with no lasting harm. Afterward the user's store is empty and they cannot project any image until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Silent Battalion.name: Silent Battalion
Silent Battalion.description: The user projects every hero, police officer and patrol car they have seen that day, life-size and moving, around a building or a city block. Every enemy inside who sees them believes they are surrounded and surrenders unless they keep fighting with a hard effort of will, and the images hold for the rest of the scene. The images bring no sirens, voices or footsteps, so an enemy who notices the silence sees through them. Strain: severe.

Homing Snap.name: Homing Snap
Homing Snap.description: The user vanishes and stands on any of their anchors within the district, arriving at rest. A grip, a net or a closing crowd is left with nothing in it, and a user falling from a height or thrown through the air snaps to an anchor and lands on their feet, unhurt. The user arrives dizzy and cannot attack until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Recall Jab.name: Recall Jab
Recall Jab.description: The user presses an anchor into the ground a few strides behind them, steps in and strikes a target within reach, then snaps back to the anchor before the target can answer. The blow deals bludgeoning damage and staggers the target; held back, it is only a sharp shove that knocks them off balance. Any counterattack meets empty air, but the anchor must be set before the user closes in. Strain: light.

Harbor Send.name: Harbor Send
Harbor Send.description: The user touches a person in danger, trapped in a crushed car, cornered on a burning ledge or caught in a crowd crush, and sends them alone to one of the user's anchors, where they arrive at rest and unhurt; whatever pinned them is left behind. One person goes per use, a person who resists cannot be sent, and the user stays where they are, still in the danger. Strain: moderate.

Cell Delivery.name: Cell Delivery
Cell Delivery.description: The user grips a target within reach and snaps with them to an anchor planted beside a police van, a holding cell or a waiting team of heroes. The target arrives on their knees, dizzy and retching, and cannot attack or flee until the end of their next turn, with no lasting harm. Only one target travels per use, and the user arrives beside them too dizzy to strike until the end of their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Tail Mark.name: Tail Mark
Tail Mark.description: The user slaps an anchor onto a moving thing within reach, a getaway car, a train carriage or a stolen crate, and the anchor holds as it moves. For the rest of the day the user feels exactly where it is and how fast it travels, and can snap to stand beside it the moment it stops. The anchor takes up one of the user's three, and the user cannot snap onto it while it is still moving. Strain: moderate.

Shuttle Rescue.name: Shuttle Rescue
Shuttle Rescue.description: The user plants one anchor in a safe place and another inside a burning floor, a flooded basement or a collapsed tunnel within the district, then snaps between them, carrying one person out on each trip. In a single turn they bring out up to five people, each arriving at rest and unhurt; the trips leave the user so dizzy that they cannot snap or attack until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Triangle Rush.name: Triangle Rush
Triangle Rush.description: The user plants three anchors around a target in one quick circling step, then snaps between them faster than the eye can follow, striking from each side in turn. The target cannot block or dodge and takes heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, the blows only sweep them to the ground. All three anchors are spent, and the user cannot plant new ones until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Three-Anchor Throw.name: Three-Anchor Throw
Three-Anchor Throw.description: The user's signature move: they grip a target and snap with them through all three anchors in a single heartbeat and hurl them down at the last. The target takes massive bludgeoning damage from the throw and the wrenching snaps and is too dizzy to stand or act until the end of their next turn; held back, the throw is a controlled takedown. Afterward the user cannot snap until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Six-Point Circuit.name: Six-Point Circuit
Six-Point Circuit.description: For the rest of the scene the user holds six anchors instead of three and snaps to any of them once each turn without losing their action, carrying one touched person along if they choose. They drop into a fight from a rooftop anchor, pull an injured ally out to a safe one and are back before the enemy turns. When the scene ends, every anchor fades at once and the user cannot plant new ones until they have rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Window Wall.name: Window Wall
Window Wall.description: The user sweeps a palm and a door-sized pane of clear glass rises between attackers and the people behind it. Blows, thrown objects and pistol rounds from the front cannot pass it until a strike lands on its weak point, which the user feels and keeps shifting while they touch the pane; the glass hides nothing, so everyone behind it stays in plain sight. Strain: light.

Bead Volley.name: Bead Volley
Bead Volley.description: The user flicks a handful of hard glass beads at a target within a stone's throw. They deal bludgeoning damage and knock the target back a step; held back, they only sting, and the beads scattered underfoot make anyone running across that patch slip and fall until they are swept away. Beads thrown at a raised riot shield or worn armor do nothing. Strain: light.

Fused Shackle.name: Fused Shackle
Fused Shackle.description: The user grips a target's wrist or ankle for a moment and grows a ring of glass around it that fuses to the floor, a railing or the target's other limb. The target cannot pull free until the shackle is struck at its weak point, which the user turns to the inside edge out of reach, broken with heavy tools or released by the user. A struggling target may slip the grip before the glass sets. Strain: moderate.

Burning Lens.name: Burning Lens
Burning Lens.description: The user grows a fist-sized lens in their palm and focuses sunlight or a floodlight onto a target within a street's width. A flash into the eyes leaves them unable to see until the end of their next turn; held on skin or gear, the point deals fire damage and can light paper or burn through a rope. Indoors, at night or under heavy cloud the lens has nothing to focus and does nothing. Strain: moderate.

Crack Glaze.name: Crack Glaze
Crack Glaze.description: The user presses both palms to a cracking wall, a sagging ceiling or a split pipe and pours glass into every crack, where it sets as seams and braces. Through the glass they feel each point of strain, so they know which parts are about to fail. For the rest of the scene that structure cannot fall or burst any further, though a blast or a fire that heats the glass can still crack it open. Strain: heavy.

Glass Stairway.name: Glass Stairway
Glass Stairway.description: The user grows a stair of thick glass up a building face, a ramp to an upper window or a narrow bridge across a street-wide gap, and runs up it as it sets. It holds the user and a line of people walking single file, and through it the user feels the weight of everyone standing on it; a heavy blow to its weak point brings it down, so the user keeps that point shifting toward the wall. Strain: moderate.

Shard Fan.name: Shard Fan
Shard Fan.description: The user throws both arms forward and a fan of glass shards bursts over everyone in a cone a few strides wide. Each takes heavy slashing and piercing damage and is driven back; held back, the user grows the shards blunt and they only batter for bludgeoning damage and knock people down. Sharp shards stay on the ground and cut anyone who crosses them, so the user must warn rescuers and clear them. Strain: heavy.

Shatterpoint Fist.name: Shatterpoint Fist
Shatterpoint Fist.description: The user's signature move: they grow a layered glass gauntlet over one fist with its weak point turned inward, then drive it into a target. It deals massive bludgeoning damage that ignores worn armor and hardened skin, and on impact the gauntlet bursts into blunt pebbles that knock everyone within a stride off their feet; afterward the user's knuckles split and they cannot grow glass until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Glass Skeleton.name: Glass Skeleton
Glass Skeleton.description: The user lays both hands on a failing building and threads glass up through its cracked columns, beams and stairwells. For the rest of the scene the building cannot collapse, every stairway stays passable, and the user feels the weight of every person on every floor, so they can point rescuers to each one. The user must keep a hand on the building and cannot move or attack while it holds. Strain: severe.

Drawn Lifeline.name: Drawn Lifeline
Drawn Lifeline.description: The user draws a coil of rope in one quick stroke and it lifts off as an ink line up to two stories long. It loops around a person on a ledge, under a fallen sign or at the edge of a roof and hauls them to the user or lowers them gently. As a quick sketch it holds one adult and snaps under a second, and water dissolves it at once. Strain: light.

Sketched Hound.name: Sketched Hound
Sketched Hound.description: The user sketches a hound in a few strokes and it peels off the surface and bounds at a target within a street's width. It bites for piercing damage and drags them to the ground; held back, it only bowls them over and stands on their chest until the end of their next turn. A solid blow or a splash of water breaks it apart. Strain: light.

Drawn Net.name: Drawn Net
Drawn Net.description: The user sweeps a net across a wall or the floor in broad strokes, and it lifts off and drops over a target within a few strides. The target is tangled and cannot run, fight or reach their pockets until they tear free with a hard effort, the net fades after a few minutes or water dissolves it. A net drawn in haste tears at the first hard pull. Strain: moderate.

Scout Sparrow.name: Scout Sparrow
Scout Sparrow.description: The user draws a small bird on their palm and it takes off, flying up to a few city blocks away and back within a couple of minutes. On its return it lands on a sheet of paper and lies flat as a careful sketch of everything it passed: who stands where, which exits are blocked, where people are trapped. Rain, a sprinkler or a swatting hand ends it, and it shows nothing it did not fly past. Strain: moderate.

Inked Ladder.name: Inked Ladder
Inked Ladder.description: The user runs a long line of rungs up a building face or across a street-wide gap, and it lifts off as a solid ink ladder or bridge. The user and a line of people can climb or cross it for about five minutes before it fades; drawn carefully it holds several adults at once. A hose or a downpour dissolves it under anyone still on it, so the user must watch the weather and the fire crews. Strain: moderate.

Ink Bulwark.name: Ink Bulwark
Ink Bulwark.description: The user spends a full turn drawing a tall shield on a wall or the floor with careful strokes, and it peels up as a slab of ink taller than a person that stands where the user points. Blows, thrown objects and pistol rounds from the front cannot pass it until a heavy blow breaks it, but a hose or a burst pipe washes it away at once, and it fades after a few minutes. Strain: heavy.

Inked Pack.name: Inked Pack
Inked Pack.description: The user drags all ten fingertips across the ground and three hounds peel up at once, each running at a different target within a street's width. Each target takes heavy piercing damage and is dragged down; held back, the hounds only pin them until the end of their next turn. Drawn this fast, each hound breaks apart at a single solid blow, and the user cannot draw again until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Grand Masterstroke.name: Grand Masterstroke
Grand Masterstroke.description: The user's signature move: in one sweeping drawing they lay a great beast across a wall or the street, and it rears up taller than a truck. It strikes a target once for massive bludgeoning and slashing damage and pins them under its weight, unable to act until the end of their next turn; held back, it only bowls them over and pins them. Then it splashes into ink, and the user cannot draw until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Living Mural.name: Living Mural
Living Mural.description: The user paints a mural across a street-facing wall during a full turn, and for the rest of the scene it keeps sending out constructs on its own: each turn a rope lowers someone from a window, a hound pins an enemy within a street's width, or a bird scouts and returns as a sketch. The mural follows the user's last orders even while they fight elsewhere, until rain or a hose washes it off the wall. Strain: severe.

Minute Mend.name: Minute Mend
Minute Mend.description: The user touches a broken non-living object up to the size of a door and returns it to its state up to a minute ago: a shattered window whole, a jammed lock working, a snapped crutch or a smashed radio usable again. Nothing older than a minute can be undone, nothing alive answers, and pieces flying back to the object bump into anyone in the way. Strain: light.

Shard Recall.name: Shard Recall
Shard Recall.description: The user touches an object broken within the last minute, a smashed crate, a split bench or a shattered pot, and its scattered pieces within a few strides fly back to rejoin it, striking a target in their path. The target takes bludgeoning damage and is knocked off balance; held back, the user calls back only the small pieces, which sting and trip. Without a freshly broken object in reach, there is nothing to recall. Strain: light.

Sealed Breach.name: Sealed Breach
Sealed Breach.description: The user touches a wall, a door or a fence that was broken through within the last minute, and it rebuilds itself whole around anyone standing in the gap. The returning bricks or planks close around their body and grip without crushing, holding them in place until they break out with a hard effort or are freed with tools. Anyone not standing in the gap is simply shut out, so a fleeing target must still be in it. Strain: moderate.

Defused by Touch.name: Defused by Touch
Defused by Touch.description: The user lays a hand on a device or a weapon for a full breath, feels what changed in it during the last minute and returns it to that earlier state: a bomb armed in that span is unarmed again, a pistol loaded in that span is empty and a support gadget switched on in that span switches off. Anything changed earlier does not answer, and the user must stay within the holder's reach while touching it. Strain: moderate.

Restored Crossing.name: Restored Crossing
Restored Crossing.description: The user touches the base of a stairway, a fire escape, a footbridge or a ladder that fell within the last few minutes, and it rises back into place whole, fixed where it was. The user and anyone with them can climb or cross it at once, and it stays standing afterward. Pieces held down by a person or carried off elsewhere stay put, leaving gaps the user must warn others about. Strain: moderate.

Wreck Unmade.name: Wreck Unmade
Wreck Unmade.description: The user lays both palms on a crushed car, a buckled elevator car or a fallen slab up to a car's size and returns it to how it stood up to a few minutes ago. Crumpled doors spring open, a crushed roof lifts off the people inside and a slab rises back into the ceiling, moving around trapped bodies without crushing them. Damage older than a few minutes stays, and the user cannot move until the object finishes returning. Strain: heavy.

Rubble Recall.name: Rubble Recall
Rubble Recall.description: The user touches a wall, a car or a pillar smashed within the last few minutes, and every scattered piece across a street's width flies back to rejoin it at once. Everyone standing between the pieces and the object takes heavy bludgeoning damage and is knocked flat; held back, the user calls only the smaller pieces, which bruise and trip. The pieces fly in straight lines, so the user must first clear bystanders from their paths. Strain: heavy.

One-Minute Reset.name: One-Minute Reset
One-Minute Reset.description: The user's signature move: a slapped palm returns everything non-living within a street's width to its state a minute ago. Craters fill, torn asphalt flies back into place, enemies in a filled crater are gripped to the waist in rebuilt road, and every enemy struck by the returning debris takes massive bludgeoning damage; held back, it only pins. Afterward the user cannot undo anything until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Standing Again.name: Standing Again
Standing Again.description: The user lays both hands on a collapsed section of a building up to the size of a house and returns it to how it stood up to ten minutes ago. Floors rise back into place, burned walls stand whole and slabs lift off the people trapped beneath them, leaving them lying in the rebuilt rooms; flames still burning are not undone. The user cannot move, speak or defend themselves until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Next-Beat Dodge.name: Next-Beat Dodge
Next-Beat Dodge.description: The user sees the next attack aimed at them about three seconds before it comes and is already moving. Until the end of the user's next turn, the first melee or thrown attack against the user from someone in their sight misses completely. An attack from behind, out of sight or through a wall still lands, and a brawl of many attackers gives the user only a blur. Strain: light.

Answered Blow.name: Answered Blow
Answered Blow.description: The user sees where an opponent within reach will be a beat from now and strikes that spot first. The blow lands before the opponent can guard and deals bludgeoning damage; held back, it is a palm strike that knocks the wind out of them. The user commits fully to the read, so any other attacker gets a clear opening on the user until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: light.

Shouted Warning.name: Shouted Warning
Shouted Warning.description: The user sees a danger a few seconds before it reaches one person in their sight, a falling sign, a swerving car, a thrown knife, and calls one exact warning: down, left, stop. A person who reacts in time avoids that danger entirely and is unhurt. The warning works for one person per use and only if they can hear the user and choose to listen, so a panicking crowd may ignore it. Strain: light.

Foreseen Grab.name: Foreseen Grab
Foreseen Grab.description: The user sees where a fleeing or struggling person within a few strides will step next and is already there, seizing an arm or collar. The target is held fast until they win a contest of strength against the user's grip; a hero with capture tape or cuffs can restrain them in that time. The grab works only on a target of roughly human size, and a target with a strength Quirk breaks it at once. Strain: moderate.

Clear Path Run.name: Clear Path Run
Clear Path Run.description: The user looks down a route within sight, a collapsing hallway, a road of speeding cars, a falling rubble field, and sees its next seconds as they run it. They cross the route untouched by falling debris, traffic or a surging crowd and may lead one person by the hand behind them. If the user stops, slows or loses sight of the route midway, the vision breaks and the danger reaches them normally. Strain: moderate.

Trigger Finger Read.name: Trigger Finger Read
Trigger Finger Read.description: The user sees the moment an opponent within reach will fire a gun, swing a blade or set off their Quirk, and strikes the wrist, arm or hand first. The weapon falls from their grip, or the Quirk activation is spoiled and does nothing this turn. The user must be within reach and gets one read per turn; an emitter who attacks without moving their body gives no tell to read. Strain: moderate.

Ten-Second Horizon.name: Ten-Second Horizon
Ten-Second Horizon.description: The user stretches their sight to about ten seconds ahead across everything they can see within a city block. Until the end of the user's next turn nobody in that area can surprise the user, and the user may shout orders that let up to three allies each avoid one attack, shot or falling hazard. Afterward a pounding headache blinds the Quirk, so the user cannot use it until the end of their following turn. Strain: heavy.

Every Branch Seen.name: Every Branch Seen
Every Branch Seen.description: The user's signature move: they see several next-few-seconds at once and choose the one where the fight goes their way. Until the end of the user's next turn, every attack the user makes against an opponent in sight hits, and every attack from an opponent in sight misses; the user's strike deals heavy bludgeoning damage, or, held back, drops the opponent unconscious. Afterward, afterimages blur the user's sight for the scene. Strain: severe.

Minute Ahead.name: Minute Ahead
Minute Ahead.description: The user fixes their sight on a scene and sees about a minute ahead: where a collapse will fall, which way a villain will run, which hostage will be grabbed and when a fuse will blow. The user may brief their team before the minute starts, and the first thing each briefed ally acts against goes exactly as foreseen. Once anyone acts, events branch and the vision ends, and the user is spent for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Glimpse Ahead.name: Glimpse Ahead
Glimpse Ahead.description: The user touches a person and meets their eyes, and in a breath sees about the next fifteen minutes of that person's life: where they will go, who they will meet, what they will do and what will happen to them. The vision shows the course if nobody changes it, and acting on it branches the future. The user can read each person once per day, and sunglasses or closed eyes block it. Strain: light.

Foreseen Throw.name: Foreseen Throw
Foreseen Throw.description: The user throws a small heavy object, a paperweight, a stone, a stapler, at the spot an opponent they have read today will be in a moment. It strikes them there before they can guard and deals bludgeoning damage; held back, it is a stinging knock that staggers them. It works only against a person the user read today, and the user needs a hand-sized object to throw. Strain: light.

Averted Accident.name: Averted Accident
Averted Accident.description: After reading a person, the user sees a danger waiting in their coming stretch of time, a car at a crossing, a fall from a platform, a villain on their route home, and acts first. If the user or an ally the user warns can reach that person before the moment arrives, the person is moved out of harm and is unhurt. If nobody can get there in time, the danger plays out as the vision showed. Strain: moderate.

Waiting Trap.name: Waiting Trap
Waiting Trap.description: The user reads a suspect, or anyone the suspect will meet, and sees where the suspect will go in the next stretch of time. Police or heroes the user sends wait at that place, and the suspect walks into them and can be restrained. If the suspect learns of the trap or changes plans, the future branches and the user knows only that the vision no longer holds. Strain: moderate.

Full Hour Reading.name: Full Hour Reading
Full Hour Reading.description: The user holds a reading longer and sees a full hour of a person's coming life in close detail: each place, each face, each spoken word in that person's hearing. This is enough to learn a meeting time, a delivery route or the shape of a planned attack. The reading takes several breaths of contact and leaves the user drained, so they cannot read anyone else for the rest of the scene. Strain: moderate.

Route Ahead.name: Route Ahead
Route Ahead.description: Before an operation the user reads a teammate and sees the operation's coming stretch from beside them: the locked door, the ambush on the stairwell, the hostage moved to the roof. The team uses the user's account to scout ahead, and the first danger the vision showed meets them already prepared, so it catches nobody by surprise. Changing the plan branches the future, and the vision shows nothing beyond that teammate's own path. Strain: moderate.

Many Hands Reading.name: Many Hands Reading
Many Hands Reading.description: The user takes the hands of up to five people in a line, meeting each one's eyes in turn, and sees about an hour of each of their coming lives at once. Where their paths cross, the user sees how those meetings go, so a team learns who will be hurt, a family learns whose route passes the danger and a hostage negotiator learns who will panic. The flood of scenes leaves the user unable to read anyone for the rest of the day. Strain: heavy.

Rewritten Hour.name: Rewritten Hour
Rewritten Hour.description: The user's signature move: after reading one opponent, they know every move that opponent will make for the rest of the scene a moment before it is made. The opponent's attacks against the user, and against any ally the user is calling out to, miss; the user's throws and strikes against that opponent hit and deal heavy bludgeoning damage, or, held back, knock them down. The user cannot use the Quirk on anyone for a full day afterward. Strain: severe.

Day Ahead.name: Day Ahead
Day Ahead.description: The user holds a person's eyes for a long moment and reads an entire day of that person's coming life, morning to night, in close detail: every meeting, every place, every danger and every turning point. Investigators use it to learn a whole plan and rescuers to learn exactly when a disaster will reach someone. The reading leaves the user unable to use the Quirk again until they have slept. Strain: severe.

Opening Measure.name: Opening Measure
Opening Measure.description: The user sings or taps a steady beat within six meters. Until the end of the user's next turn, two willing listeners keep their footing through ordinary jostling, or one opponent's next step pulls sideways and spoils a charge. The pressure moves feet, never decisions, and blocked hearing defeats it. Strain: light.

Immediate Reprise.name: Immediate Reprise
Immediate Reprise.description: The user calls "Encore" on the beat and physically repeats their last punch, step or shove before their next turn ends. A punch deals light bludgeoning damage; held back, it only nudges. The user needs room, pays twice the original exertion and cannot repeat a technique, another Quirk or this reprise. Strain: moderate.

Offbeat Ankles.name: Offbeat Ankles
Offbeat Ankles.description: The user directs three accented beats at one hearing opponent within eight meters. The pressure pulls their ankles toward each other, holding their feet together until the end of the user's next turn for capture. The target can break free with a hard effort, and the hold ends if the user stops performing. Strain: moderate.

Accented Palm.name: Accented Palm
Accented Palm.description: The user times a palm strike within arm's reach to a forceful sung accent. Rhythmic pressure behind the palm deals moderate force damage and pushes the target two steps back; held back, it only opens space without injury. The user must make contact, and a missed beat leaves the strike an ordinary shove. Strain: moderate.

Stagebound Leap.name: Stagebound Leap
Stagebound Leap.description: The user stamps in time and directs rhythmic pressure beneath both feet, leaping across a four-meter gap or onto a low balcony this turn. The user can carry one willing adult, halving the distance. The user needs a firm takeoff surface and an audible beat; losing either prevents the boost. Strain: moderate.

Exit Procession.name: Exit Procession
Exit Procession.description: The user sings clear walking counts to up to twenty people within twelve meters for three turns. Those choosing to follow keep an even pace toward a visible exit without tripping over one another. The user must walk with them and keep the beat audible; blocked exits stay blocked and frightened people can refuse. Strain: heavy.

Audience Flourish.name: Audience Flourish
Audience Flourish.description: The user spends three attention charges on a broad rhythmic gesture, sending pressure through an eight-meter stretch ahead. Hearing opponents take heavy force damage and slide two meters; held back, it only seats them without injury. Allies must clear the stretch, and the reserve empties even if the beat is interrupted. Strain: heavy.

Finale Formation.name: Finale Formation
Finale Formation.description: The user spends three attention charges on a signature musical sequence within fifteen meters. Until the end of the user's next turn, up to six hearing opponents have their feet pressed together for capture; a hard effort breaks each hold. The user must stand and perform throughout, then cannot set a beat for two turns. Strain: severe.

Company Rhythm.name: Company Rhythm
Company Rhythm.description: The user sustains a performance for the rest of the scene within twenty meters. Up to twelve willing listeners match footwork to avoid collisions and keep formation through ordinary shoves, including while carrying stretchers. The user must move at walking pace; silence or a buried beat ends it and clears attention charges. Strain: severe.

Medicinal Wrap.name: Medicinal Wrap
Medicinal Wrap.description: The user presses fresh gel onto one reachable wound, forming a clean dressing that seals surface bleeding for the rest of the scene. Small cuts begin closing after ten minutes of contact. The gel cannot seal a severed major artery or replace lost blood, and producing a fresh wrap costs water and stamina. Strain: light.

Yielding Guard.name: Yielding Guard
Yielding Guard.description: The user loosens their gel tissues around the torso core until the end of their next turn. The next punch or club strike deals reduced bludgeoning damage as the tissue compresses, or a fall of up to two meters lands with bruises instead of a sprain. The core remains vulnerable, and blades and bullets still wound. Strain: light.

Sticky Intercept.name: Sticky Intercept
Sticky Intercept.description: The user throws gel at one target within five meters, sticking a wrist or ankle to a nearby surface until the end of the user's next turn, with the face clear. A hard pull or cutting frees the limb. The user can instead glue a reachable door shut for three turns; a heavy blow tears it open. Loose dust prevents either seal. Strain: moderate.

Narrow Passage.name: Narrow Passage
Narrow Passage.description: The user compresses their gel tissues and crawls through a gap at least twenty centimeters wide, covering up to three meters this turn. The torso core stays intact and clothing must fit or be left behind. Sharp edges still cut, and the user cannot carry another adult through the passage. Strain: moderate.

Cooling Compress.name: Cooling Compress
Cooling Compress.description: The user covers a reachable burn with fresh cool gel for ten minutes, drawing off residual heat and protecting damaged skin while natural repair begins. The treatment eases pain but cannot undo deep tissue damage. The user must stay beside the patient, and flame or boiling surfaces overwhelm the gel. Strain: moderate.

Patient Tow.name: Patient Tow
Patient Tow.description: The user forms a padded gel cradle around one reachable injured adult, keeping the face clear, and draws it along the ground within six meters for three turns. The cradle supports the body without gripping wounds. The user moves at walking pace, cannot lift it over walls and must replace gel fouled by debris. Strain: heavy.

Broad Landing Pad.name: Broad Landing Pad
Broad Landing Pad.description: The user spreads a four-meter-wide gel pad within eight meters for three turns, cushioning a fall of up to six meters for two adults before flattening. The user can instead fold it into a shove dealing moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, it only seats a target. Greater falls and vehicle impacts overwhelm it, and either use leaves the user thirsty and shaky. Strain: heavy.

Guardian Gel Spread.name: Guardian Gel Spread
Guardian Gel Spread.description: The user releases a signature gel spread across ten meters for two turns, cushioning falls of up to eight meters for six adults and gumming up the legs of four grounded opponents. A hard pull frees each captive; faces stay clear. The user cannot move while feeding the spread and cannot produce gel for two turns afterward. Strain: severe.

Sustained Dressing.name: Sustained Dressing
Sustained Dressing.description: The user maintains fresh medicinal coats on four reachable patients for thirty minutes. Surface bleeding stays sealed and small wounds close faster, while deeper wounds remain protected for hospital care. The user stays within six meters and cannot attack; the treatment ends early if dehydration or exhaustion prevents further gel production. Strain: severe.

Hoarfrost Jet.name: Hoarfrost Jet
Hoarfrost Jet.description: The user throws a short jet of pale-blue flame from the palm at a target within three meters. It deals fire damage and leaves a crust of frost across the target's clothes or weapon; held back, it only singes and chills their fingers so they drop what they hold without burns. Rain or spray cuts its reach in half, and the frost crust melts away at the end of the target's next turn. Strain: light.

Cinder Glaze.name: Cinder Glaze
Cinder Glaze.description: The user sweeps a foot and spreads a sheet of ice five meters across the floor, rimmed with pale-blue embers that send up wisps of steam. Anyone on it who runs or swings hard slips and falls, and bare skin pressed to it takes minor cold damage; held back, the warm rim keeps the sheet from chilling skin while still tripping runners. Its own heat melts the sheet at the end of the user's next turn. Strain: light.

Frostwake Hop.name: Frostwake Hop
Frostwake Hop.description: Pale-blue flame bursts from the user's palms and soles and vaults them up a single story, across a narrow alley or clear of an incoming strike, leaving a harmless ring of frost where they push off and land. The burst is weaker than a pure fire user's thrust, so the user cannot stay aloft beyond the end of the turn or carry a passenger without scorching and chilling them. Strain: moderate.

Steaming Shackle.name: Steaming Shackle
Steaming Shackle.description: The user sends frost along the floor to a target within five meters and encases their wrists or ankles in blue-white ice threaded with warm vapor. The warmth prevents frostbite while the ice holds the target in place until they break free with a hard effort or until the end of their next turn, when the internal heat softens the shackle on its own. Strain: moderate.

Fogbank Curtain.name: Fogbank Curtain
Fogbank Curtain.description: The user clashes pale-blue flame and frost between both hands to roll a thick fog wall across a room or street until the end of their next turn. The damp curtain snuffs small fires and blocks sight and cameras from both sides, so shots fired through it miss, enabling allies to escape or advance unseen; running both natures at once sets the user shivering, so they cannot make ranged attacks while it holds. Strain: moderate.

Thermal Lock.name: Thermal Lock
Thermal Lock.description: The user touches an object or a five-meter patch of ground and holds it at a steady heat or freeze for the rest of the scene, keeping a hot door cool for rescuers, holding a floor slick with ice, or forcing a foe to drop a freezing weapon. At any moment the user can flip that extreme to crack a metal lock, stone slab or ice barrier via thermal shock, which leaves the user's hands numb until their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Blueflame Sear.name: Blueflame Sear
Blueflame Sear.description: The user presses a palm to a target or barrier and drives pale-blue fire into the contact point while frost rings the edges. It deals heavy fire damage that softens thin steel and chars through straps or doors without spreading flames beyond the frost ring; held back, it only welds a weapon's guard or stuns a foe with heat. It works only by touch and cannot melt thick armor plate or vault steel. Strain: heavy.

Cryothermal Shock.name: Cryothermal Shock
Cryothermal Shock.description: The user's signature move: pale-blue flame sweeps half a street ahead and turns to deep frost on impact, putting everything in its path through thermal shock. Stone cover, metal locks, ice and worn armor crack apart, and foes take massive fire and cold damage; held back, it shatters only gear and pins foes in steaming ice. Driving both natures leaves the user unable to use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Rime Ember Ward.name: Rime Ember Ward
Rime Ember Ward.description: The user spreads frost threaded with pale-blue embers across a whole room or courtyard for the rest of the scene. Sagging walls and rubble freeze solid so they cannot collapse on trapped people, fires go out, and chosen enemies are locked to the waist in warm-veined ice that holds without frostbite until broken with a hard effort; the ward reaches only one room or courtyard and thaws if the user leaves it. Strain: severe.

Charged Gust.name: Charged Gust
Charged Gust.description: The user thrusts a palm and drives a five-meter gust from their personal storm cloud into a target, laced with crackling static. It deals force damage, knocks the target a step back and makes their fingers twitch so they fumble a held weapon; held back, it only shoves them clear without injury. In a cramped space the static snaps back into the user's hands, stinging their palms. Strain: light.

Ozone Clasp.name: Ozone Clasp
Ozone Clasp.description: The user grabs a target within arm's reach and releases a measured jolt wrapped in a cool puff of storm mist that keeps the current from jumping to anyone else nearby. It deals minor electric damage and locks the target's arm or leg until the end of their next turn; held back, it only makes them drop what they hold. Rubber or heavy insulation stops the jolt cold. Strain: light.

Static Updraft.name: Static Updraft
Static Updraft.description: The user pops a crackling updraft beneath their feet to hop onto a low roof, a balcony or clear of an incoming attack, which misses them, or places the puff under a falling person to cushion the last few meters of their drop with a harmless buzz of static. The updraft reaches only half a story high and cannot keep anyone aloft past the end of the turn. Strain: moderate.

Squall Cover.name: Squall Cover
Squall Cover.description: The user vents a burst of mist, rain and static from their personal cloud across a room or alley until the end of their next turn. The static hiss scrambles cameras, radios and electronic sights inside the cloud while the rain hides the user and nearby allies for a clean escape, though the user's own radio and phone cut out until the cloud clears. Strain: moderate.

Channel Spark.name: Channel Spark
Channel Spark.description: The user shapes a narrow wind channel from their storm cloud to guide an electric spark across a room without a wire. It strikes a single target for electric damage while leaving people beside them untouched, or catches an incoming shock or live wire's current and grounds it harmlessly into the floor; shaping air and charge together roots the user in place until the end of their turn. Strain: moderate.

Downdraft Pin.name: Downdraft Pin
Downdraft Pin.description: The user drives their storm cloud overhead and drops a heavy, charged downdraft onto a target or small group within five meters. It deals force and electric damage, pins them to their knees and numbs their arms and legs so they cannot stand or attack until the end of their next turn; held back, it pins without burning. Running both natures drains the cloud, ending the user's updrafts next turn. Strain: heavy.

Vapordraft Clear.name: Vapordraft Clear
Vapordraft Clear.description: The user spins a damp current through a room or hallway, using the static in the mist to bind smoke, dust and airborne gas into heavy droplets that settle to the floor while fresh air flows in for trapped people. Hostile targets caught in the spin are shoved off balance and take force damage; the draft reaches only a single room or corridor and cannot clear a whole building. Strain: heavy.

Steered Lightning.name: Steered Lightning
Steered Lightning.description: The user's signature move: they carve a twisting wind channel down a street and fire their full storm charge along that tunnel, curving the bolt cleanly around bystanders and allies to strike every enemy in line. Each foe takes massive electric and force damage and cannot act until the end of their next turn; held back, it only knocks them flat. Afterward the user's cloud is spent until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Stormcell Sanctum.name: Stormcell Sanctum
Stormcell Sanctum.description: The user expands their personal cloud into a low mist across a room or courtyard for the rest of the scene, using thin wind seams to insulate every ally inside. The user can feed steady power into medical gear or emergency doors, or send a guided jolt through the mist into any enemy who enters for electric damage; the field covers only one room or courtyard and collapses if a heavy blast scatters the mist. Strain: severe.

Warm Slab.name: Warm Slab
Warm Slab.description: The user stamps the ground and tips up a waist-high slab of pavement for cover, smaller than a pure Earth user's wall and arriving smoking hot. Shots and thrown objects from the front stop against it, and an attacker who grabs or vaults the uncooled stone takes minor fire damage; the user must spend a moment drawing the heat back before an ally can lean on it safely. Strain: light.

Slag Glaze.name: Slag Glaze
Slag Glaze.description: The user presses a palm to stone or concrete and sends heat two strides through the floor instead of the air, blistering the rock into a glowing crust. A target standing on that patch takes fire damage and is forced a step back; held back, the crust only warms their soles and spoils their stance without burns. On wood or metal floors it fails, and the stone stays hot for a minute. Strain: light.

Cinder Ridge.name: Cinder Ridge
Cinder Ridge.description: The user slams a palm down and drives a knee-high ridge of smoking stone four strides across a floor, half the reach of an Earth Quirk user's line. Everyone on the line takes bludgeoning and fire damage and is knocked off their feet; held back, the ridge rises cooler and only trips them without burning. The broken strip radiates heat that blocks bare-handed crawlers until cooled. Strain: moderate.

Crucible Palm.name: Crucible Palm
Crucible Palm.description: The user lays a hand on brick, concrete or the stone frame around a door lock and pours heat straight into the mineral without open flame, narrower than a Fire user's steel-melting press. A fist-sized section softens into red paste in seconds, dropping a bolt or freeing a pinned limb; held back, it only softens mortar so a brick pulls free, and the user must cool the rim before anyone touches it. Strain: moderate.

Quenched Bind.name: Quenched Bind
Quenched Bind.description: The user softens the ground under a target within three strides into a hot mud trap that sinks their feet, or pours softened stone over a downed foe's wrists and draws the heat back to cool the rock into solid cuffs or a chest-high barricade. Held limbs cannot move until a heavy blow breaks the stone or the user softens it, and quenching the heat into the user's palms leaves no burn on the captive. Strain: moderate.

Vitrified Ramp.name: Vitrified Ramp
Vitrified Ramp.description: The user sweeps both hands over loose rubble and broken concrete, fusing the pile with heat into a smooth, glassy rescue ramp up to a second-story window or across a street-wide gap, then quenches the surface as they run up it.
