The cooled glass holds the weight of a crowd so civilians can climb down bare-handed, though absorbing the heat of the whole ramp leaves the user's arms aching and hot. Strain: moderate.

Kiln Vise.name: Kiln Vise
Kiln Vise.description: The user raises two waist-high slabs of glowing stone on either side of a target within three strides, smaller than an Earth user's walls, and slams them shut. It deals heavy bludgeoning and fire damage that ignores worn armor; held back, the user quenches the inner faces first so the slabs only clamp the target upright without burns until broken or released, dumping the drawn heat into the user's arms. Strain: heavy.

Caldera Surge.name: Caldera Surge
Caldera Surge.description: The user's signature move: both palms drive heat and shaping into the street at once, melting a lane of stone into a wave of slag that surges forward and quenches solid. Enemies in its path take massive fire and bludgeoning damage and are locked to the knees in cooled rock; held back, it cools before contact and only pins them. Afterward the user cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Crucible Floor.name: Crucible Floor
Crucible Floor.description: The user pours flameless heat into the stone and concrete across a single room or courtyard for the rest of the scene, half the reach of a pure Fire master. They can soften any wall or floor section to open a way for trapped people, or blister the ground under chosen enemies for heavy fire damage; held back, the warm floor only forces enemies to keep moving, and the user must cool a path before civilians cross. Strain: severe.

Warm Spray.name: Warm Spray
Warm Spray.description: The user fires a steaming stream of hot water from the palm out to five meters, half a pure Water user's range. It puts out small fires, settles dust and smoke, or hits a target for bludgeoning damage that knocks them back a step; held back, it cools to a warm splash in the face that spoils their aim until the end of their next turn. Each stream drains the user's water reserves. Strain: light.

Scald Puff.name: Scald Puff
Scald Puff.description: The user vents a sharp puff of hot vapor from the palm at a target within two strides, shorter than a Fire user's jet and carrying no open flame. It deals fire damage and forces the target to flinch back; held back, the user vents it cooler so the damp gust only stings their skin and makes them drop what they hold. In a cold room or dry air, its reach drops to arm's length. Strain: light.

Thermal Flush.name: Thermal Flush
Thermal Flush.description: The user releases a shin-deep surge of steaming water across a room, half the volume of a Water Quirk wave. Everyone in its path takes bludgeoning damage and slips off their feet on the wet floor; held back, the warm water rolls out gently to thaw ice or wash spilled fuel aside without knocking anyone down. The user must vent a cloud of steam afterward or feel the heat linger in their chest. Strain: moderate.

Vapor Sear.name: Vapor Sear
Vapor Sear.description: The user presses two fingers to a lock, a frozen pipe or an attacker's weapon and vents a needle of wet heat at contact, narrower than a Fire user's furnace press and unable to ignite dry fuel. It softens plastic, thaws ice or deals fire damage to a hand so the target drops their weapon; held back, it only warms metal too hot to grip without burning skin, and cold air weakens it. Strain: moderate.

Piston Vault.name: Piston Vault
Piston Vault.description: The user boils water in their limbs and vents high-pressure steam from the elbows or heels to drive a steam-piston strike or jump. A jump launches the user to a second-story roof or across a street, while a piston punch deals bludgeoning and fire damage and knocks a target flat; held back, the steam vents behind the elbow so the fist lands with pure bludgeoning force and no burn, leaving a loud hiss. Strain: moderate.

Valve Screen.name: Valve Screen
Valve Screen.description: The user vents a scalding-fog screen across a room until the end of their next turn, or focuses the release into a pressure valve jet at touch that bursts a jammed door or lifts a slab of rubble off someone trapped. Enemies entering the fog take fire damage and nobody can see through it; held back, it vents as warm mist that harms nobody and hides allies, though cold rooms condense it early. Strain: moderate.

Boiling Slug.name: Boiling Slug
Boiling Slug.description: The user packs a liter of steaming water between both palms and fires it across a room as a dense slug, half the range of a pure Water user's shot. It deals heavy bludgeoning and fire damage, splashes around a raised shield and knocks the target flat; held back, the user vents the heat from their wrists first so the slug strikes warm without scalding, though that steam clouds their own view. Strain: heavy.

Boiler Blowout.name: Boiler Blowout
Boiler Blowout.description: The user's signature move: they build core pressure and open a full pressure valve from both palms, bursting a steel door, lifting a collapsed roof slab or blasting a street-wide cone. Enemies in the cone take massive force and fire damage and are hurled back; held back, it vents cooler and only throws them flat. Afterward the user cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Simmering Hall.name: Simmering Hall
Simmering Hall.description: The user radiates damp, flameless heat through a single room or corridor for the rest of the scene, narrower than a Fire master's reach, coating every surface in hot condensation. Enemies inside take fire damage and their visors, glasses and scopes fog over so they cannot aim at range; held back, the humid warmth only saps their stamina and forces them to a knee without burns, though dry or freezing air halves the area. Strain: severe.

Rime Wedge.name: Rime Wedge
Rime Wedge.description: The user slaps a frost-plated palm to the floor and drives a low ridge of stone-hardened ice up to five meters into a target. It deals cold damage and locks around the target's ankles so they cannot run or dodge until the end of their next turn; held back, it only trips them without frostbite. Fire melts the ridge at once, and the slap stiffens the user's wrist with cold. Strain: light.

Frostplate Knuckle.name: Frostplate Knuckle
Frostplate Knuckle.description: The user grows a plate of ice over one fist and forearm and hardens it to stone density mid-swing, driving frost-hardened knuckles into a target within reach. It deals bludgeoning and cold damage and knocks the target back a step; held back with a smooth plate, it only staggers them and numbs their arm. The heavy plate slows the user's arm until the end of their next turn. Strain: light.

Glacier Slideway.name: Glacier Slideway
Glacier Slideway.description: The user lays a short ramp of stone-hardened ice up to a second-story window or across an alley and slides along it as it sets, carrying one person in their free arm. The dense ramp holds the weight of fleeing bystanders without cracking until heat melts it, so others can slide down to safety, but chilling their boots slows the user's running speed on the next turn. Strain: moderate.

Rime Shell Guard.name: Rime Shell Guard
Rime Shell Guard.description: The user steps over or in front of a person in danger and hardens a crust of frosted plates across their own back and shoulders. Until the end of the user's next turn, blows, blades, pistol rounds and falling debris strike the user's shell instead, doing no harm to either person and frosting any weapon that hits. Fire melts the shell, and its chill prevents the user from running. Strain: moderate.

Glacier Bear Hug.name: Glacier Bear Hug
Glacier Bear Hug.description: The user wraps both plated arms around a target within reach and fuses the overlapping ice plates into a stone-hard ring. The cold bear-hug restraint deals cold damage and locks the target's arms and torso until they break free with a hard effort, heat melts the ring or the user lets go; held back, it holds without frostbite. Running both natures chills the user's chest and slows them to a walk. Strain: moderate.

Calved Plate Shield.name: Calved Plate Shield
Calved Plate Shield.description: The user grows thick plates of ice on their forearms, hardens them to stone density and detaches up to three as armored ice shields for allies to carry or as standing cover for bystanders. For the rest of the scene each shield stops blades, pistol rounds and falling debris until a heavy blow cracks it or fire melts it. Spending both natures at once leaves the user's arms numb and slow until their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Hoarfrost Cleave.name: Hoarfrost Cleave
Hoarfrost Cleave.description: The user glazes a target's armor, shield or weapon with stone-hard frost on contact and drives a plated forearm through the brittle seam. It deals heavy cold and bludgeoning damage that ignores worn armor and shatters the struck shield or vest; held back, it cracks only the gear and shoves the target down. The deep chill locks the user's striking arm until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Anchored Glacier Stance.name: Anchored Glacier Stance
Anchored Glacier Stance.description: The user's signature move: they root into an anchored glacier stance of stone-hard ice that no charge, blast or truck can push over. Until the end of their next turn no blow harms them, and they slam both forearms down to drive a wave of stone-ice across a street for massive bludgeoning and cold damage; held back, it only pins feet. Pushing both natures leaves them unable to use the Quirk next turn. Strain: severe.

Permafrost Redoubt.name: Permafrost Redoubt
Permafrost Redoubt.description: The user plants their feet and grows overlapping layers of stone-hardened ice across their whole body, widening into a frost wall that shelters a group behind them for the rest of the scene. Gunfire, blasts, falling rubble and charging foes hit the user instead without breaking through, and attackers who strike them take cold damage, but heat softens the wall and the user cannot take a step while holding it. Strain: severe.

Balm Tendril Snare.name: Balm Tendril Snare
Balm Tendril Snare.description: Leaf-padded vines shoot from the user's forearm out to five meters and coil around a target's legs or arms. The target cannot run or use the bound limbs until they break free with a hard effort, cut the vines or the user lets go, and soothing sap on the leaves cools scrapes without leaving a bruise. In darkness or dry air the vines reach only half as far and drain brief stamina from the user. Strain: light.

Moss Poultice.name: Moss Poultice
Moss Poultice.description: The user lays a hand on a wounded person and grows a living moss dressing that clings over the injury. Bleeding stops at once, and cuts, burns and sprains mend slowly over the next few minutes, restoring some health while the user feels any deeper fracture beneath. The healing draws brief stamina and water from the user's own reserves rather than the patient's, and cannot mend the user. Strain: light.

Vine Stretcher Lift.name: Vine Stretcher Lift
Vine Stretcher Lift.description: The user casts two braided vines up to a second-story ledge or across a narrow gap to climb or swing across, and weaves broad leaves between them into a vine stretcher. The stretcher carries an injured person along beside the user or lowers them to the ground while mossy pads splint broken bones still and ease shock. Blades or fire cut the vines, and growing them drains water and stamina from the user. Strain: moderate.

Sapping Bloom Touch.name: Sapping Bloom Touch
Sapping Bloom Touch.description: The user grips an opponent's bare skin and drives a surge of plant-scented mending into a body with nothing to heal, while tiny blossoms sprout on their sleeve. The target takes biological damage as their strength drains into empty repair and cannot run or strike hard until the end of their next turn; held back, it deals no damage and only leaves them drowsy. The user pays moderate stamina from their own reserves. Strain: moderate.

Calming Pollen Drift.name: Calming Pollen Drift
Calming Pollen Drift.description: The user opens pale blossoms along their forearms and releases a cloud of calming pollen across a room. Until the end of the user's next turn, wounded allies and bystanders who breathe it feel their pain and panic fade so they can walk or hold steady despite injuries, while enemies inside have their focus dulled and cannot aim or charge. Wind blows the pollen away, and running both natures drains the user's stamina. Strain: moderate.

Nectar Fruit Bough.name: Nectar Fruit Bough
Nectar Fruit Bough.description: With light and water on hand, the user grows a fruiting branch from their wrist and pours both natures into a single ripe fruit. Any ally or patient who eats the fruit regains heavy stamina, shakes off exhaustion, knockout gas or poison fever, and has minor cuts begin to close over the next few minutes. The user cannot eat their own fruit to recover, and growing it costs the user heavy stamina and water. Strain: moderate.

Greenwood Ram.name: Greenwood Ram
Greenwood Ram.description: The user grows a bough of green wood padded with thick moss from their forearm and drives it into a target within a few strides. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage, knocks the target flat and wraps them in soothing moss that holds them still until they tear free; held back, the mossy pad absorbs the impact and only pins them to the floor unhurt. The growth needs light and water and drains the user's stamina. Strain: heavy.

Sanctuary Arbor Bloom.name: Sanctuary Arbor Bloom
Sanctuary Arbor Bloom.description: The user's signature move: they root both hands and raise a flowering arbor across a street corner. Vines lash every enemy inside for massive bludgeoning damage and bind them; held back, they only bind. Calming pollen dulls pain, vine stretchers lift the wounded onto moss dressings, and three stamina fruits ripen. Spending both natures empties the user's reserves so they cannot use the Quirk next turn. Strain: severe.

Moss Cocoon Vigil.name: Moss Cocoon Vigil
Moss Cocoon Vigil.description: The user wraps a gravely injured or dying person in a breathable bed of living moss and flowering vines for the rest of the scene. While the bed has light and water and the user keeps a hand on its roots, the patient cannot die from their wounds and slowly mends internal bleeding, deep burns and broken bones over the scene. The user cannot move away and pays extreme stamina from their own reserves. Strain: severe.

Sparking Snatch.name: Sparking Snatch
Sparking Snatch.description: The user crooks a hand at a steel weapon, tool or key ring within five meters and pulls it to their palm as a blue spark jumps across the metal. The jolt makes the holder's fingers twitch open before they can swing or fire, and the user catches the item or drops it at their feet. It cannot move objects heavier than a rifle, and plastic, wood or rubber-gripped gear ignores the pull. Strain: light.

Polar Jolt.name: Polar Jolt
Polar Jolt.description: The user touches a target's arm or shoulder and sends a measured electric jolt through them that also leaves a brief magnetic pull on any steel they wear or carry. It deals minor electric damage, forces them to drop a held item, and pulls their metal sleeves, buckles or cuffs together so they cannot run or swing until the end of their next turn; rubber or thick insulation blocks it. Strain: light.

Charged Clamp.name: Charged Clamp
Charged Clamp.description: The user marks a target within five meters and a wall, girder or car with opposite magnetic poles laced with live current. If the target wears metal armor, gear or cuffs, they slam against the surface and stick fast while a low hum numbs their arms: they cannot move from the spot until they wrench free with a hard effort or the user releases the field. Targets with no metal on them are not held. Strain: moderate.

Coil Pulse.name: Coil Pulse
Coil Pulse.description: The user claps both hands and sends a sharp electromagnetic pulse across a single room or a five-meter radius. A ring of sparks hums along nearby metal as every phone, camera, radio, card lock and remote detonator in that small area dies at once without setting explosives off. The pulse does not cross into neighboring rooms, and it fries the user's own phone and unshielded gear on the spot. Strain: moderate.

Bearing Volley.name: Bearing Volley
Bearing Volley.description: Current loops through the user's forearms as magnetic coils that accelerate coins, bolts or steel bearings down a street. At full force the shot deals piercing and electric damage; held back, the user fires flat-faced bearings as nonlethal stun shots that deal bludgeoning damage and knock the target down without breaking skin. Running both natures at once heats the user's forearms and burns through pocket metal. Strain: moderate.

Rail Glide.name: Rail Glide
Rail Glide.description: The user wraps their boots and palms in live magnetic coils and rides the pull along steel rails, girders, pipes or parked cars across a street or up a building face. They can carry one passenger and brake against steel below to turn a fall into a soft landing. Running current and pull together leaves the user's legs tingling and wipes cards and phones on both riders, and wooden or stone faces give no lift. Strain: moderate.

Arcing Catch.name: Arcing Catch
Arcing Catch.description: The user raises both hands and catches falling steel beams, rebar or thrown blades within a room's width in a magnetic field laced with crackling current. The arcs tack loose steel scraps together in midair so nothing showers onto the people below, and the user lowers the mass to a safe spot. The reach is half a pure magnet user's, and concrete, glass, wood and aluminum fall straight through untouched. Strain: heavy.

Solenoid Cannon.name: Solenoid Cannon
Solenoid Cannon.description: The user's signature move: both arms align into a magnetic coil that fires a steel bar down a street in a sleeve of lightning, dealing massive force and electric damage along the line. Held back, it fires a metal-free induction wave that knocks enemies in the lane flat until the end of their next turn. Running both natures empties the user's charge and numbs both arms until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Conduit Takeover.name: Conduit Takeover
Conduit Takeover.description: The user presses a palm to a wall's wiring and runs current and magnetic pull through one floor of a building for the rest of the scene. They can slam and lock steel doors, switch lights and alarms, and jolt any enemy touching metal on that floor for electric damage while pulling their hands fast to the fixture. It reaches only that single floor, fries the user's own devices, and ends if the user lifts their palm. Strain: severe.

Buoyant Tap.name: Buoyant Tap
Buoyant Tap.description: With a rubbery fingertip tap, the user halves the weight of a person or an object up to a scooter's weight and gives their step a gentle spring until a release gesture. A lightened ally bounds across gaps and lands softly from two stories up, while a lightened enemy loses footing and cannot brace for a heavy swing. It needs bare skin contact and reaches half a pure gravity user's load. Strain: light.

Snapback Belly.name: Snapback Belly
Snapback Belly.description: As a punch, kick, club strike or thrown object hits the user, their torso or forearm stretches inward to drink the force while their heels turn heavy to root them in place. The stretched flesh snaps back and rebounds the incoming blow straight at its source, dealing force damage and knocking an attacker back a step. Sharp blades, bullets and heat cut or burn the user instead of rebounding. Strain: light.

Sinker Grasp.name: Sinker Grasp
Sinker Grasp.description: The user stretches an arm across a room to wrap a target's wrist or ankle and pours weight into them through bare skin. The target is dragged to their knees, takes force damage from the sudden load and cannot run until the end of their next turn; held back, the weight only roots their feet to the floor without harm. The reach is short, and the weight shift turns the user's stomach. Strain: moderate.

Spring Tether.name: Spring Tether
Spring Tether.description: The user plants heavy feet, stretches an arm up to five meters to catch a fleeing target or an ally slipping off a ledge, and snaps the limb back. An ally is pulled safely to the user's side, while an enemy is yanked off their feet and cannot move past arm's reach until they wrench free with a hard effort or the user lets go. Any blade or flame on the target slices or burns the stretched arm. Strain: moderate.

Pinball Drop.name: Pinball Drop
Pinball Drop.description: The user goes feather-light to kick off walls, pillars and ceilings in rapid rebounding bounds across a street or up a shaft, then shifts to heavy weight in the final instant of landing on a target. The drop deals bludgeoning damage and knocks the target flat; held back, the user lands beside them and only bowls them off balance. Rapid weight shifts with every bounce leave the user nauseated. Strain: moderate.

Hammock Embrace.name: Hammock Embrace
Hammock Embrace.description: The user stretches their arms and torso into a wide elastic net beneath a falling person or dropped debris, goes feather-light on contact so the catch does not jar broken bones, and slowly restores weight to set them down softly on the ground. Nobody caught takes fall damage. Running stretch and weight shifts together leaves the user dizzy and vulnerable to sharp glass or hot metal in the fall. Strain: moderate.

Ballast Bracing.name: Ballast Bracing
Ballast Bracing.description: The user stretches both arms around a fallen beam, a tipping car or a pinned person and halves its weight with a springy lift so one rescuer can pull the survivor clear, or floods their own frame with weight to hold a door or ally immovable until the end of their next turn. It handles only half the mass a pure gravity user could float, and jagged metal or fire wounds the stretched arms. Strain: heavy.

Catapult Meteor.name: Catapult Meteor
Catapult Meteor.description: The user's signature move: they hook stretched hands to two walls or posts, draw their feather-light body back in a slingshot launch, and rocket down a street, turning tenfold heavy on impact. Enemies in the path take massive bludgeoning damage; held back, the user spreads wide to bowl them flat without breaking bone. Afterward nausea hits and the user cannot stretch or shift weight until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Trampoline Span.name: Trampoline Span
Trampoline Span.description: The user stretches their body and limbs across a narrow street, stairwell or alley and locks their heels down with heavy weight for the rest of the scene. People jumping from upper floors land in the user's stretched frame and are set down unhurt, while charging enemies or a rolling car rebound to a full stop. The user cannot move while spanning the gap, and blades, bullets or fire hurt them in full. Strain: severe.

Tailwind Takeoff.name: Tailwind Takeoff
Tailwind Takeoff.description: The user spreads their wings and a pocket of wind forms under the primary feathers, lifting them in a single beat onto a low roof, across a narrow street or clear of an incoming attack, which misses them. It reaches half the height of a full wing launch, the user must land by the end of their turn, and soaked or pinned feathers cannot catch the draft. Strain: light.

Pinion Push.name: Pinion Push
Pinion Push.description: The user sweeps one wing forward and drives a short, feather-shedding gust across a room into a target within a few strides. It deals force damage and knocks the target back a step while clearing smoke and dust along the line; held back, it only shoves them off balance without harm. It reaches half the range of a pure wind user's gust and grounds the user for that beat. Strain: light.

Soaring Survey.name: Soaring Survey
Soaring Survey.description: The user rides a steady cushion of wing-generated air above the rooftops and glides over a single block without flapping. They spot everyone in the open below, trace where fire or floodwater is moving and feel shifting drafts that betray movement in alleys, calling clear routes to allies. It covers half the area of a high overwatch, and strong crosswinds or heavy rain force them down. Strain: moderate.

Feather Shear.name: Feather Shear
Feather Shear.description: The user snaps a wingtip and flicks a single shed feather wrapped in a tight blade of compressed air across a room. It deals slashing damage to one target and severs ropes, straps or light cables in its path; held back, the air cushion flattens on impact and only knocks a weapon from a hand. It reaches half a street's width and costs flight feathers that take days to regrow. Strain: moderate.

Feather-Gust Sweep.name: Feather-Gust Sweep
Feather-Gust Sweep.description: The user hovers still in midair on wing-made updrafts outside a window or above a hazard and beats a feather-guided gust that sweeps up to two people out of the path of a fall, a vehicle or a collapse, carrying them a few strides onto safe ground. Running wing lift and directed wind at once drains breath fast and leaves the wings trembling, so the user cannot attack until their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Underwing Dome.name: Underwing Dome
Underwing Dome.description: The user drops over a small group, arches both wings wide and spins a tight dome of wind beneath the feathers until the end of their next turn. The dome turns aside smoke, gas, heat, thrown debris and pistol rounds while the wings take any heavier blow that breaks through. Driving a wind dome through arched wings locks the user to the spot and leaves the wing muscles too spent to fly on their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Eddy Plumes.name: Eddy Plumes
Eddy Plumes.description: The user sheds a handful of stiff primary feathers that ride small pockets of wind around a target within half a street's width. The swirling plumes deal slashing damage or pin the target's coat and sleeves to a wall or floor so they cannot move until they tear free. It covers half the range and feather count of a pure wing volley, and the thinned wings cannot lift the user until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Diving Gale Strike.name: Diving Gale Strike
Diving Gale Strike.description: The user's signature move: they climb on a wing-made updraft, fold their wings and dive in a roaring cone of compressed air that strikes a target and bursts across half a street. It deals massive slashing and force damage and hurls enemies off their feet; held back, the cone breaks early and only flattens them. Firing both natures at full force strips feathers and grounds the user until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Thermal Corridor.name: Thermal Corridor
Thermal Corridor.description: The user beats slow strokes at a building entrance or street corner, sending feather-seeded currents through half a block for the rest of the scene. The draft pulls smoke and gas out through upper windows and lifts up to a dozen fleeing people at a time in long, cushioned bounds over rubble to safety. It reaches half a pure wind user's lift, and the user must stay grounded and beating to hold the corridor open. Strain: severe.

Rattle Call.name: Rattle Call
Rattle Call.description: The user projects a sharp, low-pitched shout at a target within a few strides, and the sound carries a physical tremor that shakes what it hits. It deals sonic damage, rattles the target's grip so they cannot aim until the end of their next turn, and shakes dust from walls; held back, it only jolts them back a step. It reaches half the cone of a pure sound blast, and ear protection and padded clothing blunt it. Strain: light.

Wall-Hum Echo.name: Wall-Hum Echo
Wall-Hum Echo.description: The user hums a low note against a wall or across a smoky room, and the vibration travels through solid masonry and returns as an echo they feel in their jaw. It maps one room beyond a wall or through thick smoke, revealing where each person stands, hides or lies trapped. It reaches half as far as a pure floor reading, and soft insulation, thick carpets or running engines smother the return. Strain: light.

Bone-Conducted Call.name: Bone-Conducted Call
Bone-Conducted Call.description: The user pitches their voice so its vibration carries through rubble, doors and smoke to people within half a block, who feel the words in their ribs and jaw even over sirens or ringing ears. Frightened or buried survivors can follow the user's directions to a safe exit and tap back on pipes or stone to mark their spot. It reaches half the distance of a pure sound user's call and leaves the user's throat raw. Strain: moderate.

Buzzing Grasp.name: Buzzing Grasp
Buzzing Grasp.description: The user grabs an opponent's forearm or shoulder while humming a harsh note that drives a vocal tremor straight into the limb. It deals minor bludgeoning and sonic damage, numbs the arm so the target drops what they hold and cannot use that limb until the end of their next turn, and leaves no wound. Thick padding dulls the tremor, and the vibration rings back into the user's own ears and jaw. Strain: moderate.

Resonance Hum.name: Resonance Hum
Resonance Hum.description: The user fixes on one object within a room's width, finds its natural pitch with a quiet sweep, and holds a vibrating hum that shakes that object alone. In moments it shatters a pane of glass, a visor or a brittle lock, or rattles the bolts and pins loose on a door hinge, a shackle or a weapon casing while leaving people beside it unharmed. Holding pitch and tremor dulls the user's hearing until their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Cancelling Counter-Tone.name: Cancelling Counter-Tone
Cancelling Counter-Tone.description: The user listens to the noise in a room or corridor and holds an inverted, vibrating counter-tone that meets incoming sound waves and shakes them flat. Until the end of the user's next turn, the area falls silent, footsteps and forced doors make no noise, and any sonic attack or sound Quirk aimed into or through the space is blunted and deals no damage. Sustaining both wave and tremor leaves the user's ears ringing. Strain: heavy.

Rattling Chorale.name: Rattling Chorale
Rattling Chorale.description: The user drives a rolling chord down a corridor or half a street that shakes the floor and air together. Enemies in its path take sonic damage, have their footing rattled out from under them so they fall prone, and cannot hear spoken calls until the end of their next turn; held back, it only forces them to cover their ears and give ground. It reaches half a pure sound sweep's length, and carpets or ear protection blunt it. Strain: heavy.

Visceral Pulse.name: Visceral Pulse
Visceral Pulse.description: The user's signature move: they release a deep vocal pulse that couples sound with an inner-body tremor across a room's width. Every enemy there takes massive sonic and bludgeoning damage and drops to their knees with nausea, unable to stand or act until the end of their next turn; held back, it only stuns them without sickness. Afterward the user cannot hear or speak until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Bracing Drone.name: Bracing Drone
Bracing Drone.description: The user presses a hand to a cracking wall or a shifting rubble pile and holds a low vocal drone whose vibration locks loose stone in place across a room-sized collapse. For the rest of the scene no slab there slides further while rescuers pull people out, and the returning hum tells the user if a beam starts to give. It steadies a single room rather than a whole building, and the user cannot move or speak while holding it. Strain: severe.

Weathered Hide.name: Weathered Hide
Weathered Hide.description: The user takes an incoming bludgeoning, slashing or piercing hit in full, and layered calloused hide grows over the struck skin and knuckles by the end of their next turn. Until ten minutes after danger passes or a new threat replaces it, hits of that damage type deal half damage, and the user's punches in reach deal bludgeoning damage; held back, they only shove foes back. Strain: light.

Filter Lung.name: Filter Lung
Filter Lung.description: The user takes one choking breath of water, smoke or toxic gas at full effect, and gill slits open on their neck or filtering membranes line their lungs by the end of their next turn. Until ten minutes after reaching clean air or a new threat replaces it, they breathe that hazard unharmed and share clean exhaled air with one person held close, though they can speak only in a rasp. Strain: light.

Murk Sight.name: Murk Sight
Murk Sight.description: The user enters near-darkness, thick smoke, harsh glare or loud din, enduring brief blindness or ringing ears until wide pupils, clear eye films or damped inner ears form by the end of their next turn. While in that hazard they see and hear across a street or building floor to find hidden foes and trapped people; a sudden light or sonic burst dazzles them until their next turn. Strain: moderate.

Courted Hazard.name: Courted Hazard
Courted Hazard.description: The user touches a present hazard on purpose, such as flame, ice, a live wire or a controlled strike, taking light fire, cold, electric or bludgeoning damage right away. By the end of their next turn their skin or flesh adapts to halve damage of that type for the rest of the scene, and trained control holds two active adaptations at once before a third replaces the oldest. Strain: moderate.

Terrain Shift.name: Terrain Shift
Terrain Shift.description: The user takes a short drop, slips on a wall or plunges into water, and by the end of their next turn coarse grip pads swell on palms and soles, heels thicken or webbing joins their digits. For the rest of the scene they scale sheer walls, drop three stories unhurt or swim swift currents at a run, though thickened hands cannot work keys, phones or fine tools. Strain: moderate.

Gauntlet Carry.name: Gauntlet Carry
Gauntlet Carry.description: The user, once adapted to fire, cold, floodwater or toxic gas, shields up to two people against their changed body and hauls them out of a burning room, flooded basement or gas-filled street. Blister-proof skin, frost-proof fat or gill-fed breaths take the hazard for those carried until they reach safety; overcorrection stiffens the user to a slow walk, unable to dodge blows. Strain: heavy.

Reactive Clinch.name: Reactive Clinch
Reactive Clinch.description: The user takes a foe's close blow, blade, flame or shock in full to clinch them, growing counter-adapted plates and grip pads by the end of their next turn. Driving the clinch deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, it locks the foe in a pin their adapted attacks cannot break until a fresh damage type hits the user or they let go, while stiff limbs root the user in place. Strain: heavy.

Ordeal Surge.name: Ordeal Surge
Ordeal Surge.description: The user's signature move: their body answers every hazard taken this scene at once, layering armor hide, insulation and gill slits together. Until the end of their next turn those hazards deal no damage, and their rush deals massive bludgeoning damage in reach; held back, it bowls foes down unhurt. Afterward stiff overcorrection halves speed and blocks adaptations for one turn. Strain: severe.

Scar Memory.name: Scar Memory
Scar Memory.description: The user calls on bodily memory to grow one adaptation they have survived and trained many times before, such as plated hide, blister-proof skin, gill slits, insulation or dark-adapted eyes, in one breath without taking exposure first, and holds up to three adaptations at once this scene. It fades after ten minutes, never forms untried traits, and blocks new shifts until their next turn. Strain: severe.

Umbral Band.name: Umbral Band
Umbral Band.description: The user lifts the shadow under a target within five meters into flat black bands edged with thin smoked glass that wrap their ankles or wrists without cutting. The target cannot walk away or swing the held limb until they break free with a hard effort, a bright light thins the band or the end of the user's next turn; on shadowless ground it fails unless a standing shard casts shade there. Strain: light.

Smoked Bead Toss.name: Smoked Bead Toss
Smoked Bead Toss.description: The user grows a small handful of smoked black glass beads in the palm and flicks them at a target within five meters. They deal bludgeoning damage and knock the target back half a step; held back, they only sting, and the beads roll across the floor casting tiny pools of shade that make anyone running over them slip and fall. Worn armor stops the beads cold, and growing them dries the user's mouth. Strain: light.

Shade Ribbon Tow.name: Shade Ribbon Tow
Shade Ribbon Tow.description: The user draws the shadow under a ledge or inside a dark rubble gap within five meters into a firm black ribbon stiffened with a spine of smoked glass. It lowers one or two people from an upper floor at a safe pace or slides a trapped survivor out of collapsed debris without cutting them; strong light cracks the ribbon's glass spine and drops what it holds, so the user must keep it in shade. Strain: moderate.

Smoked Pane Ward.name: Smoked Pane Ward
Smoked Pane Ward.description: The user sweeps a palm and raises a chest-high pane of thin smoked glass between attackers and an ally within reach. It stops fists, blades and thrown objects from the front and casts a pool of real shade behind it even under bright sun, giving the user a shadow to work from; a pistol round or a blow on its weak point shatters it at once, and growing it draws water from the user's body. Strain: moderate.

Dusk Halo.name: Dusk Halo
Dusk Halo.description: The user grows a cloud of small smoked-glass shards that circle them and cast pools of shade for the rest of the scene. The shards serve both as blades that strike in reach for slashing damage, or bludgeoning if held back, and as stepping points: the user steps into the shade under one shard and out under another within ten meters. Running both natures parches the user and thins their shadow. Strain: moderate.

Penumbra Carapace.name: Penumbra Carapace
Penumbra Carapace.description: The user lays plates of smoked glass over their body as close armor that drinks light and blurs their outline for the scene, stopping fists and blades. On command they shatter a planted shard so its fragments deal piercing damage and pin the shadows of everyone within a few strides until the end of their next turn, or pin them uncut if held back. Running both natures parches the user and fades their shadow. Strain: heavy.

Smoked Spike Bed.name: Smoked Spike Bed
Smoked Spike Bed.description: The user hardens the shadows within five meters into a bed of smoked-glass spikes that bursts upward. Every enemy standing in shadow there takes heavy piercing damage and is caught among the brittle spikes, unable to move their legs until they break free with a hard effort; held back, the spikes rise blunt and only cage their ankles without drawing blood. Enemies in bright light or past five meters are out of reach. Strain: heavy.

Vesper Crossfire.name: Vesper Crossfire
Vesper Crossfire.description: The user's signature move: they fling smoked-glass shards out and step shard to shard across the battlefield in one breath, slashing each enemy before shattering the shards. Each enemy takes massive slashing damage, or bludgeoning if held back, and has their shadow pinned until the end of their next turn; afterward the user is parched, casts a faint shadow and cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Duskseam Bracing.name: Duskseam Bracing
Duskseam Bracing.description: The user presses both palms to a collapsing room, stairwell or rubble pile and threads seams of smoked black glass into the cracks. For the rest of the scene that space cannot fall any further, the dark seams cast shade over trapped people, and through the strain in the glass the user feels where each survivor inside lies. The user must keep one palm on the glass and grows parched while holding it. Strain: severe.

Bore Snap.name: Bore Snap
Bore Snap.description: The user fires one dense calcium round at a visible target within twenty meters. The shot deals moderate bludgeoning damage and shoves a standing adult back one step; held back, a softer round only staggers them. Each shot consumes bodily reserves and jars the shoulder, and anything behind the target remains at risk. Strain: light.

Braced Charge.name: Braced Charge
Braced Charge.description: The user braces and charges until their next turn, with a rising whine and bright muzzle glow, then fires within thirty meters. The shot deals heavy bludgeoning damage and knocks an adult down; held back, it only knocks them back. The user cannot fire while charging, and firing without a brace knocks the user down too. Strain: moderate.

Rope Ferry.name: Rope Ferry
Rope Ferry.description: The user seats a carried grapple or weighted rescue rope in the bore and fires it to a visible anchor or clear landing within twenty meters. A lodged grapple supports one adult if its anchor holds, or a waiting rescuer receives the rope. The user must load actual equipment and secure the line by hand; the cannon cannot reel anyone in. Strain: moderate.

Recoil Bound.name: Recoil Bound
Recoil Bound.description: The user fires at clear ground behind or below them, using the recoil to cross a gap up to five meters or slow a fall from one story before landing. The shot still strikes the ground, so the user needs an empty impact area and a clear landing. It cannot stop a longer fall, and the user cannot fire again before landing. Strain: moderate.

Blunt Arrest.name: Blunt Arrest
Blunt Arrest.description: The user fires a broad calcium round that flattens on impact against one target within fifteen meters. It deals moderate bludgeoning damage without breaking skin and knocks the target down, giving allies until the end of the user's next turn to approach with restraints. Armor can absorb the impact; head shots remain dangerous and the shot adds barrel heat. Strain: moderate.

Signal Shell.name: Signal Shell
Signal Shell.description: The user fires a light calcium shell skyward; stored energy makes it glow above a chosen point within fifty meters for three turns before it crumbles. Rescuers who can see the sky can locate that point. It deals no damage, cannot reveal anyone behind cover, and exposes the user's position; the user still spends bodily reserves. Strain: light.

Hinge Breaker.name: Hinge Breaker
Hinge Breaker.description: The user braces, charges for one turn and fires at a jammed door or gate within ten meters, breaking its hinges for heavy bludgeoning damage. The user checks that the far side is clear before firing; held back, the shot only bends a lock. Reinforced vault doors resist it, and the hot barrel cannot fire until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: heavy.

Full Bore Release.name: Full Bore Release
Full Bore Release.description: The user braces against solid cover and charges for two turns, with a rising whine and bright muzzle, then fires within sixty meters. The round deals massive bludgeoning damage and breaks vehicle armor; held back, it knocks one adult down with a broad blunt round. The recoil throws an unbraced user down, and the burned arm cannot fire for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Measured Battery.name: Measured Battery
Measured Battery.description: The user plants their feet and fires one aimed round per turn for three turns at visible targets within forty meters. Each deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, a flattening round only knocks an adult down. The user cannot move while firing, each shot spends reserves, and afterward heat prevents firing for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Ice Sill.name: Ice Sill
Ice Sill.description: The user raises a waist-high ridge of ice from their right side across three meters of ground within reach. The ridge stops thrown objects and light blows from the front until it breaks or melts, and remains after the user moves. It needs a clear path across the surface and repeated use chills the user's right side. Strain: light.

Leftward Flare.name: Leftward Flare
Leftward Flare.description: The user sends a brief flame jet from their left hand at one target within five meters. It deals light fire damage and forces the target away from that hand; held back, it scorches empty ground to make them retreat without a direct burn. The flame can ignite nearby fabric, and repeated jets raise the user's body temperature. Strain: light.

Frozen Heel Hold.name: Frozen Heel Hold
Frozen Heel Hold.description: The user spreads ice from their right hand along the ground to one person's boots within eight meters. Ice fixes the footwear to the floor until broken, melted or carefully thawed. The user keeps it below the ankles to spare exposed skin; leaping clear before it reaches the boots avoids the hold, and maintaining repeated freezes chills the user. Strain: moderate.

Gliding Ice Track.name: Gliding Ice Track
Gliding Ice Track.description: The user lays a narrow ice track from their right side and slides up to fifteen meters along it this turn, raising a low ramp to cross a shallow gap. The track remains slippery until melted or broken. The user needs a continuous surface to build from and enough space to brake; sharp turns or carrying an unsecured passenger risks a fall. Strain: moderate.

Careful Thaw.name: Careful Thaw
Careful Thaw.description: The user holds their left hand near ice within arm's reach and releases measured heat for one turn, freeing one person's frozen boots or clearing a doorway. The user stops before the ice against skin becomes hot and helps the person step clear. Steam obscures that doorway until the end of the turn, and the heat cannot repair frostbite or other injuries. Strain: moderate.

Alternating Fronts.name: Alternating Fronts
Alternating Fronts.description: The user blocks a frontal attack with a right-side ice slab, then sends left-side fire along an empty strip within eight meters to discourage pursuit until the end of their next turn. The fire warms the chilled body; it does not restore stamina. The user needs space between the fire and the people behind the slab, which cracks under heavy blows. Strain: moderate.

White Ridge Surge.name: White Ridge Surge
White Ridge Surge.description: The user drives a thick ridge of ice thirty meters across open ground, raising it to the height of a small building. It deals heavy cold damage and blocks the route until broken or thawed; held back, it rises ahead of people to fence them in. The ridge can crush nearby structures, and the user's right side stiffens until warmed. Strain: heavy.

Sudden Furnace Crash.name: Sudden Furnace Crash
Sudden Furnace Crash.description: The user chills the air ahead with a broad ice release, then heats it abruptly with left-side fire, creating a pressure blast across fifteen meters. It deals heavy explosive damage; held back, it strikes an empty barrier to scatter cover. Allies must clear the blast, and the temperature swing leaves the user unable to emit either half until their next turn ends. Strain: severe.

Balanced Flame Column.name: Balanced Flame Column
Balanced Flame Column.description: The user concentrates left-side fire into a jet reaching fifteen meters while cooling their body with right-side ice for up to three turns. It deals heavy fire damage each turn; held back, it cuts off an empty approach instead of striking people. Cooling delays overheating but does not prevent it, and the user needs a clear firing lane free of allies. Strain: severe.

Palm Weight Release.name: Palm Weight Release
Palm Weight Release.description: The user touches a person or loose object of up to an adult's weight with all five pads of one hand, making the target float until the user releases it. A small push moves it away from a hazard, and a hand or rope keeps it close. The user cannot steer it at a distance and restores gravity only when it has safe support. Strain: light.

Weightless Shoulder Throw.name: Weightless Shoulder Throw
Weightless Shoulder Throw.description: The user touches an opponent within reach with all five fingertip pads, floats them and pulls their arm into a shoulder throw. A low release deals light bludgeoning damage; held back, the user guides them onto their back without a drop. The user needs a secure grip, and a target who breaks contact before all pads land avoids activation. Strain: light.

Floating Ankles Bind.name: Floating Ankles Bind
Floating Ankles Bind.description: The user touches one opponent with all five fingertip pads and pushes them just above the floor, denying firm footing until release. The user can secure their wrists with a carried restraint while they drift. This is not paralysis: the target can still attack, use a Quirk or pull themselves to a nearby handhold, so the user must stay outside their reach. Strain: moderate.

Rope Guided Crossing.name: Rope Guided Crossing
Rope Guided Crossing.description: The user touches their own body with all five pads and floats, then pulls along an already secured rope to cross a fifteen-meter gap this turn. The user releases only above a safe landing. This requires a rope and an anchor that holds their weight when gravity returns; self-floating causes nausea, and the Quirk supplies no thrust if the rope slips. Strain: moderate.

Debris Hand Carry.name: Debris Hand Carry
Debris Hand Carry.description: The user touches one loose slab or wrecked vehicle weighing under three tonnes and floats it while rescuers pull a trapped person clear. Helpers guide the load with ropes until it rests on firm ground before release. The user cannot float attached foundations separately from the structure, and working near the weight limit causes mounting nausea. Strain: moderate.

Rubble Baton Sweep.name: Rubble Baton Sweep
Rubble Baton Sweep.description: The user floats a loose beam up to four meters long by touching it, then grips and swings it across the space within its reach this turn. It deals moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, it pushes opponents aside with the broad surface. The user must guide the beam physically, has no protection from its moving ends and needs a clear area free of bystanders. Strain: moderate.

Suspended Stone Shower.name: Suspended Stone Shower
Suspended Stone Shower.description: The user touches up to twenty loose stones, floats them and pushes them above a ten-meter patch before releasing by the end of their next turn. The shower deals moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, stones land across an empty escape route to block pursuit. Preparation needs reachable rubble, and the user cannot redirect stones after releasing them. Strain: heavy.

Courtyard Rain Release.name: Courtyard Rain Release
Courtyard Rain Release.description: The user touches and floats rubble totaling nearly three tonnes, pushes it over a courtyard up to twenty meters wide and releases it this turn. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, it falls across an empty route to block vehicles. Everyone needs warning before release, and the user vomits afterward and cannot activate the Quirk until their following turn ends. Strain: severe.

Falling Team Catch.name: Falling Team Catch
Falling Team Catch.description: The user floats themself from a secured line and reaches up to five falling people within ten meters, touching each directly with all five pads this turn. The user uses the line and helpers to guide them toward safety before release. Each person must be reachable along the user's route; the Quirk supplies no steering, and repeated self-floating leaves severe nausea. Strain: severe.

Calf Motor Dash.name: Calf Motor Dash
Calf Motor Dash.description: The user accelerates through their calf engines and crosses up to fifty meters of clear ground in a few seconds this turn. This reaches cover or closes a gap before an ordinary runner catches up. The user needs traction and a visible braking area; obstacles do not move aside, and a sudden turn at full speed risks a collision. Strain: light.

Driven Heel Strike.name: Driven Heel Strike
Driven Heel Strike.description: The user accelerates over a few strides and drives a heel into one opponent within five meters for moderate bludgeoning damage. Held back, the user reduces the throttle and uses the sole to push them off balance instead of striking the head. The kick needs firm footing, and missing leaves the user moving past the target until they brake. Strain: light.

Braking Body Block.name: Braking Body Block
Braking Body Block.description: The user sprints up to fifteen meters to reach a person in danger this turn, brakes and guides them a few steps behind cover. This moves one person clear of an approaching attacker or falling object if the route is open. The user must see the threat early enough to stop, and taking the impact themselves gives no protection from its damage. Strain: moderate.

Running Wrist Escort.name: Running Wrist Escort
Running Wrist Escort.description: The user overtakes a fleeing opponent within twenty meters, brakes beside them and catches their wrist and upper arm. The hold prevents another running start until the target breaks the user's grip or the user lets go. The user escorts them at walking pace rather than dragging them at engine speed; a much stronger opponent can wrench free. Strain: moderate.

Passenger Steady Run.name: Passenger Steady Run
Passenger Steady Run.description: The user secures one adult passenger against their back or in both arms and runs up to forty meters to safety this turn with measured acceleration and braking. The passenger arrives without being jolted by a maximum-speed start. The user needs a clear route and a secure hold; this cannot safely move someone whose injury requires a rigid stretcher. Strain: moderate.

Side Throttle Feint.name: Side Throttle Feint
Side Throttle Feint.description: The user changes output between their calf engines, steps across an opponent's approach within ten meters and accelerates away before the end of this turn. The change of angle opens a route around a raised guard or leaves an overcommitted attacker facing away. It needs planted steps between bursts; ice, loose gravel or a blocked exhaust spoils the turn. Strain: moderate.

Ten Second Overdrive.name: Ten Second Overdrive
Ten Second Overdrive.description: The user forces their calf engines above normal output for ten seconds, covering a clear three-hundred-meter route or overtaking a speeding vehicle. The user must plan turns before accelerating and cannot stop abruptly without risking injury. After the burst the engines stall until the end of the user's following turn; blocked pipes or insufficient fuel ends it early. Strain: heavy.

Full Throttle Heel.name: Full Throttle Heel
Full Throttle Heel.description: The user commits to a twenty-meter overdrive run and delivers one engine-driven heel strike this turn for heavy bludgeoning damage. Held back, the user brakes before contact and sweeps the opponent's legs with reduced force. A clear approach is essential, and afterward both engines stall until the end of the user's following turn, leaving ordinary movement only. Strain: severe.

Long Gear Pursuit.name: Long Gear Pursuit
Long Gear Pursuit.description: The user runs at sustained high output for up to three minutes along streets they can see, pursuing a vehicle or reaching a distant emergency. Stronger exhausts regrown through prior training are required. Traffic and blind corners still force braking, and the engines stall when the run ends and need several minutes of cooling before further powered movement. Strain: severe.

Tongue Wrist Loop.name: Tongue Wrist Loop
Tongue Wrist Loop.description: The user extends their tongue up to ten meters and loops it around one opponent's wrist or a loose hand-sized object. The user holds the wrist until the target breaks free or releases the object, which can be pulled back this turn. The tongue cannot overpower a much stronger target, and blades or hot surfaces can injure it directly. Strain: light.

Low Bank Hop.name: Low Bank Hop
Low Bank Hop.description: The user springs up to six meters across a gap or three meters upward and grips a firm landing with their hands and feet this turn. This reaches a low balcony or clears an obstacle without a running start. The user needs a stable takeoff and a landing they can see; the leap cannot change direction in midair and adds no protection from a bad fall. Strain: light.

Coiled Tongue Throw.name: Coiled Tongue Throw
Coiled Tongue Throw.description: The user coils their tongue around one opponent's waist within ten meters and uses a planted stance to throw them up to two meters this turn, dealing moderate bludgeoning damage. Held back, the user lowers them onto their back and keeps the coil loose enough to breathe. The target must be roughly an adult's weight, and grabbing the tongue can stop the throw. Strain: moderate.

Wallside Search.name: Wallside Search
Wallside Search.description: The user climbs ten meters along a firm wall this turn, using clinging hands and feet to reach a window or look over a parapet. The user reports visible people, hazards and entrances, and can remain attached while keeping still. Loose paint or crumbling masonry can fail under their grip, and the user cannot see through closed shutters or walls. Strain: moderate.

Channel Swimmer Tow.name: Channel Swimmer Tow
Channel Swimmer Tow.description: The user swims up to twenty meters this turn and loops their tongue around one conscious person's torso, keeping their face clear while towing them toward a bank or ladder. The person must remain within the tongue's twenty-meter reach. Strong currents, submerged snags and the user's held breath limit the tow; an unconscious person's airway needs direct support. Strain: moderate.

Shared Scent Coat.name: Shared Scent Coat
Shared Scent Coat.description: The user spreads their own mucus over up to two willing allies within arm's reach, making the three smell similar for the next ten minutes or until washed clean. A scent tracker has trouble telling their trails apart, but sight and sound still reveal each person. Applying the coating takes a turn, exposes the user and can cause mild itching on sensitive skin. Strain: moderate.

Muted Color Watch.name: Muted Color Watch
Muted Color Watch.description: The user changes their skin color to blend into a wall, foliage or rubble within arm's reach for the rest of the scene while holding mostly still. Ordinary visual searches can overlook them, allowing observation of a nearby room or street. Rapid movement, uncovered equipment, sound or touch reveals the user, and maintaining the color match tires their muscles. Strain: heavy.

Wide Tongue Sweep.name: Wide Tongue Sweep
Wide Tongue Sweep.description: The user extends their tongue to twenty meters and sweeps one opponent's legs, then coils around their torso before this turn ends. The fall deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, the user supports the descent and pins the arms without squeezing the chest. The user needs a firm anchor and cannot safely lift more than one adult; a trapped tongue leaves them exposed. Strain: severe.

High Ledge Rescue.name: High Ledge Rescue
High Ledge Rescue.description: The user secures one adult against their back and leaps up to twelve meters across or six meters upward this turn, anchoring their tongue to a firm ledge within twenty meters to steady the landing. This moves a casualty over floodwater or onto a balcony. The anchor must bear both bodies, and the user cannot attempt another loaded leap until their next turn ends. Strain: severe.

Shadow Hand Catch.name: Shadow Hand Catch
Shadow Hand Catch.description: The user sends the creature to catch one falling object, thrown weapon or person within a few meters. It stops the impact and sets a person down safely before the end of the user's next turn. In bright light it is too small to catch an adult, and a blow heavier than a falling person can break its grip. Strain: light.

Clawside Shove.name: Clawside Shove
Clawside Shove.description: The user directs the creature to strike one opponent within a few meters. A clawed hit deals moderate slashing damage; held back, the creature uses an open hand for light bludgeoning damage and pushes the target down. Strong light reduces the strike to a brief shove, and a hit against the creature also jars the user. Strain: light.

Paired Arm Pin.name: Paired Arm Pin
Paired Arm Pin.description: The user has the creature seize one human-sized target within reach and hold both arms against their sides until the end of the user's next turn. The user remains free to apply cuffs or guide an ally past them. The target can break free with a hard effort, and a bright light aimed at the creature loosens the hold at once. Strain: moderate.

Shadow Step Haul.name: Shadow Step Haul
Shadow Step Haul.description: The user sends the creature to grip a ledge or railing and pull them across a gap or up one building story. It can instead lift one person from a ledge and lower them beside the user. The creature remains attached throughout; without a sound anchor, or under strong light, it cannot support the person's weight. Strain: moderate.

Corner Reach Watch.name: Corner Reach Watch
Corner Reach Watch.description: The user extends the creature around a corner or through an open doorway to look for people and report what it sees in its own voice. It can check several rooms within its connected reach while the user stays behind cover. A closed wall stops it, and sending it into an unlit room makes it stronger but harder to recall. Strain: moderate.

Rubble Shoulder Brace.name: Rubble Shoulder Brace
Rubble Shoulder Brace.description: The user wedges the creature beneath a damaged doorway, stair landing or small slab of rubble. It holds the weight until the end of the user's next turn while one or two people crawl clear. The user must remain nearby, and a collapsing floor or direct floodlight can overwhelm the brace before everyone escapes. Strain: heavy.

Winged Shadow Carry.name: Winged Shadow Carry
Winged Shadow Carry.description: The user has the creature wrap around their torso, spread its arms and carry them through the air across a street or up several stories. One passenger may cling to the user during the flight. It cannot carry a crowd, and bright light shrinks its lifting surface, forcing a quick landing before the end of the user's next turn. Strain: heavy.

Crossbody Shadow Clash.name: Crossbody Shadow Clash
Crossbody Shadow Clash.description: The user's signature move: the user and creature rush one target from opposite sides within a few strides. The creature strikes for heavy bludgeoning damage while the user drives the target to the ground; held back, the paired blows pin without a wound. Afterward the creature recoils and cannot emerge again until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: severe.

Nightbound Shadow Command.name: Nightbound Shadow Command
Nightbound Shadow Command.description: The user keeps the creature obedient in a dark street or building for the rest of the scene. It grows tall enough to catch several falling people or hold two human-sized opponents while the user directs each action. A sudden bright light cuts its strength, and every order in deep darkness still demands the user's attention. Strain: severe.

Plugside Listen.name: Plugside Listen
Plugside Listen.description: The user plugs one jack into a wall or floor and listens for footsteps, voices and moving machinery on the connected side. Until the end of the user's next turn, they can point out one nearby person's position or warn allies that someone approaches. A quiet, motionless target may go unheard, and loud machinery can mask softer sounds. Strain: light.

Close Jack Jab.name: Close Jack Jab
Close Jack Jab.description: The user extends one jack to strike a target within several meters. The plug lands a sharp blow for light bludgeoning damage; held back, it taps a wrist or hand and interrupts what the target is holding. The jack stays exposed until it retracts, so the target can catch it and pull painfully on the user's ear. Strain: light.

Wallbeat Search.name: Wallbeat Search
Wallbeat Search.description: The user plants both jacks in a connected wall or floor and separates several sets of footsteps and breathing sounds behind it. They identify where up to three moving people stand until the end of the user's next turn, helping rescuers choose a door or route. A gap between surfaces breaks the reading, and a loud impact briefly deafens it. Strain: moderate.

Jackline Trip.name: Jackline Trip
Jackline Trip.description: The user stretches a jack across a narrow passage and pulls it taut when one runner reaches it. The target falls and loses movement until the end of their next turn, giving an ally time to restrain them. The user must remain within the jack's length, and a heavy or fast opponent can drag the sensitive cord and injure the user's ear. Strain: moderate.

Floor Pulse Break.name: Floor Pulse Break
Floor Pulse Break.description: The user plugs both jacks into an amplifier and drives their heartbeat through a connected floor. People in a room-sized area stumble, and an opponent braced to attack loses that action; the vibration deals light sonic damage. The user must have the gear and a continuous surface, and the pulse also disrupts unprepared allies standing there. Strain: heavy.

Quiet Room Count.name: Quiet Room Count
Quiet Room Count.description: The user listens through a wall, floor or heavy door to count breathing people in a nearby closed room. They can direct a rescue team toward a trapped person and distinguish a moving person from machinery until the end of the user's next turn. A silent, unconscious person may be missed, and drilling or sirens can drown out the reading. Strain: moderate.

Twin Speaker Burst.name: Twin Speaker Burst
Twin Speaker Burst.description: The user connects both jacks to worn amplifiers and aims a heartbeat burst down a hallway. Targets in that line take moderate sonic damage and lose their balance until the end of their next turn; held back, the burst only forces them to cover their ears and retreat. The gear fixes the direction, so moving out of the line avoids it, and the user's ears ring afterward. Strain: heavy.

Floorbeat Breaker.name: Floorbeat Breaker
Floorbeat Breaker.description: The user's signature move: both amplified jacks drive a sustained heartbeat into the ground, splitting a narrow strip of pavement beneath one advancing group. Targets fall and take heavy force damage; held back, the user cracks only their footing to stop the charge. The amplifiers must remain connected, and the user's ears bleed after the pulse. Strain: severe.

Whole Block Listening.name: Whole Block Listening
Whole Block Listening.description: The user alternates both jacks among connected walls, pipes and pavement for the rest of the scene, mapping movement through a building and its adjoining street. They can guide a team toward trapped people and away from approaching opponents. Gaps in the material leave blind spots, and sustained listening makes ordinary conversation painfully loud afterward. Strain: severe.

Palm Contact Spark.name: Palm Contact Spark
Palm Contact Spark.description: The user touches one target and sends a brief shock through the contact. It deals light electric damage and makes the target release what they hold until the end of their next turn; held back, it only numbs the hand. Thick insulation blocks the transfer, and the user must reach the target without touching an ally through the same conductor. Strain: light.

Short Range Flash.name: Short Range Flash
Short Range Flash.description: The user releases electricity around their body across a few steps. Everyone in that space who lacks insulation takes moderate electric damage and loses their next movement; held back, the user cuts the charge after a painful warning shock. The burst is indiscriminate, so an ally beside the user is struck too. Strain: light.

Safe Lamp Charge.name: Safe Lamp Charge
Safe Lamp Charge.description: The user feeds a controlled current into a small compatible device, such as a rescue lamp or radio, and keeps it working until the end of the user's next turn. This gives a team light or a brief call when its battery has failed. The device needs a usable contact and cannot accept more than its circuitry allows; excess current burns it out. Strain: moderate.

Conductive Grip Hold.name: Conductive Grip Hold
Conductive Grip Hold.description: The user grips one opponent directly or through a metal object and maintains a measured shock until the end of the user's next turn. The target's muscles seize, preventing escape or an attack while the contact holds; held back, the shock ends before lasting injury. Insulation breaks the circuit, and the user cannot safely touch an ally with the same hand. Strain: moderate.

Placed Marker Arc.name: Placed Marker Arc
Placed Marker Arc.description: The user fires a discharge toward a compatible targeting marker already placed within a street's width. One opponent beside that marker takes moderate electric damage and drops what they hold; held back, the arc only stuns. The marker is support gear rather than part of the Quirk, and without it the user cannot direct this distant strike. Strain: heavy.

Incoming Current Catch.name: Incoming Current Catch
Incoming Current Catch.description: The user places themselves between one incoming electrical attack and a nearby ally and takes the current into their own body. The ally avoids that electric damage, and the user can release a small charge into the ground before the end of their next turn. A surge beyond the user's safe output still short-circuits their brain. Strain: moderate.

Marker Chain Shock.name: Marker Chain Shock
Marker Chain Shock.description: The user sends electricity through up to three compatible markers placed along a street, shocking opponents beside each one for moderate electric damage. Held back, each shock only stops movement until the end of the target's next turn. Every marker must remain in place, and a wet or metal route can carry current to unintended people. Strain: heavy.

Full Circle Discharge.name: Full Circle Discharge
Full Circle Discharge.description: The user's signature move: the user releases their maximum safe charge in a broad circle across a large room. Every uninsulated person caught inside takes heavy electric damage and is stunned until the end of their next turn; held back, the user stops after the stun. Allies are equally vulnerable, and the release leaves the user's thoughts scrambled until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Sustained Current Stand.name: Sustained Current Stand
Sustained Current Stand.description: The user stands at a connected metal barrier or cable and maintains a strong current through it for the rest of the scene, denying passage to opponents while allies evacuate elsewhere. Touching the barrier deals moderate electric damage; held back, it gives a disabling shock. Broken contact ends the current, and prolonged output brings the user close to a brain short circuit. Strain: severe.

Elbow Strip Shot.name: Elbow Strip Shot
Elbow Strip Shot.description: The user fires one strip from an elbow to stick to a small object or reachable surface several meters away. They pull the object into hand or use the line to steady themselves until the end of their next turn. A heavy object may pull the user instead, and dust, oil or loose plaster can make the tape peel away. Strain: light.

Sticky Wrist Wrap.name: Sticky Wrist Wrap
Sticky Wrist Wrap.description: The user shoots a short strip around one nearby person's wrists and fixes it to itself or a firm surface. Their hands stay bound until they tear the tape free or someone cuts it; held back, the wrap leaves room to avoid injury. The user needs a clear line to the wrists, and a powerful target can break the strip. Strain: light.

Anchor Point Swing.name: Anchor Point Swing
Anchor Point Swing.description: The user sticks a strip to a sound beam, railing or wall above them and swings across a street-wide gap. They may release at the far side and land on their feet before the end of their next turn. A weak anchor tears loose, and the user cannot change direction in midair without firing a second line to another surface. Strain: moderate.

Falling Tape Catch.name: Falling Tape Catch
Falling Tape Catch.description: The user anchors two strips to firm surfaces and stretches them beneath one falling person. The tape slows the fall and leaves that person hanging until the end of the user's next turn, when the user or an ally can lower them. The anchors must hold the person's weight, and a fall from much higher can tear the strips. Strain: moderate.

Floorline Snare.name: Floorline Snare
Floorline Snare.description: The user fixes tape between two low anchors across a passage. The first running target who crosses it trips and remains tangled until the end of their next turn, giving an ally time to apply cuffs. A cautious target can see and step over the line, and a blade or hard pull can break it. Strain: moderate.

Overhead Tape Carry.name: Overhead Tape Carry
Overhead Tape Carry.description: The user fires alternating strips into sound overhead anchors and swings while carrying one willing person across a blocked street or damaged floor. Both arrive beyond the hazard before the end of the user's next turn. The passenger must hold on, and a failed anchor drops both unless the user secures a replacement line. Strain: heavy.

Alley Net Spread.name: Alley Net Spread
Alley Net Spread.description: The user crosses several tape strips between the walls of an alley or hallway, making a visible net. Up to three advancing human-sized opponents are caught and held until they cut or tear free; held back, the net cushions a collision. It needs firm anchors on both sides, and fire or blades can open a route through it. Strain: heavy.

Twin Reel Slam.name: Twin Reel Slam
Twin Reel Slam.description: The user's signature move: the user attaches both elbow strips to solid points beyond one opponent, reels forward and strikes with the momentum for heavy bludgeoning damage. Held back, the user wraps the opponent and drives them to the ground for capture. Missing either anchor spoils the approach, and the abrupt stop leaves the user's elbows painful. Strain: severe.

District Line Rig.name: District Line Rig
District Line Rig.description: The user strings tape among roofs, poles and firm walls across several connected streets for the rest of the scene. Allies can follow marked safe crossings, while pursuers meet visible wraps and trip lines at chosen approaches. Every line needs a real anchor, and the long output dries the user's elbows until fresh tape becomes difficult to produce. Strain: severe.

Belly Beam.name: Belly Beam
Belly Beam.description: The user faces a target within a classroom's length and fires one brief laser burst from the navel. It deals moderate light damage and can knock a person back a step; held back, the user aims at the ground beside them to force them away without a direct hit. Cover blocks the straight beam, and another immediate shot brings a stomach cramp. Strain: light.

Bright Guard.name: Bright Guard
Bright Guard.description: The user fires a short beam across the path of one incoming attacker within several strides. The attacker must stop or take moderate light damage, giving one nearby ally room to move until the end of the user's next turn. The beam remains straight and can scorch anything behind the attacker, so the user must check the line first. Strain: light.

Narrow Burn.name: Narrow Burn
Narrow Burn.description: The user steadies their abdomen and draws a thin laser line across a lock, rope or small metal fitting within sight. The cut opens that single obstruction without striking a person beside it. The user must hold still for a full turn, and an impact or sudden turn of the torso sends the beam off its intended line. Strain: moderate.

Backward Lift.name: Backward Lift
Backward Lift.description: The user aims the beam down and behind them for a brief push, clearing a gap of several strides or rising to a nearby ledge. They can reach someone stranded above street level but cannot carry another adult during the lift. The beam scorches the surface below, and sustained thrust brings abdominal pain before the user can hover. Strain: moderate.

Debris Opening.name: Debris Opening
Debris Opening.description: The user cuts a person-wide opening through a thin wall or a pile of light debris within a few strides, making a path to someone trapped behind it. The user checks where the survivor is before firing and keeps the beam off their body. Thick structural supports resist the cut, and holding the beam long enough to open the path causes painful cramps. Strain: heavy.

Crossing Bursts.name: Crossing Bursts
Crossing Bursts.description: The user fires two brief bursts while turning their torso, striking two visible targets across a street. Each hit deals moderate light damage; held back, each beam hits the ground at a target's feet and drives them away from a doorway. The user cannot fire behind their back, and the quick second shot brings a sharp stomach ache. Strain: moderate.

Barrier Breach.name: Barrier Breach
Barrier Breach.description: The user holds a focused beam on one solid barrier within a street's width until it burns an opening wide enough for a person to pass. The beam can break a reinforced door or a thick concrete section, but it cannot curve around anyone behind it. The user must know the space beyond is clear, and the sustained firing leaves them doubled over until the end of their next turn. Strain: heavy.

Radiant Straightaway.name: Radiant Straightaway
Radiant Straightaway.description: The user's signature move: they brace their body and fire a sustained beam straight down a clear street. It breaks heavy cover and deals massive light damage to anything caught in its path; held back, the user sweeps it through empty pavement to cut off pursuit. It cannot turn once fired, and abdominal pain prevents another laser use until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: severe.

Long Line Rescue.name: Long Line Rescue
Long Line Rescue.description: The user traces one continuous, controlled beam across the face of a collapsed structure, cutting several small openings for air and access without touching the people inside. Rescuers can reach those openings for the rest of the scene. The user needs a clear view of each cut line, and the extended firing leaves their abdomen painful for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Sticky Toss.name: Sticky Toss
Sticky Toss.description: The user plucks one scalp ball and throws it at a person or object across a room. On contact it sticks the target to the next surface they touch until they cut away the caught clothing, break the surface or the ball loses its hold. The throw can miss, and a single ball cannot pin a strong person's whole body. Strain: light.

Scalp Spring.name: Scalp Spring
Scalp Spring.description: The user plants a ball underfoot and rebounds over a person, a car or a short gap, landing several strides away.
