A nearby ally can follow only if the user carries them through the jump. The ball remains stuck where it was placed and may catch someone else, so the user must choose a safe launch point. Strain: light.

Sleeve Snare.name: Sleeve Snare
Sleeve Snare.description: The user throws two balls onto a target's sleeves or trouser legs within a classroom's length. When the target brushes a wall, floor or their own clothing, the caught limbs stick and their movement stops until they remove the clothing or break free. The user needs two clear hits, and bare skin gives the target fewer safe ways to pull away. Strain: moderate.

Safe Rebound.name: Safe Rebound
Safe Rebound.description: The user places a line of balls across a damaged hallway or narrow roof and rebounds from one to the next, crossing without touching the hazard between them. They can carry a child or a small rescue bundle. A missed landing ends the route, and the balls left behind remain hazards for everyone else. Strain: moderate.

Doorway Cluster.name: Doorway Cluster
Doorway Cluster.description: The user scatters several balls across one doorway or passage a few strides wide. Anyone rushing through sticks a foot or hand to the floor or frame and must stop to free it; allies who know the gaps can pass carefully. The cluster does not block projectiles, and its hold weakens as the balls age. Strain: moderate.

Rescue Bounce.name: Rescue Bounce
Rescue Bounce.description: The user places a ball at the base of a wall and rebounds to a ledge one story above, reaches one stranded person, then guides them down by a clear route. The ball catches others who step on it, so the user marks its position for rescuers. Repeating the climb quickly makes the scalp sore and begins to draw blood. Strain: heavy.

Crosswalk Net.name: Crosswalk Net
Crosswalk Net.description: The user throws a pattern of balls across a street crossing, sticking pursuing opponents to pavement, vehicles or one another as they move through it. Up to several human-sized targets remain caught until they tear free or the hold fades. The pattern has open gaps for an evacuation lane, and it cannot distinguish an ally from an enemy who enters it. Strain: heavy.

Hundred Point Hold.name: Hundred Point Hold
Hundred Point Hold.description: The user's signature move: they pluck and throw a dense cluster around one large target within a street's width, fastening its limbs to nearby surfaces from several directions. The target stays held until it breaks those surfaces or the balls lose their hold. The rapid plucking makes the user's scalp bleed, preventing further ball use until it recovers. Strain: severe.

Spring Route.name: Spring Route
Spring Route.description: The user lays a connected route of scalp balls across a building's broken floors and walls. For the rest of the scene the user can rebound along it to reach trapped rooms, return with one person at a time and avoid gaps in the floor. Everyone else still sticks to the route, so rescuers need clear markers; placing it leaves the user's scalp painfully raw. Strain: severe.

Sweet Lift.name: Sweet Lift
Sweet Lift.description: After eating sugar, the user lifts a heavy obstacle within reach, such as a fallen beam or a jammed garage door, and holds it long enough for one person to pass. The boost lasts roughly three minutes from activation. The user must have secure footing, and the weight falls if they lose their grip or the surge ends. Strain: light.

Fueled Strike.name: Fueled Strike
Fueled Strike.description: After eating sugar, the user lands a powerful close-range punch that deals moderate bludgeoning damage and drives a target back. Held back, the user strikes the ground beside them or uses an open palm to knock them down without a crushing hit. The Quirk adds no reach, and the user's judgment grows duller during the surge. Strain: light.

Doorway Break.name: Doorway Break
Doorway Break.description: During a sugar-fueled surge, the user forces open one reinforced door or breaks a thin wall within reach to create an escape path. They check the space beyond before pushing through. The effort takes most of a turn, and the user's strength returns to normal when the short surge ends. Strain: moderate.

Load Bearer.name: Load Bearer
Load Bearer.description: During a surge, the user braces a collapsing beam or slab and holds it for up to several minutes while rescuers move people clear. The support works only while the user remains beneath or against the load. Their judgment becomes too dull for detailed instructions, and another support must take the weight before the surge ends. Strain: moderate.

Powered Leap.name: Powered Leap
Powered Leap.description: The user pushes off with sugar-fueled leg strength and clears a car, a broad gap or a low rooftop edge, reaching a person or position several strides away. The Quirk does not protect the user from a hard landing, so they need a clear destination. Repeated leaps use up the short surge and leave their thinking increasingly dull. Strain: moderate.

Gentle Grip.name: Gentle Grip
Gentle Grip.description: The user uses boosted strength to hold a struggling person still without crushing them, keeping their arms pinned until the end of the user's next turn so an ally can apply restraints. The user must stay within reach and concentrate on the pressure of their hands. As the sugar surge dulls their thinking, a prolonged hold risks an unsafe squeeze. Strain: moderate.

Rubble Haul.name: Rubble Haul
Rubble Haul.description: The user consumes sugar and drags a car-sized piece of debris clear of a rescue opening, exposing people trapped beneath or behind it. They move the load only a few strides and set it down on stable ground. They cannot both haul it and carry a survivor, and the large effort leaves their thinking dull for the rest of the surge. Strain: heavy.

Sugar Hammer.name: Sugar Hammer
Sugar Hammer.description: The user's signature move: during a fueled surge they deliver one full-strength blow to a close target, dealing massive bludgeoning damage or breaking a thick barrier. Held back, they strike the surface beside a person to block their advance without hitting them. The blow spends the surge at once, leaving the user weak and mentally foggy until they rest. Strain: severe.

Lasting Brace.name: Lasting Brace
Lasting Brace.description: The user prepares sugar and sustains a trained surge long enough to hold a major structural support while a whole room is evacuated. They remain in place for the rest of the scene and cannot plan the evacuation themselves as their thinking dulls. When the surge ends, the support needs a replacement immediately and the user cannot activate again until they recover. Strain: severe.

Corner Eye.name: Corner Eye
Corner Eye.description: The user extends one extra arm around a nearby corner and forms an eye at its end. They see the room or passage beyond without exposing their head and can report visible hazards to allies. The eye needs light and an unobstructed view, and an attack on the extended arm hurts the user. Strain: light.

Many Hand Hold.name: Many Hand Hold
Many Hand Hold.description: The user forms hands on their extra arms and grips a person within reach from several sides, holding their arms and shoulders until the end of the user's next turn. An ally can apply restraints during that time. The user must keep enough arms committed to the hold, and a stronger target may break free or injure a limb. Strain: light.

Wall Ear.name: Wall Ear
Wall Ear.description: The user extends an arm to a nearby doorway, vent or thin partition and forms an ear near the far side. They hear voices, movement or cries for help there and can guide a team toward the sound. A thick wall still blocks hearing, and a loud noise at the exposed ear causes pain and breaks the user's concentration. Strain: moderate.

Linked Climb.name: Linked Climb
Linked Climb.description: The user forms several hands and climbs a wall, ladder or damaged structure while keeping two grips free for a small child or rescue supplies. They can move one story before needing another secure hold. The arms need real handholds, and a broken support can pull the user and passenger down together. Strain: moderate.

Wide Search.name: Wide Search
Wide Search.description: The user forms eyes and ears on several extended arms, checking multiple openings across one room or short hallway at once. They locate visible exits, moving people and audible calls for help, then tell allies what they found. Each organ still needs a clear position, and overlapping sights and sounds make fine details hard to follow. Strain: moderate.

Extra Arm Shield.name: Extra Arm Shield
Extra Arm Shield.description: The user spreads their extra arms around one nearby person, intercepting a falling object or a close strike until the end of the user's next turn. The protected person avoids that one hit, while the arms take its force. The user feels the impact and cannot fully cover someone from an attack arriving behind both of them. Strain: heavy.

Sixfold Carry.name: Sixfold Carry
Sixfold Carry.description: The user uses all six arms to lift and carry two injured people across a room or down a clear corridor, keeping their heads and limbs supported. They can still form an eye to watch the route, but cannot fight while carrying both. The passengers must be within the user's physical lifting capacity, and damage to an arm can force the user to stop. Strain: heavy.

Complete Enclosure.name: Complete Enclosure
Complete Enclosure.description: The user's signature move: they form hands on all four extra arms and close all six arms around one person within reach, pinning their limbs without striking them. The target remains held until they overpower the grips or an outside force pulls the user away. Every arm is committed, leaving the user unable to guard another person, and injury to one arm weakens the enclosure. Strain: severe.

Rescue Array.name: Rescue Array
Rescue Array.description: The user extends several arms through adjacent openings in a damaged building, forming eyes, ears and hands to locate survivors and guide them toward one safe exit. The array stays active for the rest of the scene while the user remains in place. Each arm must fit through a real opening, and too many simultaneous signals leave the user unable to track a fast fight. Strain: severe.

Rear Brace.name: Rear Brace
Rear Brace.description: The user plants their tail against solid ground behind them and braces against one shove or close blow before the end of their next turn. The extra contact keeps them standing against an ordinary adult's force, but a vehicle or stronger Quirk can still move them, and the tail takes the impact. Strain: light.

Tufted Strike.name: Tufted Strike
Tufted Strike.description: The user swings the thick part of their tail into one opponent within two meters, dealing moderate bludgeoning damage and pushing them a step aside. Held back, it checks the opponent's advance without knocking them down. The swing needs clear space and leaves the user's front exposed until the tail returns. Strain: light.

Ankle Curl.name: Ankle Curl
Ankle Curl.description: The user hooks their tail behind one opponent's ankles within two meters and pulls while pressing forward with their stance. The opponent falls if their footing gives way and must spend their next movement getting up. A planted heavier target can resist, and the user releases the hook before it twists a knee. Strain: moderate.

Coiled Tail Hold.name: Coiled Tail Hold
Coiled Tail Hold.description: The user coils their tail around one adult's waist within two meters and pins an arm against the body until the end of the user's next turn. The user keeps pressure below a crushing grip. A stronger opponent can pry free, and holding the target prevents using the tail to strike or support the user's balance. Strain: moderate.

Grounded Tail Vault.name: Grounded Tail Vault
Grounded Tail Vault.description: The user plants their tail on firm ground and pushes upward to clear a low wall or a gap about three meters wide, landing before their turn ends. The tail supplies the push while the hands remain free. Loose gravel, a weak edge or an injured tail spoils the launch, and the user cannot redirect once airborne. Strain: moderate.

Tail Rescue Hook.name: Tail Rescue Hook
Tail Rescue Hook.description: The user hooks their tail around the waist of one person slipping from a ledge within two meters and draws them onto the same footing this turn. The user braces with both feet and spreads the pressure to avoid crushing. A long fall already at full speed can injure both people, and weak footing gives way. Strain: moderate.

Turning Tail Drive.name: Turning Tail Drive
Turning Tail Drive.description: The user plants their feet and turns their hips through a full tail strike against one target within two meters, dealing heavy bludgeoning damage and driving them back several steps. Held back, it sweeps a guard aside for an ally. The tail needs an unobstructed arc, and a missed swing pulls the user off balance. Strain: heavy.

Three Limb Finish.name: Three Limb Finish
Three Limb Finish.description: The user braces on their tail, kicks a nearby opponent's guard aside, then turns into a tail strike that deals heavy bludgeoning damage within two meters. Held back, the final strike stops at a controlled takedown. Missing the opening kick exposes the user, and the tail cannot support another vault until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Burdened Beam Crossing.name: Burdened Beam Crossing
Burdened Beam Crossing.description: The user carries one adult on their back across a beam or broken walkway up to ten meters long, using the tail for balance and contact with nearby supports. The crossing takes the user's turn and needs a continuous foothold; the tail cannot bridge empty air. The load prevents attacks and strains the tail's base. Strain: heavy.

Metallic Brace.name: Metallic Brace
Metallic Brace.description: The user transforms into steel and covers their head and chest until the end of their next turn, reducing ordinary punches, cuts and handgun hits to bruising impacts. Concentrated heavy blows can still injure them and drain the form quickly. Smoke and poison gas still enter their lungs. Strain: light.

Metal Knuckle Jab.name: Metal Knuckle Jab
Metal Knuckle Jab.description: The user transforms and drives a steel fist into one target within arm's reach, dealing moderate bludgeoning damage and staggering an unbraced adult. Held back, it is a short push with the palm. The user still needs sound footing and an open line to the target; the transformation grants no extra reach. Strain: light.

Metal Arm Clinch.name: Metal Arm Clinch
Metal Arm Clinch.description: The user transforms and closes both arms around one adjacent opponent's upper body, holding their arms until the end of the user's next turn. The steel resists ordinary attempts to strike free, but a stronger target can break the hold. The user avoids the throat and cannot punch or block another attacker while clinching. Strain: moderate.

Steeled Door Entry.name: Steeled Door Entry
Steeled Door Entry.description: The user transforms and drives a shoulder through a wooden door or light partition within a few steps, opening a person-wide route this turn. A reinforced wall stops the charge and jars the user. The user must check the far side first to avoid hitting someone; steel does not protect anyone struck by flying fragments. Strain: moderate.

Metal Grip Ascent.name: Metal Grip Ascent
Metal Grip Ascent.description: The user transforms and pulls onto a ledge within raised-arm reach, using steel hands and forearms to cross a jagged sill this turn. The form protects against sharp edges but adds no reach and creates no footholds. The ledge must support the user, and an unstable edge can break away under the pull. Strain: moderate.

Steel Rescue Carry.name: Steel Rescue Carry
Steel Rescue Carry.description: The user transforms and carries one adult up to ten meters toward cover, turning their back toward small falling fragments and handgun fire until their turn ends. The passenger must stay behind the user's body to gain shelter. A large slab can crush both, and neither gains clean air or protection from poison gas. Strain: heavy.

Metalwork Body Blows.name: Metalwork Body Blows
Metalwork Body Blows.description: The user stays transformed through a series of close punches against one opponent, dealing heavy bludgeoning damage and forcing them back up to three meters. Held back, the user stops after breaking the guard and shoves them away. Each blocked punch contributes to iron fatigue, and the sequence leaves no hand free to shield an ally. Strain: heavy.

Relentless Steel Advance.name: Relentless Steel Advance
Relentless Steel Advance.description: The user transforms and advances up to ten meters through ordinary strikes and handgun fire to deliver one heavy bludgeoning blow. Held back, the finish pins the target against a clear surface without crushing. Heavy attacks can halt the advance; afterward iron fatigue prevents transformation until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: severe.

Furnace Endurance March.name: Furnace Endurance March
Furnace Endurance March.description: The user maintains steel through intense external heat for up to two turns, crossing ten meters per turn to reach an exit or opponent. The metal heats and may glow, making bare contact unsafe. The user produces no heat, still needs breathable air and must withdraw before collapse; further exposure can overwhelm the trained tolerance. Strain: severe.

Broadhand Guard.name: Broadhand Guard
Broadhand Guard.description: The user enlarges one hand about a meter across and raises its palm between their upper body and one visible close attack before their next turn ends. The broad hand catches a thrown object or softens a punch, but a blade can cut it and heavy force can push it back. The user's sides and legs remain exposed. Strain: light.

Growing Palm Strike.name: Growing Palm Strike
Growing Palm Strike.description: The user enlarges one hand and drives an open palm into a target within two meters, dealing moderate bludgeoning damage and pushing them back a step. Held back, it moves the target aside without a full swing. The enlarged hand needs room to pass, and striking a hard surface can injure the fingers. Strain: light.

Open Finger Capture.name: Open Finger Capture
Open Finger Capture.description: The user enlarges a hand around the clothed torso of one adult within two meters, leaving their head and airway clear. The loose grip holds until the end of the user's next turn unless the target forces the fingers apart. The user must keep checking pressure and cannot use that hand to attack while holding them. Strain: moderate.

Ledge Palm Pull.name: Ledge Palm Pull
Ledge Palm Pull.description: The user enlarges one hand to catch a sound ledge up to three meters above their feet and pulls onto it this turn, placing the other hand for balance. The larger grip needs a ledge that can bear the user's weight; the arms do not lengthen. A weak sill may tear away, and the pull leaves the torso exposed. Strain: moderate.

Broad Palm Venting.name: Broad Palm Venting
Broad Palm Venting.description: The user enlarges both hands and fans loose smoke or gas toward an open exit within five meters, clearing a small patch beside them until the end of their next turn. The gas remains dangerous wherever it moves, so the user needs a clear downwind route. A sealed room or continued gas production defeats the opening. Strain: moderate.

Cupped Hand Carry.name: Cupped Hand Carry
Cupped Hand Carry.description: The user cups both enlarged hands around one injured adult and carries them up to ten meters this turn, shielding them from small loose debris and direct splashes. The hands leave breathing gaps and cannot keep out poison gas. The user cannot strike while carrying, and a heavy impact can injure the hands or passenger. Strain: heavy.

Broad Knuckle Breach.name: Broad Knuckle Breach
Broad Knuckle Breach.description: The user enlarges a fist to nearly two meters across and punches a light masonry partition within reach, opening a person-wide route this turn. Against a person it deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, it only drives their guard aside. Reinforced walls can stop the blow and injure the hand, and flying rubble endangers bystanders. Strain: heavy.

Closing Distance Fists.name: Closing Distance Fists
Closing Distance Fists.description: The user throws two short punches at one target within two meters, enlarging each hand just before contact to deal heavy bludgeoning damage and drive them off balance. Held back, the second hand opens to catch the target upright. A missed first punch exposes the torso, and the user's hands shake until their next turn ends. Strain: severe.

Braced Hand Shelter.name: Braced Hand Shelter
Braced Hand Shelter.description: The user holds both hands enlarged around a doorway-wide space for three turns while up to four people crouch behind them. The palms turn aside light fragments and ordinary thrown objects from the front. The user must kneel and cannot advance or attack; blades, gunfire and heavy rubble can injure the hands and break the shelter. Strain: severe.

Vine Fringe Guard.name: Vine Fringe Guard
Vine Fringe Guard.description: The user bunches their vine hair across their upper body and catches one thrown object or close strike within two meters before their next turn ends. The layers slow an ordinary blow but do not shield the legs. A sharp blade can cut through the bundle, and fire damages the vines instead of being extinguished. Strain: light.

Bunched Vine Lash.name: Bunched Vine Lash
Bunched Vine Lash.description: The user swings a vine bundle at one target within five meters, dealing moderate bludgeoning and slashing damage from the stems and thorns. Held back, it hooks loose clothing to pull the target a step off balance without a full strike. A cutting guard can sever the bundle, and nearby allies risk scratches. Strain: light.

Loose Coil Arrest.name: Loose Coil Arrest
Loose Coil Arrest.description: The user wraps several vines around one adult's clothed arms and torso within ten meters, leaving the face and airway clear until the end of the user's next turn. The coils prevent ordinary arm movements without crushing. A blade or superior strength breaks them, and tightening carelessly can cut the target. Strain: moderate.

Vine Ladder Ascent.name: Vine Ladder Ascent
Vine Ladder Ascent.description: The user loops vine bundles around a sturdy railing up to five meters above and pulls upward while climbing with hands and feet. The ascent takes one turn and needs a clear path and an anchor that bears the user's weight. A failed anchor or severed bundle drops the user, and the pull strains the scalp and neck. Strain: moderate.

Forked Vine Disarm.name: Forked Vine Disarm
Forked Vine Disarm.description: The user sends two vine bundles up to ten meters, one around a visible weapon and one around its wielder's clothed forearm, then pulls the weapon aside this turn. The user avoids fingers and the face. A firm two-handed grip can resist, an active blade can sever the vines, and thorns may scratch exposed skin. Strain: moderate.

Woven Vine Sling.name: Woven Vine Sling
Woven Vine Sling.description: The user forms a broad sling beneath one stranded adult within ten meters and draws them along a clear path onto stable ground by the end of the turn. Layers of clothing or a blanket must separate skin from thorns. The user braces before pulling; a pinned casualty needs debris removed first, and a heavy load strains the neck. Strain: moderate.

Layered Vine Screen.name: Layered Vine Screen
Layered Vine Screen.description: The user weaves a dense screen across a passage up to five meters wide within fifteen meters, slowing attackers and catching light debris for two turns. Crossing the thorns risks light slashing damage; held back, the user opens a marked gap for evacuation. Fire or repeated cutting breaks the screen and spends growth that needs water and sunlight to replace. Strain: heavy.

Closing Vine Network.name: Closing Vine Network
Closing Vine Network.description: The user spreads vine bundles over a courtyard within twenty meters and loosely coils up to five visible opponents around their clothed limbs until the user's next turn ends. Faces and airways stay clear. Cutting attacks or superior strength break individual holds; the spread exposes the user's body and leaves little growth free for defense. Strain: severe.

Street Vine Cordon.name: Street Vine Cordon
Street Vine Cordon.description: The user spreads vine bundles along a thirty-meter stretch of street for three turns, keeping one marked walkway open while catching runners' clothing on either side. Captured people stop until they cut free, overpower the vines or are released. The user stays planted and cannot cover unseen exits; fire and repeated cuts steadily dismantle the cordon. Strain: severe.

Sectioned Palm.name: Sectioned Palm
Sectioned Palm.description: The user detaches one hand and guides it up to several meters away. It can press a button, retrieve keys or grip a light object until the end of the user's next turn, then returns to rejoin the arm. The hand cannot pull an adult or overpower a firm grip, and the user's arm cannot grasp anything while it is away. Strain: light.

Loose Hand Lift.name: Loose Hand Lift
Loose Hand Lift.description: The user sends a detached hand over a short wall, through an open window or around a corner to catch a ledge or lift a latch. It can open a route for the user or a nearby ally until the end of the user's next turn. The hand must physically fit through the opening and can be caught or struck while separated. Strain: light.

Corner Eye Watch.name: Corner Eye Watch
Corner Eye Watch.description: The user sends one eye around a corner or above a nearby roofline and sees what it faces until the end of the user's next turn. They can report a person's position or a safe route to allies within hearing. The empty socket gives no sight, and an eye turned away, covered or trapped leaves the user with no view from that angle. Strain: moderate.

Segment Snare.name: Segment Snare
Segment Snare.description: The user sends both hands and part of an arm around a person within several meters, grips their wrists or clothing and draws the pieces tight. The target is held until the end of the user's next turn unless they pull free or strike the detached parts. The user has no hands on the central body while maintaining the hold. Strain: moderate.

Scattered Search.name: Scattered Search
Scattered Search.description: The user divides into several small pieces and sends them through open gaps across one building floor to find a missing person or an exit. Each piece can be called back with a sighting before the end of the scene. Doors and sealed walls still block them, and following several views at once makes the user slow to notice threats beside the main body. Strain: moderate.

Split Body Screen.name: Split Body Screen
Split Body Screen.description: The user separates the part of their body about to be struck, letting one blow pass through the gap, then guides the pieces back together by the end of their next turn. A nearby ally can use the opening to move clear. The user must see the attack coming; a broad blast or several simultaneous hits can still catch separated pieces. Strain: heavy.

Forty Piece Sweep.name: Forty Piece Sweep
Forty Piece Sweep.description: The user divides most of their body into dozens of flying pieces and sweeps them through a hall or street to find people, block exits and distract one opponent until the end of the user's next turn. A clustered strike deals moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, the pieces only shove. The exposed central portion cannot move far while the pieces are spread. Strain: heavy.

Circling Body Rush.name: Circling Body Rush
Circling Body Rush.description: The user divides into many pieces and drives them around one target within a short street, striking from several directions before rejoining. The impacts deal heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, hands and limbs pin the target until the end of their next turn. If the pieces cannot return, replacing them drains the user's stamina sharply. Strain: severe.

Full Body Scatter.name: Full Body Scatter
Full Body Scatter.description: The user separates into as many as fifty controlled pieces and sends them throughout a building or nearby street for the rest of the scene. They can watch many entrances, carry small supplies and close around one target to restrain them. Each lost piece must be regenerated, and the user cannot maintain clear attention on every piece at once. Strain: severe.

Held Breath Slip.name: Held Breath Slip
Held Breath Slip.description: The user phases the part of their body a visible punch, blade or projectile would hit, allowing that single attack to pass through. The user turns solid again by the end of their next turn. They must see or anticipate the line of attack, and a phased hand cannot grab or counter until it becomes solid. Strain: light.

Wall Spring.name: Wall Spring
Wall Spring.description: The user holds a breath, phases through a wall no thicker than a few steps and turns solid beyond it by the end of their next turn. The passage can bypass an obstacle or reach a trapped person. While inside the wall they cannot see, hear or breathe, and ordinary clothes or gear left outside the phase can snag or fall away. Strain: light.

Passing Guard.name: Passing Guard
Passing Guard.description: The user keeps one arm and shoulder phased while closing with an opponent within a few steps, letting a single guard or grab pass through them. They turn solid to seize the opponent's wrist until the end of the user's next turn. The grip is ordinary once made, and another attack can hit the solid arm. Strain: moderate.

Blind Route Run.name: Blind Route Run
Blind Route Run.description: The user memorizes a short route, holds a breath and passes through two thin obstacles before reappearing within the same room or corridor. They can scout a blocked passage or reach a person on its far side by the end of their next turn. They receive no sight or sound during the passage, so a changed route can send them into danger. Strain: moderate.

Floor Rebound.name: Floor Rebound
Floor Rebound.description: The user drops through a floor and switches off Permeation inside the structure, allowing the expulsion to launch them into open space nearby. They can reach a higher ledge or escape a surrounding group by the end of their next turn. They cannot steer precisely while blind below the floor, and a ceiling or wall can make the landing hazardous. Strain: heavy.

Narrow Gap Rescue.name: Narrow Gap Rescue
Narrow Gap Rescue.description: The user phases alone through rubble or a blocked doorway to reach one trapped person within a room's length. On turning solid, they can clear loose debris, give aid or open an accessible exit until the end of their next turn. They cannot phase the person out with them, and they must hold their breath through the blind approach. Strain: heavy.

Solid Point Strike.name: Solid Point Strike
Solid Point Strike.description: The user lets an opponent's visible attack pass through a phased shoulder, then makes one fist solid at close range for a counter. The blow deals moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, it stuns without breaking bone. The fist is vulnerable at the instant of contact, and an attack from a second direction can still land. Strain: heavy.

Underfloor Circuit.name: Underfloor Circuit
Underfloor Circuit.description: The user dives through a floor, rebounds from solid matter and emerges beside one opponent within a short street to deliver a precisely timed blow. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, it knocks the target down. The user cannot see, hear or breathe below ground, and an incorrect route can eject them away from the target. Strain: severe.

Unseen Approach.name: Unseen Approach
Unseen Approach.description: The user chains brief phases through obstacles and incoming attacks for the rest of the scene, turning solid only to stand, breathe or act. They can reach a guarded doorway or cross a dangerous room without being stopped by ordinary blows. Each solid instant can be attacked, and losing track of the route while blind risks a fall through the floor. Strain: severe.

Shell Hand Block.name: Shell Hand Block
Shell Hand Block.description: After recently eating shellfish, the user covers one hand and forearm in a hard shell and catches one visible strike aimed at them or someone within arm's reach. The shell prevents ordinary bludgeoning damage from that strike until the end of the user's next turn. It cannot cover the whole body, and repeated heavy blows can crack it. Strain: light.

Tentacle Hold.name: Tentacle Hold
Tentacle Hold.description: After recently eating octopus, the user grows one tentacle from an arm and wraps it around a person or object within several meters. The grip holds until the end of the user's next turn unless the target tears free or cuts the tentacle. It cannot pull someone much heavier than the user, and the user must keep the limb extended. Strain: light.

Octopus Reach.name: Octopus Reach
Octopus Reach.description: After recently eating octopus, the user manifests several tentacles and reaches into an open gap to pull a child, a bag of supplies or loose debris toward them. The reach lasts until the end of their next turn. The tentacles need a clear path and can be caught or injured; they cannot pass through sealed walls. Strain: moderate.

Feathered Glide.name: Feathered Glide
Feathered Glide.description: After recently eating poultry, the user grows wings and feathers that slow a fall or carry them across a short gap until the end of their next turn. They may hold one small child while descending, but a full adult is too much weight at this level. Narrow rooms and injured wings prevent a safe glide. Strain: moderate.

Mixed Trait Guard.name: Mixed Trait Guard
Mixed Trait Guard.description: After recently eating both shellfish and octopus, the user shields their torso with shell while keeping two tentacles free to pull one nearby ally behind them. The protection lasts until the end of the user's next turn. A strong strike can break the shell, and both foods must still be available to the Quirk. Strain: heavy.

Many Limb Hold.name: Many Limb Hold
Many Limb Hold.description: After recently eating octopus, the user manifests several strong tentacles to restrain one person within a room's length against a wall or floor. The hold lasts until the end of the user's next turn unless the target breaks free or the limbs are cut. The user cannot maintain the grip while moving far from the target. Strain: heavy.

Full Meal Array.name: Full Meal Array
Full Meal Array.description: After a meal containing octopus, shellfish and poultry, the user manifests tentacles, a shell guard and wings at once for the rest of the scene. They can defend one ally, restrain one nearby opponent or cross a short gap, choosing one action each turn. The forms shrink as their sources are digested, and using all three rapidly drains stamina. Strain: heavy.

Feast Form Rescue.name: Feast Form Rescue
Feast Form Rescue.description: After eating suitable seafood and poultry, the user spreads protective shell across their body and uses several tentacles and wings to reach one person amid nearby debris. They hold loose rubble back and carry the person to clear ground by the end of their next turn. Heavy debris can break the shell, and the form consumes its food supply quickly. Strain: severe.

Focused Trait Shift.name: Focused Trait Shift
Focused Trait Shift.description: The user shifts traits from several recently eaten foods between body parts for the rest of the scene, placing shell where a blow will land, tentacles where a grip is needed and wings where space permits. Each change requires a moment of control, and a digested food can no longer supply its feature. Strain: severe.

Spiral Palm.name: Spiral Palm
Spiral Palm.description: The user releases a small spiral shockwave from one palm toward a person or loose object within several meters. It deals light bludgeoning damage and pushes the target a step; held back, it moves the target without injury. The wave travels slowly enough for an alert person with room to move to dodge it. Strain: light.

Heel Wave Lift.name: Heel Wave Lift
Heel Wave Lift.description: The user sends a spiral wave from their feet to rise above a low obstacle or slow a fall until the end of their next turn. The lift can place them on a nearby ledge or bring them down safely. It requires open space beneath the feet, and a second lift immediately afterward draws more stamina. Strain: light.

Slow Pulse Push.name: Slow Pulse Push
Slow Pulse Push.description: The user sends a broad, slow spiral wave across a room to drive one opponent back from a doorway or a person they are threatening. It deals moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, it only knocks the opponent off balance until the end of their next turn. The visible wave gives a mobile target time to sidestep. Strain: moderate.

Twin Spiral Bind.name: Twin Spiral Bind
Twin Spiral Bind.description: The user sends two spiraling waves from their hands to press one nearby opponent against a wall or the ground until the end of the user's next turn. The pressure can hold them for an ally to apply restraints. The target can escape by moving before the slow waves arrive, and the hold ends when the user stops feeding it stamina. Strain: moderate.

Upward Rescue Stream.name: Upward Rescue Stream
Upward Rescue Stream.description: The user directs a controlled wave beneath one falling person within a short street, slowing their descent until they land without injury by the end of the user's next turn. The user must see and reach the falling person with the wave in time. A person behind a wall or already at ground level cannot be saved by this release. Strain: heavy.

Sweeping Wave Guard.name: Sweeping Wave Guard
Sweeping Wave Guard.description: The user spreads a spiral shockwave across a room's width to push loose debris and one approaching opponent away from nearby allies. The wave deals moderate bludgeoning damage to someone who stays in its path; held back, it only shoves. Allies caught in the same open lane are also pushed, and the broad release costs substantial stamina. Strain: heavy.

Broad Spiral Burst.name: Broad Spiral Burst
Broad Spiral Burst.description: The user releases a powerful spiral shockwave down a clear street, striking several opponents in its path for heavy bludgeoning damage. Held back, it scatters them and leaves them able to recover. The wave is visible and slower than a straight blast, and the user must keep civilians out of its wide path. Strain: heavy.

Surging Spiral Drive.name: Surging Spiral Drive
Surging Spiral Drive.description: The user gathers a large wave and drives it into one target within a short street. The impact deals severe bludgeoning damage; held back, a broader push knocks the target down without a crushing blow. The spiral takes a moment to arrive, and the release leaves the user too drained to fly until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Sustained Wave Flight.name: Sustained Wave Flight
Sustained Wave Flight.description: The user feeds continuous spiral waves from their feet to fly above nearby buildings for the rest of the scene. They can cross a street quickly or guide an evacuation route from overhead while sending smaller waves from their hands. Flight ends when their stamina fails, and carrying an adult shortens it sharply. Strain: severe.

Red Wing Hop.name: Red Wing Hop
Red Wing Hop.description: The user beats their red wings and flies up to twenty meters to a visible ledge or open landing, clearing a fence or a street. The user lands before the end of their turn and carries only normal clothing and light equipment; too many detached feathers leave insufficient lift for the crossing. Strain: light.

Quill Clothing Pin.name: Quill Clothing Pin
Quill Clothing Pin.description: The user sends two stiff feathers into a target's loose sleeves within twenty meters, pinning the fabric to a wooden door or plaster wall until the target tears free or the feathers return. The user aims clear of skin; close clothing or a hard backing prevents the pin, and those feathers cannot support flight. Strain: light.

Feather Listening Post.name: Feather Listening Post
Feather Listening Post.description: The user settles three feathers beside a doorway within thirty meters and reads vibrations from footsteps and nearby speech until the end of the user's next turn. The user learns whether someone approaches and catches audible words, but gains no sight; loud machinery masks the signal and deployed feathers reduce lift. Strain: moderate.

Red Quill Draw.name: Red Quill Draw
Red Quill Draw.description: The user stiffens a long wing feather and swings it at a target within arm's reach, dealing moderate slashing damage to an exposed surface. Held back, the user cuts a strap or loose weapon sling instead of flesh. The feather occupies one hand until returned and breaks against sufficiently hard armor. Strain: moderate.

Paired Feather Lift.name: Paired Feather Lift
Paired Feather Lift.description: The user gathers a bundle of feathers beneath one adult within thirty meters and carries them to visible safe ground by the end of the user's next turn. The feathers support the torso and limbs rather than the neck; the user stays grounded because the bundle removes too much wing area for shared flight. Strain: moderate.

Quill Weapon Clamp.name: Quill Weapon Clamp
Quill Weapon Clamp.description: The user directs several feathers around a weapon hand within thirty meters and presses it against a wall until the end of the user's next turn. The user leaves fingers and circulation free; a strong wrench scatters the feathers, and holding the clamp commits feathers that otherwise provide flight or rescue lift. Strain: moderate.

Scarlet Intercept Flight.name: Scarlet Intercept Flight
Scarlet Intercept Flight.description: The user folds their wings into a fast dive across fifty meters and spreads them to catch one falling adult before landing at a visible clear spot this turn. The user needs height and most flight feathers attached; the passenger's weight prevents a sharp second turn, and a blocked landing forces an early drop to a lower ledge. Strain: heavy.

Full Plumage Arrest.name: Full Plumage Arrest
Full Plumage Arrest.description: The user deploys nearly every feather across fifty meters, pinning up to six people's loose clothing to nearby walls until the end of the user's next turn. The user avoids flesh and leaves breathing clear; targets can tear free, fire destroys the pins, and the user cannot fly until enough feathers return. Strain: severe.

Divided Feather Escort.name: Divided Feather Escort
Divided Feather Escort.description: The user splits their feather stock into three bundles and carries up to three adults within fifty meters to visible safe ground over two turns. The user stays on solid ground and abandons all other feather tasks; heavy loads, burning debris or broken feathers force an early landing rather than extra lift. Strain: severe.

Open Palm Kindling.name: Open Palm Kindling
Open Palm Kindling.description: The user projects a brief palm jet at one target within four meters, dealing moderate fire damage. Held back, the user burns empty ground ahead of the target to interrupt an approach without touching them. The jet adds body heat, and nearby clothing or fuel can catch fire even after the burst ends. Strain: light.

Burning Boundary Strip.name: Burning Boundary Strip
Burning Boundary Strip.description: The user lays a three-meter strip of flame across bare pavement within four meters and maintains it until the end of the user's next turn. Crossing it deals light fire damage; the user leaves an open route for surrender or retreat. The flames do not stop projectiles, and maintaining them adds body heat. Strain: light.

Door Latch Burn.name: Door Latch Burn
Door Latch Burn.description: The user focuses a narrow flame on an exposed metal latch within arm's reach, softening it enough to push open a jammed exit this turn. The user directs trapped people away from the hot fitting before opening it; hidden fuel, an explosive device or a load-bearing hinge makes the attempt unsafe, and the burn adds body heat. Strain: moderate.

Heel Flame Skip.name: Heel Flame Skip
Heel Flame Skip.description: The user expels short flames behind their feet and crosses eight meters to a visible landing before the end of this turn. The user clears low obstacles or leaves a melee attack's path, but cannot hover or carry another adult with this burst; the exhaust scorches the takeoff area and adds body heat. Strain: moderate.

Narrow Ember Stream.name: Narrow Ember Stream
Narrow Ember Stream.description: The user compresses a palm flame into a narrow stream reaching twelve meters, dealing moderate fire damage to one exposed target. Held back, the user cuts an unattended strap or wooden obstruction instead of flesh. The straight stream requires clear aim, can ignite objects behind the target and rapidly adds body heat. Strain: moderate.

Heated Weapon Release.name: Heated Weapon Release
Heated Weapon Release.description: The user directs a thin flame onto an opponent's exposed metal weapon within eight meters until the end of this turn, heating it until an unprotected hand must release it or take light fire damage. The user stops before touching flesh; insulated grips defeat the disarm, and the hot weapon remains dangerous on the ground. Strain: moderate.

Piercing Furnace Jet.name: Piercing Furnace Jet
Piercing Furnace Jet.description: The user concentrates a brilliant flame into a twenty-meter jet that cuts a narrow opening through a metal barrier and deals heavy fire damage to anything on its line. Held back, the user cuts an empty obstruction after checking the far side. The sustained compression sharply raises body heat and leaves molten edges. Strain: heavy.

Vertical Flame Release.name: Vertical Flame Release
Vertical Flame Release.description: The user releases maximum flame upward around a target within reach, dealing massive fire damage through a column twenty meters high this turn. Held back, the user directs the column into empty space to deny an approach. The user checks overhead clearance first and cannot emit more flame until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Thrust Rescue Ascent.name: Thrust Rescue Ascent
Thrust Rescue Ascent.description: The user directs strong flame jets away from one adult held against their chest and flies thirty meters to a clear landing by the end of the user's next turn. The user keeps the passenger outside every exhaust path; tight corridors prevent safe use, and the accumulated heat forces a turn without flames after landing. Strain: severe.

Sole Vent Dash.name: Sole Vent Dash
Sole Vent Dash.description: The user expels a short burst from both soles and crosses ten meters to a visible open landing before the end of this turn. The user clears a low obstacle or escapes a closing grip before it catches; sealed footwear blocks the vents, and another burst requires enough stored breath and space to brake. Strain: light.

Air Driven Shoulder.name: Air Driven Shoulder
Air Driven Shoulder.description: The user vents air through their soles and drives a shoulder into one target within five meters, dealing moderate bludgeoning damage. Held back, the user checks the acceleration and pushes the target one step off balance. The user needs a clear braking space beyond the target and spends stored breath on the approach. Strain: light.

Angled Wall Return.name: Angled Wall Return
Angled Wall Return.description: The user plants a foot against a sound wall within ten meters and fires a sole burst to leave at a new angle, reaching a visible spot ten meters farther away this turn. The user can pass around an opponent's guard, but loose masonry or slippery paint spoils the rebound, and each burst spends stored air. Strain: moderate.

Breath Powered Carry.name: Breath Powered Carry
Breath Powered Carry.description: The user holds one cooperative adult firmly against their torso and propels both across ten meters to clear ground by the end of this turn. The user uses several checked bursts to keep the passenger upright; the extra weight shortens the route and empties the air reserve, so the user must inhale before another carry. Strain: moderate.

Sole Burst Brake.name: Sole Burst Brake
Sole Burst Brake.description: The user swings both soles toward their direction of travel and expels air to slow a rush or a fall from one story, landing on a clear patch within ten meters this turn. The user needs stored breath and time to turn the legs; it cannot arrest a longer fall or prevent injury after the user already strikes an obstacle. Strain: moderate.

Rebound Wrist Check.name: Rebound Wrist Check
Rebound Wrist Check.description: The user rebounds from a nearby wall and passes a target within ten meters, striking a weapon wrist for light bludgeoning damage and knocking a loosely held weapon away. The user lands beyond the target this turn; a locked grip resists the disarm, and the route requires a sound wall, clear footing and stored air. Strain: moderate.

Three Corner Assault.name: Three Corner Assault
Three Corner Assault.description: The user uses successive wall rebounds along thirty meters of a clear corridor and strikes up to three opponents for heavy bludgeoning damage before landing this turn. Held back, the user checks each impact to knock opponents down. Unsound surfaces interrupt the sequence, and the user must stop to inhale afterward. Strain: heavy.

Final Reserve Impact.name: Final Reserve Impact
Final Reserve Impact.description: The user spends a full breath on a maximum acceleration strike against one target within twenty meters, dealing massive bludgeoning damage this turn. Held back, the user brakes into a sweeping trip instead of a direct collision. The user needs a clear run and landing and cannot propel again until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Measured Pursuit Bursts.name: Measured Pursuit Bursts
Measured Pursuit Bursts.description: The user chains short air bursts over a visible sixty-meter route for three turns, landing briefly at clear points to inhale and redirect. The user overtakes ordinary runners and clears street obstacles, but carries no passenger; smoke or a blocked landing interrupts the pursuit, and the user needs a turn of rest afterward. Strain: severe.

Pavement Cover Rise.name: Pavement Cover Rise
Pavement Cover Rise.description: The user touches concrete and raises a chest-high wall two meters across within five meters, providing solid cover from that direction for the rest of the scene. The wall remains after contact ends, but heavy blows can break it; thin paving cannot supply the same thickness without opening a nearby depression. Strain: light.

Concrete Heel Bump.name: Concrete Heel Bump
Concrete Heel Bump.description: The user touches a concrete floor and raises a low, blunt ridge beneath one target within five meters, dealing light bludgeoning damage and upsetting their footing this turn. Held back, the ridge merely blocks the next step. The target must stand on connected concrete, and the user cannot reach through a gap in the floor. Strain: light.

Ankle Concrete Hold.name: Ankle Concrete Hold
Ankle Concrete Hold.description: The user touches connected concrete and folds it around the ankles of one target within ten meters, holding them in place for the rest of the scene without squeezing. The user leaves circulation clear; heavy blows or tools can break the restraint, and a jumping or airborne target avoids it before it closes. Strain: moderate.

Folded Concrete Stair.name: Folded Concrete Stair
Folded Concrete Stair.description: The user presses a hand to a thick concrete wall and folds steps outward to an opening six meters above, leaving a climbable rescue route for the rest of the scene. The user checks the opening by sight; insufficient concrete or obstructing reinforcement limits the stair, and the Quirk supplies no safety rail without more material. Strain: moderate.

Supported Shelter Arch.name: Supported Shelter Arch
Supported Shelter Arch.description: The user touches a thick concrete floor and raises an arch over three people within ten meters, diverting loose falling debris for two turns while they crawl out. The user maintains contact to adjust the supports; a falling building section can overwhelm the arch, and drawing material from damaged foundations can worsen a collapse. Strain: heavy.

Sliding Partition Check.name: Sliding Partition Check
Sliding Partition Check.description: The user touches concrete and folds a broad partition sideways into one target within fifteen meters, dealing moderate bludgeoning damage and pushing them away from an exit this turn. Held back, it stops short and closes their route instead. The slab stays joined at its base, needs enough source material and can crush nearby objects. Strain: heavy.

Foundation Platform Lift.name: Foundation Platform Lift
Foundation Platform Lift.description: The user draws on a thick concrete foundation to raise a platform beneath three people within twenty meters, lifting them to a clear opening up to twenty meters high this turn. The user maintains contact at the base; thin paving lacks the volume, and the platform stays still afterward until reshaped or broken. Strain: heavy.

Rolling Concrete Barrier.name: Rolling Concrete Barrier
Rolling Concrete Barrier.description: The user touches a broad concrete foundation and drives a folding surge thirty meters ahead, dealing massive bludgeoning damage to targets caught this turn. Held back, it rises ahead of them and closes the route without impact. The surge requires ample joined material and leaves the user too exhausted to shape until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Courtyard Concrete Dividers.name: Courtyard Concrete Dividers
Courtyard Concrete Dividers.description: The user keeps both hands on a concrete courtyard and raises six connected walls within fifty meters over two turns, separating opponents and leaving a marked evacuation lane. The walls remain for the rest of the scene and can be broken; the user must see each placement, preserve material volume and stay in contact while shaping. Strain: severe.

Corona Ray.name: Corona Ray
Corona Ray.description: The user fires a thin beam of white light from the palm at a target within about ten meters, half a pure light user's reach, while a dark rim trails the beam and stretches the target's shadow behind them. It deals light damage and chars cloth; held back, it only stings a hand so the target drops what they hold. Opaque cover stops the shot, and the flash shows everyone watching where the user stands. Strain: light.

Sundial Snare.name: Sundial Snare
Sundial Snare.description: The user lifts the shadow under a target within about five meters, half a pure shadow user's reach, into flat black bands edged with a pale glow that wrap the ankles or wrists without hurting. The target cannot walk away or swing the held arm until they break free with a hard effort, a strong light hits the bands or the end of the user's next turn. In shadowless light the bands cannot form. Strain: light.

Corona Cut.name: Corona Cut
Corona Cut.description: The user narrows their light at fingertip range into a short cutting line rimmed in flat black shadow that swallows its own glare. Over a few seconds it slices through a jammed car door, a lock or a steel bar to free a trapped person without blinding or burning them, or at low heat seals a bleeding cut shut until a doctor treats it. It reaches only arm's length and fails if the user moves. Strain: moderate.

Sundial Step.name: Sundial Step
Sundial Step.description: The user steps into a shadow at least as wide as their shoulders and steps out of another shadow in sight within about five meters, half a pure shadow user's reach, while a pale ring glints around both patches. Attacks aimed at their old spot miss, and they can carry one held person past a locked door or out of a fall; a floodlight on either shadow blocks the way, and the glint shows where they land. Strain: moderate.

Flare Pin.name: Flare Pin
Flare Pin.description: The user snaps a bright flare overhead that throws every foe's shadow within a room's width outward, then pins those cast shadows to the floor in a dark ring while a halo of light keeps shadows off nearby allies. Even in a bright room, each enemy is held by the ankles without injury until the end of their next turn or until they wrench free with a hard effort. It burns stamina and thins the user's shadow. Strain: moderate.

Strobe Blackout.name: Strobe Blackout
Strobe Blackout.description: The user strobes white light and flat darkness across a room to disorient watchers, then swallows the glare to drown the room in total darkness for a few seconds, until the end of their next turn. Enemies inside are blinded and disoriented and cannot aim or run, while the user sees by a faint glow on their own skin and leads allies clear. Running both natures burns stamina and drains the user's own shadow. Strain: heavy.

Searing Corona.name: Searing Corona
Searing Corona.description: The user fires a focused beam of white light across half a street's length, half a pure light user's long reach, that lands the instant it leaves the palm while a sleeve of shadow trails along it and snags the target's shadow. It deals heavy light damage that passes through glass and windshields; held back, it only heats a held weapon so the target drops it unhurt. Kickback pushes the user back a step and dims their vision. Strain: heavy.

Coronal Eclipse.name: Coronal Eclipse
Coronal Eclipse.description: The user's signature move: they hang a black sphere ringed with a white corona over a street, drowning it in total darkness while beams lash from the rim. Every enemy there takes massive light damage and is pinned by their own shadow until the end of their next turn; held back, it only dazzles and binds unhurt. It burns stamina and spends the user's shadow, so they cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Umbral Sanctum.name: Umbral Sanctum
Umbral Sanctum.description: The user takes hold of every existing shadow across a room or a street's width for the rest of the scene, never a whole block. They raise dark glass panes edged with a pale glow to stop bullets and falling rubble, lower trapped people on shadow ribbons and bind any enemy standing in shade there unhurt until a hard effort or a floodlight breaks the hold. Where bright light erases the shade, the hold ends. Strain: severe.

Special Move Training.name: Special Move Training
Special Move Training.description: The user tries to create a new Special Move: a use of their Quirk (or, with no Quirk, of their body, gear or fighting style) that they have drilled, had a teacher correct, or improvised under real pressure, aimed at one clear result. +10 on the attempt. On full success they learn it as a new Special Move; a failed or mixed attempt teaches nothing yet. Cost: as the move attempted.

Tailwind Burst.name: Tailwind Burst
Tailwind Burst.description: The user bursts forward on a tailwind and crosses up to a short street's length in a blink, slipping past one foe or reaching a person in danger before anyone else moves. Anyone they pass is buffeted a step aside. A tight corner, a slick floor or a crowd shortens the dash to a few strides. Strain: light.

Passing Gust.name: Passing Gust
Passing Gust.description: The user sweeps past a target within a few meters and the wind of their passing slams into them, dealing force damage and knocking them off balance so their next attack is easier to avoid; held back, it only staggers them and scatters what they hold. It needs room to run past the target. Strain: light.

Updraft Stride.name: Updraft Stride
Updraft Stride.description: Riding a rising gust, the user runs up a wall to a second-story ledge, across a gap of a few meters or along a narrow beam without slowing, and can drop back down cushioned by the same wind. The stride lasts only until the end of the turn; a wet wall or a downdraft drops them early. Strain: moderate.

Cyclone Circle.name: Cyclone Circle
Cyclone Circle.description: The user runs tight circles around one foe and spins a vortex of dust and wind around them until the end of the user's next turn. The foe is blinded, cannot advance out of the ring without being shoved back, and has a harder time hitting anyone outside it. An indoor room with clutter or a strong crosswind breaks the ring early. Strain: moderate.

Sheltered Carry.name: Sheltered Carry
Sheltered Carry.description: The user scoops up one person and carries them out of danger at full speed inside a pocket of still air, so heat, smoke, debris and wind never touch the passenger. Together they cover a street's length in a moment and land gently. The carried person must be within reach and no heavier than about two adults. Strain: moderate.

Vacuum Wake.name: Vacuum Wake
Vacuum Wake.description: The user sprints the length of a corridor, a stairwell or a street and the pulling wake behind them drags smoke, gas or dust out with them, clearing a path for others to breathe and see until the end of the next turn. The same wake can tug loose light objects and a stumbling person a few meters in the user's direction. A sealed room with no exit for the air leaves the wake nowhere to go. Strain: heavy.

Cyclone Kick.name: Cyclone Kick
Cyclone Kick.description: The user builds speed over a short run and launches a flying kick wrapped in a spinning cyclone. It deals heavy force damage to one target and hurls them several meters; anyone right beside them is shoved aside. Held back, it only sends the target tumbling into a soft landing. It needs a running start. Strain: heavy.

Jet Stream Run.name: Jet Stream Run
Jet Stream Run.description: Signature. The user lays a long tailwind corridor across a street or a collapsing building and runs it again and again in one turn, carrying or sweeping a whole group of up to ten people out of danger to a safe point, each inside a pocket of still air. Foes caught in the corridor are knocked flat. The run fails in a space too cramped to turn. Strain: severe.

Eye of the Storm.name: Eye of the Storm
Eye of the Storm.description: The user circles a group of people at full speed and raises a moving storm wall around them that travels with them until the end of the user's next turn. Debris, thrown objects and small projectiles are swept aside, and foes cannot push through the wall; inside, the air is still and calm. The user must keep running the whole time, and a building interior with no room to circle stops it. Strain: severe.

Sunfall Expanse.name: Sunfall Expanse
Sunfall Expanse.description: The user releases flame in every direction at once and floods a whole city block, from the street to the rooftops, with a sheet of fire that burns for the rest of the scene. Every enemy inside takes heavy fire damage at the end of each of their turns until they leave the block, and steel, glass and asphalt there soften in the heat; held back, the flame only scorches and drives enemies out. The user cannot shape this fire around people, so allies and bystanders must be cleared from the block first. Strain: severe.

Hearth Command.name: Hearth Command
Hearth Command.description: The user reaches into every fire they started this scene and takes it back under control, however far it has spread through a building or a city block. They can draw it back into their palms, hold it still behind a line they choose, or send it along a street at enemies, who take heavy fire damage; held back, it only walls them in. Fires the user did not start stay out of reach, and every flame drawn back adds its heat to the user's body, so the Drawback strikes at once when the last one goes out. Strain: severe.

Permafrost Reach.name: Permafrost Reach
Permafrost Reach.description: The user drives frost down into the ground and out along every street, pipe and wall it reaches until ice covers a district several city blocks across within a minute. For the rest of the scene the user can raise a wall, a ramp or a restraint anywhere in that district without touching it, and an enemy struck by ice the user raises takes heavy cold damage; held back, the ice only locks them in place. Every road there is unusable for traffic, and the user must keep a hand on the ground the whole time or the district stops answering. Strain: severe.

Unmelting Seal.name: Unmelting Seal
Unmelting Seal.description: The user packs frost into ice so dense that, for the rest of the scene, it does not melt in fire and does not crack under any blow, bullet or blast. They seal a doorway, a burst gas main, a live bomb or a single enemy inside it; an enemy sealed whole takes heavy cold damage at the end of each of their turns, and held back, the seal leaves the head and chest clear and only holds them. The user can keep only one such seal at a time, and while it lasts their own hands stay numb and cannot make other ice. Strain: severe.

Stormfront Canopy.name: Stormfront Canopy
Stormfront Canopy.description: The user releases their charge upward until it hangs as a crackling cloud over a whole city district, and for the rest of the scene they call bolts down from it onto any enemy in that district they can see. Each enemy struck takes heavy electric damage and cannot act until the end of their next turn; held back, a bolt only knocks them down. Every unshielded phone, camera and radio under the cloud burns out, the user's own and the responders' included, and the user cannot move faster than a walk while the cloud holds. Strain: severe.

Arc Lattice.name: Arc Lattice
Arc Lattice.description: The user charges the railings, lampposts, wires and fences along a street and strings standing arcs between them into a web that holds for the rest of the scene. Any enemy who crosses or touches a strand takes heavy electric damage and is locked in place until the end of their next turn; held back, a strand only jolts them and throws them clear. The user can open a gap for any ally or bystander they see, but must keep a hand on one of the charged anchors the whole time and cannot discharge anywhere else. Strain: severe.

Skyline Barrage.name: Skyline Barrage
Skyline Barrage.description: The user rises above the rooftops on a column of blasts and rains detonations down across a whole city block for up to a minute. Every enemy in the open there takes heavy explosive damage at the end of each of their turns and cannot stand; held back, the blasts land beside them and only throw them flat. Windows shatter and loose rubble falls across the whole block, so bystanders must be sheltered first, and afterward both of the user's arms are numb and cannot fire for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Blowout Charge.name: Blowout Charge
Blowout Charge.description: The user hurls themselves to the heart of a burning building or a blazing fuel spill and sets off a single shaped blast there. The shock wave tears the flame from its fuel and puts out every fire across the whole building or the length of a street at once, and enemies at the core take heavy explosive damage and are thrown down; held back, the blast only knocks them flat. Every window in the building breaks and everyone inside is deafened until the end of the scene, so people must be moved away from the core first. Strain: severe.

Great Bell Toll.name: Great Bell Toll
Great Bell Toll.description: The user builds a single note until the ground hums, then releases it in a ring that rolls out across a whole city district in every direction. Every enemy in the open within that district takes heavy sonic damage, is knocked off their feet and cannot hear until the end of the scene; held back, the ring only drops them and deafens them for a minute. Every window in the district shatters, allies without ear protection are deafened with the enemies, and the user cannot make sound with the Quirk for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Heartbeat Ledger.name: Heartbeat Ledger
Heartbeat Ledger.description: The user sends a single pulse through a collapsed building or a buried street and hears every heartbeat, breath and shifting slab inside it at once. For the rest of the scene they know where each trapped person is and which slabs will fall next, and they send their voice to each survivor alone, telling them when to stay still and when to move; rescuers who follow the user's calls are never caught by a further collapse. The user must stand still while listening and hears nothing else around them, so an ally must guard them. Strain: severe.

Midnight Noon.name: Midnight Noon
Midnight Noon.description: The user releases a sphere of light that rises over a whole city district and burns at full daylight for the rest of the scene. Nobody there can hide in shadow, and the user can bend a ray down from the sphere onto any enemy in the open below it, dealing heavy light damage that the target cannot dodge; held back, the ray only sears a hand so the enemy drops what they hold. While the sphere burns, the user's own body gives off no light, so they cannot fire beams or flare from their body until it goes out. Strain: severe.

Turning Ray.name: Turning Ray
Turning Ray.description: The user fires a beam that bends in midair along a path they trace, around corners, down stairwells and through gaps in rubble, to a target up to a city block away that the user has seen this scene. It deals heavy light damage to that target alone, or cuts a cable, a lock or a held weapon without touching the person; held back, it only sears the skin and makes them let go. The bent beam leaves a glowing trail back to the user for anyone to follow, and the user cannot fire another until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Typhoon Crown.name: Typhoon Crown
Typhoon Crown.description: The user spins up a storm that turns over a whole city district for the rest of the scene, with the user standing in its calm center. Every enemy in the open within it who tries to rise is thrown back down and takes heavy force damage; held back, the wind only keeps them flat. Smoke and gas blow clear of the district and nothing but the user can fly through it, but fires there flare in the wind and signs, glass and loose debris fly, so bystanders must shelter indoors, and the user cannot leave the center while it lasts. Strain: severe.

Thousand Drafts.name: Thousand Drafts
Thousand Drafts.description: The user splits their wind into dozens of narrow, separate currents and steers each one on its own along a whole street. In a single turn they pluck every weapon from every enemy hand there, carry each falling person or shard of glass to a safe spot, or press each enemy against the nearest wall, where they take heavy force damage and are held until the end of their next turn; held back, the currents only pin them without bruising. The user must stand still with both hands raised and cannot make any other wind until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Monsoon Veil.name: Monsoon Veil
Monsoon Veil.description: The user throws water straight up in a column that breaks into a heavy rain over a whole city district for the rest of the scene. Every ordinary fire under it goes out within minutes, smoke and dust wash out of the air, and the user can drop the rain onto any enemy in the open as a downpour that deals heavy bludgeoning damage and knocks them flat; held back, it only pins them down and blinds them. Streets there flood ankle-deep, so live wiring becomes a danger to everyone, and afterward the user is parched and cannot make water for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Thread Jet.name: Thread Jet
Thread Jet.description: The user narrows the water to a jet thinner than a pencil lead, at a pressure that cuts through steel plate, concrete and a car frame along any line they trace across a street. It frees anyone pinned without harming them, or deals heavy slashing damage to a single target; held back, it only cuts straps, a weapon or armor away from the skin. The user must plant both feet and brace against the kick, and anything behind the target along the line is cut too, so they must aim clear of people. Strain: severe.

Unmoored Block.name: Unmoored Block
Unmoored Block.description: The user presses both palms to the ground and sends the Quirk out through it, so every person, car and loose slab touching the ground across a whole city block counts as touched. For the rest of the scene the user can make any of them weightless or several times heavier with a gesture: floated enemies drift helpless, and weighted enemies take heavy force damage and cannot stand; held back, the weight only pins them flat. The user's palms must stay on the ground the whole time, and if they lift, everything floated falls at once. Strain: severe.

Crossway Fall.name: Crossway Fall
Crossway Fall.description: The user touches a person, a vehicle or a slab and turns the direction of its weight toward any side they choose for the rest of the scene. A touched enemy falls hard into the nearest wall or ceiling, taking heavy force damage and staying pinned there until the user lets go; held back, they only slide into it and stick. Touched allies can walk up walls and across ceilings. Each touch counts against the user's total weight, and a turned car or slab hurtles along its new fall until it hits something unless the user turns it back. Strain: severe.

Tensile Quarter.name: Tensile Quarter
Tensile Quarter.description: The user presses both hands to the pavement and the Quirk spreads through every road, wall and rooftop across a whole city district for the rest of the scene. Falls and collapses there end in a soft rebound, so nobody inside is hurt by falling rubble or a fall from any height, and enemies who run, charge or strike a surface are flung back off it and take heavy force damage; held back, the rebound only throws them down. Allies lose their footing too unless the user warns them, and the user cannot move from the spot while it holds. Strain: severe.

Banked Recoil.name: Banked Recoil
Banked Recoil.description: The user sets a single elastic pane that holds every blow, charge, bullet and thrown object it catches instead of throwing it back, storing their force for the rest of the scene. On the user's word the pane releases everything it has stored at once in a direction the user chooses: everyone in that line along a street takes heavy force damage, more the more it caught, and is thrown down; held back, it only throws them flat. The user can hold only one such pane, and if the user is knocked out it releases in every direction. Strain: severe.

Foundry Rampart.name: Foundry Rampart
Foundry Rampart.description: The user braces both arms and, over a single turn, pours a two-story wall of layered steel and rubber out of their back and forearms that runs the length of a city block, with gated openings wherever they choose. Gunfire, blasts, vehicles and thrown debris from the far side cannot pass it until heavy blows breach a section, and it stays standing after the scene. The effort empties the user's reserves: they cannot make anything for the rest of the scene and must eat and rest before the Quirk works again. Strain: severe.

Touchstone Replica.name: Touchstone Replica
Touchstone Replica.description: The user lays a palm on a machine, a lock, a weapon or a piece of support gear and learns its makeup down to every material and part in moments, then makes a working duplicate or the exact part it needs from the skin: a key that fits the lock, a replacement valve for a failing pump, the missing piece of a hero's broken gear. The knowledge fades at the end of the scene unless the user studies the object properly afterward, and the user is left shaking with hunger and cannot make anything until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Verdant Overrun.name: Verdant Overrun
Verdant Overrun.description: The user drives roots deep into the soil and, for several minutes, trunks and vines burst through pavement across several city blocks at once. They lift trapped and fleeing people onto living platforms above floodwater, fire or rubble, and coil around every enemy on the ground, who takes heavy bludgeoning damage and is held aloft until cut loose; held back, the vines only grip. The roots crack foundations and water mains across the area, collateral the user must steer around, and afterward the user cannot grow anything for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Sentinel Seedbed.name: Sentinel Seedbed
Sentinel Seedbed.description: The user plants seeds of their own vines across a building, a street or a field, and the plants that sprout keep a single standing order for up to a day after the user leaves: bind anyone who forces the doors, hold any slab that shifts over a survivor, or catch anyone who falls. The user feels through the roots whenever a seedling acts, from anywhere in the city, and the bindings grip without bruising. While any seedling lives, the user's own vines reach only half as far, and fire or a blade kills the seedlings as easily as any other vine. Strain: severe.

Bedrock Dominion.name: Bedrock Dominion
Bedrock Dominion.description: The user drives both palms into the street and the ground across several city blocks answers at once. In a single push they raise a stone ring around the whole area that no vehicle or runner can cross, lift every collapsed slab off the people beneath it, and sink every enemy standing on open ground to the knees in setting stone that grips without crushing, holding them until a heavy blow or tools break it. Water mains and gas lines crack throughout the area, collateral the user must call out to rescuers, and the user's hands go numb until they rest. Strain: severe.

Deep Seam.name: Deep Seam
Deep Seam.description: The user presses a palm to the ground and their shaping runs through every joined stretch of rock and concrete up to about a kilometer away. They feel the shape of the stone they reach, so they find tunnels, basements and the hollows where people are trapped, and can shape stone there unseen: open a stair out of a flooded basement across the district, seal a tunnel ahead of a fleeing villain or close a stone cage around a target at the far end. The user must keep the palm down and cannot move, speak or defend themselves until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Iron Horizon.name: Iron Horizon
Iron Horizon.description: The user seizes the steel of something enormous within sight, such as a derailed train, an elevated highway span or the frame of a collapsing high-rise, and holds it still or moves it at a walking pace for several minutes, setting it down where it harms no one. Every phone, card and unshielded electronic within several blocks is wiped, and anyone nearby with a pacemaker or metal implant must be moved clear before the user starts. Afterward the field is spent and the user cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Lodestone Brand.name: Lodestone Brand
Lodestone Brand.description: The user touches a target and leaves a lasting pole on them for a full day.
