Wherever the target goes in the city, the user feels the direction and rough distance of the brand, and whenever the target comes within a street's width, the user can slam them to the nearest steel or to the ground: at full strength the target takes heavy force damage, and held back they are only pinned until they wrench free with a hard effort. The user holds one brand at a time, and while it lasts every other use of the Quirk reaches only half as far. Strain: severe.

Hissing Floodplain.name: Hissing Floodplain
Hissing Floodplain.description: The user's skin pours out acid in a volume it never held before, running ankle-deep across a whole city block at a strength they set. Every enemy standing in it takes heavy corrosive damage each turn they stay as their boots, armor and support gear are eaten away, and vehicle tires melt so nothing drives out; held back, it only stings and leaves the footing so slick that anyone running falls. The acid flows downhill into drains and basements, so the user must steer it off bystanders, and afterward they cannot make acid until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Dormant Etch.name: Dormant Etch
Dormant Etch.description: The user paints a clear, inert film onto surfaces with a touch: a doorframe, a stair's supports, a rack of weapons, a vehicle's axles. It stays harmless for up to an hour until the user flicks a single drop of a second acid onto it from across a street, and then everything painted dissolves in moments. Painting takes the user's full attention for about a minute, the film never takes hold on skin, and any strong acid or cleaner can set it off early, so a careless spill or a chemical fire triggers it before the user means it to. Strain: severe.

Lowland Lull.name: Lowland Lull
Lowland Lull.description: The user exhales for a full minute and a low, heavy knockout blend spreads street by street across several city blocks, holding the course the user sets even against wind. Everyone who breathes it without a sealed mask, allies and bystanders included, falls asleep until the scene ends or until shaken awake. It stays a sleep dose in open air, but it builds inside closed rooms, so the user must keep it out of homes and basements where it could stop someone's breathing. Afterward the user's throat is raw and they cannot release gas for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Chosen Breath.name: Chosen Breath
Chosen Breath.description: The user fills a room, a bus or a train car with a thin trace gas, learns each person breathing it, then thickens a blend only around the people they pick. Hostage-takers breathe knockout gas and fall asleep until the end of the scene, or breathe irritant and take heavy toxic damage, while the hostages beside them breathe clean air; held back, the irritant deals only tears and coughing. The user must stay still and silent until the end of their next turn to hold the blends apart, and an open window, a fan or a sprinkler mixes them. Strain: severe.

Thoroughfare Gate.name: Thoroughfare Gate
Thoroughfare Gate.description: The user opens a single gate as wide as a street and holds it for several minutes, its exit set at a safe place they know anywhere in the region, so an entire neighborhood, its cars and its stretchers can pass through. Anything that crosses the threshold goes through, pursuers included, and while the gate stands the user cannot move, defend themselves or open any other gate. When it closes, it pushes anyone halfway through back out unharmed, and the user cannot open a gate for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Moored Gate.name: Moored Gate
Moored Gate.description: The user anchors a linked pair of door-sized gates between two places they know well anywhere in the city, and the pair stays open for a full day without the user's attention. Anyone can walk through either way, so a hospital and a disaster site, or an agency and a hideout under watch, become a single step apart. The gates work for villains as well as heroes, the user feels every crossing and cannot sleep while they stand, and when they close the user needs a full night's rest before anchoring another pair. Strain: severe.

Nightfall Reach.name: Nightfall Reach
Nightfall Reach.description: At night or in a blackout, the shadow spreads through every unlit space across several city blocks for the rest of the scene and can rise out of any patch of darkness there. It pins enemies in alleys until they break free with a hard effort or a bright light falls on it, catches falling people and hauls the trapped out of dark rubble, and strikes for heavy slashing damage on command; held back, it only pins. Each turn it is spread, the user must rein it in with a hard effort of will or it lashes at whoever is nearest, allies included. Strain: severe.

Untethered Shade.name: Untethered Shade
Untethered Shade.description: The shadow leaves the user's body entirely and works on its own anywhere within a city block for the rest of the scene, at full strength in darkness. It carries out the user's orders out of sight, scouting, guarding a door, hauling survivors or striking for slashing damage, held back to a shove when the user says so, and whispers its reports back. While it is away the user cannot use any other technique of the Quirk, every blow and burn the shadow takes hurts the user too, and the shadow may still refuse any order it is given. Strain: severe.

Thousand-Bed Ward.name: Thousand-Bed Ward
Thousand-Bed Ward.description: For several minutes the Quirk spreads from the user as a field of warm light across an evacuation ground, a stadium floor or a city block's street, reaching every injured person they choose within sight. Each one stops bleeding, cannot die from their wounds for the rest of the scene and regains some health at the price of heavy stamina, while anyone too weak to pay is only kept alive. The user must stay standing in the open the whole time, and afterward they collapse, cannot heal anyone for the rest of the scene and need a full day of rest. Strain: severe.

Shouldered Price.name: Shouldered Price
Shouldered Price.description: The user lays both hands on a patient too exhausted to pay for their own healing and carries the price themselves: the user's own stamina pays for the repair instead of the patient's. A grave wound closes and the patient regains most of their health, or an old injury that healed wrong is set right, without costing the patient anything. The user loses extreme stamina and cannot heal again until they rest, and a user already worn down falls unconscious once the work is done. Strain: severe.

Broadcast Edict.name: Broadcast Edict
Broadcast Edict.description: Through a public address system, an emergency broadcast or stadium speakers, the user asks a question that reaches every ear across several city blocks. Everyone who answers aloud anywhere in that reach, ally, enemy or bystander, falls under a single shared command, such as shelter in place, weapons down or walk to the evacuation route, for several minutes until hurt, shaken hard or released; an order to hurt anyone frees them all. The user cannot choose who is caught, their voice gives out for the rest of the scene, and the Commission reviews every use. Strain: severe.

Sleeper Cue.name: Sleeper Cue
Sleeper Cue.description: The user gives a person under their control a single order tied to a spoken cue, such as drop the weapon and kneel when they hear a chosen word. The order sleeps for up to a week, the person acts normally, and whenever anyone speaks the cue within the person's hearing, they obey it at once before coming back to themselves. An order to hurt themselves or anyone else breaks it, and so does a hard shock at the moment of the cue. The user can keep only one cue at a time, and while it stands they can hold only a single person with the Quirk. Strain: severe.

Stilled Quarter.name: Stilled Quarter
Stilled Quarter.description: The user climbs to a high vantage and drags the look once across a whole city block: every street, window and rooftop in sight. Every person the user saw in that sweep loses their Emitter and Transformation Quirks for the rest of the scene while they stay inside the block, even out of sight, so a gang hiding in the buildings fights on foot and by hand. Allies caught in the sweep lose theirs too unless the user skipped them, and Mutant features keep working. Afterward the user sees only blurs and cannot use the Quirk until they rest. Strain: severe.

Long Quiet.name: Long Quiet
Long Quiet.description: The user holds the look on a single person in sight for a full minute without a blink, doing nothing else, and the stop settles into that person's body. Until the user next sleeps, that person cannot use an Emitter or Transformation Quirk anywhere, in or out of the user's sight, so a dangerous prisoner stays powerless through a transfer, a hearing or a night in a holding cell. The user can hold a single such mark at a time, and while it lasts every other look of theirs ends at the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Greater Echo.name: Greater Echo
Greater Echo.description: The user opens a copied Quirk past anything its owner has ever reached and fires it across a whole city block: a copied barrier walls off the block, copied water floods its streets ankle deep, or a copied attack strikes every enemy the user picks there and deals massive damage of that Quirk's own type; held back, it only knocks them flat. The user's body is not built for the copy at that scale, so copied fire scorches their hands and copied cold numbs them. The copy burns out, and the user cannot copy again for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Kept Impression.name: Kept Impression
Kept Impression.description: The user reaches back through every Quirk they have ever copied and calls one up again without touching its owner, even an owner in another city or long since jailed. The recalled copy works at a beginner's level for a few minutes, and the user knows at once what has changed in it since they last held it. Mutant features remain out of reach. While a recalled copy runs, the user cannot take a new copy by touch, and the Drawback strikes the moment it ends. Strain: severe.

Whole Ward Census.name: Whole Ward Census
Whole Ward Census.description: The user stands still, closes their eyes and feels every mind across a whole city district at once, through walls, floors, rubble and floodwater. For the rest of the scene they know where each person in it is, whether they are awake, unconscious, panicking or in pain, and the moment any of them moves or fades, so no survivor under a collapse is missed and no hidden attacker stays hidden. The user must keep still with eyes closed to hold it, sends no messages while it runs, and needs a full rest afterward before the Quirk works again. Strain: severe.

Steady Hand Relay.name: Steady Hand Relay
Steady Hand Relay.description: The user streams their own trained know-how into a single ally's mind, step by step and movement by movement, faster than speech. For the rest of the scene that ally performs one task the user knows, such as packing a wound, defusing a device or shoring a sagging beam, with the user's full skill, even with no training of their own. The user must stay focused on the link and can take no other action; if the ally is hurt while linked, the user feels it and takes heavy psychic damage. Strain: severe.

Mortar Rain.name: Mortar Rain
Mortar Rain.description: The user fires a dense spray of fine adhesive high over a whole city block, and it settles on every facade, sign, window and loose brick. For the rest of the scene nothing glued that way falls: cracked glass stays in its frame, a sagging balcony holds, and shaken debris stays put through aftershocks. People it settles on are only lightly tacky, but doors it settles on stick shut and must be pried open. The spray drains the user: afterward they make no adhesive until they have eaten and drunk. Strain: severe.

Set on Cue.name: Set on Cue
Set on Cue.description: The user calls on every strand, glob and sheet of their own adhesive in the scene at once and changes each one by choice. Chosen pieces let go and flake to dust, freeing captives, allies or a glued street; the rest set rigid, so a wrapped enemy cannot twitch, a web stiffens into a walkway that bears a crowd, and a taped limb is splinted straight. Rigid adhesive never sets across a face or chest, so the bound still breathe. The user makes no new adhesive until the end of their next turn, and anyone set rigid must be cut out with tools. Strain: severe.

Hundredfold Muster.name: Hundredfold Muster
Hundredfold Muster.description: The user pours out hundreds of doubles that spread across several city blocks and each take a post: directing traffic, holding doors, carrying the injured, searching stairwells and guiding crowds out. They work for the rest of the scene and call every find back along the line, so a whole district can be emptied at once, though each still bursts when hit hard. When the scene ends or the last double bursts, the user drops to the ground spent and cannot make doubles again until after a full rest. Strain: severe.

Homeward Selves.name: Homeward Selves
Homeward Selves.description: The user sends doubles out to scout, search or listen, and each one carries what it learns home. The moment a double bursts or touches the user again, its memories flow back into the user: every room it saw, every word it heard, every face and every trap, so a whole building can be scouted in seconds from outside it. The bursts come back with the memories: the user feels each double's last moment, and after taking more than a handful back they are dazed until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Ashfall Block.name: Ashfall Block
Ashfall Block.description: The user presses a full hand to the ground and lets the decay run through it across a whole city block: asphalt, cars, barricades and cover crumble to gray dust, and every enemy standing on it drops into loose grit, taking massive bludgeoning damage. The decay stops at living flesh, and the user must hold it out of every building with people inside, or those buildings come down. Held back to the surface, it levels cover and vehicles alone. Afterward the user's hands crack and go numb, and they cannot decay anything for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Sleeping Fault.name: Sleeping Fault
Sleeping Fault.description: The user grips a door, a vehicle, a weapon or a beam and plants the decay without letting it act. It waits in the material for up to an hour and crumbles that object the instant the user wills it or a condition they set is met: a getaway van falls apart as its engine starts, a stolen gun turns to grit when drawn, never touching the hand that holds it. The user can plant a handful at once; each aches in the palm until spent or called back, that hand cannot decay anything meanwhile, and a forgotten plant still goes off. Strain: severe.

Grand Clearance.name: Grand Clearance
Grand Clearance.description: The user sets both palms on the ground and sends the compression through everything loose across a whole city block: every car, crate, rubble pile, barricade and dropped weapon folds into a sphere and rolls to the user's feet, leaving open roads for rescuers and no cover for enemies. Walls, floors and fixed doors stay put, and nobody is taken unless they choose. Until the user releases the spheres or sets them down somewhere safe, they cannot compress anything else, and a broken sphere unfolds full size where it lies. Strain: severe.

Held Moment.name: Held Moment
Held Moment.description: The user compresses a person who agrees or is unconscious and keeps the sphere sealed far past its usual minutes: for hours, until the user chooses to open it. Inside, no time passes, so a patient bleeding out arrives at surgery no worse than when taken, and a victim of a toxic gas reaches an antidote before it spreads further. The user can hold only a few such spheres, cannot compress anything else while one is sealed past the usual limit, and if the user is knocked out every sealed sphere opens at once wherever it is. Strain: severe.

Standing Citadel.name: Standing Citadel
Standing Citadel.description: The user raises a dome of force over a whole city block and holds it for the rest of the scene. Nothing passes through it but heat, light and sound: falling debris, gunfire, a flood or a villain's charge all stop at its surface, and only a blow strong enough to level a building cracks a section. The user can open doorway-sized gaps to let people in or out. The user cannot move or attack while holding it, and when it drops they collapse and need a full rest before the Quirk works again. Strain: severe.

Nested Panes.name: Nested Panes
Nested Panes.description: The user closes layer upon layer of panes around a danger at its source, such as a bomb, a gas leak, a fire or a Quirk running wild, without forming any pane inside an object or a body. The blast or spill stays boxed: each layer takes what it can and bursts, the next takes the rest, and nothing solid, liquid or gas gets out until the force is spent. Heat, light and sound still pass through, so people nearby must stand well back. The user can do nothing else until it is spent, and if the last layer breaks, what remains escapes. Strain: severe.

District Hush.name: District Hush
District Hush.description: The user opens up and spreads a steady calm through every person across several city blocks, inside buildings and out. For the rest of the scene panic stops: crowds walk out in order, rioters lower their hands and stand back, and the trapped wait quietly for rescue, though a fresh shock breaks the calm for that person. The calm spills onto allies and the user too: every ally in the area reacts a beat slow until the end of the scene, and afterward the user needs a full rest before pushing feelings again. Strain: severe.

Heart Crossing.name: Heart Crossing
Heart Crossing.description: The user draws a feeling out of one person in sight and pours it into another: a hostage's terror into the captor, a veteran hero's steadiness into a panicking trainee. The giver is free of that feeling for the rest of the scene and the receiver holds it in full; terror or despair received this way deals heavy psychic damage, or, held back, only shakes the receiver's grip. Love and trust cannot be moved. The feeling passes through the user on the way: they feel it in full and cannot push feelings until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Thousand Seams.name: Thousand Seams
Thousand Seams.description: The user presses both hands to a carpet, a flag or a coat and spreads their reach through it into every woven thing across a whole city block. They feel every clothed person in it, indoors or out, and lock the clothing of every enemy they find wherever that enemy hides, binding arms to bodies and legs together until the end of the user's next turn. Cloth is never pulled at the throat. The user must keep both hands on the fabric and cannot move, and afterward their fingers cramp and cannot move fibers until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Set Pattern.name: Set Pattern
Set Pattern.description: The user weaves rope, curtain and carpet thread across a few doorways, stairwells or gaps and sets a fixed rule into each weave. For the rest of the scene, with no user watching or touching it, each pattern grips the clothing of anyone the user did not mark while weaving, binding their legs as they pass, and catches any falling person unhurt; the user feels the moment each one acts. While patterns stand, the user moves only fibers they touch, not those they see, and a cut or burned pattern is gone for good. Strain: severe.

Scarlet Lattice.name: Scarlet Lattice
Scarlet Lattice.description: The user opens both forearms and sends their blood out in hair-thin threads along gutters, walls and lampposts across a whole city block, then hardens every thread at once. Each enemy the user chooses in that block is bound at the wrists and ankles and cannot move until they break free with a hard effort, and every bleeding person there is sealed. The bindings leave no injury. Afterward the user has lost nearly a liter of blood, cannot stand without help and cannot release blood until they have rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Garnet Mantle.name: Garnet Mantle
Garnet Mantle.description: The user lays a thin skin of their blood over their whole body and keeps it half-liquid, hardening each patch the instant something strikes it. For the rest of the scene blades, bullets and blows stop at the mantle, which flows back over any gap, and the user can harden any part of it into hooked spikes that deal piercing damage to anyone grappling them; held back, the spikes only grip clothing. It stops no heat, gas or electricity, and when it falls the user has lost a large share of their health. Strain: severe.

Thousand Throats.name: Thousand Throats
Thousand Throats.description: The user's call passes from animal to animal until it covers a whole ward of the city, dozens of blocks wide. Within minutes the user knows where every fire, collapse, fight and trapped person in the ward is, and dogs, cats and birds lead every lost or stranded bystander they find to the nearest shelter or rescuer. The animals still refuse fire, gunfire and fights. Afterward animal voices crowd the user's hearing and they cannot use the Quirk for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Pack Accord.name: Pack Accord
Pack Accord.description: The user speaks at length with one group of animals, up to a pack of dogs or a whole flock, and wins their full trust. Until the end of the day the group carries out a long task with several steps the user lays out, such as guarding a door, following a person and bringing word at each change, and keeps at it through noise and threats; guard and police dogs set against the user stand down. The animals still never fight to the death, and while the task lasts the user cannot ask any other animal for anything. Strain: severe.

Ironbound Hour.name: Ironbound Hour
Ironbound Hour.description: The user hardens to a density their skin has never reached and holds it for the rest of the scene instead of a minute. Rifle rounds, a speeding car, a strength Quirk at full power and a falling floor of a collapsing building do them no harm, and their ridged blows deal heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, they strike with smoothed fists that only knock a target down. Heat, cold, electricity and gas still hurt them. When the scene ends the hardening cracks away and the user cannot harden until they have rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Ridge Lock.name: Ridge Lock
Ridge Lock.description: For the rest of the scene the user stays soft and hardens only the exact spot of skin an attack touches, in the instant it touches. They keep full speed, fine touch and the ability to swim and carry injured people without cutting them, while blows, blades and pistol rounds stop at that spot, and any weapon that strikes them is caught in a closing ridge and wrenched from the attacker's grip. An attack the user does not see coming lands on soft skin, and heat, electricity and gas still hurt them. Strain: severe.

Horizon Stature.name: Horizon Stature
Horizon Stature.description: The user grows to twice the height of the tallest building nearby and holds it for a few minutes. They cross a river or a ward in a few strides, catch the upper floors of a toppling high-rise and set them down, and their blows deal massive bludgeoning damage; held back, an open palm only pins a giant opponent or a vehicle in place. Every step cracks roads and bursts pipes, so the user must watch each footfall. Afterward they drop to normal size and cannot grow for the rest of the day. Strain: severe.

Stepwise Titan.name: Stepwise Titan
Stepwise Titan.description: For the rest of the scene the user changes size in a blink as often as they choose and grows any single part on its own. They pass through a doorway at normal size and stand up giant in the street beyond, reach a giant hand into a high window while their feet stay small enough to spare the cars below, and land a blow with a fist grown only at the moment of impact, dealing heavy bludgeoning damage, or held back, a flat-palmed shove. When the scene ends they cannot grow again until they have eaten and rested for several hours. Strain: severe.

Hunter's Ward.name: Hunter's Ward
Hunter's Ward.description: In full beast form the user lifts their head and takes in the scents and sounds of a whole district at once. For the rest of the scene they know where every trapped or hurt person, every gas leak, every fire and every armed group in that district is, and they pick out any one person's scent among thousands and follow it anywhere inside the district. The user must hold the full form the whole time, and when it ends strong smells and noise overwhelm them until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Steady Fang.name: Steady Fang
Steady Fang.description: The user takes a form halfway between person and beast and holds it for the rest of the scene with a clear head. They keep the beast's strength, senses and hide but also full speech, working hands that use tools and a body that fits through doors, and pain, fear and anger no longer pull them toward instinct. Their claws deal heavy slashing damage; held back, the user strikes with the paw's heel and only knocks the target down. When the form ends the user cannot change again until they have rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Longreach Arc.name: Longreach Arc
Longreach Arc.description: The user grows a single blade from the forearm out to the length of a bus in under a second and sweeps it across a street. Every enemy in the arc takes massive slashing damage and is thrown down; held back, the flat strikes instead and deals heavy bludgeoning damage. Lampposts, car roofs and steel girders in the arc are cut through, so the user must keep bystanders and load-bearing walls out of its path. Afterward the blade snaps off at the root and the user cannot grow blades from that arm until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Bone Trellis.name: Bone Trellis
Bone Trellis.description: The user drives both forearms into the walls of a collapsing room and grows long blades crosswise through it, each one biting into brick, concrete or wood and locking with the others into a rigid frame. For the rest of the scene a sagging ceiling, a buckled floor or a leaning wall falls no further, and people can climb through the gaps to safety. The user cannot move or attack while the frame stands, and when they draw it back their arms are torn raw and lose a large share of their health. Strain: severe.

Boundless Guise.name: Boundless Guise
Boundless Guise.description: For the rest of the day the user can take the form of anyone whose sample they carry, whatever their size, from a small child to a heteromorph three meters tall, and switch between every carried form between one step and the next without breaking line of sight. Each form holds through blows, sleep and shock. Copied wings still do not fly, and the user gains none of anyone's Quirk, memories or skills. When the day ends the user's bones ache and they cannot change form until they have slept. Strain: severe.

True Counterfeit.name: True Counterfeit
True Counterfeit.description: From a full vial of a person's fresh blood, the user takes their form down to blood, scent, fingerprints and voiceprint. Until the sample runs out after about an hour, blood tests, DNA scanners and tracking dogs confirm the user as that person. The user still gains none of their Quirk, memories or skills, so a personal question exposes them, and heroes may do this only with consent or an authorized undercover operation. When the form ends the user cannot change form for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Sustained Surge.name: Sustained Surge
Sustained Surge.description: The user's boost holds at full peak strength for the rest of the scene instead of a minute. Their blows deal heavy bludgeoning damage and punch through reinforced concrete, they lift a loaded truck overhead and throw a car the length of a block; held back, a blow only knocks a target flat with no broken bones. The boost adds no toughness or speed. When the scene ends the crash hits all at once: the user collapses, cannot boost for the rest of the day and needs a large meal and hours of rest. Strain: severe.

Exact Measure.name: Exact Measure
Exact Measure.description: For the rest of the scene the user swells only the muscles a task needs, by the amount it needs, and their hands keep fine touch while boosted. They tear a crushed car apart around the people inside, open a bomb casing without jarring it, pry a hostage out of a grappler's grip, or land a blow that deals heavy bludgeoning damage to armor, a shield or a held weapon and none to the body beneath. Each use drains the user's reserves, so when the scene ends they crash for an hour instead of minutes. Strain: severe.

District Circuit.name: District Circuit
District Circuit.description: The user runs every street, alley, lobby and stairwell of a whole district in under a minute. They learn where every injured or trapped person and every armed enemy in the open is, pluck every gun, blade and detonator from enemy hands as they pass, and carry anyone in the path of immediate harm to the nearest safe spot. The user must brake around crowds or risk collisions. Afterward their soles have burned through, their feet are blistered and they cannot speed up for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Hairline Second.name: Hairline Second
Hairline Second.description: The user speeds up their nerves along with their body until people around them seem to stand almost still. Until the end of their next turn they take several actions for each one anyone else takes, read every attack as it starts, step out of the path of gunfire, catch thrown objects and falling people, and stop dead from full speed in a single step. Afterward heat floods their body and their legs cramp: they cannot speed up until the end of their following turn and cannot run for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Undertow Transit.name: Undertow Transit
Undertow Transit.description: The user sinks fully into the ground, crosses phased under streets and through whole buildings, and lets the Quirk shove them back out of matter at any spot they choose within a city block, on a rooftop or inside a sealed room. If they rise beside a target, their blow lands before the target can turn and deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, it only knocks the target down. The user travels blind and deaf, working from a layout they know, and afterward cannot phase until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Inside Reach.name: Inside Reach
Inside Reach.description: The user phases a single hand through the casing of a bomb, a locked safe, a car door or a gun's frame and turns the fingertips solid in the hollow space inside. In one action they pull a detonator wire, lift a firing pin, trip a lock from within or free a jammed seatbelt, and they can do this to one weapon or device within reach each turn for the rest of the scene. The phased hand cannot see, so the user works by touch alone, and a wrong move inside a live device sets it off. Strain: severe.

Mountain of Give.name: Mountain of Give
Mountain of Give.description: The user's body swells to the height of a two-story building and the width of a street, and stays soft for the rest of the scene. Every blunt blow, collapsing facade, crashing vehicle and blast wave that reaches that street from either side sinks into the user and stops, so nobody behind them takes damage, and all of it is stored for one release. The user cannot move from the spot while swollen, and blades, heat and gas still pass through. Strain: severe.

Settled Account.name: Settled Account
Settled Account.description: The user keeps a separate count of the force each attacker drove into them during the scene. In one action they press into every enemy within reach and return to each one exactly the force that person dealt: each takes bludgeoning damage matching their own blows and is thrown down, and anyone who never struck the user is untouched. Held back, each is only knocked flat. Afterward the user's stores are empty and they cannot soften until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Harbor Colossus.name: Harbor Colossus
Harbor Colossus.description: After a meal of crab, lobster or clams, the user grows a single feature to the size of a building: a claw that lifts a bus or tears the roof off a wreck, or a shell dome that covers a crowd filling a street. The claw deals massive bludgeoning damage to every enemy in a street-wide sweep, or held back, pins them under its weight; the dome takes every blade, blow and falling slab until the end of the user's next turn. Either form burns every meal eaten that day, and the user cannot manifest again until they eat. Strain: severe.

Course by Course.name: Course by Course
Course by Course.description: For the rest of the scene the user reshapes any part of their body into any feature from that day's meals in a breath, and each limb can carry a different one: a claw holding a villain's wrist, tentacles anchoring a falling worker, wings slowing the user's own drop, gills from eaten fish for breathing underwater. Switching never costs an action, and a cracked shell or torn tentacle is shed and regrown from another meal at once. Afterward every meal is burned and the user cannot manifest until they eat and rest. Strain: severe.

District Bound.name: District Bound
District Bound.description: The user's animal body runs at its full limit for the rest of the scene: each bound clears a city block, and they cross a district by rooftop, wall and street in moments, carrying up to two people at once. In one action they strike every enemy on a whole city block in turn with their natural weapons, dealing heavy slashing or bludgeoning damage; held back, each enemy is only knocked flat. When the scene ends the user's legs give out, and they cannot bound or sprint until they rest a full night. Strain: severe.

Long Hunt.name: Long Hunt
Long Hunt.description: The user takes a single person's scent, sound or movement with their animal's sharpest sense and hunts them for the rest of the scene. However the person runs, hides, changes clothes or doubles back across a city district, the user follows straight to them, closes the last gap in one bound and pins them under claws, jaws or legs until they break free with a hard effort or the user lets go; the pin does no harm. The hunt shuts out everything else, so the user cannot sense or answer any other threat while it lasts. Strain: severe.

Thousand-Feather Watch.name: Thousand-Feather Watch
Thousand-Feather Watch.description: The user sheds every flight feather they can spare and steers them across a whole city block, inside buildings and around corners. For the rest of the scene the feathers lift fallen people a few at a time clear of rubble, smoke and fire, and any enemy on the block can be slashed for heavy slashing damage or pinned to a wall until they tear free. The user cannot fly while the feathers are out, and the lost feathers take a week to regrow. Only feathered wings can do this. Strain: severe.

Narrow Sky.name: Narrow Sky
Narrow Sky.description: The user's wings stop failing them in tight or rough air. For the rest of the scene they fly at full speed through hallways, stairwells, alleys and train tunnels, beat through rain, gusts and cold without slowing, and turn in a space barely wider than their folded wings. They can carry two people at once, and gunfire and thrown objects aimed at them in flight miss. When the scene ends the muscles of the user's back give out, and they cannot fly until they rest a full night. Strain: severe.

Deep Chorus.name: Deep Chorus
Deep Chorus.description: The user's clicks carry through every connected body of water around them: a whole harbor, a river through a city district, or the storm drains and flooded subway beneath it. For the rest of the scene they know the layout of all of it, where every person and vessel in or under the water is, who is trapped in an air pocket and how much air is left, and where anyone hiding in it moves. Building the map takes full attention: the user must stay submerged and still, unable to swim or fight, until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Abyssal Descent.name: Abyssal Descent
Abyssal Descent.description: The user dives to any depth, down to the floor of the bay, without pressure, cold or darkness slowing them, and can stay there for the rest of the scene. They reach a sunken ferry, submarine or car, ram open its weakest seam and bring every person aboard to the surface fast enough that none of them drowns, and nobody they carry up takes damage from the pressure. Against a diver or a submerged villain, the ram deals heavy bludgeoning damage. Afterward the user must rest in water for a full night before they can dash again. Strain: severe.

Overpass Bearer.name: Overpass Bearer
Overpass Bearer.description: The user's extra limbs swell with the strength of a dozen adults each and brace against the largest load in reach: a collapsing building face, a falling highway span or a toppling crane. Until the end of the scene, or until the user lets go, nothing they hold falls further and everyone beneath it can walk out unhurt. The user cannot move their feet or use the extra limbs for anything else while bracing, and if they are knocked down the load drops at once. Strain: severe.

Watchful Crown.name: Watchful Crown
Watchful Crown.description: The user buds a working eye and ear at the tip of every extra limb and spreads them around a room, a corner or a wall of rubble. Until the end of the scene the user sees and hears in every direction at once: nobody can surprise or flank them or a person they hold, the first attack each turn from behind or above is blocked by a limb, and budded mouths let them talk to several trapped people at once. A blow to any bud hurts the user and blinds that limb until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Listening District.name: Listening District
Listening District.description: The user opens their senses across a whole city district for the rest of the scene. Every scream, gunshot, breaking window, fire and gas leak in it reaches them as it happens, with its exact place and the number of people near it, and they can direct heroes, police and rescuers to each incident by radio before the first call comes in. The flood of input leaves the user unable to fight or move faster than a walk, and sonic damage dealt to them is doubled until the scene ends. Strain: severe.

Groan of Steel.name: Groan of Steel
Groan of Steel.description: The user tunes every sense to the materials around them: creaking steel, cracking concrete, hissing gas, the smell of hot wiring. For the rest of the scene they know which beam, floor or wall in the building will fail next, roughly when, and which spots will hold, so they can call allies and civilians away from every collapse, blast or flashover before it happens, and nobody who follows their calls is caught by one. The user must stay inside the building to keep reading it, and any loud blast deafens them until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Vanished Avenue.name: Vanished Avenue
Vanished Avenue.description: The user bends the light across a whole stretch of street, a city block long and wall to wall, around everyone and everything inside it, without touching anyone. For the rest of the scene nobody outside can see into that stretch: civilians, vehicles and heroes in it vanish from enemy eyes and cameras, though sound, scent and footprints still give them away. It fails in darkness, the user must stand still at its center and cannot attack, and the effect ends the instant they take a hard hit. Strain: severe.

Daylight Needles.name: Daylight Needles
Daylight Needles.description: Unseen, the user splits the light gathered through their body into many fine white-hot threads and lays one on each chosen target in a room at once. In one action they cut every rope, zip tie and cuff binding the hostages there without harming them and dazzle every guard until the end of their next turn; a guard struck directly takes heavy light damage, or held back, only a sting. It needs daylight or bright lamps, and afterward the user's outline flickers into view until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Redline Marathon.name: Redline Marathon
Redline Marathon.description: The user's engines hold their top speed for the rest of the scene instead of a minute, fast enough to outrun expressway traffic. They cross a whole city district in moments, run evacuation trips between a disaster site and a shelter several blocks away until everyone on the site is out, and reach any point in the district before anyone there can act. Nobody they carry takes harm from the speed. When the scene ends the engines stall, and the user cannot run them until they rest a full night. Strain: severe.

Needle Throttle.name: Needle Throttle
Needle Throttle.description: The user feathers the engines in short, exact bursts, so top speed no longer means wide turns or long stops. Until the end of their next turn they weave through a crowded room, platform or street at engine speed and kick every chosen enemy in it once, dealing heavy bludgeoning damage or, held back, only knocking them flat, without touching any bystander or hostage between them. The bursts overheat the ports, and the user cannot use the engines until the end of their following turn. Strain: severe.

Endless Renewal.name: Endless Renewal
Endless Renewal.description: For the rest of the scene the user's body repairs every wound the moment it lands: cuts and bullet holes close behind the blow, broken bones set in a breath, burns fade as they form and a severed limb regrows in moments. The user still feels every injury, a single heavy enough blow still knocks them down, and a wound that would kill outright still kills. When the scene ends they collapse and sleep until the next day, and wake starving. Strain: severe.

Unbound Marrow.name: Unbound Marrow
Unbound Marrow.description: The user takes exact control of their own healing. In one action they dislocate or break their own bones to slip any grip, hold, cuffs or binding and set them again as they come free, push out every bullet, blade and shard lodged in them so the wounds close behind, and wake themselves from a knockout by healing the blow. Until the end of the scene, no restraint holds them past their next turn. Each break is felt in full, and afterward the user cannot use the Quirk until they eat a large meal. Strain: severe.

Long Dusk.name: Long Dusk
Long Dusk.description: At night or in a blackout, the user takes hold of every shadow across several city blocks for the rest of the scene. In a single breath they bind every enemy standing in shadow there until each breaks free with a hard effort or a strong light falls on them, and they can step between any two shadows in the area and lower anyone trapped on a ledge or in a dark shaft to the ground on shadow ribbons. Searchlights, fires and headlights cut the area into pieces the user cannot reach, and when the scene ends the user cannot shape shadow until they have rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Standing Nightglass.name: Standing Nightglass
Standing Nightglass.description: The user hardens shadow so deeply that it no longer needs the dark. For the rest of the scene every pin, pane and bind they harden stays solid in noon sun, floodlights and fire: a dark glass bridge across a street, a sealed pane over a burning stairwell, or a cage around a target that holds until heavy blows shatter it. Each shape draws on the user's own shadow, so while any stands the user casts no shadow, cannot step between shadows and feels every blow the shapes take as a jolt through the hands. Strain: severe.

Suspended Ruin.name: Suspended Ruin
Suspended Ruin.description: The user locks the motion of something enormous that is already falling or sliding, a collapsing building, a derailing train or a landslide across a street, and holds it in place for up to ten minutes instead of a heartbeat. Everyone beneath or inside it can be led or carried out while it hangs. The user cannot move, speak or use any other technique while holding it, and when they let go or are struck hard, everything resumes its fall at the speed it had, so the user must call the danger zone out to rescuers. Strain: severe.

Waiting Lock.name: Waiting Lock
Waiting Lock.description: The user touches up to five things during a scene, a door, a car wheel, a villain's wrist or a cracked ledge, and sets a lock in each that waits. The first time each one moves, it locks dead and turns the way the user chose: a fleeing car's wheel locks and the car slides to a stop, a punch from the marked wrist stops short of its target, a falling ledge hangs until the people below clear. While any set lock waits the user cannot lock at a glance, and each lock that fires jolts through the user's hands. Strain: severe.

Rubble Wheel.name: Rubble Wheel
Rubble Wheel.description: The user sweeps their hands across a collapsed building or a wrecked street and sets every loose piece they touch, up to slabs the size of a car, circling them in a ring a city block across for the rest of the scene. Rubble lifts off everyone trapped beneath it, the ring blocks every vehicle and runner trying to cross it, and the user can let any piece fly for heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, it lands in front of the target as a wall. If the user steps from the center, the whole ring flies outward, so they must keep bystanders out of its path. Strain: severe.

Shifted Center.name: Shifted Center
Shifted Center.description: The user touches a person, a vehicle or a pillar and makes it the center of an orbit in place of themselves for the rest of the scene. Around an ally, a ring of debris knocks aside attacks aimed at them; around an enemy, circling cords and scrap wind tighter each turn until the enemy is bound standing, unable to move their arms until cut loose; around a pillar, a ring of rubble walls off a street. Only one borrowed center holds at a time, the user's own orbits drop while it does, and if the center moves faster than a run the ring flies apart. Strain: severe.

Thistledown Crossing.name: Thistledown Crossing
Thistledown Crossing.description: The user turns lighter than they have ever been, a few hundred grams, and for the rest of the scene rides the wind across several city blocks: rising up any building face on its updraft, hanging above a street to watch every alley, and turning heavy at any moment to drop onto a target for heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, they land beside the target and the shock knocks them down. They can carry nothing heavier than a phone, a strong gust can sweep them a block off course, and when the scene ends they cannot change density until they rest. Strain: severe.

Tuned Weight.name: Tuned Weight
Tuned Weight.description: For the rest of the scene the user sets their weight to any amount between a few grams and a loaded truck and changes it smoothly within a heartbeat. They hang at any depth underwater to work on a sunken car, cross a roof about to give way or thin ice at the weight of a cat, match a falling person's weight on a rope over a pulley to lower them gently, and strike at the exact weight that knocks a target down without breaking bones. The focus leaves them unable to use any other technique, and a hard blow snaps them back to their normal weight wherever they are. Strain: severe.

Streetwide Salvo.name: Streetwide Salvo
Streetwide Salvo.description: The user braces against a solid structure and charges for two turns, broadcasting a rising whine and bright muzzle glow, then fires six dense rounds at separate visible targets within a hundred meters. Each deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, broad rounds only knock adults down. Every firing lane must be clear of bystanders. The recoil can break weak bracing, and afterward the burned forearm cannot fire until treated and rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Rescue Recoil Chain.name: Rescue Recoil Chain
Rescue Recoil Chain.description: The user carries one adult with their free arm and releases three precisely metered shots during a single leap, steering through open air up to thirty meters and braking onto a visible landing before the end of their next turn. Each shot needs an empty impact area below or behind them; the user cannot hover, and a missed impulse spoils the landing. Afterward the user's shaking arm cannot fire for the rest of the scene, and they need help carrying the rescued person. Strain: severe.

Twilight Cordon.name: Twilight Cordon
Twilight Cordon.description: The user raises a high halo of white light over a whole building or city block for the rest of the scene, casting hard, aimed shadows across every street and floor below. The halo keeps shadows and smoke off allies and lights safe lanes for rescuers, while rings of cast darkness sweep the ground to bind every enemy in sight or lash them with searing light for heavy light damage; held back, the rings only pin enemies unhurt. Running both natures at this scale burns the user's stamina and drains their shadow flat, leaving spots in their vision until they rest. Strain: severe.

Locked Penumbra.name: Locked Penumbra
Locked Penumbra.description: The user hangs a bead of light over up to five targets in sight for the rest of the scene, casting a sharp shadow beneath each one that follows them even under floodlights or in midair. Once per turn the user can strobe any bead to disorient its target and snap the cast shadow upward for heavy light and piercing damage while pinning them in place; held back, it only dazzles and binds them without injury, or steps the user or an ally between two linked shadows. Each use burns stamina and consumes part of the user's own shadow until none remains. Strain: severe.

Tempest Circuit.name: Tempest Circuit
Tempest Circuit.description: The user runs a circuit around a whole city block for the rest of the scene, and the block becomes their wind. Each turn they can be anywhere on the circuit in an instant, sweep every civilian in the block to the edge inside pockets of still air, or slam one foe for heavy force damage with the full weight of the circling gale, knocking them flat; held back, the gale only pins foes in place. The circuit breaks if the user stops running, and holding both natures at this scale triggers the user's Drawback at once. Strain: severe.

Vortex Lance.name: Vortex Lance
Vortex Lance.description: The user runs a long straight line at full speed and drags the wind behind them into a horizontal tornado that keeps going after they stop, tearing down the line for a full street's length. Every foe in its path takes heavy force damage and is hurled aside, and it rips smoke, gas and loose debris out of the street; held back, it only knocks foes flat and clears the air. It needs a long straight run, and the user cannot change direction once it starts. Strain: severe.

Tremor Web.name: Tremor Web
Tremor Web.description: The user drives both palms into the street, and their sensing and their shake run through the ground across several city blocks for the rest of the scene. They feel every footstep and hollow there and know where each person is running, hiding or trapped. Once per turn they shake the ground under any group of enemies they feel for moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, it only throws them down. The user must keep both palms down and cannot move or defend, and loose facades crack, collateral they must call out to rescuers. Strain: severe.

Kindred Shatter.name: Kindred Shatter
Kindred Shatter.description: The user holds one object, feels the exact pitch at which its material breaks, and sends that pitch through the ground to every object of the same make within a city block at once. Every rifle of that model, every pane of that glass or every blade of that steel shatters together, while other materials and every person stay untouched. The user needs the sample in hand, flying shards can cut anyone beside a shattering window, and afterward both hands are numb until the user rests. Strain: severe.

Every Surface Speaks.name: Every Surface Speaks
Every Surface Speaks.description: The user lays both palms on a building's frame and reads every surface joined to it at once, back a full week. They learn every person who entered, which rooms each one used and when, every hidden room and every place a weapon, a drug stash or a bomb was set down, and can follow any one person's path through the building hour by hour. The reading takes the user out of the present until the end of their next turn, and the crowd of strangers' strongest moments leaves them unable to use the Quirk again until they have rested. Strain: severe.

Distant Handling.name: Distant Handling
Distant Handling.description: The user holds an object for a moment and keeps hold of its residue after it leaves their hand. For the rest of the day, wherever it goes in the city, they feel each new hand that takes it, the face and mood of that person and the surroundings of every spot it is set down, close enough to send heroes there. They can track up to three objects at once, such as marked ransom money, a stolen phone or a planted bag. While tracking, the user cannot read anything else, and a reading that arrives in the middle of a fight leaves them dazed until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Precinct Override.name: Precinct Override
Precinct Override.description: The user lays a hand on a traffic signal box or a rail switch, and every machine joined to the city's network across several city blocks answers them for the rest of the scene. They turn every signal to clear a lane for ambulances, bring every train to a gentle stop at a platform, hold every elevator at a floor, open or seal any electronic door and stall every vehicle a villain is using. Ordinary drivers and passengers are stranded too, so the user must keep naming the machines that have to keep running, and they cannot move or defend themselves while they hold. Strain: severe.

Implant Whisper.name: Implant Whisper
Implant Whisper.description: The user's reach extends to machines inside or worn on a living body: a pacemaker, an insulin pump, a ventilator, a prosthetic limb or a villain's implanted weapon. With a touch they keep a failing pacemaker or ventilator running steady until medics arrive, or lock a villain's prosthetic arm or implanted launcher dead for the rest of the scene. Flesh, organs and Quirks stay out of reach, the device can only do what it was built to do, and a wrong command to a medical device can kill, so heroes touch one only to keep someone alive. Strain: severe.

Block-Wide Mirage.name: Block-Wide Mirage
Block-Wide Mirage.description: From a high point, the user fills several city blocks they can see with hundreds of moving images for the rest of the scene. They can send an image of every hiding hostage running the wrong way, so villains hunting them chase light, set a line of heroes at every exit and lay lit arrows down every street to a shelter. The images still have no weight, sound or touch. The user must stay at that high point and keep the area in sight, and afterward their store is empty until they have slept. Strain: severe.

Standing Imprint.name: Standing Imprint
Standing Imprint.description: The user fixes a projected image to a spot and walks away from it, and it keeps playing on its own for up to a day: a replay of a crime on loop for investigators, a decoy of the user standing guard at a window, lit arrows down a stairwell to the exit or a closed shutter across an alley. They can leave up to three at once anywhere they have stood that day and end any of them from any distance. Each still has no weight, sound, touch or shadow, and while any of them stands the user's eyes store nothing new. Strain: severe.

Citywide Mooring.name: Citywide Mooring
Citywide Mooring.description: For the rest of the day the user's anchors reach across the whole city, about thirty kilometers, and they hold up to ten at once. They feel every anchor's distance and direction without effort, snap to any of them at will, and may send or carry one touched person on each snap, so a hostage across town is reached in a breath and a burned worker stands at a hospital entrance a heartbeat later. Snaps still move one person at a time, never a group, and each arrival leaves the user dizzy. When the day ends every anchor fades and the user cannot snap until they have slept. Strain: severe.

Send Elsewhere.name: Send Elsewhere
Send Elsewhere.description: For the rest of the scene the user can snap objects without going along. When a thrown grenade, a falling girder, a speeding car or any non-living thing up to the size of a car comes within their reach, they touch it and it vanishes to one of their anchors planted in an empty lot or a dry riverbed, arriving at rest. They can do this once each turn, even in the middle of an enemy's action. A bomb sent this way still goes off where it lands, so the user must keep that anchor in an empty place and warn rescuers away from it. Strain: severe.

Glazed Quarter.name: Glazed Quarter
Glazed Quarter.description: For the rest of the scene glass pours from the user by the tonne instead of the bucket. They raise walls of glass as high as a building across every street of a city block, lay a glass bridge between two towers, glaze shut every cracked facade in the block and fuse a shackle to the ground around every enemy within a street's width who stands still. Each piece still breaks at its weak point, and the user can keep only so many points turned from danger at once. When the scene ends the user's knuckles bleed and they cannot grow glass until they have drunk and rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Seamless Weld.name: Seamless Weld
Seamless Weld.description: Through their glass, the user now feels the strain in any material it touches, steel, concrete, cable or stone, and fuses glass seams that make a broken thing whole and strong. For the rest of the scene they can weld a snapped crane cable, seal a cracked dam or rejoin a split bridge span, and a single glass bead pressed onto an enemy's armor, shield or support gear finds its weak point and splits it open, leaving it useless. Each weld holds only while the user keeps it in mind, and holding more than three at once makes the oldest fail. Strain: severe.

Open Gallery.name: Open Gallery
Open Gallery.description: The user runs their fingertips along every wall of a street as they move, and the drawings across a whole city block wake for the rest of the scene. Their constructs no longer fade after minutes, and the user commands up to a dozen at once: a flock of scout birds over the block, ladders up every burning building, nets over fleeing enemies and hounds that bite for heavy piercing damage, or only pin when held back. Water still dissolves every one. When the scene ends the user's fingertips crack and bleed, and they cannot draw until they have rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Midair Strokes.name: Midair Strokes
Midair Strokes.description: For the rest of the scene the user draws on empty air. Each stroke hangs where their fingertip passes and lifts at once into a construct, so with a few flicks they draw a stair up into the sky, a net under a falling crowd or a cage around a target. Constructs drawn this scene do not dissolve in water, but every midair drawing is a quick sketch that breaks under a heavy blow, and the user can still keep only three going at once. When the scene ends their ink is spent until they have slept. Strain: severe.

Hour Unmade.name: Hour Unmade
Hour Unmade.description: The user presses both palms to the street and everything non-living across a whole city block returns to how it stood up to an hour ago. Collapsed buildings rise, shattered windows close, burst mains seal and wrecked cars spring back into shape, while every person trapped in rubble is left lying in open, rebuilt rooms. Enemies in the path of the returning debris take heavy bludgeoning damage, or are only pinned when the user holds back. Whatever was used up stays gone, fires already lit keep burning, and the user cannot undo anything until they have rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Unbroken Moment.name: Unbroken Moment
Unbroken Moment.description: The user touches up to three non-living things and holds each in the moment of the touch: for the rest of the scene, every change made to them is undone the instant it happens. A cracking pillar cannot break, a bomb's trigger cannot move, a cell door cannot open and a gun cannot fire while it stays held. Living bodies still never answer, the user cannot use any other technique of the Quirk while holding, and when the hold ends they cannot use the Quirk until they have rested for an hour. Strain: severe.

Watchtower Minute.name: Watchtower Minute
Watchtower Minute.description: For the rest of the scene the user sees about a minute ahead across everything visible from where they stand, from a rooftop several city blocks, and the vision renews itself each turn without effort. They know every collapse, shot, crash and escape route in that area before it happens and can direct a whole team or an evacuating crowd around each danger by radio. When the scene ends the user's sight goes grey and blurred until they have slept, and they cannot use the Quirk until then. Strain: severe.

Chosen Second.name: Chosen Second
Chosen Second.description: For the rest of the scene the user sees every branch of the next few seconds at once. Once each turn, when an attack, a fall or an accident is about to strike anyone in the user's sight, the user takes one quick action from among the branches they saw, a shove, a thrown chair, a word, and that harm misses its target entirely. The user must be able to act on the branch this turn; a danger no action of theirs could change still lands. Afterward the user is unable to stand without help until the end of the scene. Strain: severe.

Glance Prognosis.name: Glance Prognosis
Glance Prognosis.description: For the rest of the scene the user no longer needs touch: meeting a person's eyes is enough, and with one sweep of the eyes across a room or a crowded platform they read everyone who looks back, seeing about an hour of each of their coming lives. A whole hostage room, a squad of villains or a panicking crowd is read in a breath, and the user knows who will run, who will fight and who will be hurt. When the scene ends the user cannot use the Quirk until they have slept. Strain: severe.

Shared Prognosis.name: Shared Prognosis
Shared Prognosis.description: For the rest of the scene the user can pass a reading on. After reading a person, the user grips an ally's hand and the ally sees the same coming stretch, every scene exactly as the user saw it, and acts on it as their own knowledge. Up to four allies can share each reading. Each ally who shares one suffers a splitting headache and cannot use their own Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Open Street Chorus.name: Open Street Chorus
Open Street Chorus.description: The user carries a continuous live performance across fifty meters for three turns. Up to sixty willing listeners move toward exits without tangling, while up to ten hearing opponents have their next step pulled sideways each turn. Everyone keeps their choices. Soundproof barriers still block the pressure, and the user cannot perform again until an hour of rest after the chorus ends. Strain: severe.

Perfect Reprise.name: Perfect Reprise
Perfect Reprise.description: The user spends three attention charges and calls "Encore" to physically repeat the last ordinary Encore technique they completed this scene, at its original range and strength, despite its cooldown. The user pays twice its normal exertion and performs every motion again; targets can react afresh. The user cannot repeat an Ultimate, awakened ability or reprise, and cannot use the Quirk for the rest of the scene afterward. Strain: severe.

Shelter Gel Network.name: Shelter Gel Network
Shelter Gel Network.description: The user feeds connected gel channels across thirty meters for three turns, forming six padded cradles that carry injured adults at walking pace and sealing up to four doors against pursuit. Faces and exits for rescuers stay clear. Cutting a channel stops its cradle or door seal, vehicle impacts tear the gel, and the user cannot produce more gel until an hour of rest afterward. Strain: severe.

Measured Living Dressing.name: Measured Living Dressing
Measured Living Dressing.description: The user maintains a medicinal gel coat on one adult within ten meters for the rest of the scene. The user senses pressure and warmth through the connected gel, adjusting its grip to seal accessible bleeding and support a damaged limb during movement. The coat speeds repair over hours, never regrows limbs or replaces blood, and cannot reach hidden internal wounds. The user must remain conscious and cannot produce other gel while treating the patient. Strain: severe.

Solstice Front.name: Solstice Front
Solstice Front.description: The user releases pale-blue fire and deep frost together across a whole city block, filling the streets with thick fog and putting barriers and cover through thermal shock for the rest of the scene. Enemies inside take heavy fire and cold damage as their weapons and armor crack, while allies move unseen through the mist; held back, the surge cracks only gear and locks foes to the ankles in steaming ice while sparing bystanders. Driving both natures across a block swings the user's core into fever and chills, triggering their Drawback at once. Strain: severe.

Extreme Stillpoint.name: Extreme Stillpoint
Extreme Stillpoint.description: The user places a temperature lock on up to a dozen objects, walls or patches of ground across a street for the rest of the scene, holding each at steady heat or deep freeze regardless of surrounding fire or weather. They can keep a sagging floor frozen solid, hold rescue lanes warm, or flip any locked spot between heat and frost to crack stone, steel doors or enemy armor for heavy fire and cold damage; held back, the flip breaks only locks and weapons. Keeping the locks active drains the user's body heat, slowing them to a walk. Strain: severe.

Squall Canopy.name: Squall Canopy
Squall Canopy.description: The user swells their personal storm cloud across a whole city block for the rest of the scene, filling the street with rain, static cover and guided wind channels. Each turn they can drop a charged downdraft on foes in the block for heavy force and electric damage that pins and numbs them until the end of their next turn, or lift allies a story high on static updrafts; held back, the downdrafts only hold foes flat. Sustaining both natures across a block scrambles every radio and camera inside and triggers the user's Drawback at once. Strain: severe.

Slipstream Conduit.name: Slipstream Conduit
Slipstream Conduit.description: The user threads dozens of thin wind channels through a building or street for the rest of the scene, turning the air into insulated wiring. They can steer lightning paths around corners and past hostages to hit chosen foes for heavy electric and force damage, catch any live current in the area and ground it safely, or pipe fresh air to trapped people; held back, the arcs only numb and disarm. The user must stand still to hold the channels, and moving snaps the charge back to stun them until their next turn. Strain: severe.

Mantle Basin.name: Mantle Basin
Mantle Basin.description: The user drives both palms into the pavement and spreads fused heat and shaping across a whole city block for the rest of the scene. They soften streets into knee-deep hot mud traps that halt vehicles and runners, fuse fallen rubble into glassy shelter arches over trapped people, and deal heavy fire and bludgeoning damage to enemies on the stone; held back, the mud cools around their legs and only pins them. The user must cool each stretch before civilians step on it, and the absorbed heat triggers their Drawback at once. Strain: severe.

Obsidian Weld.name: Obsidian Weld
Obsidian Weld.description: The user melts and quenches stone in a single heartbeat, turning broken concrete, brick and bedrock along a street into seamless volcanic glass. In one turn they seal a collapsing tunnel, draw all lingering heat out of a burning building's masonry so rescuers can enter, and cast poured-stone cuffs onto every enemy on the street for heavy fire damage; held back, the cuffs quench cool in mid-flow and lock them harmlessly in place. Pulling that heat through their hands leaves the user unable to use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Geyser Canopy.name: Geyser Canopy
Geyser Canopy.description: The user vents all their stored water and heat skyward at once, blanketing a whole city block in a roiling bank of pressurized steam for the rest of the scene. Within the block the user senses every person by how the vapor parts around them, smothers every open fire, and can drive a steam-piston downdraft onto any enemy for heavy force and fire damage; held back, the bank stays a warm mist that only blinds enemies and cushions falls. When it ends, the user is parched and cannot use the Quirk for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Closed-Loop Valve.name: Closed-Loop Valve
Closed-Loop Valve.description: For the rest of the scene the user recycles their vented steam, drawing the moisture and heat back through their skin before it dissipates so even dry air or a freezing room cannot weaken the Quirk. Each turn they can fire a pinpoint pressure valve jet across a street that lifts a bus-sized slab of rubble, bursts a vault door, or deals heavy force and fire damage to one target; held back, it cools in flight and only pins them to a wall. Keeping the hot loop sealed builds core heat, so if the user takes a heavy hit the loop breaks and triggers their Drawback at once. Strain: severe.

Glacial Bastion Ward.name: Glacial Bastion Ward
Glacial Bastion Ward.description: The user drives both frost-plated hands into the pavement and grows ribs of stone-hardened ice across every sagging wall, doorway and shelter line in a city block for the rest of the scene. Collapsing roofs lock still on the petrified ice, allies behind the plates take no harm from gunfire or blasts, and enemies who charge a rib take heavy bludgeoning and cold damage; held back, the ribs only shove them back. Open fire melts the nearest rib, and running both natures across a block roots the user in place until the scene ends. Strain: severe.

Shared Carapace Forge.name: Shared Carapace Forge
Shared Carapace Forge.description: The user lays hands on up to four allies within reach and grows fitted, jointed suits of stone-hardened ice over their clothes for the rest of the scene. Each armored ally shrugs off blades, clubs, pistol rounds and falling debris, and their unarmed blows deal heavy bludgeoning and cold damage; held back, their strikes only knock targets down. Fire or intense heat melts a suit away, and pouring out both natures at once leaves the user shivering at half walking speed and unable to plate their own skin for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Convalescent Canopy.name: Convalescent Canopy
Convalescent Canopy.description: The user drives roots into the street and raises a canopy of flowering vines, moss beds and fruiting boughs across a whole city block for the rest of the scene. Calming pollen drifts through the block to numb pain, vine stretchers draw every injured person onto moss dressings that stop bleeding and mend wounds slowly, and enemies who force entry are struck by boughs for heavy bludgeoning damage and bound; held back, the vines only hold them still. The canopy wilts without light and water, and feeding it drains the user to collapse when the scene ends. Strain: severe.

Grafted Lifebloom.name: Grafted Lifebloom
Grafted Lifebloom.description: The user plants a living seed in a moss dressing over a patient's severed limb, crushed organ or mortal chest wound and feeds it with water and their own stamina. Fine rootlets thread the injury, keep the patient alive while heart or lungs fail, and slowly knit tissue, nerves and bone back together over the rest of the scene, leaving a faint green scar when the blossom withers. It cannot revive the dead, the user must keep both hands on the dressing the whole time, and afterward the user falls unconscious from exhaustion. Strain: severe.

Induction Corridor.name: Induction Corridor
Induction Corridor.description: The user links every lamppost, rail, pipe, car and wire along a city block into one electromagnetic corridor for the rest of the scene. On command it accelerates bearings into volleys or slams metal-armored enemies into walls for heavy force and electric damage, pinning them until they wrench free with a hard effort; held back, it only knocks targets down and disarms steel weapons. Running both natures across a block fries every phone, camera and battery there and slows the user to a walk while it lasts. Strain: severe.

Faraday Cagework.name: Faraday Cagework
Faraday Cagework.description: The user weaves standing coils of current and magnetic force between steel girders, cars or pipes around a crowd or over a live bomb for the rest of the scene. Metal projectiles, shrapnel and electric attacks hitting the cage stop dead, every radio trigger and detonator inside dies without firing, and any enemy who forces through takes heavy electric damage and is thrown back; held back, the cage only shoves them clear. Holding both natures in tight balance roots the user to the spot and empties their charge when the cage drops. Strain: severe.

Ricochet Cyclone.name: Ricochet Cyclone
Ricochet Cyclone.description: The user turns feather-light and ricochets from wall to wall and roof to roof across a whole city block in a blur, stretching arms out to scoop bystanders clear of danger or snapping heavy at the moment of each strike. Every enemy in the open across the block takes heavy bludgeoning damage and is knocked off their feet; held back, each glancing pass only disarms and topples them without lasting injury. Dozens of weight reversals in seconds leave the user retching and unable to stand or use the Quirk until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.

Counterweight Web.name: Counterweight Web
Counterweight Web.description: The user stretches their arms and fingers into a lattice across a street or courtyard and shifts weight through the strands on the fly for the rest of the scene. Every punch, thrown object or charging villain that strikes the lattice is robbed of weight and rebounded straight back at its source for heavy force damage; held back, the strands wrap and pin the attacker in a heavy fold without harm. Blades and fire still wound the user's stretched flesh, and the user cannot leave the spot until they pull their limbs back in. Strain: severe.

Slipstream Skyway.name: Slipstream Skyway
Slipstream Skyway.description: The user sheds flight feathers into a wind ring that spans a whole city block from street to rooftops for the rest of the scene. Inside it, the user hovers without flapping to pluck people from windows, and feather-guided updrafts catch every falling person and float trapped groups to safety; enemies in the currents take heavy force damage and are thrown back, or are only pinned in place when held back. Strong crosswinds at the perimeter fray the ring, and when it ends the lost feathers and exhausted back ground the user for an hour. Strain: severe.

Whispering Pinion.name: Whispering Pinion
Whispering Pinion.description: The user stills the air around every feather on their wings, erasing all sound and wind trail from their flight for the rest of the scene while keeping a thin shell of compressed air along each wing edge. They fly unseen and unheard through smoke or darkness, slip between falling slabs by feeling air pressure on each quill, and strike one target per turn for heavy slashing and force damage that cuts steel cable; held back, the wing flat only stuns and disarms. Holding silent pressure prevents the user from speaking or sending gusts at range. Strain: severe.

Echoing Quarter.name: Echoing Quarter
Echoing Quarter.description: The user sends a deep, vibrating vocal chord rolling through the air and walls across a whole city block for the rest of the scene. The returning echoes map every room, basement and smoke-filled floor through solid walls, locating every person inside, while the user can focus the hum on any window, lock or bolted barricade in the block to shatter the glass or shake its bolts loose from afar; directed at enemies, it deals heavy sonic damage or, held back, only stuns them to a knee. When it ends, the user's hearing drops to a muffled ring for an hour. Strain: severe.

Null Resonance.name: Null Resonance
Null Resonance.description: The user hums a multi-layered counter-tone that wraps themselves and allies within half a street in a moving pocket of governed vibration for the rest of the scene. Inside it, sonic attacks, shockwaves and vibration Quirks cancel out harmlessly, collapsing rubble loses its shake before it can fall on survivors, and once per turn the user can flip the pitch on one target in sight to drop them to their knees with nausea and heavy sonic damage, or only stun them when held back. Keeping the weave leaves the user's throat raw and unable to speak above a whisper afterward. Strain: severe.

Calamity Stride.name: Calamity Stride
Calamity Stride.description: The user steps onto a burning, flooded or collapsed street, breathes its air once, and adapts by the end of their next turn to every environmental hazard across a whole city block for the rest of the scene: fire, cold, water, toxic gas, smoke, live wires and falling debris. They cross the block unharmed, shield and haul groups of trapped people out, and drive foes back for heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, they only shove them clear. Fresh enemy attacks still land first, and afterward the user cannot adapt again until they rest an hour. Strain: severe.

Wary Flesh.name: Wary Flesh
Wary Flesh.description: For the next three turns, the user's nerves sense the air push of a swing, radiant heat, ozone or trace gas a split second before contact, growing the counter-adaptation on the struck spot before the first hit lands. Blows, shots, fire, cold, electric shocks and gas they see or hear coming are halved even on first contact, and close counters deal heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, they only disarm or floor a foe. Unseen attacks still land in full, and afterward their Drawback strikes at once and blocks new shifts for a turn. Strain: severe.

Gloaming Quarter.name: Gloaming Quarter
Gloaming Quarter.description: The user releases hundreds of small smoked-glass shards across a whole city block for the rest of the scene, each casting a pool of real shade even under floodlights. On any turn the user can step between any two shards' shade on the block, pull a bystander through to safety, or shatter a planted shard so its fragments deal heavy piercing damage and pin the shadows of enemies within a few strides; held back, blunt fragments pin their shadows uncut.
