Sustaining the swarm parches the user and drains their shadow until they rest. Strain: severe.

Faceted Umbra Weave.name: Faceted Umbra Weave
Faceted Umbra Weave.description: The user fuses their shadow into smoked-glass plates over their body and a ring of planted shards across a street for the rest of the scene. While the armor holds, their blurred outline makes attacks beyond arm's reach miss, allies stepping into a shard's shade emerge under any shard the user picks, and an enemy whose shadow meets a shard takes heavy slashing damage and is locked in place, or only pinned if held back. The user grows parched, casts no shadow and cannot use the Quirk until the end of their next turn if a plate breaks. Strain: severe.

Intersection Cold Surge.name: Intersection Cold Surge
Intersection Cold Surge.description: The user circulates right-side cold and left-side heat through their chest, then releases cold flames and a spreading mass of ice across an intersection up to sixty meters wide. It extinguishes exposed fires and deals massive cold damage; held back, it freezes empty ground and equipment while sparing bodies. The ice remains until broken or melted. Allies need cleared shelter, and the user cannot emit either half until their following turn ends. Strain: severe.

Circulating Cold Mantle.name: Circulating Cold Mantle
Circulating Cold Mantle.description: The user maintains the circulation of both halves through their chest for three turns, carrying cooling flames around their body while closing through intense heat. Each turn the user can press a cooled hand against one opponent within reach to freeze clothing and restrain a limb until the ice breaks or melts. Held back, contact avoids bare skin. The cooling can be overwhelmed, needs uninterrupted concentration and leaves the user unable to continue it for the scene. Strain: severe.

Crowd Contact Lift.name: Crowd Contact Lift
Crowd Contact Lift.description: The user touches one person with all five fingertip pads and spreads weightlessness through people touching that target, continuing through a connected crowd across a city block. Dozens float for up to three turns, beyond the ordinary three-tonne limit, and attacks needing ground traction lose their footing. Disconnected people are unaffected; allies in the chain also float. The user cannot steer the crowd and is unable to activate the Quirk again for the scene. Strain: severe.

Gentle Crowd Return.name: Gentle Crowd Return
Gentle Crowd Return.description: The user eases an already floating crowd and its loose equipment back toward the ground across a city block over two turns, restoring gravity gradually without pressing the fingertip pads together. The controlled return avoids an abrupt mass drop and lets rescuers receive injured people. The user cannot move targets sideways or stop incoming attacks and must stay conscious throughout; afterward they need help standing and cannot activate the Quirk for the scene. Strain: severe.

Ten Minute Dispatch.name: Ten Minute Dispatch
Ten Minute Dispatch.description: The user maintains overdrive through strengthened, previously regrown exhausts for up to ten minutes, covering several city districts while making controlled stops to collect or deliver one passenger at a time. Each stop needs room to brake and each passenger needs a secure hold; the user gains no protection from collisions. Fuel must be sufficient before starting, and the engines stall afterward until the user rests, refuels and cools them for at least ten minutes. Strain: severe.

Cold Exhaust Courier.name: Cold Exhaust Courier
Cold Exhaust Courier.description: The user receives external cooling across both exhaust assemblies, secures one passenger and drives at maximum output along several kilometers of open roadway in under a minute. Carefully timed throttle changes keep the passenger held through planned bends and the final braking run. Cooling must be supplied by an ally or equipment; this Quirk produces none. Obstacles force an abort, and afterward the engines stall for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Floodwall Rescue Circuit.name: Floodwall Rescue Circuit
Floodwall Rescue Circuit.description: The user combines wall adhesion, swimming and loaded leaps for up to ten minutes across a flooded three-story building, retrieving one adult at a time with their twenty-meter tongue and delivering each to a reachable dry landing. Repeated trips let the user evacuate a whole small group without increasing tongue length or carrying capacity. Cold water can still trigger hibernation, and afterward the user's legs and tongue cramp until they rest for at least ten minutes. Strain: severe.

Hidden Tongue Escort.name: Hidden Tongue Escort
Hidden Tongue Escort.description: The user keeps their skin and extended tongue camouflaged against changing surroundings while moving along a wall for three turns. Each turn the user can secure one person within twenty meters, draw them behind cover and loosen the tongue without dropping them, or hold one opponent's arms with the same careful coil. The carried person remains visible; sound, touch and damaged surfaces reveal the approach. Afterward tongue cramps prevent further tongue techniques for the scene. Strain: severe.

Wide Night Guard.name: Wide Night Guard
Wide Night Guard.description: In deep darkness, the user directs the enlarged creature through an open street or hall for the rest of the scene. It stays connected to the user while catching falling people, blocking heavy debris and restraining several opponents within its extended reach. Each turn the user must actively command it; a lapse lets it strike whoever is nearest. Bright light drives it back to the user's side. Strain: severe.

Deep Dark Carry.name: Deep Dark Carry
Deep Dark Carry.description: The user has the creature lift them and several people above a collapsing street for the rest of the scene, using its enlarged body to shield the passengers from falling debris. It can set each person down within its connected reach and strike an attacker for heavy bludgeoning damage, held back to a shove. The user must keep giving orders, and a strong floodlight or a heavy blow can force everyone to land. Strain: severe.

Building Pulse Survey.name: Building Pulse Survey
Building Pulse Survey.description: The user plants both jacks into a building's connected structure and tracks vibrations across its floors for the rest of the scene. They can report the position of moving people, active machinery and fresh collapses to a rescue team each turn. The reading cannot find a silent person on an isolated surface, and one major impact can overwhelm the user's hearing and interrupt the survey. Strain: severe.

Twin Pulse Barrage.name: Twin Pulse Barrage
Twin Pulse Barrage.description: With two working amplifiers, the user sends repeated heartbeat pulses along a connected street or hall for the rest of the scene. Each pulse knocks advancing opponents back and deals heavy sonic damage; held back, it breaks their footing without striking their bodies directly. The pulses travel through the chosen surface and can endanger allies standing on it. The user's ears bleed, and the technique ends if either jack or amplifier is damaged. Strain: severe.

Street Marker Circuit.name: Street Marker Circuit
Street Marker Circuit.description: The user works through a prepared network of compatible targeting markers for the rest of the scene, choosing one marked position each turn for a disabling discharge. A target beside that marker takes heavy electric damage; held back, the shock immobilizes them until the end of their next turn. The markers can be removed, and conductive ground may carry current beyond the chosen target. Sustaining the circuit steadily clouds the user's thinking. Strain: severe.

Last Charge Stand.name: Last Charge Stand
Last Charge Stand.description: The user releases repeated broad electrical bursts from their body for the rest of the scene, stopping an advancing group across an open street. Each burst deals heavy electric damage and stuns uninsulated targets; held back, it stops after they fall. Allies must stay clear, and water or metal can spread the current beyond the intended space. When the release ends, the user's brain short-circuits and they cannot act coherently until they recover. Strain: severe.

Streetwide Tape Catch.name: Streetwide Tape Catch
Streetwide Tape Catch.description: The user rapidly layers strips between firm buildings or poles across a street for the rest of the scene. The web catches several falling people or stops a charging group, holding each until rescuers free them; held back, the tape cushions rather than crushes. Heavy vehicles can tear through it, every span needs sound anchors, and sustained output leaves the user's elbow skin cracked and painful. Strain: severe.

Continuous Anchor Run.name: Continuous Anchor Run
Continuous Anchor Run.description: The user fires and reels alternating tape lines across a district's connected roofs and walls for the rest of the scene, carrying one person at a time to safety or wrapping opponents along the route. A wrapped opponent remains restrained until they cut or tear free. The user must see and reach each new anchor, and a failed attachment can cause a fall. Prolonged output dries the dispensers and ends the run. Strain: severe.

Blockwide Beacon.name: Blockwide Beacon
Blockwide Beacon.description: The user fires a sustained navel laser across a city block, cutting a clear route through several barriers in one straight line. It deals massive light damage to anything left in that line; held back, the user aims above people to break empty upper sections for an evacuation route. The user must confirm the entire path is clear of civilians, and afterward stomach pain prevents further firing for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Threaded Passage.name: Threaded Passage
Threaded Passage.description: The user controls the beam in a succession of short, exact cuts while turning their body, opening locks, restraints and debris around several visible people inside one building. Each cut follows a straight line from the navel, and each person is freed without a direct hit. The user must see every intended surface; one obscured cut is skipped. When the work ends, cramps prevent another laser use until the end of the scene. Strain: severe.

District Scatter.name: District Scatter
District Scatter.description: The user scatters balls across several connected streets from a high position, turning entrances, vehicle paths and escape lanes into sticky obstacles for the rest of the scene. People caught by a ball must free themselves or wait for its hold to fade. The user leaves a clearly marked evacuation lane, but cannot make the balls spare an unmarked civilian; the mass plucking draws blood and ends further ball use. Strain: severe.

Rebound Corridor.name: Rebound Corridor
Rebound Corridor.description: The user places a precise chain of balls across a damaged building, then rebounds through turns, vertical shafts and broken rooms to retrieve several stranded people one at a time. The user chooses each landing so a passenger never touches a sticky ball. The route lasts for the rest of the scene, but a missing or covered ball breaks that section, and the user's scalp needs rest afterward. Strain: severe.

Building Bearer.name: Building Bearer
Building Bearer.description: After consuming a large prepared sugar supply, the user supports a failing section of a building for the rest of the scene, keeping a floor and its escape route open while many people leave. They must remain planted at one load-bearing point and cannot protect another area at the same time. Their thinking grows severely dull during the effort, and the structure needs permanent support before they release it. Strain: severe.

Measured Power.name: Measured Power
Measured Power.description: The user divides a prepared sugar supply into successive short strength surges, adjusting their grip between them to move heavy debris around several trapped people without crushing the spaces they occupy. Each surge still dulls the user's thinking, so an ally must give simple directions and check each placement. When the supply is spent, the user loses the boost and must rest before another activation. Strain: severe.

Building Survey.name: Building Survey
Building Survey.description: The user grows and extends a dense spread of additional arm branches through the open passages of a building, forming eyes and ears at their ends. For the rest of the scene they can report visible hazards and audible survivors across several floors to an evacuation team. The branches cannot cross sealed walls, and the flood of separate sights and sounds prevents the user from following a detailed conversation. Strain: severe.

Shelter of Hands.name: Shelter of Hands
Shelter of Hands.description: The user branches their extra arms into many shorter gripping limbs around a group within one room, holding people steady and catching loose debris while guiding them toward an exit. The protection lasts until the end of the user's next turn and stops impacts the limbs can physically reach. Each caught blow hurts the user, and they must remain anchored in the room; afterward the injured arms need rest. Strain: severe.

Unbroken Tail Circuit.name: Unbroken Tail Circuit
Unbroken Tail Circuit.description: The user sustains coordinated tail braces, close blocks and footwork for five minutes while escorting people through a damaged building. Each turn they can steady one person within two meters against a stumble while keeping their own footing. The tail remains its normal length and cannot stop heavy rubble; afterward its base cramps and cannot bear weight until the user rests. Strain: severe.

Tail Counter Capture.name: Tail Counter Capture
Tail Counter Capture.description: The user combines a hand parry, a tail hook and a hip turn against one visible attacker within two meters, redirecting the attack into a controlled ground hold without a crushing strike. The tail holds the opponent until they overpower it or the user releases them. The sequence requires firm footing and a readable close attack; afterward the tail trembles and cannot strike until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: severe.

Sustained Steel Service.name: Sustained Steel Service
Sustained Steel Service.description: The user sustains the steel transformation for five minutes of rescue work across one building, carrying one adult at a time and shielding them with the user's body from small debris. Repeated heavy impacts can still exhaust the form early, and gas remains dangerous. The work spends the user's available iron reserves; afterward they cannot transform again until they have rested and eaten. Strain: severe.

Heated Steel Counter.name: Heated Steel Counter
Heated Steel Counter.description: The user lets an existing heat source heat their steel body until it glows, then times a punch within arm's reach to deal heavy bludgeoning and fire damage. Held back, the user strikes a weapon or shield and stops before touching skin. The user creates no heat, cannot spare allies from hot contact and must leave the heat this turn; afterward they need cooling and rest before transforming again. Strain: severe.

Sustained Hand Evacuation.name: Sustained Hand Evacuation
Sustained Hand Evacuation.description: The user keeps both hands enlarged for five minutes while evacuating a building, carrying up to two cooperative adults at a time in supported palms through clear passages. Each trip still requires walking and room for the hands; no one gains protection from gas or heavy collapse. Repeated loads exhaust the shoulders, and afterward the user cannot enlarge their hands again until they rest. Strain: severe.

Graduated Palm Catch.name: Graduated Palm Catch
Graduated Palm Catch.description: The user catches one adult falling from a window up to one story above, enlarging both hands beneath them and lowering their arms while bending the knees to slow the fall. The user adjusts hand size and finger placement to support the head and torso without crushing. The catch requires firm footing and a visible fall; greater height can injure both, and afterward the hands cannot bear another passenger until rest. Strain: severe.

Building Vine Enclosure.name: Building Vine Enclosure
Building Vine Enclosure.description: The user spreads healthy vine hair around the open corridors and exterior of one small building within fifty meters for three turns, screening exits and loosely binding up to eight visible opponents. One marked exit remains open for evacuation, and faces and airways stay clear. Solid walls block the spread unless a gap exists; fire or cutting can open routes, and afterward the spent growth needs water and sunlight to recover. Strain: severe.

Interwoven Rescue Lanes.name: Interwoven Rescue Lanes
Interwoven Rescue Lanes.description: The user divides their vines between three supported rescue slings within twenty meters, independently lowering one adult in each by up to five meters over two turns while keeping a clear path for rescuers. Clothing or blankets must cover skin against thorns. Every sling needs an intact anchored bundle, and the user stays braced and cannot attack; a severed support drops its load, and afterward neck strain prevents further lifting until rest. Strain: severe.

Wide Area Watch.name: Wide Area Watch
Wide Area Watch.description: The user maintains the full spread of up to fifty pieces across several neighboring streets for the rest of the scene. Detached eyes and ears relay where people are trapped or fleeing, while hands open accessible doors and guide evacuees. Each piece still has to travel through an actual opening, and several destroyed or trapped pieces leave the user too drained to regenerate them all during the scene. Strain: severe.

Last Piece Return.name: Last Piece Return
Last Piece Return.description: The user scatters nearly the whole body before a crushing impact, steering the pieces clear and rejoining at a safe point within the same street by the end of the user's next turn. They may bring a small carried item held by a detached hand. The pieces must have a physical route to that point; broad flames, sealed spaces or captured pieces can still harm them, and replacing losses leaves the user exhausted. Strain: severe.

Long Passage Run.name: Long Passage Run
Long Passage Run.description: The user strings together memorized wall and floor passages across several connected rooms for the rest of the scene, using rebounds to emerge wherever their planned route reaches open space. They can scout exits and approach a trapped person despite barriers. Each phase still cuts off sight, sound and breath; a newly sealed passage or lost route can eject them into danger, and no passenger can phase with them. Strain: severe.

Return Point Strike.name: Return Point Strike
Return Point Strike.description: The user repeatedly phases around one nearby opponent and becomes solid for a single controlled strike each turn for the rest of the scene. Each landed blow deals moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, it drives the opponent back without a grave injury. The user must breathe and take bearings between phases, and each solid fist or foot remains exposed to a prepared counter. Strain: severe.

Sustained Meal Form.name: Sustained Meal Form
Sustained Meal Form.description: After preparing and eating several suitable foods, the user maintains multiple manifested traits across the whole body for the rest of the scene. Tentacles can hold two nearby people clear of danger while shell protects the user and wings assist a descent. Every trait must come from food actually eaten, and the forms weaken as that food is digested; maintaining them leaves the user exhausted. Strain: severe.

Rapid Trait Exchange.name: Rapid Trait Exchange
Rapid Trait Exchange.description: For the rest of the scene, the user rapidly moves traits from recently eaten foods between body parts, replacing a broken shell guard, extending tentacles to catch a falling person or forming wings for a short glide. Only traits from food still being digested are available. Each new feature remains vulnerable to injury, and the repeated changes consume the user's stamina and food supply. Strain: severe.

Whole Street Spiral.name: Whole Street Spiral
Whole Street Spiral.description: The user releases a broad, controlled spiral down a clear street, pushing rubble aside and driving opponents away from an evacuation path for the rest of the user's next turn. Those directly struck take heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, the wave only forces them back. It cannot turn around buildings, and anyone left in its path can be hit, so the user must clear the route before release. The effort sharply drains their stamina. Strain: severe.

Endless Wave Current.name: Endless Wave Current
Endless Wave Current.description: For the rest of the scene, the user maintains a continuous spiral stream beneath their feet for flight while directing smaller waves from their hands to slow falls or keep opponents away from civilians. Every output still spends stamina, and the waves remain visible and slow enough to evade. When the stream ends, the user must land at once and is too exhausted to produce another large wave during the scene. Strain: severe.

Streetwide Feather Evacuation.name: Streetwide Feather Evacuation
Streetwide Feather Evacuation.description: The user sends their full feather stock along a visible hundred-meter street and carries up to eight ordinary adults at once to clear ground by the end of the user's next turn. Smaller bundles retrieve dropped children or phones instead of adding adult loads. The user remains grounded, needs unobstructed routes and cannot perform other feather tasks until the bundles return; burning or trapped feathers reduce the number rescued. Strain: severe.

Quill Signal Coordination.name: Quill Signal Coordination
Quill Signal Coordination.description: The user stations small feathers throughout one building within a hundred meters and reads footfalls and voices while larger feathers carry two survivors along already checked routes for three turns. The user distinguishes urgent calls from movement without gaining remote sight or seeing through rubble. Dense noise masks speech, all deployed feathers reduce flight, and managing both tasks leaves the user unable to fight until the operation ends. Strain: severe.

Avenue Flame Discharge.name: Avenue Flame Discharge
Avenue Flame Discharge.description: The user braces and drives a broad, concentrated flame discharge fifty meters along a clear street, dealing massive fire damage to exposed targets until the end of this turn. Held back, the user directs a shorter discharge across empty pavement ahead of opponents, leaving them a retreat. The user must clear civilians and fuel from the line first; dangerous overheating prevents further flame generation for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.

Threaded Thrust Extraction.name: Threaded Thrust Extraction
Threaded Thrust Extraction.description: The user holds one adult clear of their exhaust, uses foot flames to hover beside a window and divides hand flames into fine streams that sever up to three exposed metal restraints within reach. The user withdraws with the passenger to clear ground within thirty meters by the end of the user's next turn. Contact with a stream still burns, hidden restraints cannot be targeted, and overheating prevents more flames until the user rests and cools. Strain: severe.

Repeated Street Retrieval.name: Repeated Street Retrieval
Repeated Street Retrieval.description: The user chains tightly timed bursts and breathing stops along a hundred-meter street, retrieving up to four cooperative adults one at a time over three turns. Each passenger travels against the user's torso to the same clear refuge, with checked landings instead of high-speed collisions. The user needs breathable air and a clear return lane for every trip; a blocked lane ends the sequence, and afterward the user cannot propel until they catch their breath. Strain: severe.

Close Quarters Redirection.name: Close Quarters Redirection
Close Quarters Redirection.description: The user alternates precisely angled sole bursts with brief wall contacts inside a room fifteen meters across until the end of the user's next turn. The user changes direction around two allies, intercepts one approaching attacker and deals heavy bludgeoning damage with a checked kick; held back, it becomes a trip. The route requires visible clear surfaces and offers no protection from unseen attacks, and the user exhausts their stored air afterward. Strain: severe.

Building Concrete Partition.name: Building Concrete Partition
Building Concrete Partition.description: The user keeps both hands on a substantial concrete structure and reshapes connected floors and walls across sixty meters for three turns. The user raises twelve partitions up to twenty meters high, dividing a visible crowd into accessible courtyards with open exits for civilians. The operation redistributes existing material rather than creating it; reinforcement and structural loads restrict placement, and afterward the user cannot shape until rested. Strain: severe.

Braced Passage Exchange.name: Braced Passage Exchange
Braced Passage Exchange.description: The user keeps a hand on a damaged concrete building and alternates precise reshaping between support columns and an adjacent evacuation passage within thirty meters for three turns. The user transfers weight onto new braces before moving the next slab, opening a route to survivors whose positions rescuers already confirm. The user cannot sense hidden people, move reinforcement or exceed available material, and a mistaken load estimate can still cause collapse. Strain: severe.
